reviews.author: M F
reviews.title: They are better resorts in Cancun
reviews.text:
We recently stayed at this resort with a group of nearly 20 family members to celebrate my father’s 85th birthday and our engagement. Family traveled from both Canada and the UK for this special occasion, and we booked six rooms well in advance. Unfortunately, the experience fell far short of expectations.

The check-in process was extremely long and disorganized. Despite being in contact with the resort multiple times before arrival regarding our group booking, there was still confusion with room assignments. Most of our family received their rooms, but I was initially assigned a room that was already occupied, which was particularly concerning as my key still worked for that room. While the issue was eventually resolved, it was not a great start to our vacation.

Room-related issues were widespread throughout our group. My parents experienced a significant leak that soaked their clothes and suitcases. As compensation, they were offered one complimentary night for a future stay at the same resort, which was of little value given our experience. Our cousin’s room had both a leak and a cockroach, another family’s air conditioning was not working properly, and another room’s fridge was not cooling. Our own room was clean, but the minibar was barely stocked and inconsistently replenished throughout our stay. Considering we booked six rooms, it was disappointing how many guests experienced maintenance issues.

We had informed the resort multiple times both before and during our stay that we were celebrating an engagement and an 85th birthday, yet there was no acknowledgment whatsoever—not even a small cake, dessert, card, or room decoration.

This contrast is especially striking because we have stayed at other resorts in Cancun and know the level of service that is possible. During a previous stay at the Royalton CHIC Cancun, I celebrated a milestone birthday, and the staff went above and beyond throughout my entire stay. They made the day feel special with thoughtful touches such as wine, chocolates, and personalized room amenities, which made me feel genuinely valued as a guest.

Dining was another challenge. With a group of nearly 20 people, securing reservations was almost impossible. The only way we were able to dine together was by paying an additional $15 USD per person for one evening. Given the significance of the celebration, we expected more flexibility and accommodation.

As for the food, if you’re a foodie, this may not be the resort for you. The Italian restaurant was the standout meal of the trip, while most other dining options were average and forgettable. The ice cream shop was excellent, and the coffee was good depending on who was preparing it.

Another ongoing issue was the lack of available seating at both the pool and beach. Guests had to wake up very early to secure chairs; otherwise, there was little chance of finding a spot later in the day.

The frustrations continued even after we returned home. A deposit charged to one of our family members’ credit cards was never properly reversed. What should have been a simple fix took approximately six weeks to resolve, with multiple follow-ups, transfers between departments, and emails to different contacts before the issue was finally addressed.

While this resort was not terrible, it did not deliver the level of service, accommodations, or experience we expected for such an important family celebration. Between the room issues, poor organization, lack of recognition for special occasions, difficulty securing dinner reservations, limited seating at the pool and beach, mediocre food, and frustrating post-stay customer service, we left disappointed and would not return.

reviews.author: Mark
reviews.title: A disappointing stay
reviews.text:
Paradisus Cancún has some genuinely positive qualities. The pool areas are attractive and well maintained, the grounds are impressive, and the hotel enjoys a beautiful location on a lovely stretch of beach. Unfortunately, despite these strengths, the overall guest experience fell well below expectations.

The biggest issue was the lack of sleep. Our room had a faulty air-conditioning unit that produced a loud screeching noise throughout the night. Engineers attended twice, but the problem continued every night of our stay.

To make matters worse, loud music from the hotel lobby could be clearly heard in our room throughout the night. On one occasion it was still playing at around 3:30am, forcing us to call reception. We were told it would be turned off, but instead the music continued and remained clearly audible within our room.

The room also contained flashing lights from a faulty fitting and large Wi-Fi routers mounted directly above the beds, creating a constant flashing light effect throughout the night. We even attempted to cover them ourselves in order to sleep.

By the third day, the cumulative effect of the noise, flashing lights and lack of sleep had left us exhausted and unable to properly enjoy the holiday.

Equally disappointing was the all-inclusive offering. Several restaurants were closed during the evenings and even the main buffet restaurant was closed on two occasions during our four-night stay. Dining options were therefore significantly reduced from what had been advertised.

There also appeared to be a lack of evening social spaces for guests. For a resort of this size and positioning, there were surprisingly few bars or comfortable seating areas where guests could gather, enjoy a drink and socialise during the evening. Once dining options became limited, there was very little atmosphere or provision for guests wishing to spend time together outside their rooms. The resort would benefit from a review of its evening facilities and social areas to better meet guest expectations.

The main hotel building also felt surprisingly commercial in character. Rather than creating the atmosphere of a luxury resort, much of the central area resembled a shopping mall, with retail outlets and open public spaces dominating the environment. This detracted from the relaxing and premium ambience that many guests are likely expecting when booking a resort under the Paradisus brand.

What was most frustrating was that these issues were reported daily. Despite repeated complaints and engineer visits, very little changed. We spent far too much of our holiday chasing solutions rather than relaxing.

I also found it disappointing that when I spoke with the hotel’s sales manager about the ongoing problems, the conversation repeatedly shifted towards selling the Meliá Circle membership programme rather than addressing our concerns as paying guests.

Many other guests appeared to be expressing similar frustrations during our stay, and the overall impression was that the resort is still struggling following its recent refurbishment and is not yet operating at the level expected of a premium all-inclusive destination.

For a resort positioned and priced as a premium all-inclusive destination, the gap between expectation and reality was simply too great.

The setting, grounds and beach are undoubtedly attractive, but sadly the guest experience fell well short of expectations. Until the operational issues, service standards, evening facilities and overnight noise problems are properly addressed, I would struggle to recommend Paradisus Cancún to anyone looking for a relaxing luxury holiday.

reviews.author: Allen M
reviews.title: Beautiful but too many loose ends with leadership
reviews.text:
Good price, beautiful and clean resort. Major problems with staff, most food/restaurant staff were exceptional.  The concierge the front desk all need training on hospitality. 

We were greeted by a man just sitting at his desk with a half%#ss hello, didnt say a word after that. Then kept us and our hungry children in our airport clothes for 2 hours in check in.

2 hours later they send us up to our rooms (2) with the wrong wrist bands and put me and my wife and 2 children in a 1 full bed with a pull out couch, the pull out couch did not open up. It was hitting the wall and we slept in 1 bed  that night and my sister took 2 of my children other to her room.

They gave us a room 2 towers away from the main lobby, we then had to walk back and forth 10 different times due to our wristbands not opening our doors. 

It turns out they were only approving our wristbands for 24 hours and we kept having to rest them and kept blaming the last person who reset the wristbands, this is exhausting to exoplain.

The food was what you would expect. Breakfast was great but kept running out of stuff and nobody was aware to refill things such as syrup. Fresh crack eggs are a hit and those chefs were fantastic. The buffet had some bad staff but some VERY GOOD.

The pool people were all fantastic. No complaint there.

Restaurant times/dates and information were all messed up. Very inconsistent times for all the dinners.

Place is a 2/5 overall. Very Clean place.

reviews.author: CJ T
reviews.title: Lo que era una experiencia de lujo ahora es cuando menos algo promedio
reviews.text: Me he alojado en múltiples ocasiones en este hotel pues me parecía un referente en Canun con respecto a; calidad de servicio, amenidades, comida, bebidas y  comodidad, generalmente en el servicio "plus" antes Royal Service, ahora The Reserve y temo que esta fue la última, la persona que nos recibió en The Reserve con una cara que parecía que tenía 24 horas trabajando sin parar y es probable, me dice que hubo un error en las reservaciones y que no tienen habitación en the reserve para nosotros, nos hacen esperar casi una hora para ver que va a suceder y nos dicen que nos van a acomodar en la zona estándar con el servicio plus que pagamos, "situación que por supuesto no paso", cabe mencionar que nos cambiaron en la segunda noche pero lo perdido, perdido estaba,... la calidad de las bebidas y los alimentos ha decaído demasiado, lo que antes era un verdadero servicio a la habitación ahora parece un city express, ni siquiera abastecieron los minibares adecuadamente, cuando antes podías disfrutar por ejemplo de un buen vino incluido en cualquier bar o restaurante ahora por todo el hotel hay un vino de pésima calidad como para mejor evitarlo, lo que fue un desayuno buffete realmente exquisito ahora es cuando menos promedio y si quieres algo mejor debes pagar adicional como un vino para la cena que cobran 4 veces su valor el cual después de 30 minutos de haberlo ordenado te avisan que no tienen, cuando ya estas a media cena. El SPA también recibió un ahorro y se nota, en fin uno espera la experiencia que ha recibido anteriormente y es decepcionante darte cuenta como se ha economizado en todo, lamentablemente habrá que explorar en otro lado.

reviews.author: pttuan
reviews.title: Mixed Experience – Great Location but Several Service and Policy Issues
reviews.text: The resort has a beautiful location in Cancún, but unfortunately our stay was impacted by multiple frustrations.The food quality was disappointing overall. The sashimi was terrible, and it took 30 minutes just to get our food at one restaurant. Even with a reservation, we had to wait another 30 minutes to be seated at the Italian restaurant.The steakhouse felt like a scam. It heavily promotes "The Reserved Experience," leading guests to believe they'll get a complimentary steak, but you actually have to pay extra if you want steak. This was very misleading.Our butler was not helpful at all. She showed no enthusiasm for making our stay better and failed to inform us about important details, such as the need to reserve canopies at the adult pool. She also never offered to reserve one for us during our stay.This lack of information caused problems later. On Sunday, I sat at an empty canopy and an employee told me it was fine as long as I left my personal belongings on it. I did so and enjoyed the day without issues.On Monday, however, I sat at another empty canopy around 7:30 AM and stayed until 11 AM, when an employee suddenly told me it was reserved. There was no sign or any indication it was booked. I was shocked and pointed out that if canopies are reserved, there should be a visible "Reserved" sign — especially when there are no personal belongings on them — just like they do on the beach canopies. The employee was polite, but his supervisor was very unfriendly and looked at me as if I had done something wrong. I chose not to escalate further and moved, but this situation could have been easily avoided with better communication from the butler and clearer signage.Overall, the resort needs to improve its food quality, restaurant management, butler service, and especially transparency around canopy reservations to prevent these frustrating experiences.

reviews.author: Katie M
reviews.title: Please don’t waste your money coming here
reviews.text:
Honestly the experience was a lot better here before the multi million dollar renovations. The renovated rooms are nice but as a whole this hotel is not ready to be open yet.. or ever again really. Their tag line is “The icon is back” I fear the icon has left and is never coming back after seeing what’s happened to this place.
Buffet just not open sometimes, no signs or advance notice. Rusty nails and plastic construction materials strewn about at the bottom of the stairs to the beach. Zero signage anywhere for toilets, what floor you’re on, where anything is. The staff seem fed up and annoyed most of the time. Melia Group should be embarrassed to have this location under their umbrella.
Please do not waste your money on family concierge either. The “benefits” include dinner at a steak house but it’s an 18+ restaurant. A ritual at the spa again which is adults only. No more separate area for family concierge on the beach, zero beds available for kids that want to play and actually be on the beach in the mornings because all seats are taken by towels for hours before anyone arrives to sit on them.
They selectively delete comments on Instagram so there's a reason you only see complimentary comments.

reviews.author: dward0115
reviews.title: Disappointed with kids club experience
reviews.text:
I am currently staying at Paradisus, and while the resort itself is absolutely beautiful, my experience with the Kids Club has been very disappointing.

I was informed to bring my 8-year-old daughter 10–15 minutes before check-in time if the children would be leaving for another activity or location on the resort. We arrived early, around 5:50 PM (check-in was at 6:00 PM), but I was told that she could not enter because they were only accepting children participating in the show. Her cousins, who were right in front of us, were allowed in, but my daughter was turned away.

She was heartbroken and spent the evening in our room crying, not understanding why she couldn’t return to a place she had enjoyed earlier that day. She had been there all day and only needed to leave because the staff were taking their scheduled break from 5:00 to 6:00 PM. When I asked when she could return, I was told 9:30 PM — which caused me to miss my 9:00 PM dinner reservation.

There also appears to be inconsistency in the check-in process. When I registered my daughter, I was not asked to present her passport, yet another family member was told her child could not attend without showing one.

Additionally, the Kids Club is only available for children up to age 10, leaving limited activities for older kids, which can be challenging for families traveling with children of different ages.

Overall, while the resort grounds, rooms, and amenities are stunning, the lack of organization and consistency within the Kids Club was disappointing. For a family-friendly resort, I expected a smoother and more accommodating experience for children. Unfortunately, based on this, I would hesitate to return or recommend Paradisus to other families.

reviews.author: Kim423232
reviews.title: Family Vacation
reviews.text:
The hotel did not meet the standards of a 4-star establishment. The rooms were unremarkable and lacked appeal. Despite paying extra for concierge service, there was no record of this upon arrival, requiring me to visit the check-in desk and provide proof of payment, which was both inconvenient and frustrating. Considering the cost of our stay, the experience felt significantly overpriced. Our concierge offered only average service, and by the time she reached out, our friends had already secured reservations through their own concierge. The kids' club was disappointing for our 10-year-old, as its activities were primarily designed for younger children, resulting in a lack of engagement for older kids. Moreover, our room was situated near the activity area, making it difficult to get to bed before 11 p.m. This was particularly problematic given we had a 7-year-old and a 10-year-old with morning plans, which negatively impacted our overall experience. When the concierge finally checked on us late Monday afternoon, she offered to look for an alternative room, but we declined as our departure was scheduled for Wednesday morning.
Ultimately, while the food and the excellent restaurant and cabana staff redeemed our stay, without their exceptional service, we would have rated this hotel 1 star. It was the dining experience and the professionalism of the waitstaff that truly saved our trip.

reviews.author: Mama475
reviews.title: horrendous service in emergency situation
reviews.text:
I am going to preface this review by saying that I have been coming to the Cancun area for 40 years and have stayed at dozens of hotels in Mexico. I stayed at this resort’s sister property in Playa del Carmen which was wonderful.

February, 2025: Our first night here, my mother tripped on an ill-placed ledge going into the bathroom in our room. She broke her hand in two places, was severely bruised all over her body, and broke a crack in her knee. Medical care came to the room at midnight. We spent 6 hours the next day in the hospital and she will need surgery. She could not go in the water during our stay and was mostly confined to the room because she did not feel well enough to get around.

I am absolutely astonished by the hotel’s complete lack of care regarding this incident. We had to take our own cab to the hospital. I spoke to two managers and a dozen different people and no one addressed anything regarding this fall. We had an additional complaint from night one regarding the noise outside the room being blaring music until 10pm— we were told this would not be every night, which was flat-out untrue.

I was given an anonymous WhatsApp guest service phone number to text and all they did for us is make a dinner reservation. I asked multiple times over WhatsApp and email for a copy of the hotel’s incident report and they refused to give it to me— they handed me my own handwritten paragraph regarding the incident. There are so many small things that could have been done to make my mother’s stay more comfortable and…. nothing.

I would maybe just chalk it up to “Mexico” but when our friends who had the family concierge were upset about their son’s birthday cake being an hour late, they were sent two cakes and a bottle of champagne.

Honestly, this experience has completely turned me off from the entire Melia brand, whose marketing is terrific. This ruined our vacation as well as the week was about being a nursemaid to my mother rather than relaxing, and with no one else to help with my young son.

She has a bill from the hospital that will need to be addressed, but that the entire staff basically ignored that this happened on the property was astounding to me.

The kids club was terrific and the best aspect of our stay.

reviews.author: Maria
reviews.title: Highly Disappointed! Don't waste your time and money here, they don't value their guest!
reviews.text:
Our family trip was incredibly meaningful, marking multiple celebrations: my parents' 40th wedding anniversary, our 7th anniversary, and both my son's and my birthdays. It was extra special as our first family trip together ever. 

Upon arrival, our excitement dwindled when we were assigned our rooms. Despite our requests, nothing was accommodated or acknowledged. Romina at the front desk informed us that nothing could be changed due to a big group arriving the next day, making us feel like we didn’t matter. Not to mention, there was nothing special setup in our rooms for our special occasions like we've experienced at other resorts. This definitely set the tone for the rest of our trip as we litterally felt like we were getting the bottom of the barrel treatment.

Our initial rooms felt like a "hole in the wall" on the basement-like bottom floor—claustrophobic, and the balcony faced a wall. Displeased, I returned to the front desk. Thankfully, Enrique was helpful. He changed my parents’ room to a higher floor and provided us with a room with the king-size bed we prioritized, though still on the bottom floor.

Enrique promised room changes could occur in 3 days, as they would be available by the 15th. We accepted this and was asked to return in 20 mins for our room, only to encounter Romina again. She told us the earlier promise couldn’t be fulfilled due to the large group arriving the next day, displaying a very bad attitude unwilling to help and seeming intent to block Enrique's solution.

To prevent further distress, I accepted the situation with the new room, which faced only half a wall this time, resolving to not let these issues ruin our hard-earned trip.

At first glance, the room seemed acceptable, but as we settled in, it became clear how worn out everything was. Two lights were out, making the room very dim. The bathroom was filthy and appeared improperly cleaned; the tub looked like it needed replacing. This was the worst cleanliness I've encountered at an all-inclusive, and I've stayed at Grand Oasis before in my early 20s. Over our seven-day stay, the cleaning person showed up only two times, our fridge was never stocked, until we complained and even then it only got stocked on the last day, and no one came to collect the room service dishes even after we called. Midway through the trip, we discovered two mid-sized roaches in the room and later encountered many tiny baby roaches in the bathroom. 

The food was below average. Despite a wide array of options, the dishes didn't taste great and were often overly salty. The cooks looked over worked and unhappy at the buffet. The service varied there, as well. 

During our stay the large group Romina mentioned ended up being a corporate conference who were not being serviced privately resulting in huge lines everywhere and multiple nights of large private dinners by the main pool where the entertainment would typically be being blocked off and only accessible to the conference goers. Again, changing the atmosphere for people who are there on vacation. 

Anyhow, the entertainment was lackluster, though the entertainment team seemed to try their best with limited resources; unfortunately, it fell short for us.

The beach was the highlight, even during a windy week when the water was too rough for swimming until the second last day. The service from Eduardo at the beach club with the Kanna Bali beds was excellent, though not included, costing an additional $250 USD or available as a gift if you endure a sales pitch for Club Melia membership. I strongly advise against joining Club Melia. The brand lacks integrity and consistently fails to address issues promptly, missing multiple opportunities to make things right. why join a club when they can't do things right the first time? Second or third.. 

Activities for kids were well-managed by Nestor, who ran the workshops admirably and beach activities. 

The kiddie pool section was great for young children, with knee-high water, though it wasn't cleaned daily and seating was limited.

The nine-hole golf course, though appeared promising, was neglected, with broken bottles and rough greens. 

The main area in building 3 is dreamy with all the vines coming down, but that's where it ends.. everything else shows its age. The resort is closing in May for a year-long renovation, and it seems many staff have lost motivation or aren't performing at full potential during this time and it shows. 

Would we return? No, because our business didn’t feel valued at all on multiple occasions during our stay. I highly recommend saving your money, time, and energy by booking elsewhere.. somewhere where they actually cared about your experience.

reviews.author: David A
reviews.title: Disappointing Experience at Melia Paradisus Cancun;  a poorly managed, frustrating experience.
reviews.text:
The resorts look impressive on pictures. Review: Disappointing Experience at Melia Paradisus Cancun

We recently stayed at the Melia Paradisus Cancun, expecting a luxurious experience based on its reputation and beautiful common areas. Unfortunately, while the resort itself appears well-maintained on the surface, the quality of service and room conditions left much to be desired.

From the start, our stay was filled with issues. We spent the first two nights in a room with no working air conditioning, making sleep nearly impossible in the humid Cancun weather. Despite multiple visits to reception, we were repeatedly told there was “nothing available,” with no real effort made to accommodate us. Even as Melia members, we were denied an upgrade, despite the clear need for one as a family of three squeezed into two full-sized beds for five nights.

Another major issue was the sewage smell that filled the air in the evenings, making it unpleasant to even sit outside and enjoy the resort. On top of that, the resort was severely understaffed—room service took over an hour, housekeeping had to be called twice just to clean our room after it was left untouched for two full days, and simple requests required waiting for approval from someone outside of reception or customer care. It felt like no one on site had the authority or willingness to resolve even basic issues.

The biggest disappointment was the lack of empathy from management. Despite our repeated complaints, they remained uninvolved and dismissive, offering no solutions or gestures to make up for the inconveniences. With the poor service, rundown rooms, and constant frustration, our stay was far from the relaxing and enjoyable vacation we had hoped for.

Would I return? Absolutely not. If you’re considering this resort, be warned—the beautiful exterior hides a poorly managed, frustrating experience.

reviews.author: Ali H
reviews.title: Lack Luster Resort
reviews.text:
I had high hopes for our trip, but unfortunately, it fell far short of expectations. The biggest disappointment? The food. Buffets were repetitive, bland, and often lukewarm. The à la carte restaurants weren’t much better—long wait times for mediocre dishes that lacked any real flavor. But the worst part was the bakery. Stale pastries, dry cakes, and artificial-tasting desserts made it clear that little effort was put into quality.

As for the hotel itself, it’s in desperate need of an update. The rooms felt worn out, with dated decor, musty smells, and furniture that had clearly seen better days.

The only reason this isn’t a 1-star review is that the beach was beautiful, and the staff were friendly. But for the price, I expected way more. I wouldn’t stay here again.

reviews.author: Aisha F
reviews.title: Subpar holiday vacation
reviews.text:
Very disappointing stay. I booked this resort based on the good reviews and was completely surprised on day one of our stay. We arrived on Christmas Day and couldn’t get a reservation for dinner.  I had called them weeks earlier to reserve dinner, but they told me that I had to do it upon arrival and that I wouldn’t have any issues. Well our whole family had to wait 3 hours to be seated at any of the restaurants, which was way past our kids bedtimes. 

There is very little customer service and it takes an atrocious amount of time to make dinner reservations at all the hotel restaurants. Food is subpar, the only decent food we had was during the day when we had to pay $250 for a daybed which came with a nice seafood lunch. 

The beach chairs are hard to come by, you have to race out at 6 or 7a to get a decent spot. And then our chairs were stolen by the time we got to them. I’m sorry, but this is not an idea of a relaxing vacation when you have to fight for chairs. 

The hotel is also old and run down. As I was taking a shower, the entire left side of the shower ceiling collapsed on me, which was absolutely disgusting. It took them two hours to come fix it, which they simply put some plaster on the ceiling. I went to guest service to let them know how unacceptable it is for the ceiling plaster to come off like that and there should be some compensation, such as a food/beverage credit, and he looked at me and responded with “the only thing we can do is send you a gift” and never even apologized to me. Not sure what the “gift” was because it never showed up. Absolute worst customer service and highly recommend to NOT stay here.

reviews.author: Vicky C
reviews.title: Déceptions par dessus déceptions, clairement pas un 5 étoiles
reviews.text:
Horrible expérience sur toute la ligne! Un des pires voyages de notre vie. 

Nous avions réservé une suite avec vue sur le lagon. Dès notre arrivée dans le couloir donnant sur notre chambre, cette section de l’hôtel avait l’air abandonnée/négligée, mais nous n’y avons pas apporté plus attention que cela… 

première nuit, nous n’avons pas dormi de minuit à 4h-5h du matin, car il y a un bar de l’autre côté de la rue et le bruit était intense. Notre lit en tremblait tellement la bass était forte. Nous avons demandé un changement de chambre dès le lendemain matin vers 6h30, mais comme l’hôtel affichait « complet » il était impossible de nous changer de chambre pour le moment. On nous a dit de revenir le lendemain matin pour confirmer la demande de changement de chambre. 2e nuit, même chose… comme demandé, nous avons été au front desk pour confirmer notre demande de changement de chambre et on nous a demandé de repasser vers 4h pour faire le changement, car évidemment, la chambre n’était pas nettoyée. 

Vers 4h, nous avons été au rendez-vous donné le matin même et curieusement, notre demande n’avait pas fonctionnée. Ils étaient incapables de nous donner une chambre. 

Nous avons demandé à plusieurs reprises de parler au superviseur, car pour nous, le but premier d’un hôtel est de dormir, ce que nous n’avons pas réussi à faire les premières nuits. JAMAIS il n’a voulu nous le faire voir, mais il a fini par accéder à notre demande de changement de chambre. 

Nous avons donc fait le changement, sans être au bout de nos problèmes, la chambre donnée n’avait pas d’air climatisée! Nous sommes tout de suite retournés au front desk pour demander à parler au superviseur, David. Il a finalement trouvé une solution temporaire, soit un changement de chambre pour une nuit, un peu moins près du bar en question, mais une chambre mieux nous serait donnée par la suite. Nous n’avons pas bien dormi encore une fois, mais David nous avait promis une nouvelle chambre… nous avions espoir d’un upgrade pour les inconvénients, mais non!

Bref, après 4 chambres nous avons réussi à dormir presque normalement. Les lits sont tellement inconfortables que mon mari a dû dormir avec notre fils pour réussir à avoir un semblant de confort. 

Aucune des 4 chambres que nous avons eues n’était rénovée et dans la dernière le mini frigo ne fonctionnait pas. Nous avons demandé à 2 reprises de le faire réparer, mais ça n’a pas été fait. 

Le service de nettoyage aux chambres passait beaucoup trop tard et nous avons manqué de serviettes. J’ai dû appeler 2 fois pour en avoir et ça pris 2h avant d’en avoir alors que je leur avait mentionné attendre après ça pour nos douches.

Côté nourriture, rien d’exceptionnel non plus. Il faut débourser pour avoir un semblant de repas convenable. Les portions sont minuscules. Pas un filet mignon ou de homard sans avoir à payer en plus du prix exorbitant déjà payé pour le séjour. Il faut réserver pour les soupers au restaurant alors qu’ils sont toujours vides! Il semble manquer de personnel également. Le service est très long.

Notre concierge Pablo semblait plus intéressé à nous vendre des upgrades de l’hôtel que de nous servir. C’était fatiguant. Hôtel très axé sur les upgrades et extras payants. Je n’ai jamais vu ça! Même pour faire mettre une demande spéciale au dj de la piscine il faut débourser! Sans compter les douze milles fois où quelqu’un de l’hôtel est venu nous voir pour nous vendre des forfaits photo ou d’activités. Sérieusement, il serait facile de sortir avec une facture supplémentaire de 3 à 4 000$ plus cher que le forfait « de base ».

Côté propreté, c’était ordinaire aussi. Verres d’alcool de la veille sur la plage pas toujours ramassés, et gouttes d’urine par terre dans toutes les chambres. Planchers clairement pas lavés régulièrement. 

Seul côté positif, la gang du bar de la piscine : Didier, Jorge, Flore et Edouardo ont réussi à nous faire oublier momentanément ce voyage décevant.

D’ailleurs, au déjeuner Pascual et son équipe : Manuel, Rafael et Ariadna nous ont offert un service impeccable tous les matins nous offrant un de meilleurs endroits pour manger.

Je ne recommande pas cet hôtel aux gens qui souhaitent avoir le luxe d’un hôtel 5 étoiles et qui s’attendent à ce que tout soit réellement inclus. Très déçue. 2e et dernière fois dans un Mélia.

reviews.author: Louise S
reviews.title: AWFUL start, slightly redeemed by amazing staff helping to remedy stressful start.
reviews.text:
I wanted to believe all the positive reviews on here before I arrived at the Paradisus in the hope that they won over the negative ones;  and the holiday i'd booked for 15 of us (aged 12-81) a year ago would be as wonderful as it looked.  BUT those negative reviews, sadly won out.  I had sent many, many emails in advance (right up until 2 days before arrival), reassuring and checking our accomodation plans were in place having noted previous guests issues. All to no avail. We arrived with no room for my 81 year old father (despite it being confirmed and showing these emails to the reception staff) and all our rooms were scattered despite several emails requesting them next to eachother due to children etc. The room of doom (AKA reception) could not have been more unhelpful if they tried - throughout our trip. The rooms were tired, water pipes leaking everywhere - my father fell and gashed his head as a result having already complained about the water on the floor outside his room;  and generally we felt like we were staying at Fawlty Towers. The ONLY redeeming factor was the brilliant Alejandra Vilches who looked after us when we found her on day one begging for some help to get our rooms sorted and restaurants booked.  I was so stressed, dissapointed and underwhelmed that Melia has been so utterly blind in accepting their customer services and reception teams do not commmunicate and therefore they have disgruntled guests the minute they walk through the door. 

Alejandra was an angel from start to finish in ensuring the remainder of our stay after a stressful first 48hrs was calm and helped us daily fix, sort and upgrade to ensure we could make the best of the situation. Did we make the most of it, and find laughter and joy in the ridiculously stressful situation?  absolutely - thank god for family.... . But would I return, NO.  Would i visit another Melia hotel - probably not. Shame, as we had the BEST xmas 2023 at the Gran Canaria hotel which prompted us to book in Mexico in the first instance.

reviews.author: Vacation230202
reviews.title: will we go back? absolutely not!
reviews.text:
Paradisus Cancun is a very nice resort with very poor customer service: we felt like they were very short staffed. Every time we asked for room service (mostly asking for milk for my one year old daughter) things were very flaky; sometimes they would forget or it would take them hours to bring what we asked. The food quality was poor generally speaking: the service was also not reliable at all; we asked for food for my daughter once and it took them 65 minutes to bring it. Not recommending at all. 

We had someone through the family concierge helping us who was very nice. Helped us with a room switch (we stayed 10 days and asked for a room switch on day 1 and we finally got it on day 7). He was very helpful for dinner reservation.

reviews.author: Louis K
reviews.title: Expected Better From an expensive 5-star Resort
reviews.text:
Many, many problems with the room some of which were never resolved.  Am a handicapped guest and my repeated requests for a shower chair were ignored.  As a result, I fell 2 times.  No hot water at times, inability to open balcony door due to repairs being needed etc. etc.  Numerous requests to speak to the Reserve General Manager, Alicia, were denied saying she is in a meeting or too busy.  It is a shame for upper management to ignore guest issues when the staff under her tried very hard to resolve problems.  Great staff such as Victor & Emmanuel tried but were not able to resolve issues beyond their control.  Usually stay at RIU when in Cancun but wanted to try this place.  Guess we will go back to RIU where attention to guest issues is a priority.

As a footnote, Guest Service Center Management promised to look into these issues immediately and get back to us but never did.

reviews.author: Allie
reviews.title: Melia All-Inclusive is a Bait and Switch - Not Real All Inclusive
reviews.text:
I don’t typically leave reviews, but my experience of Paradisus Cancun was NO WHERE near what I hoped or expected, especially given the cost.

By no means was everything awful. The public spaces in the resort were largely quite lovely and pleasant to be in. The resort was large and didn't feel overly crowded, though around meal times the parts of the resort where most of the restaurants were could get quite busy. The spa was small but nice and the massage therapists were fantastic. It felt like certain staff members went above and beyond and some of the food was quite tasty.

But that’s kind of where the pleasantness ends. The whole resort in a lot of ways felt like a bait and switch. We bought into the premium all-inclusive package, or The Reserve, as they call it, which supposedly included access to an adult only area in the resort, premium alcohol and food, and a private concierge. The adult only area was fine, though not particularly large, and the private concierge was helpful, but even though we were lead to believe that we would have access to everything as part of the Reserve, we would discover later that premium alcohol was only included within the sectioned off parts of the resort, and that large chunks of every restaurant were an extra charge. Not just a supplemental charge, but paying full price. This felt like a huge betrayal of the all-inclusive mentality, and the constant up selling of these extra charge items felt quite inappropriate. God help you as well if you AREN’T part of the Reserve, because then they really slap you with extra charges for everything. Bali beds by the main hotel pool cost around $225 for the day. At least we got those included in our private section of the resort.

The resort itself is quite run down and in need of renovation. We had to move rooms because our first room was full of broken things, like door handles and towel racks. Our second room was better, but still had a broken toilet seat and holes in the walls where stuff used to be. You can find things in poor condition all over the resort if you look. The rooms themselves also felt sparse and plain compared to the photos where the walls were painted and the room was smartly decorated. I’ve stayed in worse rooms, but given the cost of this place, I expected a lot better than this.

Service in the resort was a mixed bag with both extreme ends of the spectrum. Some staff were incredibly helpful and attentive and seemed to want to create a nice experience, where others were very checked out, or seemed untrained and confused. The people walking around upselling excursions or asking to come listen to a 90 minute presentation selling their 'exclusive membership' (think time share but maybe worse) were also a bit much and not what you want when you're trying to relax. I feel bad because clearly some folks are trying really hard, but on the whole their effort is not enough to make up for all the short comings of this place.

Tldr: this place is pretty on the surface, but it’s run down and not a true all-inclusive resort in the end, instead it’s one where only half of the offerings are actually included and you’ll get pushed towards spending more money at every turn.

reviews.author: astridbiebers
reviews.title: Muy malo
reviews.text: Los servicios son malos, los que te atienden atienden mal, la comida es mala y cierran muy temprano.

reviews.author: Mari
reviews.title: Un verdadero desastre
reviews.text:
Una decepción…Vengo por tercera vez porque las dos últimas fueron un espectáculo y esta vez todo es un desastre.

El servicio es pésimo, sobre todo en las zonas de piscina y playa. Personal poco dispuesto, todo lo que piden la respuesta es "no es posible". 

Bebidas calientes en la habitación, puerta del baño rota, ducha en pésimas condiciones y una enorme gotera en el pasillo que lleva a la habitación.

Todos los servicios han sido largos y las bebidas llegan aguadas de tanto esperar. La impresión que me da es que trabajan por obligación, no generando ninguna experiencia en el cliente. 

La cena de Navidad de ayer en el restaurante Malva fue la peor en la que he estado. En el bar de arriba, el vino espumoso se servía en vasos de plástico, pedí una copa y una vez más la respuesta fue "no es posible". En el bar de arriba, el vino espumoso se servía en vasos de plástico, pedí una copa y una vez más la respuesta fue "no es posible". Pagar 40000 por beber vino espumoso en un vaso de plástico es una vergüenza. 

En fin, la última vez que vine, que fue en 2019, la calidad de los servicios, la gente y la experiencia bajó de un 10 a un 4.

reviews.author: Jeff L
reviews.title: No value for money
reviews.text:
There are not enough activities for kids. There is one pool table with poor conditioned cues, one video game station with very long wait constantly. There is a large pool but little fun activities. The nightly performances are at a crammed area with poor visibility. The escape room is fun but expensive. Overall kid experience design is lazy and limited. 
The food is generally not tasty though variety is decent. Quality of ingredients is quite low and all the restaurants taste generic. 
There are not enough beach chairs by the pool - too many people vie for a few of them. Too many spots are reserved for premier members or pay-for-upgrade. 
Staff in general appears to lack training and/or motivation. Management appears to focus on cost cutting and upselling. 
The beach and ocean are world class but not something the hotel can claim credit for except the cleanliness. 
In its current state there’s little value for money. It’s a beautiful place but an empty shell. We are definitely not coming back.

reviews.author: Hitesh R
reviews.title: 5-star tuned into 2-star
reviews.text:
A 5-star hotel has turned into 2-star. Positives: Beaches, Restaurant Service Staff.
Negatives: Family concierge is a scam. Overall staff attitude is gone down the drain. Frequent out-of-stocks on Food/Towels. No care for customer experience.

reviews.author: Lucas
reviews.title: O paraíso não é mais aqui
reviews.text:
3- é última vez no Paradisus Cancún.
Primeiramente escolhemos a opção family concierge mais mudaram as regras e realmente não vale a pena pagar mais pra não ter praticamente nada de volta, antigamente dava acesso ao SPA full time e agora uma única vez por estada, o mesmo acontece com os bangalôs na praia e na piscina, nem as amenidades de banho tem diferencial sem falar na sala do family concierge que deixou de oferecer todos os mimos possíveis, os adultos hospedados no family concierge não tem acesso a área de adultos que também era possível no passado para tomar um café em um local tranquilo e etc.
O quarto precisa passar por uma reforma urgente está tudo muito velho é desatualizado.
O atendimento da recepção demorado.
Todas as cervejas que peguei estavam quentes.
A única parte que continua boa é a alimentação de resto tudo despencou de qualidade de 2020 pra cá.
Arrependimento de ter dado a 3- chance ainda mais em um período tão caro como natal e ano novo.
Fujam pois caiu demais a qualidade

reviews.author: Laura R
reviews.title: Go elsewhere!!!
reviews.text:
Worst resort ever! They’re closing June 2025 for major Reno’s and they don’t care about their guests one bit. The food wasn’t the greatest always finding hair in the buffet dishes. The workers did not care about you the steak restaurant wasn’t included you had to pay for it and kids weren’t allowed. The rooms are old and outdated the showers and bathrooms were gross. 
The whole time we were there the waves were rough never calm that side of Cancún is always like that they told us. 
Don’t waste your money here go elsewhere
The last day at the resort my whole family got sick. They don’t wash the cups at the bars with soap just water after everyone has drank from them, disgusting. 
Would not recommend this chain.

reviews.author: AJ C
reviews.title: Pros and cons but more cons
reviews.text:
Beautiful property, beaches and great entertainment for families and adults.

Room had constant maintenance issues and repairs were temporary patches. The food and beverage facilities close way too early and there are no other options available.

reviews.author: Miss p
reviews.title: Old hotel with cold food. Save your money and go elsewhere.
reviews.text:
I am a mom of two kids, the founder of a company, and came with my extended family to this hotel for thanksgiving. I have stayed in multiple all inclusives and interesting thing I have noticed about this hotel is service is terrible. 

I have a feeling the reviews of this hotel are probably fake. Here’s why:

1) We booked family concierge and when we arrived, there were no sheets for the kids beds. In fact, we all had to sleep on one bed because there was no “concierge” available to take our call. 

2) The restaurants, even though half empty, can’t handle the guests. They ran out of chicken in one restaurant and the other restaurant had cold meat. Not sure it was worth paying the all inclusive price. 

3) The hotel is super outdated. The rooms are falling apart. We paid almost $4200 for these rooms. 

I slept terribly. I’m actually scared there are bed bugs. Please save your money and go to Hyatt Ziva. I stayed there last year and had a great time. None of these issues.

I have 6 more days left here… not sure what I’m going to to.

reviews.author: Dennis B
reviews.title: Hot, humid, roof leaked pretty bad in several areas, our concierge was hard to reach, and room had issues with A/C
reviews.text: To start, our check in took way longer than they said it would. Had to change rooms due to the patio door letting hot humid air in so  the A/C didn’t work. Our concierge was hard to reach most of the time, and had to keep on him to get things done! Won’t go again. Spent most of the time hot and sweaty due to no air movement inside the resort. Food was decent, and beach set up was nice! Best part of trip was Dolly the Cat that lived at the resort and would visit you for pets.

reviews.author: Jasmin K
reviews.title: Preis/Leistung sehr schlecht
reviews.text:
leider habe ich nur 200 Zeichen Bewertung

Zu uns kommen aus dem Allgäu, Pärchen, 38 Jahre alt, keine Kinder 

Diese ist absolut Fake, TikTok entspricht nicht der Wahrheit . Man fühlt sich nicht besonders im Reservebereich. Alles kostet extra. Butler bisher nur einmal gesehen.  Unsauber. Renovierungsbedürftig.

Liege am Strand und möchte mein Geld zurück.

reviews.author: Joel
reviews.title: Atendiemnto péssimo. Não vale o preço.
reviews.text:
Tivemos que pedir alteração de quarto por cheiro excessivo de mofo e a recepcionista nos tratou com muita má vontade. O novo quarto alagou quando houve uma chuva mais forte. Para piorar, estavam reformando o quarto acima do nosso e o barulho começava às 7:30 da manhã.
A maioria dos funcionários prestaram um péssimo atendimento, alguns com bastante grosseria.
Para o padrão do hotel, esperávamos uma experiência melhor.

reviews.author: gsswjmc
reviews.title: Lackluster
reviews.text:
I purchased personal concierge service. Not worth it. The room was not worth it. Free round trip transfer was hard to book, so I had to pay for personal service. NONE of the promotional benefits were NEVER offered.

When I travel, I don’t like to bring any of my personal payment. The resort had the credit card on file, but did NOT run that payment. I had to pay when I got there and I didn’t have my physical payment. I wanted to pay by CC tap since my card is on my phone. I was told I couldn’t. I had to then tell my husband on his surprise trip that he has to pay.

Step up bathroom is a NO! The room was too small to be a suite. Will NEVER get this room again for the price.

My goodness. Never is this addition worth it. I forgot a book in my room that I wanted to read by the pool and I asked the concierge (that I paid for service) to go to my room to retrieve a personal item. He told me he was in a meeting and NEVER updated me of his availability. On top of that, when he first introduced himself at check in, he had an obnoxious stain on his shirt. I could have done his job. I told them before hand that it was my husband’s 40th bday and we didn’t get NOTHING special in the room. Even if it was a door sash…NOTHING!

Too many kids and not any adult only. And if it was adult only, we couldn’t access since we didn’t get that package. Very stupid.

Flight wasn’t until 10a and we had to take a shuttle 10 min up the road @4:30a. The hotel was supposed to give the ride for free, but we still had to pay. Way too early and I was NOT happy about having to get up at 3:30a to be at the airport 6 hrs early.

reviews.author: Cathy L
reviews.title: For a 5 Star Resort - The Reserve - You would expect MUCH better!!!
reviews.text:
Arrived Sunday Nov. 3, 2024 - for a work conference.  The check in process was slow - but that was expected with a large group.  Most of the group had paid for the upgrade to be in The Reserve section of the resort - adults only - along with perks outlined on their website.    
Once in The Reserve - pyramid 5 - we were advised that any issues or concerns moving forward would be addressed at the Customer Service Desk within The Reserve.   
We were escorted to the room we paid for - an OceanView Suite - when the door was opened - there was a very strong chemical smell - ignoring the smell for a moment and excited to see our OceanView - I ran to the curtains to open them...just to find a large grass berm - you could "see" the ocean if you looked past the berm to the left or right - but there was definitely no OceanView - to pay additional for - very disappointing.  
...back to the smell - it was so bad our Bell Hop was waiving his hand in front of his nose - and made the comment "you can not stay here".  
I went to the Customer Service Desk - I sat down to discuss our concerns with ALANDRA - I expressed the fact we paid extra to be in the OceanView Suite and along with the smell - we would like to be moved to another room.  She very quickly and rudely said "no" - no care for our situation at all.  I pleaded with her - stating even their Bell Hop said we could not stay in the room - and she very bluntly again said "no - we have no where to move you"    ....again pleading with not only her - but her coworker beside her (I did not get his name) - I asked that either one "please come to the room to smell the odour - and you will see - we are not able to stay in the room" - they then spoke Spanish to each other ...laughed...and the gentleman looked at me and said "I will not be going anywhere with you ma'am" in a VERY sarcastic manner.    I WAS MORTIFIED....this is a 5 star resort - and we paid EXTRA to be within The Reserve section.  And to be treated this way - I couldn't believe it.   
It was at this time - a concierge came over - understanding I was upset at this time.  He spoke to them and it was only then that we were told they would "try" to help us get a different room.   Three hours later we were shown to a room in Pyramid 4 and settled there - being told we could keep our "Reserve" wrist bands so we could still receive the benefits of paying for The Reserve upgrade. 

After speaking with many of our business associates - they also had the same experience with ALANDRA - she was rude - unwilling to help with concerns that were brought to her attention.  On more than 1 occasion (myself included) we were told that even though we paid the upgrade to be in The Reserve section of the resort - since we booked with a group - we were considered "lesser" (Alandra's words) and we would not receive what the website stated were "perks" of paying for the upgrade in The Reserve section.  Shocked to say the least.

On top of Alandra being so unprofessional:
- the food was...at best...a 6/10 - most of the time coming cold to the table.   
- for being an all inclusive - there were many things that you still needed to pay for if you wanted to take part - food on the menu's / seating at the pool / certain alcohol's
- Spa credits - as part of paying for The Reserve were not honoured because we were part of a group
- MiniBar/Snacks were not replenished daily (for our Reserve business associates either)
- Front Desk - Customer Service - if concerns were brought to them - they also would tell us - they could not help because we booked as a group.  

I just want to make this very clear - when we booked with our group - I am very diligent at researching the resort and pricing myself (I just want to know what we are paying with the group vs. booking ourselves) - I went on Expedia - the exact same dates - in The Reserve - for a OceanView Suite - was $1,500.00 cheaper than what we paid for with the group - so to continually be told we were "lesser" somehow because we booked with a group - we paid $1,500.00 more than if we would have booked ourselves AND we would have not had an issue what-so-ever receiving the "perks" of being a Reserve Guest.   Unreal!

The service outside of The Reserve was great - poolside / waiters/waitresses / cafe's / bars - they were all professional and kind. 

The ONLY thing that deserved a 10/10 for this resort ...the Beach - if you are willing to forego everything I just mentioned above - the Beach is beyond gorgeous!  
White Sands - Turquois Water - Gorgeous!

reviews.author: janyang31
reviews.title: 房間老舊 音樂很大聲 好吵
reviews.text:
整體燈光太暗 房間老舊 浴室有蟑螂 
禮品店東西太貴 會騙人 換算美金匯率故意算很貴 如果付美金現金  一直浪費我們的時間要我們買他們的time share.

reviews.author: Connector656016
reviews.title: Based on my experience, I cant recommend this property
reviews.text:
To be clear, this review is a reflection of the property itself. The staff was very warm and accommodating.

The property is very old and outdated. There are newer renovated rooms, but we were in one of the older rooms facing the street. There is a loud night club across the street, it makes falling asleep very difficult if you face the lagoon. Of all of the all inclusive I've been to, this is by far the most outdated property. Outside of your room, do not expect air conditioning. For such a a large property, there isn't a location for their nightly shows other than the lobby...the unairconditioned lobby.  Sure it was not comfortable sitting there, but the performers were drenched in sweat. 

We were there unfortunately during tropical storm Helene...We had almost an inch of water in our room. We thought it was an isolated incident until we went to breakfast and saw the entire hotel was leaking.... hallways, steps, everywhere. Several of the elevators were shut down as well. There was so much water there were trash cans everywhere to catch water. I felt bad the employees were feverishly trying to keep water out during a tropical storm. Lots of people slipped and fell.... we saw someone with a broken arm. 

The women at the kids club were great, but there isn't much for them to do inside. If the weather is bad the kids stay inside and do coloring/crafts. The kids club is fairly small/setup for very young kids.

Food overall was decent. Not great, but not bad either.

reviews.author: elimon2024
reviews.title: Hotel con falta de mantenimiento.
reviews.text: El hotel con el mantenimiento que requiere y puliendo 2-3 áreas, capacitación de chefs en cocina, atención al cliente podría ser 5 estrellas.

reviews.author: Sebastian B
reviews.title: Volvimos y no fue lo mismo.
reviews.text:
LO BUENO
Muy bien ubicado / La playa / Algunos restaurantes excelentes/ 

LO MALO

Comparado con la primera vez que fuimos  , la atencion y cordialidad del personal es el punto mas preocupante.
Volvimos por la buena experiencia y nos llevamos una sorpresa. Incluso algunos cargos gerenciales ( guest service) nos dieron un trato que no dan ganas de volver. 
Los cuartos, estan viejos y mal cuidados. Se nos cayo el techo y las duchas estan en mal estado. Se entiende es un hotel antiguo pero no puede pasar eso en un 5 estrellas.

Saco de mis comentarios negativos al personal de : Entretencion, Gym, Sport Bar, Lemon Fish y Flora.. Ellos muy bien.

reviews.author: Siraj A
reviews.title: If you like to sweat in 90 degrees constantly, pick this hotel
reviews.text:
Exterior Hotel accomodations are great although interior really needs improvement. Experienced cockroaches in my room, AC will not go below 75 in room, cant sleep, constant smell of food in balcony preventing you from opening balcony door, no AC in lobby or common areas so you are constantly sweating walking to restaurants or hanging out by bar, lack of vegeterian options. 

Paid for upgrade of ocean view with balcony, did not even use it during stay due to restaurant itchen exhaust fan blowing right into our balcony with food smell

between my family of 14 people, we had reserved 5 rooms. 

Hotel does not seem to care to fix, we have tried calling the main phone number, a 3rd party picks up, tries to transfer you but no one picks up. I have emailed twice with my compaint and no one has replied, its been over 7 days already.

reviews.author: John S
reviews.title: AVOID!
reviews.text:
Arrived back from a 10 night stay at Paradisus Cancun. The hotel itself is beautiful, however do not be fooled by the grand lobby that greats you on arrival.

We checked in around 9pm with my wife and two children, and were assigned a room in Pyramid 3 on the 3rd Floor. We had booked a Junior Suite - Luxury Ocean View and while the Ocean view was stunning, the room was far from Luxury. The sliding door was broken and hard to open, the furniture was broken, numerous areas of the bathroom just in general disrepair and the sink blocked with small bugs which flowed out and sat in the basin after use. We attempted to sleep however the noise was horrendous from the entertainment which went on to 11pm.

At 5am the next morning I went to reception to request a room change, I was told this was possible but not until 4pm. I advised that there were live bugs in my sink and that I didn't want my family to have to wash in it, I was asked to wait and was then offered a temporary room until our new room was available. The temporary room was lovely.

At 4pm we collected the key for our new room, and it was much better than the first although given the claim that this was a Junior Suite - Luxury Ocean View, it didn't have tea or coffee making facilities which is a basic even in a Premier Inn! I requested a kettle which was delivered, I think requested tea and coffee and was provided with some tea bags and 4 Nespresso pods?! I explained I couldn't use those and asked if a Nespresso machine was being delivered but was met with a blank response.

If you chose an Ocean View Room be prepared to not get any sleep until 11pm, as the evening entertainment alternates between the inside bar and the terrace outside next to the beach, you cant get away from it!

The food was ok, but basically the same every day, apart from one station which changed. My wife witnessed bugs crawling through the food so didnt eat the whole of the holiday. The pizzas were very good which can be ordered outside near the pool.

The pool itself is dirty, our daughter ended up with an ear infection and my wife and I both had blocked ears after a few days.

There is very little entertainment for children, both in the day and evening.

The entire hotel is getting a bit weary, just needs a makeover as parts of it are literally falling down!

On a positive, the staff are amazing and so friendly! Could not fault any one of them! They work tirelessly and always have a smile on their face.

The beach is beautiful.

All in all, I wouldnt recommend staying here, it was a big disappointment after looking forward to it for so long, spending a lot of money and enduring a long flight.

AVOID!

reviews.author: Janet D
reviews.title: Unless you’re a Meliá Member, don’t recommend
reviews.text:
I booked a last minute trip for Labor Day weekend and I would not recommend this place unless you get it at a super cheap rate or you have the top tier Meliá status.

As a regular paying customer, you will not get any special treatment. They even convinced me of paying an extra $400 to get the “family concierge treatment” so we went for it. We arrived at 11am and the lady assisting us didn’t really engage or seem happy or communicate much but she told us that they would text me when my room was ready. We waited and waited and went back around 1pm and then she told us that it wouldn’t be ready until 3pm and that the family concierge would notify us when the room was ready. 

The family concierge reached out to us around 3pm and asked how we were doing. I said we were waiting for our room and she said that the room was actually already ready. She also asked us to meet her to go over the itinerary. I said we were at the pool/beach and it would take us about 30 minutes to get there. We got there and she had left already. She then messaged me to come back down so I did. She really didn’t do much except call to make a few reservation which we could have done for minimal effort. Nothing worth an extra $400. She said she would send something up for my birthday but nothing came. She said she would set us up for a Bali bed and nothing, I had to reach out to her on our last day to see and she said I had to go on the waitlist. On the last day, we were supposed to meet downstairs to get our transportation and she promised our baggage would be picked up and it never was. They said they didn’t have it on the list. They ended up coming late and when we went down they told us to check out before we went to the transportation. The people at guest services took their time even though there was no one else there. They didn’t even say hello when we walked in. I waited and starred at them for a few minutes. By the time I checked out I went to the transportation and they said it left and it was a no show. The transportation company said it’s the hotels fault. The hotel family concierge said there was nothing they could do. So we ended up having to pay another $70 for a taxi.

We ended up doing the Melia circle presentation which honestly sounds like a good deal but based on my stay I wouldn’t want to go back. They basically tell you that if you’re a member, you would get the room as soon as you arrive, you would get the best treatment.  Which makes me feel like, I paid to be here and to have an all inclusive trip but because I didn’t buy in to their program, I do not get the best service. I have stayed at the Fiesta Americana and even paid less there but they gave us the best accommodations just for being their guest without having to sign up for anything. 

Lobby, pool and beach: 10/10

Food: 5/10 - the buffet is not great. The restaurants are 50/50. 

Alcohol: they did not have the best selection and even when I asked for recommendations they just said “we have everything” but really they don’t unless you pay extra

Rooms: 4/10. Apparently we got the upgraded suite but the rooms look outdated, shower smelled, paint was peeling, beds and pillows were hard and uncomfortable. 

Service: 2/10. There is a huge lack of communication and again, unless you have their “white wrist band” which we were even told in the presentation that they would put it on us so we could see how it feels to be treated better, you don’t get any special service and I don’t know if it’s because it’s off season but the workers don’t acknowledge you and are just on their phones and don’t seem to want to be there.

reviews.author: Jose M
reviews.title: Preferencias del personal y mala atención
reviews.text:
Muy mala atención, por parte de todos los meseros del malva, siempre se nota la preferencia ante el turista extranjero, al turista nacional, la camarista de nuestra habitación, nunca limpiaba bien y dejaba las cosas a medias muy mal, Servicio y y atención.  
Definitivamente no regresa regresaría a este hotel y no lo recomiendo para nada. Te hacen pasar muy malos ratos todo el personal mi estancia fue muy incómoda .

reviews.author: Fahd Khan
reviews.title: Good facility but bad management, would not recommend
reviews.text:
I have been going to beach resorts in Mexico with my family since 12 years, and this year we decided to go Paradisus in Cancun managed by Melia. After this experience I will prefer never to stay at a Melia property. 
First let me cover the positives and then explain why I would not recommend this hotel and never go there again myself. 
It is a good size hotel, gives a good impression upon arrival and has a massive swimming pool. The lobby area and restaurants look nice and overall the hotel has a nice vibe. There were shows every night we were there and they were fun. The waiters in the restaurants were friendly and accommodating offering special dishes for the kids.
Now to the negatives. Two main reasons.
1. Condition and Maintenance: Upon arrival we were assigned a room which was not in best shape, the shower was damaged and dirty, the couch was broken and walls were damaged (pictures attached). When I complained about it to the reception, they first shoved it off saying it’s a renovated room. Then I went and took the pictures and showed the staff, their response was that we will send house keeping. At this point I pushed stating this is not just a house keeping issue, I want to change room, which they did but clearly the lady at reception was not happy about it and did not provide any apology for assigning us a damaged and dirty room. In addition to this, the swimming pool is not very clean, there are dead insects floating around, we even saw a dead cockroach in the pool!
2. Too Commercial: The deal breaker for us is how commercial this place is, they are trying to upsell you things at every point. Upon our arrival a concierge member approached us stating that given that we are visiting from Europe (most visitors were American and Mexican) we are entitled to a free massage in return they request us to promote the hotel to our friends and family in Europe. When we requested the coupons for the massage he pushed us for attending a 40 minute description about their loyalty program. I clearly told this person, if this is about a time share or any kind of investment, I am not interested, to which he responded saying no nothing like that it’s about our Melia loyalty program and its benefits. So we went for it, it took more than an hour and it was a pitch for investing into a time share, exactly what I told them that I was not interested in. When I was clearly stating that I am not interested and will not make any investment decision during my holiday, the salesman (Mathew) even tried mocking me hinting that I am lying that I don’t discuss investment and work during holidays. Really unpleasant experience. But it doesn’t end there, the concept of all-inclusive is that you don’t carry around your money, in the all-inclusive hotels I have been to in Mexico before this one, the servers don’t expect any tips either as you are supposed to be cash free. At Paradisus Cancun this was not the case, every bar counter had a big tip jar in front of you and the kind of service you received from them and servers at pool area differed if you were tipping or not tipping. Then you have all these tour operators and water sports activities people walking around the hotel trying to grab you at every corner to try to sell to you. In the restaurants for several dishes you have to pay additional. Even during a massage, they tried to upsell using a better quality oil for the massage! Absolutely absurd.
The room experience gave it a bad start, the lie about timeshare left a bad taste overall and the constant dodging of people trying to sell you stuff did not make us feel relaxed. This is why I would never go back to this hotel and overall avoid Melia.
On top of all of this, Cancun is absurdly over priced. My last resort break was in Puerto Vallarta, I would rather recommend to go there instead of Cancun.

reviews.author: Slickstep18
reviews.title: What was once a great place to visit fell short in expectation.
reviews.text:
I would like to start that my family and I had stayed at Melia Paradisus two years ago for my birthday and had an great time. We decided to return and this time bring 38 people including family and friends to share in our experience.

What was once a great stay, Melia had fell short in their high standard of hospitality and quality of their property ( as a Melia club member).

Upon check-in on the 1st night the AC in our suite was not working, the lever in the bathroom was broken, jacuzzi jets were not operational, and at night found a cockroach in the kitchen unit.

I informed front desk at 845am the following morning regarding all my concerns. At 445pm I followed up with alternatives to our stay, and the front desk replied "still looking into it". They had the whole day to take action and find a resolution and nothing was  done. We then had to escalate to management and it wasn't until 7pm where we had to move our items. They seem to drag their feet in everything.

Throughout our stay you can see that the structure around the pool and inside the pool itself is falling apart. The walls has chunks of material missing, the ceiling under the bridge in the pool had panels gone. 

Even having informed front desk that I was celebrating my 40th Birthday bringing in 9 rooms 50+ room nights, the hotel fell short in taking care of their guests on a momentous occasion. 

The only saving grace is that the F&B staff was all exceptional, the food was great, and attentiveness to our needs in this department was met. 

This will probably be the last time we visit the property.

reviews.author: Leonardo Ruiz
reviews.title: FRAUDE en reservaciones en línea
reviews.text: Reservé en línea a través de un línk de Instagram. El link decía Melia.com y mi reservacion si se realizó. El problema está en que la aplicación me daba la opción de niños hasta 17 años. Tengo un hijo de 14 puse los datos necesarios y al llegar al hotel me dicen que los niños son máximo de 12 años y como el mio era más grande tenían que cobrarme a la persona extra a precio de front desk qué es el más caro de todos. Pagué 28 mil pesos por la reservacion y me querían cobrar 31 MIL PESOS DE MAS SOLO POR MI HIJO!!!! Un total fraude por engaños ya que al estar ahí no queda de otra más que pagar.  Además van a cerrar ese hotel y le dan  cero mantenimiento. Recomiendo evitar quedarse en el hotel Paradisus Cancun sobre todo si van con adolescentes.

reviews.author: GrandTour248827
reviews.title: Worst service ever
reviews.text:
I am rating this 2, thinking I should rate it a 1. A lot of things were horrible since day one of our arrival. I, along with my family, booked five rooms in total. I asked for at least two rooms to be together or close by to be with my kids, and they told me they couldn’t do that day until the following day. They gave me a room with one bed, although I had my babies. When I asked for two beds, they said my kids could sleep on the sofa bed, which was very thin, old, and uncomfortable. My kids had to sleep with us in bed; I couldn’t sleep. The following day, they sent me to a smaller room with one bed, so we had to go back to the old room, and the whole week, we had to sleep with my young kids, which was very uncomfortable although I was on vacation.

The worst of all was the service. I gave it a 0. They had no people to help, neither in the pool area, restaurants, or buffet. We couldn’t try the restaurants because every time we went to get a table, they would say 1 1/2 to 2 wait times, and by the time they had a table, the kitchen was going to be closed, so they didn't allow us even to put our name down. We had to eat at the buffet every night, and they usually had the same food and, again, no one to help us get our drinks or anything. We had to wait in line every morning for at least half an hour to have breakfast at the buffet. We go to different resorts yearly, and we have never experienced this. The reservation at the restaurant is a lot better.

Lastly, the hotel's entertainment was very short and very small. We even experienced no face painting for the kids because it was only for the kids at the kids' club. There was no entertainment past about 10. There was only one bar at night, and they closed early.

This has been the worst experience we had in many years. The only good thing was the beach in the hotel.

reviews.author: Matilda C
reviews.title: Paradisus cancun, staff made up for it’s shortcomings!
reviews.text:
Alejandro from nespresso as well as  Joni and Armando from aquamarina were awesome!! 
They were so accommodating and went over and beyond for us

The resort itself is very old and is dire need of repsirs

We stayed at the nikte section because it was supposed to be an upgrade.i honestly think it is not worth the extra $$$.
It’s supposed to come with a concierge but you can do without. It came with a free dinner at SAL. However, the free menu was not really impressive and there is a significant upcharge for the better steaks, etc. The aquamarina breakfast is reserved for nikte and reserve guests so i guess that was an advantage

The pools are kind of gross and the pool edges are very sharp. On our first day, there was a kid who actually tore her skin from one of these sharp edges. She had a gaping deep laceration and was bleeding pretty bad. It took so long for her to get medical attention. She was crying the whole time (naturally). 
Also, i wish there were more restrooms by the pools

Food wise- aquamarina, lemon fish and blue agave were great! The buffet was pretty standy, nothing special.
The drinks were not strong which is wha ti prefer! 

The rooms- old and needs repair. The balcony is small and dirty . We stayed in pyramid 3. There was a party poolside every night until past 11pm so was hard for us to sleep. The housekeeper kept our room clean and had it made up by the time we got back in the afternoon. Although everyday we had to call housekeeping to get our supply of water. Otherwise, it was not refilled

The worst though were the sales talk. We were bombarded everyday by people trying to sell us stuff. There are booths on the first 3 floors at multiple corners, hy the elevator, stairwell, as well as by the towel stand. So the first 2days we wasted time trying to look for routes that would avoid them. It was terrible! I wish paradisus would stop doing this. It really takes away from the vacation

reviews.author: jvongkha
reviews.title: Beach area is beautiful
reviews.text: We went with other family members. They didn't get their room upgrade that they booked and manager was hostile during the entire encounter. Customer service is lacking, buffet was ok. Restaurants were good and there was not much of a wait. Beach area is beautiful and best part of the stay.

reviews.author: Shawna
reviews.title: They need customer services skills and EDI (Equity, diversity & Inclusion)
reviews.text:
Horrible service! Never again! First of all the staff were not welcoming at all. 
I paid for 2 rooms with two beds. Checked in early and was told to come back at 3pm to activate our bracelets and get the room number. We'll, we were given a room with 1 bed and was told to come back the next morning. Meanwhile the guy behind us was given a room with two beds and he paid for one. Management was not accommodating. Oh not to mention the 2nd room they gave us flooded. I called guest services and no one came. When asked why no one came, I was brushed off. 
The only restaurant that had great food was Lemon Fish.

reviews.author: Lauren H
reviews.title: They could of did better!
reviews.text: I was very disappointed. It rained quite a bit during our vacation and the hotel had leaks all over. The floors were very slippery and wet. Couches in the lounge and restaurant areas were soaked and wet. Only one small elevator worked which was very inconvenient because I had a small child in a stroller. There were no slippers and robes in the room.  The phone in the room did not work and we had to communicate with room service via what’s app. They ran out of towels at the pool area. The bars and restaurants close at 11pm. The entertained was non existing. There was also trash left when we checked in our room. The ATM did not work. Lastly, we never received our complementary wine.

reviews.author: brendapgarcia
reviews.title: EL PEOOOR HOTEL, NO VAYAN
reviews.text:
Estuvimos una semana y todo fue HORRIBLE, hemos estado en Cancún muchas veces en diferentes hoteles, está ocasión quisimos probar el hotel Paradisus por los comentarios positivos y por cómo se venden pero fue la peor decisión, aquí les va el porque:
1. Check in la espera fue como de una hora, todos se quejaban del pésimo servicio.
2. La recámara no surtían diario el mini bar cuando supuestamente así iba a ser.
3. La comida de todos los restaurantes muy poco variada, con 3 opciones en el menú, el buffet horrible, sin variedad, pésimo sabor de los alimentos, no te hacen sentir all inclusive porque las mejores opciones de los menús tienen costo adicional.
4. Al 3er día encontramos una CUCARACHA en nuestra habitación.
5. Personal de mala actitud, todo aburrido, desde las 6 ya no dan alcohol en la alberca y desde 10 en todo el hotel ya no puedo tomar alcohol. 
6. La hora de espera para los restantes es de 2 horas.
7. Instalaciones viejas, les falta mucho mantenimiento, la televisión se veía negra, en si todo horrible.

NO VAYAN AL MENOS QUE QUIERAN REGALAR SU DINERO.

reviews.author: Tanya C
reviews.title: If you read any review read this one
reviews.text:
If you read any review read ours. We are a traveling family, our daughters have been everywhere since they were 7 days old (now 12 and 9) We own with Marriott Abound and are not new to traveling to Mexico, even St. Lucia, Jamaica, Antigua, Bermuda etc. We are not hard to please, do not expect perfection out of travel and hate complaining. To be honest of all the places we’ve travelled to this is the first negative review we’ve ever left. So here we go:
