When we arrived at 6:30 PM the front desk said they only had a king bed available after we booked 2 beds in FEB as we were traveling with our 9 and 12yr old. 
They said well we don’t have a room available so go eat or something and come back in an hour or so. When we came back they said we had to “upgrade” you to jr luxury suite because we couldn’t find 2 beds in your lagoon view, but it’s in the basement, floor “zero”. Wait what?! 
So we get to our “Upgraded suite” in the basement and we’re greeted with a malfunctioning AC, broken TV, a view of a BUSH, like no pool, no ocean, no lagoon. BUSHES!! 
The shower smelled like mold and leaked.
Broken toilet seat. Empty Fridge. 
My husband went back up to the front desk like please don’t do this, we were really looking forward to this vacation. Can you please even move us ONE floor up so we can have a view of the pool, ocean, lagoon etc. 
They took him to another room and said this is your only other option and showed us a room with view of the PARKING LOT, like literally shuttle vans and a McDonald’s sign! This was NOT a sold out resort, it was not packed, they HAD more available accommodations to offer but for some reason chose not to make sure we had a wonderful trip. The supervisor HAD the power and choice to deliver excellent customer service and ensure we were happy and comfortable but for reasons unknown chose otherwise. 
On our last full day we were contacted by guest services to ask how our stay was going, I am 100% positive my contact to the Melia International complaint department had everything to do with them reaching out. They tried to make up for all of our week long issues by offering us a “courtesy” pool side cabana for one day, a late check-out the following day and escape room tickets. When my husband asked for a night back instead they said “no we can’t do that”.  
I am not even joking when I say the cabana they gave us was beside the seafood restaurant that was under construction and smelt like sewage and mold. Someone was in the pool cleaning with a 50ft hose that we had to swim around! We thought they were just being funny at this point but they made us sign a paper basically accepting the “compensation” and ensuring we wouldn’t ask for anything else. Mind blowing!!! 
A couple things unrelated to check in, we had an entire resort power outage one night from 9pm-2am. In 106° weather, with a child with severe asthma and our room without any air conditioning for 5 entire hours was INSANE! My husband also got food poisoning 4 days in and was so sick the last 3 of our stay. 

The resort reminds me of a pig with lipstick. You’re distracted by the beautiful organic greenery and natural wooden elements, but the actual accommodations are very mediocre. Maybe if you stay in a suite in the adult only reserves you’ll have a different experience but we still spent $4,000 and feel so much was lacking. This will be our first and last time here. We enjoyed Seadust 10x more at half the price. Paradisus missed the tiny details that make a wonderful experience, unsure how it received such a high review. Had to have been from people who were drunk 90% of the time and notice anything else lol OR from the adults in the Reserve Adult Only section. 

Aside from all the above I will say the staff work HARD! They did not go unnoticed, 90% of them were so polite and friendly and eager to help. With the exception of the front desk/reservation staff. 
Alejandro at the Nespresso bar was one of the best humans we’ve ever had the pleasure of meeting. He was always smiling and happy, him and our 9 yr old daughter formed such a cute little friendship and she thought it was so funny how he would take her stuffed dragon and make it look like he was making our coffee and getting our treats for us lol 
Another positive is the views, the view of the ocean is unmatched. It’s so blue and absolutely stunning especially from the small pool with the glass showers. The actual beach area, however, was full of seaweed and just lacked so much. No maintenance team works down there to even attempt clean up throughout the beach area. 
This place has such potential but missed so many marks.

Here is our pro’s and cons of Paradisus Cancún: 

CONS:
👎🏼Pool closes at 7
👎🏼Atrium is SO hot (main areas inside are not air conditioned. Hot everywhere!! 
👎🏼Buffet is so hot the charcuterie section meat and cheese  looked wet from it being so hot. 
👎🏼Beach view is beautiful to look at until you get down there and it looks so trashy. 👎🏼The cabanas on the beach are old and broken looking.
👎🏼Pool chairs do not adjust so you are unable to lay flat or sit up straight. They are stuck at a 45° angle
👎🏼 there are not enough umbrellas for the source of the sun. There needs to be double what they have since they’re on a first come first serve basis. 
👎🏼 gym is nice but the attachments for the machines are rusted and the steel coating is coming off leaving metal slivers in your hands. 
👎🏼Shower has no shelves so toiletries sit on the ground and that’s just disgusting ESP when the shower smells like mold
👎🏼Shower leaks everywhere. Have to stuff towels under door. 
👎🏼Had to call for 3 days to get a fan and a cot. Called multiple times, went to the desk and called again before we were finally given one. 
👎🏼Have to call daily to restock fridge bec if you don’t ask they will not come. 
👎🏼 Buffet is just okay. Mostly vegetables and weird stuff like cactus and octopus. No fries or things kids will eat. Our kids ate corn and noodles with spaghetti sauce for 7 days lol
👎🏼first few days buffet and restaurants were so mellow and easy to get into. By day 5 there were literal lines to get in to the buffet to eat breakfast. It closes at 11am and I added a photo of the line at 9:30 am
👎🏼Very little entertainment for kids. Only saw 1-2 crafts. 
👎🏼the QR code they provide to check daily activities didn’t even work so when you scan it it says no activities scheduled today, every single day. Can only see them on the tv. 
👎🏼 buffet is hot, literally the cheese looks like it’s slipping away lol meat looks wet 🫣

PROS: 
👍🏽 the resort smells amazing, every floor just smells like the best scents, relaxing and subtle but noticeable (until you get random wiffs of mold and mildew)
👍🏽Staff (beside front desk) very friendly and helpful. They go above and beyond
👍🏽Bakery items from Nespresso cafe are homemade and SO good. Every drink from there is so good too. 
👍🏽June is a super hot month for Mexico however it worked in our favor bec we loved how mellow the atmosphere was.
👍🏽Pool was not too overcrowded at the beginning of our stay Tues-thurs 
👍🏽restaurants or cafe never crowded 
👍🏽If you like to drink they do keep the drinks coming. 
👍🏽
♥️Alejandro at nespresso is the best. Knew our 9yr old by name and what we liked. So friendly and always smiling. His red velvet cupcakes are the best I’ve EVER had anywhere. 
👍🏽The Italian restaurant is good. That was our fav.

reviews.author: Carolina D
reviews.title: Think twice about staying here
reviews.text: We travel to Cancun yearly and this was our first stay here. This was the worst experience we’ve had, the customer service was hit or miss. The rooms are average and dated, our AC in our room was mediocre. One night we ordered room service and had to wait almost 2 hours for it to be delivered to our room and to top it off last night the power went out in the whole hotel! No AC or running water! That was the last straw for me, I will never be staying at this hotel again. There are some good things about this hotel, there’s a lot of places to eat, the beach is beautiful, the hotel in general is beautiful but when you start seeing it up close you start to see its old and in need of renovations. Unfortunately the bad outweighs the good for me.

reviews.author: EMILIO M
reviews.title: Muy Mala Atención
reviews.text: Gran desilusión nos llevamos , fuimos en familia 17 personas , el día del check in fue un desastre , no encontraban las reservas de 7 habitaciones y a las ves muy poco amables , lo mismo ocurre en los restaurantes, muy poco amables , lentos y cuando se aproxima la hora de cerrar , corren . La comida buena . Cuartos normales . Muy buena pileta , con 200 reposeras y 10 sombrillas , para días de 28/38 . No recomendable , estoy todavía en el hotel .

reviews.author: Natalia
reviews.title: Skip this place
reviews.text:
I wouldn't recommend Paradisus Cancun. Having stayed at their Playa del Carmen branch, I found it to be vastly superior in terms of room amenities, treatment, and professionalism.

To start, upon arrival, I had a birthday room upgrade, but Enrique tried to charge me extra despite the promotion clearly stating the upgrade was at no additional cost. The manager, David, claimed it was subject to availability and couldn't accommodate the upgrade, even though two members of my party received upgrades without any vouchers, both before and after my check-in. The lack of professionalism was evident throughout.

A few days later, my sister had a major slip and fall due to a leak from the roof. Overall, it was an unpleasant stay, and I won't be returning to the Paradisus Cancun location.

reviews.author: Shiv Panda
reviews.title: Extremely Disappointing!
reviews.text:
I’m writing this review in the middle of my vacation at Cancun and at Paradisus Cancun. It’s been disappointing so far. 

1) They really need to find a solution to the extreme heat and sweat one encounters in their lobby. There are NO air conditioners there and honestly it makes it really difficult to even wait in the lobby beyond 15-20 minutes. The only areas where you would see the air conditioners working are the small area wherein you “check in”. Again, this place is very crowded most of the time and small.

2) The folks at the checkin/guest desk need to be sensitized in terms of how to deal with hotel guests who do not speak Spanish. I’m not saying they are rude but then there were many issues when we checked in. We were not told which floor are our rooms. The entire hotel map is very confusing. The rooms elevators are very slow and few and it took us almost 30 plus minutes to find our room with all of our bags. Remember, one cannot use the elevators to go to our rooms (rooms are 30xx series for us). 

3) The mens restroom near the checkin was broken and there was no water. I had to complain to couple of folks and I’m not sure if it was repaired or not?

4) Food - Overall, we have found the food to be very average. There are hardly any options for folks who don’t eat meat. Also, no Asian or Indian food selections in Malva (their buffet restaurant) makes it very difficult for folks like us. I’m sincerely hoping the hotel management takes this feedback into consideration and plans a really diverse cuisine experience.

5) The rooms are outdated in my opinion and I was probably given the worst rooms they had. Remember, I had booked 3 junior suites and there is no resort view or anything from these rooms. The AC stops and starts every 15-20 minutes and it is very annoying and does not allow for a peaceful sleep at night. I even told them that I’m a returning a customer having stayed at their sister property at Punta Cana but to no avail. 

Advice to management - please really start implementing the feedback that travelers share with you.

reviews.author: Andrés W
reviews.title: Primera Decepción del servicio del Melia
reviews.text:
Empiezo por las cosas positivas el muy buen trato y atención recibido por mi hijo en el Kidsdom , especialmente por Yami, Monse y Gove, gracias a eso mi hijo tuvo una buena estadía en el hotel. En el bar Sport la atención de Cristian, Karina y Gladys  y en el restaurant Malva la atención de Ramiro.
Las negativas 
A  excepción de la buena atención recibida citada anteriormente, en general la atención de los demas colaboradores del hotel no fue buena
Poca variedad de comidas en el buffett del Malva donde además en el desayuno tardaban en reponer los panes, las frutas, los quesos y demas, solo funcionaba una isla para la preparación de omelettes y huevos por lo que uno podía perder 15 minutos en la fila.
 En el sector de la playa donde están las reposeras cerca del Kanna nunca fue un mesero a atendernos siendo que las veces que iba hasta el bar había una gran cantidad pero solo atendían parece a los kamastros.
Primer hotel que voy que hasta las 11 se peuden ofrecer beibidas alcoholicas, nose la razón

reviews.author: Jenna G
reviews.title: I just don’t know.. I’m speechless
reviews.text:
I contemplated writing a review but I wouldn’t want anybody to experience what I did.
Pros - Lily, she is one of the most accommodating and responsive associates I came across here. She is the reason why I didn’t leave on my second day here.
The food is okay, it’s not terrible.
The beach area is beyond kept and beautiful, the waves are rough here though so if you like to swim at the beach then this isn’t for you.
Amenities are good
The smell of the reserve area was everything
The sunset cruise was included free of charge
This hotel is aesthetically gorgeous.
Cons -
We arrived early to check in (11a) and were told to wait 4 hours for our room…… requested a Manager and never talked to one, I practically had to get up and find one… never found one, I then met Lily and expressed my concern.
The quality of food and food options.
There are up charges all throughout the hotel which negatively impacted my experience. We were incorrectly charged for 2 drinks at Cielo, which was about $55. (Picture below)
The staff basically ignored us at the pool area
The pool is very WARM and low in elevation
The drinks are not top shelf, just full of sugar. They have bars with top shelf but will charge you about $20 per shot. They have coconuts at the Beach and charge you $10 for these and only have coconut water????
My room was so HOT (80°F precisely), we called on maintenance 4 times throughout our stay and had to request fans. We couldn’t even leave our window open.
The property could use updating
The adults steakhouse has minimal options with subpar food, the best food was honestly the pool restaurant and Mexican.
There is no beach attendant??
They advertised cabanas to be included with The Reserve but this solely means pool cabanas and They must be reserved 24 hours in advance, the beach view are $160 and you have to buy a food package… at a resort?? ALSO they have 6 whole chairs that lay flat for tanning, the rest are permanently adjusted at an angle.
The towels in the bathroom are ROUGH
Oh, also transportation is not included as advertised on their website so expect $100+
There was an issue also with my room upgrade, I requested and paid for an ocean view with 2 beds. I was then emailed and quoted a lower price by their in house reservation team and they did not offer a refund or credit for the difference I paid.. instead I was charged for the upgrade a second time upon checking Out and They practically held us and held our transportation until this was resolved. I showed the emails, receipts, and conversation but was treated less than human.
I mean I could go on for days.
Overall, I would not stay here again or recommend it. There are hotels that check boxes of all necessities needed to enjoy your stay. (This is coming from someone who’s traveled to Mexico over 20 times). Expect a bill at check out… even though this is a all inclusive resort.

reviews.author: LAURA A
reviews.title: Mala
reviews.text:
1. El elevador no tiene aire acondicionado y es un horno.
2. No cuentan con sombrillas suficientes en las albercas, 5 en toda la piscina y es sumamente molesto.
3. Todas las amenidades se acaban a las 11 y es no hay algún lugar para distraerse.
4. Los conectores para la luz no son suficientes y los que hay no funcionan.
5. Meseros en la piscina no son los necesarios para todos los huéspedes.
6. Cobran todas las camas que cubren del sol.

reviews.author: Quemiller40
reviews.title: Roaches, nats and loud music
reviews.text: There is a gap in the doors and I saw a roach run into our room. I killed it and thought that was just a one off. A couple days in we found more running around. Nasty! There were nats all in the room and hotel. The toilet stop flushing on day 3 and our concierge wasn’t too helpful when it came to booking reservations.

reviews.author: Diego M
reviews.title: Dissapointed
reviews.text:
I`m very disappointed with all experience and how the employees managed problems on their side. I was also thinking about becoming a Circle Melia member but give up after the whole experience.
I booked 2 rooms (one for my family with 2 kids and another for my parents). The check-in was supposed to be at 3pm but my parent`s room were not ready – only 4 pm. So I invite my parents to take a shower and drop all they luggage in my room in the meantime. At 4 pm their room had NO drinks and snacks (we paid for them) and they only dropped drinks and snacks the following day at nighttime. Same happened to my room regarding snacks. 
After me calling DAILY to ask to restock the drinks and snacks we spent 2 days with 1 less towel as I was sharing the same towel with my wife. I called twice but they only brought an extra towel 48 hours later after me complaining with the Guest Center at the Hotel.
Besides that, my rooms were not clean and was full of dust on the floor + a super noisy air conditioner making our sleep nights more difficult. My parents’ rooms had a clothing drawer completely broken and falling apart and they also killed two little roaches in their bathroom.
Talking about bathroom. My parents’ bathroom was leaking water since the first day and my mom hurt her feet at first day as she didn’t see the water on the floor. I called Guest Service and they said they fixed but the issue was still all days during our stay so my mother just left a huge towel on the floor to avoid her falling again.
After ALL those issues on both rooms I went to the guest service and the employee wrote down everything and did NOTHING else. “Thank you Sir. We`ll use this to improve ourselves”.
That was unbelievable for me so I spoke with the Concierge Manager about all above. After that she asked me to go back and talk to the Guest Service Manager again and believe me due to all the situation, he offered me a plain cabana to spend the day. I told him that we don’t use cabana as the kids uses the pool all the time.. So he tried to convince me adding one side of “Chicken with Nachos” for my cabana. I thought that he was joking as this plate is offered for free for all guests.  
I did not accept his offer and following day he texted me saying that was TRYING to get approval to get tickets for “Escape Room”. I gently replied him saying: I`m not coming to Cancun to spend hours in a Escape Room with 2 little kids + 2 senior people" BAD TEAM ..BAD HOTEL.

reviews.author: Paradise22253242049
reviews.title: Muito Mau
reviews.text: Estive neste hotel há 17 anos e regressei agora com os meus filhos. Foi uma autentica desilusão. O hotel na evoluiu NADA, parece parado no tempo. Os quartos estão velhos e degradados , o buffet com muito pouca comida internacional e muita comida Mexicana barata, pouca escolha. Deixou de existir o melhor restaurante que era de grelhados de peixe e marisco. Para um 5* deixa mesmo muito a desejar.

reviews.author: Nancy K
reviews.title: Coffee and hot showers hard to get
reviews.text:
The hotel is visually beautiful.  I loved that it is not done in that dark neo-dungeon style that is so popular now. Instead, there are hanging plants and natural materials that make the environment very welcoming.

The staff is very friendly and helpful.  The food was also good, ranging from good to excellent.  However, they need to work on labeling foods for gluten and vegan.  The male waiters did not care about gluten, but the female wait staff were more in tune to the requirements of someone with celiac disease.  The hotel needs to really work on labelling the foods on the menu and in the buffet for gluten and vegan.

If your idea of a vacation is to relax with a cup of coffee or tea on your beautiful porch in the morning then don’t stay here.  There is no coffee maker in the room, and you have to go all the way down to the first floor and stand in a long line to get a cup of coffee.  The hotel should put big coffee urns and muffins on each floor, or coffee makers in each room.

If you like a hot shower before dinner, don’t stay here.  The shower at 5 pm was not even slightly warm.  It was cool.

There are 8 floors and 4 elevators in building 3 but most of the time one or two of the elevators were not working.  Someone pointed out the head maintenance person as he snuck by and I told him both of the elevators in one bank were stranded on two floors, but he did not care.  He just made a face, said they were busy, and hurried into the staff room.

There are not enough electrical outlets in the bedroom for charging and the one outlet that was not hidden looked spongy and improvised (room 3427).  It was difficult to get a charger to stay in it.

While we were there a ceiling panel at the entrance to the beach fell on a woman and she was bloody and appeared injured.

This hotel does not need to renovate the decor, that would be a waste of money.  But the infrastructure is badly in need of updating and the head maintenance guy might need to be replaced.

reviews.author: Abner C
reviews.title: Not the best place.
reviews.text: The place is nice but the pool crew next to the reserve is very disrespectful. I’m Latino and they only care to serve white Americans or white Spanish people. One of them even told me a sex joke to verify my sexual orientation and was a bad experience if you’re on vacation.

reviews.author: Reza A
reviews.title: Nice views, good food, lineups and poor service
reviews.text:
Our family of three, consisting of a couple and an eleven-year-old, from Toronto, Canada. We travel regularly to destinations in the sun. 

Our recent experience at Paradisus Cancún left us with mixed feelings. While the resort boasts a picturesque setting, we encountered numerous challenges during our stay, ranging from limited amenities to poor management decisions.

Check-in, Staff, and a Safety Incident:
The check-in process was slow and poor, lack of staff authority, requiring constant referral to higher management for even basic requests. Despite generally friendly interactions, the staff seemed not motivated to address guest needs promptly or even to listen and show a basic level of empathy, demonstrating a lack of understanding of the basics in the hospitality world. We did, however, witness a commendable response from management during a safety incident (hair dryer was so old that it caught fire while being used).  

Amenities and Swimming Pools:
Despite the resort's sprawling size, it fell short in providing essential amenities commensurate with its capacity. Access to necessities like towels and showers was often accompanied by long queues, with inadequate seating and umbrellas causing further inconvenience at both the pools and beach. All these easily manageable to address, however, no sign of any willingness to help and or even trying to improve. 

Night Entertainment and Dining:
Nightly entertainment offerings were underwhelming, lacking quality, adequate seating and a designated stage area. 

On the culinary front, while the food quality ranged from acceptable to good, the constant upselling of additional items excluded from all-inclusive and the exclusion of certain restaurants from the all-inclusive package left much to be desired.

Drinks and Rooms:
While the resort offered a decent selection of beverages, the frequent extra charges for certain items detracted from the all-inclusive experience. Any wine other than house wine, cava or Sake are all extra! Even Coconut juice is extra!!!

Room quality varied inconsistently, with multiple relocations necessary due to maintenance issues and inadequate bedding options. Air conditioning units are located in the ceiling of the rooms as individual units.  Very noisy and hardly able to control the temperature and humidity in the rooms.  

In conclusion, our experience at Paradisus Cancún left us dissatisfied with the overall value for money. The resort's shortcomings in amenities, service, and room quality overshadowed its scenic beauty. We have no intention of returning and would advise seeking alternative resorts in the area offering better value and more guest-focused management.

reviews.author: Sherpa28292340476
reviews.title: Mixed Bag.
reviews.text:
Clean, great location, amazing beach, food at the various restaurants was good. Wait staff super friendly and hospitable. Hotel is pretty cool, designed after a cenote. 

But. 

Asked a concierge a question and got totally roped into a really long "presentation" of the Melia Circle Membership, which, despite being told explicitly that 1) it would be less than an hour and 2) it would be no-pressure, it was over 2 hours long and seriously stressful high pressure sales pitch for their version of a timeshare, which they don't say is a time share, but is, as far as I can tell. Luckily we got away unscathed and didn't sign anything, but it was frustrating to say the least. Also felt very much like a scam, but I'll leave it there. 

Secondly, one late afternoon we called for housekeeping service, and for maintenance/management (?) to come to our room for a maintenance issue. We left the room for a couple of hours. When we returned, the safe (tucked away in the closet) was open, and over $300 had been stolen - from the safe. 

If it had not been for these two incredibly negative experiences, this would have been a 5-star review.

reviews.author: raulwarnholtz
reviews.title: Mal servicio, habitaciones muy viejas y buena comida, pero no regresaría, hay mejores opciones en Cancún por este precio
reviews.text:
El hotel tiene algunas zonas remodeladas, pero las habitaciones se perciben muy viejas, lo único bueno de la habitación es que tenía un jacuzzi.

La comida está rica, de buena calidad, y la atención del personal del restaurante Malva, bastante bien. Ojalá esa calidad de atención se pudiera permear al resto del hotel. Porque los recepcionistas, no están bien capacitados, no conocen bien sus procesos ni los servicios con los que cuenta el hotel; y lo peor es que contestan mal encargados y de mala gana. 

Room Service lo intente usar 2 veces y no pude, la primera tardaron casi 2 horas y nunca llegó la comida, quizás se les olvidó, pero me casé de esperar y tuvimos que bajar a cenar y la segunda vez no servía su sistema y no pudieron tomar mi orden.

Los bell Boys groseros, el personal del restaurante Mascalzone también, en fin, tuve varias incidencias en mi estancia que me dejaron un mal sabor de boca de este hotel, lástima porque era un hotel bueno y se vino a mal. Por el precio definitivamente hay muchas mejores opciones en Cancún.

reviews.author: gkoskinas75
reviews.title: Auful
reviews.text: Second and last time in Paradisus .first time was amazing this time not sure from where to start and finish. Most important room awful in pyramid 1. Receptionist in the front unwilling to help and unfriendly and bothered from my questions . I paid for upgraded room and they gave us the worst of the worst . So noisy small outdated room 1king while I requested 2 quenns because we re a family of 3. Never again

reviews.author: Saumei L
reviews.title: Si son jóvenes no vayan (20s-30s)
reviews.text: Separe el hotel all inclusive adults only reserve experience. Y la verdad que no tuvo nada de lujo ni de 5 estrellas. El servicio al menos de nuestro concierge fue pésimo. El estado de las habitaciones mal, tiempo de espera más de las 3 (hora del check in) para que nos dieran las habitaciones mal. No les recomiendo para nada el restaurante SAL. PÉSIMO servicio y demoraron 2 horas en servirnos la comida que estaba normal. En tema de bebidas, ofrecen cocteles diluidos, shots diluidos y licores premium inexistentes. La zona de la posiciona era el 90% adultos de mayor edad, y no ponian ni música alta.  no había vida nocturna en el hotel y el único karaoke/sports bar con DJ cerraban temprano y el servicio del bar fue terrible.

reviews.author: kasolira4
reviews.title: La sección reserve no vale la pena
reviews.text: Desde el momento del check-in, nos prometieron dos habitaciones dobles, pero nos asignaron una king y una doble. A pesar de tener un "personal concierge", nunca respondía a nuestros mensajes. La calidad de las habitaciones dejaba mucho que desear: una de ellas no tenía puerta de baño y una cortina estaba rota. La comida en general era insatisfactoria, especialmente en el restaurante Sal, donde esperamos 30 minutos por el pan de cortesía y 2 horas por la carne, la cual llegó mal cocida en todos los términos (algunos estaban medio hechos y otros muy poco hechos). Nunca recibimos el alcohol "premium" que se suponía estaba incluido, ni siquiera nos lo ofrecieron. A pesar de pedir varias veces que rellenaran los nespresso pods negros (que contenían cafeína), nunca lo hicieron. Además, en el segundo día, tuvimos que pedir que limpiaran la habitación porque ya eran las 5 de la tarde y nadie lo había hecho

reviews.author: Polett Banda
reviews.title: De regreso y mala experiencia en Aguamarina
reviews.text:
Es notable que han surgido áreas de oportunidad, en servicio, sabor de los alimentos que pasaron de muy buenos a simplones y en algunos casos ligeramente desabridos, estamos hospedados en la torre 1 de Club Melia y es notable el deterioro de las habitaciones, sin duda hace falta renovación de las áreas, así como actualizar el hotel y poner instalaciones para niños.

Hoy que es nuestra segunda noche de reserva (aunque llevamos años de socios y vacacionamos seguido en los Paradisus) cenamos en un restaurante llamado Aguamarina, con la especialidad de mariscos, aunque parecería que se especializan mas en meseros neuróticos, donde fuimos "atendidos" por Miguel, quien parecia mesero de cantina, a todo momento atendiendo de prisa, grosero, desafiante, distraído y necio, trayendo lo que quería cuando quería, y asegurando que cada cosa que se le olvidaba era nuestra culpa porque no se lo pedimos, en fin, la situacion fue escalando a la par de la decepción  hasta que el otro mesero, llamado Wilber, que cabe mencionar que nos atendió bien, tuvo que disculparse por él, "pidiendo comprensión porque Miguel estaba un poco acelerado ya que andaba raro ese día", a palabras del buen Wilber.

Por supuesto, despues de que la queja fue escalonando, el mesero Miguel fue poniendose al Tú x Tú con nosotros y pedimos hablar con el capitán Rafael, quien tardó en llegar, y fue amable pero con una personalidad muy tibia, arregló el problema a su estilo, que dudo sea efectivo o por lo menos funcional  dada la pésima atención y manejo de su equipo de trabajo, a juzgar por el poco respeto que le muestran, y lástima porque la comida que había probado hasta ese momento era de regular a buena, aunque nada destacable, pero ya no seguímos comiendo porque la situación nos quitó el apetito.

No todo es malo, terminamos retirandonos casi sin comer, porque sinceramente no nos sentíamos cómodos de comer alli.

Pasamos a otro restaurante  que está  escazamente promocionado, llamado Flora, que nos sorprendieron los platillos, LO MEJOR QUE HEMOS COMIDO EN PARADISUS CANCUN, desde los langostinos al carbón, el pulpo al olivo o algo así, Sopa de tomate, ensaladas deliciosas y postres exquisitos, y con un servicio amable, organizado y donde se nota un manejo totalmente controlado de la A a la Z, es de ESTRICTA VISITA cuando alguien venga al paradisus Cancún. 

En este momento estamos hospedados en la habitación y definitivamente mañana volveremos a deleitarnos con el servicio y sabor de Flora, y con la fabulosa atención de Tere la capitán, que sería bueno que le enseñara a Rafael como motivar a su equipo, y a la mesera que su trato nos hizo recordar porqué decidimos comprar hace muchos años la membresía, entre tanta delicia que probabamos olvidamos su nombre, pero gracias a Tere y a Ella por cambiar nuestra mala experiencia en el restaurante Aguamarina.

reviews.author: Cynthia D
reviews.title: Trouble in Paradisus
reviews.text:
Pros - Near Airport, ocean front
Cons- Sudden water shut-offs, ours lasted for 7 hrs in all of the 3 ocean front Nikté rooms we reserved on 2 out of our 4 night stay.  No water for flushing toilets, sinks, nor showers from 11am-6pm.  When water was restored to our rooms, our sinks did not drain.  Our room keys (bracelets) had to be reset several times.  On one occasion, the lock system needed a battery and we needed to go back and forth to the front desk for assistance.   Rooms are not maintained to the standard of a 4 star hotel, let alone a 5 star hotel.  Mini bar was never restocked during our 4 night stay.  Room service was not included in the all-inclusive prices.  At The Blue Avage Restaurant, our server did not get any of our orders right and refused to bring extra guacamole to our table.  Our flight was unexpectedly changed by American Airlines and had to check-out 1 day early.  We explained and showed evidence of the change to no avail.  We were charged for the extra night anyway.  We were also charged for the days we experienced the water shut-offs.  Not sure what recourse there is for when guests are left without water in their rooms.  Overall, our stay was not up to par with what we are accustomed to in a 5 star accommodation.

reviews.author: hodan13
reviews.title: Disappointed customer
reviews.text: For a supposedly a five star resort, the jacuzzi had a leak & a bad pump. Mini fridge was wobbly bcuz it had one broken leg. Noisy party goers outside of our room. Guest attendants couldn’t help with me and other guest issues. Some of the restaurants were under staff, had longer wait to be seated.

reviews.author: Jocelyn R
reviews.title: Limited Mobility Review
reviews.text:
Hello Everyone, 
My wife and I travelled to Paradisus Cancun for 5 nights. My wife uses a $10,000 manual custom wheelchair. We booked our trip with a travel agent, and we requested an accessibility room. In a call to the resort one week before departure, we explained that we would need a barrier-free bathroom and shower. We were assured that would happen. This was our first vacation in over 10+ years since my wife lost use of her lower half. 
When we arrived, the hotel had a LARGE curb to enter after offloading from the bus. 
The hotel issues us our FIRST room. While it may be rated accessible, it is not. In the Bathroom, you can not even access the toilet due to a sliding door and a commode; the shower has a lip of 2 inches, and in the bedroom, my wife could not even wheel over to the bed and turn her chair around. 
We were unpacking when we heard a LOUD PLOP and found the ceiling in the sink. We called the front desk and were informed that we would need to change rooms, but there were no other accessible rooms. My wife and I were trying to have a good vacation and work well together, so we said anything is better than no room. She can access the bathroom or bed without help due to the turn radius. 
Off to room two; this is where things are funny. The second room, which was the same grade as the room, had a better bathroom. While she could not take her chair into the shower, she could access the toilet on her own. Best of all, she could reach the bed and turn around alone. 

The resort is NOT accessible. The ramps to the pools are ski slopes that are beyond slick. I speak Spanish, and my wife does not; witnessing the unkind remarks spoken behind my wife's back was more than I could handle. The restaurants are less than accommodating. The Mexican restaurant had a very large glass door that the staff did not open, requiring my wife to struggle to open, and Asian fusion required 2-6 steps to enter each of the huts. 
The buffet was frustrating to navigate when you were on your own. She would try and wheel with her plate on her lap. The staff were less than helpful. There is zero ramp to the beach. 

Sent bombs. The hotel has sent sprayers every 20 feet, spraying out smells so strong you taste it. If you have asthma, good luck. 

The coffee vendor was the one spot of joy for my wife. The morning guy would see my wife and come down to her (4 steps down) and ask her what she wanted and bring it to her.

reviews.author: 936sean
reviews.title: Pool side bar us great but thats it.
reviews.text: The staff at the pool swim up bar is fantastic.  The rest of the staff is friendly and good.  The management team is poor.  Very day there was food and dity plates left outside of rooms for up to 18 hours.  Tables were not well cleaned in the restaurants.  Just bad management.

reviews.author: juancho992024
reviews.title: Febrero = Temporada alta = Mala idea para vacacionar
reviews.text: El aire acondicionado de la habitación, sonaba horrible. En el baño, no hay batas ni bolsas para lavandería. Los camastros de la alberca, totalmente apartados sin ser ocupados por alguna persona desde las 7 de la mañana. Sólo hay dos baños para mujeres en el área de las piscinas, por lo que, se hacen filas interminables, además de que están muy lejos de las mismas. Llegamos a las 5 de la tarde, hambrientos y cansados y no había ningún restaurante disponible. Un comentario más... El área de recepción es muy pequeña para el tamaño del hotel, además de que las instalaciones ya lucen muy viejas (nada que ver con la galería de fotos de la página web

reviews.author: lucicasi
reviews.title: While entertainment department was great, the service was definitely lacking and rooms were not up to par.
reviews.text: Rooms smelled of mold and we had water issues outside our room that caused several people in our party to slip and fall and no one really did much about it after bringing it to managements attention. Our larger party was not accommodated at Capella, which originally we were fine with to splitting up however then they would seat other large parties. Staff was selective in who they would accommodate and who they wouldn't. The gift shops were vastly overpriced and everything was an upsell so definitely be cautious and ake sure to bring the lotions, sunscreens, aloe, kids floaties, etc that you need if you come here otherwise they take advantage and charge 10x more.

reviews.author: Latrail31
reviews.title: I WILL NOT BE BACK!!!!
reviews.text: Second time visiting Cancun, different resort, same experiences...feeling ignored and overlooked simply because of the color of my skin is NOT COOL...ESPECIALLY when I tip each and every staff member that assists me.  Not to mention, I only enjoyed the buffet food for the most part (SMH)..oh and the wings from the beach bar ...everything  else including drinks...SUBPAR!!!

reviews.author: mareaps
reviews.title: Pésima experiencia
reviews.text:
vista al mar!
Y para abundar, al solicitar el cambio respectivo a sugerencia de Viajes Palacio que fue mi agente de viajes, me la ofrecen al siguiente día con un horario de entrega a las 4 pm cuando lo normal sería a las 3 pm, en suma, una PÉSIMA EXPERIENCIA EN UN HOTEL DE UNA CADENA PRESIGIOSA Y SUPUESTAMENTE DE CALIDAD MUNDIAL Y POR CIERTO, NADA BARATO

reviews.author: cmikkelman
reviews.title: Worst dining experience ever
reviews.text: The room was great as was most of the staff . However the experience of service at every restaurant except the steak cave was horrible. The servers never made you feel welcome and never really provided decent service. I don’t know if it was because I was a solo diner but I always felt unwelcome and uncomfortable. Actually the worst dining service I have ever had and I am a restaurant owner myself so I know a little about dining service. Very disappointed to say the least.

reviews.author: Fernando M
reviews.title: No volvería a este hotel en mi próxima visita a Cancun
reviews.text:
El hotel y sus instalaciones son muy buenas. La comida y calidad de la misma EXCELENTE. 
Críticas, lo PEOR los tragos. Pésima calidad para esta categoría de hotel, Margarita de bidón, vasos de plástico.
Poco mantenimiento de los baños. Tuvimos varios inconvenientes en diferentes habitaciones 
No reponen algunos días los snacks y café de las habitaciones

reviews.author: demcodever
reviews.title: Los alimentos incluidos en el paquete dejan mucho que desear y el servicio aún más. Los alimentos pagados están de 10!!!
reviews.text: Deben mejoras la atención al huésped y el tiempo de espera en los restaurantes todo incluido, posiblemente organizar mejor los tiempos de espera mediante reservaciones, la actitud del personal que recibe en los restaurantes es pésima

reviews.author: Matias F
reviews.title: Disappointing Week.
reviews.text: Disappointing to have an experienced a complex and room with broken AC. Not much was done to remedy the situation. In fact they didn’t seem to care. Don’t expect much from the entertainment staff. Buffet variety was lacking. A la carte restaurants were ok.

reviews.author: Enrique G
reviews.title: Solía ser un muy buen lugar.
reviews.text:
Felicidades a Stelian mi concierge y al equipo del restaurante de alberca/playa en The Reserve incluyendo a Gaby, Valeria y a los chicos de negro. Si, gran parte del personal pone todo de su parte para que tengas una muy buena experiencia. Aquí algunos de los puntos por los cuales pensaría seriamente el regresar a este hotel al cual tengo varios años asistiendo:
HABITACIÓN: En el muro de la cabecera de la cama hay una tira de leds la cual es un buen detalle. Sin embargo, en mi habitación no se apagaban del todo por lo que durante la noche tenias luz en la cara. A pesar de haberlo reportado en repetidas ocasiones, mantenimiento no hizo nada durante toda la estancia. Bastante incómodo. Igualmente se hizo el reporte de un problema en la regadera el cual fue reparado mediocremente.
RESTAURANTES: Para los restaurantes de especialidad alguien tuvo la idea de eliminar el sistema de reservaciones. Ahora, uno debe anotarse al momento del consumo ante lo cual se tiene la respuesta de regresar dentro de hora y media!!! Esto no es lo ideal, verdad? En el caso de “Cielito Lindo” el comentario de la hostess fue que, a pesar de haber mesas disponibles, solo tenia un mesero y un cocinero por lo que no podía asignar mesas.
RECEPCIÓN: Siendo las 2:50 pm me indican que vaya a comer y regrese mas tarde ya que la política del hotel es entregar las habitaciones a las 3:00 pm. Really? Espere ahí mismo hasta que dieron las tres en punto. A esa hora tengo el comentario que “no hay certeza de que la habitación esté limpia” y que no hay comunicación con el area correspondiente. Efectivamente, en Housekeeping no contestaban el teléfono.
ROOM SERVICE: Llamé a solicitar más cápsulas de Nespresso (hay cuatro en la habitación), recibí por respuesta que esa era mi asignación diaria y que no me las llevarían, cosa que cumplieron. Comento que en cuatro días solamente consumí: dos coca cola light, unos cacahuates, un paquete de Oreos y si, bastante café. Parece que hay una nueva definición sobre ALL INCLUSIVE.
EVENTOS: Asistí a una plática en su salón principal. Se sirvió la comida al final de la misma. Los platillos se puede decir eran “minimalistas” por no decir escasos además de que si se requería algo mas que agua, uno debía salir de la sala a conseguir la ansiada bebida.

CONCLUSIÓN: En esta ubicación lo pagado bien lo valía. En esta ocasión no lo fue. La razón de mi visita fue un evento de una institución. No pagué la tarifa del evento sino que me registré normalmente pagando la tarifa “full” en The Reserve por lo que no hay pretexto de que tenía una tarifa reducida. En fin, recibí comentarios de los ejecutivos de la institución organizadora que muy probablemente el próximo año no regresemos, con justa razón y es una lástima. Cuando aquí mismo comenté que no regresaría a Melia Nuevo Vallarta hace cinco años, claro que lo cumplí!!!

reviews.author: Fabiola B.
reviews.title: Would never go on my own means.
reviews.text:
Went to a conference the 2nd week of January. The food, drinks and ambience is ok. The last day I was there, flees bit me all night. Left early and couldn’t report. Room 3120 so you can disinfect it. Last year tennis shoes were stolen from my room without any help. Would never go on my own means. There are better hotels in that zone.
.

reviews.author: AshL
reviews.title: Never Again - READ before you book!
reviews.text:
We’ve been to 20 resorts that rank in the same category, and this is by far the worst. We’ve never had issues with food illness until now. Will write the pros and cons:

PROS
-Caesar and Oscar on the Reserve and a few of the other servers were great 
-Bed was comfortable 
-Adequate Towels 
-beautiful ocean and sand 
-interesting building and beautifully done inside with the water features and plants 
-decent sized fitness center and equipment 

CONS
- good chance of food poisoning and don’t expect an apology of if you do get sick. Do expect a hefty bill from the resort doctor ($700USD)  if medical attention is required. 
- Restaurants are busy and you can’t make reservations even when staying in the reserve and paying a premium for a better experience. 
- Buffet food is always cold and a lot of what is served for food  in the restaurants is not edible. Such a shame and a waste to see so many plates dumped because it’s not edible. The reserve restaurant has beef items that can’t even be chewed through just gristle and poor quality meat (tacos, skewers etc.) and the fish is not fresh and very fishy. Mexican restaurant is the worst we’ve ever had and even the staff said “don’t eat there.”  The Italian had some ok options. The steak restaurant was better but most good items are an up-charge and some very unsettled stomachs after the meal. 
- We felt forced to eat off the resort for our remaining meals and that cost definitely added up. There are some amazing restaurants across the street and within walking distance. 
- The AIR CONDITIONING barely works in the room, especially in the morning. Im guessing this is due to the poor construction and single pane windows that have no insulation to keep the cool air in. The vents are gross and dirty. You can’t enjoy the ocean view from your room without having extreme heat issues. So the blackout curtains need to be fully shut for the temperature to be tolerable. Such a shame when you pay a premium for the ocean view. 
- Pool is constantly dirty and has a yellow oily film on top on sections. It doesn’t filter properly because the water level is too low for it to reach. The staff kept blaming it on sunscreen but that pool was not that busy at all and should not be the excuse. Pools with 100+ people in it never have that same problem. 
- outdated rooms and not deeply cleaned (dirty stained curtains, dust etc.) see photos. 
- Certain staff have attitude when matters are brought to their attention (Cecilia and some room service staff). She basically told our group to leave if we didn’t like it and had food poisoning. Very unprofessional. 
- Coffee can take more than an hour to get delivered. First morning it took 1.5 hrs 
- Room service is cold and meals are rarely prepared properly. The fries were not even cooked and raw. Breakfast is cold but probably has the most flavour. 
- Nespresso in the room only has two flavours - the darkest possible espresso and decaf. Most days we were only stocked with decaf and when we asked for more creamer it was a wild goose chase every time. 
- Spoke to several couples that had been here a few years back and their experience now doesn’t even compare. They said EVERYTHING has gone downhill. 
- 
EVERYTHING TAKES SO LONG and you are literally chasing staff down to try and get anything done that you’ve paid for. The “all inclusive” is actually up to you to fight for. Nothing is easy. You feel like you are just a number here due to the size of the resort. Paying more to be in the reserve doesn’t give you the perks that you were promised. Our concerns were mentioned to several management staff and nothing was ever done. Promises to speak with us and resolve but we were never followed up with. All that says to me is everything we brought up was something they hear regularly and there is no desire to fix any of the issues. If you are ok with a 2 star experience, then book here.

reviews.author: Adventure324086
reviews.title: Don’t book save your money!
reviews.text:
As a 5* hotel you would expect the rooms to be in tip top condition and clean but in our 10 day stay we moved 4 times! The hotel and lobby itself is really nice and looks 5* and the restaurants were really good with lots of the selection however the rooms were just not to standard at all! 

For the money we paid this was a massive let down, each room we changed had a new issue…bathroom dirty/mouldy and outdated, AC is too loud you can’t sleep, a weird smell coming through, noisy, in our last room you can hear construction work near by and a club across the road. We wasn’t able to leave as we unfortunately booked it as non-refundable otherwise I would be the first one out of here! I do not recommend this place!! 

The staff and the beach were what made the holiday. The staff did deal with us nicely and were very accommodating. And the beach was just beautiful. But I wish we did not stay here and maybe considered an air bnb. 

Also if they try get you to join a presentation it is a way of you to sign up to 30 years membership packages I.e timeshare

reviews.author: 972maggie
reviews.title: I would suggest not doing the upgrade.
reviews.text: We booked reserve adult only to find out there really isn’t enough perks to even bother on this property and the front desk manager was absolutely no help. As a matter of fact she told me I could leave but couldn’t have any of my money back on day 2 of a 14 day stay

reviews.author: Yex W
reviews.title: AMERICANS BEWARE
reviews.text:
Understaffed, poor maintenance, facilities falling apart (bathrooms by the lobby were always dirty/broken), furniture in room damaged/dated, stucco on balcony falling apart, food at the buffet was not marked (have food allergies), service was poor because you are understaffed and overbooked. Several employees were rude, and it was obvious that they were overworked. I slipped and almost fell on the wet floor and several other people did too, it was raining inside the pyramid area, and nobody cleaned it up, I had to ask someone to clean it. I went by the same area later and it was wet again, not fixed. Floors are extremely slippery if you are wet or are coming from the pool/beach area, watch out! Suggest adding rugs or anti-slippery stripes.
Hostess always ask for your allergies, but the food is not labeled. I asked a couple employees if a dish had gluten and they did not know. A lot of them did not understand me. Unable to try most of the restaurants as they were always full, the waiting time was 45 – 60 mins. The food at the buffet seems to be the same, lots of kids running around alone touching dishes.  Restaurants do not have AC (if they do, units need to be updated!), if you like to eat at 83 – 87 degrees this is your hotel. 
My main complaint is the lack of bottled water, when you ask for it, employees act like you are asking for champaign. Only water in a tiny cup and you must wait for it.  By the time it arrives it’s already warm. If you ask servers to fill your own water bottle (ex; we brought our own tumblers) with ice and water, they act surprised and some of them will just flat out be rude and leave unless you show them a big tip. 
This hotel is owned by Melia, which is a Spanish company.  They cater to Europeans, not Americans thus the lack of bottled water, clean bathrooms, updated rooms, friendly servers. I did not see too many Americans in the hotel over the holidays, most of the guests were Asian and/or European; I guess they like being dehydrated. 
Paid for Nikte as per their website is for the most demanding families and was highly disappointed, it’s not worth it.  No separate check-in, lines were long, there were only 3 employees, and they were very slow. Nikte rooms are dated, reminded me of my grandma’s wicker white furniture form the 90s. The stucco on the balcony is falling apart, and some of the balconies need repair as they have exposed screws/steel bars. The only perk of Nikte is the ocean view. 
The Beach is the best part of this hotel, beautiful location, lots of cabanas with chairs, clean and safe. No vendors harassing you to purchase souvenirs. The shower (not the bathroom) is amazing, very powerful and up-to-updated. 
 I really had high expectations for this hotel but was disappointed.

reviews.author: Gabriela Roxana A
reviews.title: Primera y última vez que elegimos Meliá
reviews.text: No es un hotel 5 estrellas para nada, el servicio es realmente de calidad media - regular. Fuimos para festejar año nuevo y nos intoxicamos con comida del hotel, perdimos un día entero por estar en cama y tampoco pudimos festejar. Filas para todo, comida re calentada, en los restaurantes especiales se demoran un montón en atenderte. Problema de antaño instalado en el hotel con las reposeras, para ir a la pileta o al mar nunca hay lugar ya que algunos turistas vivos van temprano a reservar y dejan las toallas tomando sol todo el día y dejan sin lugar a quienes quieren disfrutar, y el personal del hotel no hace nada al respecto. Nos fuimos con una muy mala experiencia del hotel Paradisus Cancún , primera y última vez que elegimos Meliá a causa de esta experiencia… somos de Argentina y trabajamos un montón todo el año para poder salir de vacaciones a fin de año y llevarnos este mal trago nos hace  tomar la decisión de no volver más a este hotel ni volver a elegir la cadena.

reviews.author: 3Ring
reviews.title: Avoid at all costs
reviews.text:
Wow - what an incredible disappointment. We came to this hotel (The Reserve - adults only) after 6 days at the Zilara Riviera Maya and the difference was night/day. The Reserve is the adults-only section of the hotel and we thought we might be able to stay largely in that area. Unfortunately, it seems the Reserve is an afterthought and an attempt to attract adults to the property. There are no dedicated adult bars and there is one outside restaurant with a limited menu. There are several other bars throughout the property, but there were always children present until closing. At the main lobby bar, they set up a DJ and had a toddler show in the bar.
At check-in we were assigned a personal concierge. She gave us her WhatsApp for any of our needs and told us she would let us know when our rooms were ready. Throughout the day we sent several messages to her asking about our rooms and trying to get restaurant reservations. She never responded. Finally, after 5pm, I went to the check-in desk and was told our rooms had been ready for hours. They simply failed to inform us despite our repeated inquiries.
Many of the staff were lovely, but a surprising number were rude and surly. Wait times for service were very long. Room service was frequently 2-3 wait. The buffet (the only option available to us one night as our concierge was not available to make reservations) ran out of many food items long before closing time. Food quality was unimpressive generally (and especially at Agua Marina). The rooms were adequate but small and dated.
This was very much a cruise ship free for all experience more than a luxury adult getaway.l

reviews.author: velina2809
reviews.title: Not worth the all inclusive pass since food options are not great
reviews.text: Not worth the all inclusive pass since food options are not great   We ended up preferring to eat outside.  Room service was kind and great with requests. The vibe of the hotel checks but there was a lot of confusion on how to book restuarents and know what events are there for the day.

reviews.author: Pablo Cesar C
reviews.title: Paradisus no vale la pena
reviews.text: Compré en The Reserve pero la verdad no sirvió para nada (excepto para ir al Restaurante Sal), estuve 4 días pero nunca pude encontrar silla para la playa porque siempre estaba lleno, no se podía reservar silla, solo unos camastros pero por el camastro me pedían unos módicos 250 dólares por el día. Este hotel tiene una opción de pasadía y los estudiantes son los que tienen llenas todas las sillas de la playa, no deberían tener esa opción de pasaría pues los huéspedes somos los afectados(pagamos mucho más y no podemos disfrutar nada), la primera noche me tocó en una habitación terrible pues el baño emitía un ruido como el pito de un tren, toda la noche ese ruido y por eso no pude conciliar el sueño, luego en la segunda noche, había viento fuerte y el balcón era el que pitaba, las instalaciones son antiguas con goteras en casi todo el edificio, recuerdo que hasta en el restaurante lemon fish tenía una gotera encima. En fin, no me gustó este hotel.

reviews.author: Yoon L
reviews.title: Not good stay so far
reviews.text:
We arrived on Christmas. We understand it is a busy time of year but wait time for any service for the room, expect to take 3+ hrs.  

We are staying 5 nights but have not completed our stay yet.
Pros so far: food is decent. Agua Marina is great.  Some servers at restaurants are very friendly.
View from the room is awesome
Beach is great

There are A LOT of cons:

Music is so loud that my kids cannot sleep.

Its just crazy loud.

People with young kids must avoid this hotel at all cost.

Floor is marble and hard my kid fell on the floor. It is super dangerous.

Mold in shower.  AC is loud.

It will take 3 plus hrs to get your water in your room.

We are also here for our anniversary, and even made a note on it when booking and no mention of this at all from the resort.

My husband just got very very ill on the third night.

Will update this review again when we complete our stay

reviews.author: Explorer820360
reviews.title: Only looks good,bad hotel
reviews.text: Bad reception guys...Rafael was the one we spoke to, doesn't know how to speak to guests. Needs training in communication skills. Bad hotel, only looks are good, bad food, bad drinks, bad staff. Specially reception guys.

reviews.author: vivekrairikar
reviews.title: Vegetarian options are close to none.
reviews.text: Lot of things were missing. Room missing lot of basic things….comparatively old….restaurants missing vegeterian options. Lack of Indian food. Additional services are not cheap and cost lot of money. Staff not helpful.

reviews.author: Jester M
reviews.title: Frustação com estadia no Melia.
reviews.text: Hotel em má conservação. Adicionam serviços para poderem cobrar mais durante a estadia (colocam poucas espreguiçadeiras para colocar locais que são sobrados a parte - USD 250/dia). Realmente uma decepção com a rede Meliá.

reviews.author: coedsjob0h
reviews.title: Servicio en The Reserve muy desmejorado
reviews.text: El servicio de los conserjes ha desmejorado notablemente, lo que ofrecen en el app como “beneficios únicos” como cupones y opciones de upgrade es mentira, las instalaciones están muy deterioradas, goteras por todo el hotel y pisos resbaladizos como consecuencia.

reviews.author: nehasony8
reviews.title: Lack of Veg options and rooms availability
reviews.text:
They are not able to confirm Double beds and group rooms before actual checkin process.
No vegetarian options, only pizzas and pastas. No Indian food in any restaurant. Expected some more shows and entertainment.

reviews.author: Mike G
reviews.title: Inconsistent service
reviews.text:
We went with my extended family (12 people) and from the start we became disappointed. The biggest issue with the hotel is the inconsistent service.  The majority of the time the hotel staff would be pissed off you wanted something. However, every once in a while you get someone offering to go the additional mile like Martin who served us the last two mornings at the breakfast buffet. 

Check-in: It took almost 90 minutes to check-in. It was frustrating that there were several (what i assume to be) managers standing behind the counter doing nothing while guests waited. The long check-in time seemed to be the norm based on discussions with someone in their “vacation club” (timeshare). Prior to our arrival, we had emailed the hotel two times asking for a crib and they “noted it on the reservation”. The check-in attendant was not aware of the request and they were not helpful in providing this. After we checked in (finally) we asked guest services and they tried to arrange. After a few hours of not having a place for our baby to nap we called down to complain and received the crib sometime that evening. 

Cleanliness: Most of our rooms were dirty, with hair, tissues and other junk in the bathroom. We asked hotel cleansers to re-clean and they did a much better job after our request. One persons room was not cleaned at all and it seemed the housekeepers had not yet gotten to it by 3:30 (after checking-in). 

Rooms: I don’t usually care about outdated rooms, but these rooms needed some love. They were very spacious with nice balconies, but the furnishings were old and worn and poorly repaired. My main complaint is that there were no outlets near the bed. 

Food: The food was good for an all-inclusive in this range. Unfortunately, however, 5 of the 12 of us got sick the first night (food poising?). Buffet had plenty of selection and there were several restaurants which all had great options to choose from. We seldom had a dish that we didn’t like. Their centerpiece restaurant, Lemon-Fish had a wait at peak times, but the other restaurants were easily accessible unless they were closed for a private event (which happened to us a few times). 

Service: As I mentioned in the intro, most of the waiters and front office staff were rude and unhappy to help.  Many requests and orders fell on def ears. The biggest frustration for me was the persistent difficultly of getting a high chair at meals; not because they didn’t have them, but because nobody wanted to help (e.g. hostess said to ask the waiter, waiter said ask the bus boy, bus boy was clueless). Bell boys and guest services were generally helpful though. Room service was inconsistent and we had a few occasions where we ordered waters and towels which never came. We ordered food to the room twice and the first time had the wrong order. 

Kids club: we had a 2 and 3 year old who participated in the kids club. We picked this resort because it was one of two which allowed 2 and 3 year olds to be together. Staff at the kids club was great and they communicated via WhatsApp if there were any issues. It was never crowded and we felt safe leaving the little ones there. 

Pool/beach: Pool and beach chairs were hard to come by unless you snagged one by 8 am (which is fairly normal for a resort like this. There were a lot of stairs down to the beach which was not easy for us with kids in strollers. The pool and beach servers were generally kind and available to take orders.  There were some fun activities at the pool and the beach was beautiful.

reviews.author: Mario L
reviews.title: Mucho que mejorar / No vuelvo
reviews.text:
Cuarto de Hospitality con cucarachas, restaurante de tacos blue agave pesimo en su calidad, carne dura sin sabor y tardadisimos, la atención muy deficiente, le hace falta mucho mantenimiento de cosas basicas, baño de mujer en zona de la alberca SIN asiento como de gasolinería, una puerta de baño de hombre de madera le faltaba una barra todo se veia, muy sucios los baños de alberca no los limpian costantemente, NO es un hotel para familias con niños, el área de la alberca con dos simples chapoteaderos con falta de mantenimiento uno de ellos con la tapa del piso rota, no hay juegos, abandonados totalmente ni una resbaladilla en su alberca, los shows de la noche son cerca del lobby la mayoría parados todo incomodo, ponen pocas sillas y son para adultos NO enfocados en niños, hubo un mago muy pesado que le avento leche a una niña en la cabeza de mal gusto. Hay elevadores donde la pantalla del elevador no sirve así que no sabras en donde vas y para bajarte hay que atinarle.
- Cosas buenas: Aqua Marina, el esfuerzo de Kidsdom con lo poco que tienen, bell boys que lamentablemente olvide sus nombres-
- Si quieres Paradisus mejor el de Playa del Carmen, Cancun No-
- No vuelvo-
-Habitación 3338-

reviews.author: Peter M
reviews.title: Does anybody care
reviews.text:
No, just no.
Still 3 days left in this place
Not even a 3 star property.
Room needs a reno , dated, smelly and noisy. 
Food is so so and many “specialty” items on menus are at a “specialty” additional cost.
Stall are efficient but not service oriented.
Meliá should be embarrassed to be presenting this as a luxury resort. Brand is important, yours is tarnished.

reviews.author: ejlb1997
reviews.title: Didn’t like it
reviews.text: The food was awful, and they had the same menu all the time, food was cold and you can tell was reused… the bathroom and bedroom looked old and need remodel to look fancy, we didn’t enjoy this hotel. And for the price is to expensive…

reviews.author: Matheus Soares
reviews.title: Péssima experiência de check-in
reviews.text: De toda a experiência, o mais grave foi o quarto não estar pronto no horário previsto. Eu tinha um casamento no próprio hotel, e expliquei à equipe que precisava entrar um pouco antes no quarto para me arrumar. Além de não serem flexíveis nisso, o quarto simplesmente não estava pronto no horário. Tive que tomar banho e me arrumar no quarto de um amigo. A equipe do hotel não resolveu meu problema e não demonstrou importância a algo que estava previsto na reserva. Além disso, algumas pessoas forneceram péssimo atendimento e flexibilidade nas opções de alimentação. Honestamente, pelo preço que custa, esperava muito mais serviços, atrações e facilidades no hotel. A sensação é que, além de ter poucas opções, as poucas que existem são cobradas de forma avulsa. Até a sauna é cobrada. Não recomendo a experiência.

reviews.author: Lynn Cavazos
reviews.title: No vale el precio por la calidad
reviews.text: Fuimos de viaje familia, la ubicación, instalaciones y cuarto son buenas, sin embargo, la calidad de los alimentos y el alcohol no fueron de mi agrado, pagamos 30k por dos personas y esperaba otra calidad en ello, esto por 4 dias. Habíamos ido anteriormente y tenían mejor calidad de bebidas y comida, todos los restaurantes venían incluidos, esta vez tenían dos de ellos con costo adicional, por el momento no me volvería quedar, siendo hotel de 5 estrellas esperaría un diferencial en bebida y comida y no la tiene. Y de los restaurantes que teníamos acceso era demasiado el servicio, para que me sirvieran un taco, tardaron como 50 minutos.

reviews.author: gbsafety
reviews.title: Parasidus Hotel Cancun
reviews.text:
not impressed with their rooms -rooms need a little more upgrade. 
In the middle of the night we had to change rooms due to door not closing and ac no working.....got sent to a less room...........................

reviews.author: mparaud
reviews.title: Expected more
reviews.text:
In general good BUT is an old hotel, the AC not works good, a loooooot of good things with “extra charge” 

The staff frendly with disposition but a lot of things that escapes from their hands and nothing to do in the moment

reviews.author: Compass41507201153
reviews.title: ALL INCLUSIVE ,NOT INCLUSIVE.
reviews.text: Es un establecimiento confortable en el diseño y ambientación, las habitaciones standares, con personal con un fastidio inherente, pocos cortes o pobremente dispuesto. No es todo incluido, la carta ide restaurantes, incluye cargos adicionales, es limitada y monótona. Hay restricción hasta para el uso de camastros, horarios poco flexibles.

reviews.author: arefinwadud
reviews.title: Paradisus review
reviews.text: The resort was very good except the check in procedure was such a hassle. We told the hotel prior that we are getting 2 rooms and that we need them next to each other given they don’t have connecting. They told me the day I got there after my 6 hour flight that they can’t do it until the next day.  The balcony doors were broken in both the rooms we got as well as the door for the bathroom was broken as well.

reviews.author: GoPlaces146562
reviews.title: Não voltaria
reviews.text:
Foram diversas situações que fizeram que minha expectativa fosse frustada, Vou apenas pontuar para nao ser extenso. 
Primeiramente, todos os atendentes desde o restaurante Malva, Lemon Fish, serviço de piscina, serviço de praia, Italiano, etc... 
Não existe um sorriso dado pelos atendentes, a impressão que nos dá é que estou sendo inconveniente em pedir qualquer coisa.  Vc chama eles fingem que não escutam, notasse uma sobrecarga muito grande sobre eles, trabalham descontes e infelizmente e descontam nos hospedes.
Atendimento muito ruim no servico de praia, pedi mais de 5x uma batata frita, demorou mais de 1 hora e meia, fora o humor dos atendentes. 
Fiz o pedido de agua 3x em meu frigobar, pois no serviço de quarto não reabasteceram, Um as 08 da PM na recepção, outro as 11 horas por telefone e outro as 12 horas por telefone tb, chegou as 12:30hrs. Tinha dia que era reabastecido e dia que não era reabastecido. 
Filas pra conseguir uma mesa no café da manhã, pela quantidade de hospedes teria que ter apoio de um outro restaurante servindo, no caso o restaurante Mexicano, assim não existiria filas. 
Solicitei pra arrumar a vazão de agua da pia do banheiro, pois não estava funcionando, não arrumaram, se deixasse 1 minuto ligada ela transbordava. 
Dentre varias outras coisas.
Ou seja a minha expecitativa estava sendo altissima por esse hotel está entre os 10 melhores hoteis do RCI, eu queria ficar no Hard Rock e acabei sendo convencido de ficar no Paradisus, minha expecitativa foi altamente frustada e com certeza não indico pra ninguém, e ficarei mais atento com as redes Melia. 
O Mau humor dos atendentes é simplestemente geral, o unico que foi mais coordial foi o atendente Didie do serviço de piscina, ao menos um foi simpático nesse hotel.

reviews.author: Maria Lourdes N
reviews.title: La relación calidad precio no es buena
reviews.text:
Somos clientes Melia habituales y es el primero que nos decepciona. Hemos estado tanto en España como en el extranjero, disfrutando de esta cadena hotelera y no entiendo cómo permiten este nivel de servicio. 
Las habitaciones son muy antiguas, el aire acondicionado no enfría los suficiente y suena muchísimo. El baño tiene cortinas en vez de mampara, por lo que se encharca el suelo de todo el baño. En general el estado de las habitaciones no cumple con las mínimas expectativas. Hemos solicitado el cambio de habitación varías veces y desafortunadamente no lo arreglaron. 
Solo hay tres restaurantes en todo el hotel disponible sin cargos adicionales con aire acondicionado, teniendo en cuenta las temperaturas y el grado de humedad, me parece poca opción sobre todo si estás más de una semana. 
La relación hamacas y número de huéspedes es muy deficiente. 
El restaurante cielito fue el que más disfrutamos, la atención y la comida nos pareció excelente. 
No repetiría. Es una pena, pero ha sido realmente decepcionante.

reviews.author: Daniela L
reviews.title: Mala experiencia
reviews.text: Desde que llegamos confundieron la reservación y me dejaron esperando una hora o más para resolverlo, cuando por fin me dieron las habitaciones la de mis  hijos, q debería ser doble, me la dieron king size y se tardaron otras dos o tres horas en re asignarme a unas nuevas , al final me pusieron en torres y pisos diferentes lo que represento un gran problema para mi estancia en general . Para colmo mi habitación huele a humedad y el aire acondicionado suena como tractor, hoy no limpiaron mi habitación ni la de mis hijos porque seguían con datos erróneos y nos dejaron cartas de check out cuando salimos hasta dentro de dos dias, la recepción nunca tiene a nadie disponible del staff, no hay quien sepa como se reserva la cancha de tenis, y uno de los meseros de Playa me dijo que “primero perro” a ser del país de donde vengo (cabe señalar que el señor pensaba que yo era mexicana y se “le salió” su opinión personal pero lo dijo 😵) ojalá pueda terminar mi estancia sin más contratiempos… eso si, no volveré jamás. Lo demás bueno que puedan tener ya no me interesa ni conocerlo.

reviews.author: lisselotgeronimo
reviews.title: Hotel no recomendado
reviews.text: Hotel con un ambiente agradable y muchos spot para fotos pero el servicio del personal y las opciones gastronómicas muy pobres, estuvimos en el area de reserve y te asigna una persona para que te ayude en lo que necesites y nunca vimos esa persona hasta el último día, por igual el personal de limpieza estuvo revisando mi bolsa que deje fuera de la caja fuerte porque era muy grande y tomaron el unico dinero que tenia en efectivo en el momento (100us) a mi esposo no le gusto la comida y siento que el area de lounge del buffet hay muchas palomas alrededor de ti que te ponen nerviosa al comer y no puedes dejar tu mesa ni un momento sola

reviews.author: Anna B
reviews.title: Reasons Not to Stay at this Property
reviews.text:
On arrival our luggage was taken immediately even though I told them I needed to get into my luggage. Instead I was given a ticket and told to check in first before I could get into my own personal belongings. 

We were also given the wrong bracelet! Our concierge luckily figured this out quickly. We already paid for higher end drinks-of course we were not reimbursed. The wines are horrible-so you need to ask for a wine menu if you prefer a drinkable wine. You will not be offered a wine menu unless you ask for one. Wine list is not offered at the buffet. 

Our refrigerator mini bar/snacks were not restocked. We had to call and request. We were told "we only do that between 9-5" . We already paid for this service! 
Trash was not taken from room so we did that ourselves and then we were never given a new bag. Had to call multiple times for the correct amount of wash cloths on multiple days. 

The resort is not climate controlled!  Expect the heat and humidity inside. Our room air conditioning did not cool the room and we called twice with no repair. We were in the main building on the top floor. I spoke to some people who also complained and they were  moved to another tower and there rooms were cooled. The lobby area was also cooled. 
Bathroom outlets, and 3 other outlets in room did not work. We had no running water in our room for approx 6 hours! So imagine no shower, no flushing toilet! 
Only one place to eat for breakfast-buffet style and the food is cold. Don't think that your experience at the Italian restaurant or any other place is special-it is all coming from the only 1 kitchen they have which is in the buffet! So don't pay the extra costs ! 

The cabana's are great however; the lobster/beef fajitas are awful. Don't pay for the meal portion and you will save about 75$ but they won't tell you that. Swim up bar there is only one unless you upgrade to Reserve only pool. Kids allowed at swim up bar! Kids in pool with food which made a mess. Mold and Mildew around pool edges. 

Will never stay here again.

reviews.author: MarySol
reviews.title: Worst Experience in Cancun
reviews.text: I traveled with a group of 17 people (family and friends) during July 12-16, 2023. Unfortunately, this hotel is the worst I’ve ever stayed at in Cancun, and I have been going to Cancun for over 35+ years. The buffet food is horrible. The Blue Agave restaurant tacos were good and the Lemon Fish sushi was by far the best meal. The only good experience was Eliseo at the pool bar. The customer service was lacking to say the least. The hotel is old and not worth the cost.

reviews.author: Antarsul
reviews.title: ZERO value from the “reserve” option. Stay away
reviews.text:
Trying hard to put my emotions aside. This place is grand, no question. The hotel design, lobby areas, and the so called “reserve” sections are all magnificent. The reserve is in particular very well maintained. The pool area is pretty extensive, well setup. Some of the personnel enjoy their jobs, but certainly not all. These are in my mind the only positives of this hotel. The quality of the  all- inclusive food is dubious. While the omelet station and ready made food is OK, the rest is not. While there are restaurants where you can sit and order food, good luck trying to get a table, specially at the on-prem steak house. This place is a joke. Guests who pay for the “reserve” enjoy a portion of “included” items from the menu. Good luck trying to get a table while you are staying here. They clearly discourage you from trying to eat at this place, unless you are ready to part with thousands of pesos for the best items in the menu. Worst is the deal with the “sushi/Peruvian” place, I think it is called lemon fish. Try putting your name on the waiting list and they give you a standard hour and a half waiting time. If you brave the time and come back you will be given a table with an attitude. They will give you 50% of what you order and the other 50% will be whatever they feel you deserve as a non-paying (all-inclusive) customer. All this with an unpleasant attitude from an annoyed server. Truly disappointed with this hotel and the “reserve” option. The “dedicated” concierge added ZERO value to our stay, ZERO. On top of all I got 2 pairs of sunglasses stolen from my room, which, by the way, was totally average. The only saving grace for the room was the terrace with a side view to the ocean. 

Come to this place if you are looking for a beautiful hotel and grounds (this is why I am giving 2 stars) Everything else is well below average, including the useless “reserve” concierge  and personnel. 

To the hotel management: you can save your cookie cutter reply to my review.

reviews.author: cgarci11
reviews.title: Terrible overall experience
reviews.text: Waited 2 hours past check in time to get a room. Shower curtain smelled and shower head sprayed everywhere. A/C did not work the last 2 days of our stay. They forgot to leave towels and stock our mini bar 1 day. Room service had up 2 hours of wait time. All restaurants had a line and waiting time of over 45 mins. We were not able to eat at the Lemon Fish restaurant because every day they had a waiting time of 2 hours. Staff and waiters were no help and were very rude. I had previously stayed at the resort in 2016 and had a wonderful experience. Came back for that reason. This time I am not planning on ever going back.

reviews.author: Jennifer
reviews.title: Make sure your AC cools enough!
reviews.text:
The rooms need a mayor AC renovation, we had to change rooms twice because they didnt cool down.
Other than that, the personel was very nice. My respects and 100 points to CRIS from guest services, who was so nice and helped us twice retrieveing forgotten items in our room changing voyage.

reviews.author: Yaneidis A
reviews.title: El aire acondicionado del hotel entero está roto
reviews.text:
El aire acondicionado del hotel está defectuoso hace meses, la gerencia del hotel lo sabe y no hace nada al respecto para arreglarlo, y lo peor es que siguen vendiendo el hotel como si no hubiera ningún problema. Pasé un calor horrible en toda la instalación, en el lobby, en mi habitación, en los restaurantes sudábamos mientras cenábamos, a mi hermano lo tuvieron la primera noche hasta la 1:30 de la madrugada caminando por el hotel, llevándolo a otros cuartos tratando de encontrar alguno más fresco, y todos estaban igual, o peor que el que ya le habían dado, y terminaron dándole un ventilador para ayudarlo a dormir, algo inaudito con los miles de dolares que cuesta hospedarse allí.
