Esta situación arruinó por completo la experiencia, y mi cumpleaños que lo fui a celebrar allá, y siendo yo miembro reward de Melia, y habiendo reservado directamente con ellos en su aplicación, ni una cortesía de cumpleaños tuvieron conmigo.
Además, también compramos en el mismo hotel, una excursión a Isla Mujeres con la compañía OTIUM Contoy Adventures, en la que nos ofrecieron una serie de actividades, como llevarnos a ver delfines, y la casa del pirata, que nunca sucedieron. Solo nos llevaron a hacer media hora de snorkeling, y luego a una pequeña y sucia playita entre 2 piers, llamada playa Tiburón, donde almorzamos una comida no muy buena, pero aceptable si tienes hambre, nos dejaron allí por 2 horas, derritiéndonos de calor todos los que no quisimos meternos en esa agua llena de sargazo. Nos recogieron y entonces nos llevaron a una playa realmente linda, limpia y de aguas cristalinas al norte, y allí estuvimos como por 2 horas más. Allí nos debieron llevar desde el principio, en vez de hacernos perder horas en el primer lugar, que fue casi una tortura.
En fin, no pienso regresar a éste hotel jamás.

reviews.author: espinosakarel
reviews.title: NO HAY AIRE ACONDICIONADO
reviews.text: El aire acondicionado no funciona bien.  No pude dormir por tanto calor. Todas las habitaciones tenían el mismo problema con el aire acondicionado. No hubo solución a esta situación. Ni en los restaurantes había aire acondicionado. La atención por parte del personal si es muy buena.

reviews.author: Federico202306
reviews.title: Paradisus cancun
reviews.text:
Mala relación precio - calidad. Mala atención, la playa a la que da el hotel es sumamente angosta y ni siquiera tienen sillas / reposeras para sus huéspedes.
Pedis ayuda y te derivan a hablar de una punta a la otra del hotel sin resolver nada. 
El restaurante más solicitado (de comida italiana) es con reserva y tenés que reservar 2 días antes (una locura) o no podés ir. Es decir que si sólo vas sos noches seguramente no puedas cenar ahí.

reviews.author: J-RO
reviews.title: Beware .   slip and fall Hazzard
reviews.text: Hotel rooms are outdated . overall a ok hotel .   Best experience was the Pool bar near " lunch Box " the server Gabby was amazing . Best employee by far .    Twice I fell on wet floors with no caution signage present .  I was offered creams and was told they would go to Pharmacy to grab advil if I gave them Money.  Requested accident report twice and told not ready yet.   Buffet food was the same everyday  The Lemon fish was good . service was shaky .

reviews.author: Tom H
reviews.title: Beautiful resort, excellent staff, serious corporate issues
reviews.text: The resort is impressive, it is beautiful and it feels safe. The beach was beautiful despite significant amounts of seaweed. The local staff were extremely kind, hard working, and went above and beyond almost everytime. Every issue we had was with the hotel itself, mainly being that it EXTREMELY underpays their staff. About 8-12 USD per day. There was even an entire STRIKE where guests had to shelter in their rooms all because Melia refuses to pay their employees fair wages. This is unacceptable. Melia also did not communicate this information to any guests which is extremely concerning. Finding water was almost a constant battle when we were there.

reviews.author: Sunshine45041187586
reviews.title: BEWARE - Hotel's pest cockroach pesticide Spray could be unsafe to guests.
reviews.text: There seem to be a cockroach infestation. we observed the hotel maintenance crew with gas gas masks on were spraying pesticide to rooms. This seem to be a protocol to control, but the sprays seem to be high volume, and without guests awareness. On one incident, a maintenance crew with gas mask on, entered our room without knocking the door. my startled wife was asked if they could spray the pesticide, and ofcourse, she rejected the pesticide fumigation offer.  Throughout our stay, we've noticed the hotel's pesticide spray is quite common. The sprays looks to be in between guest checkouts, during daily house keeping, and even while guests are in their rooms. The sprays seem to be around the room's wall/floor perimeter. All guests, especially ones with young children should be mindful of the hotel's pesticide  spray practice.

reviews.author: ALEJANDRA E
reviews.title: Decepción  total
reviews.text:
El hotel mucho piripi pero la atención es muy mala.al llegar,lo q elegiste q te salio carisimos ,para estar mejor un up grade, previo pago . Sin ese extra no podes ni tocar una palapa aunque no estan indicados a que sector pertenecen. Los comedores todos pese a ser all inclusive , los mejores platos mejores hay que pagarlos! Y hay q anotarse con anticipación. Se ven empleados por todos lados pero en corrillos, las cosas a la playa hasta q la bandeja no esta llena, no las bajan asi q el Daikiri llega derretido y la cerveza caliente. La comida regular para abajo. En el buffet te llevan la bebida cdo terminaste la comida. Excepto Mario y Luz del Ginger el resto de los empleados regular para abajo
La pileta del frente : el agua temperatura termal!! 
El guardavidas realmente fue bueno!! Me hizo sentir segura cuando me metia al mar.
Deberian recomendar a los pasajeros las precauciones sobre el sargazo porque las irritaciones en la piel son muy comunes y muy molestas.

reviews.author: Jessica B
reviews.title: Poor service
reviews.text: This resort was just not what I expected and was by far the worst vacation we have been on. The service was subpar, our rooms were dirty, the food was terrible, and our mini fridge was only stocked after we asked a few times. One of our friends rooms bathroom was flooding when using the shower and it took 2 days to move them. Please check out a different resort.

reviews.author: marce_huerta
reviews.title: The Reserve, no “luxury”
reviews.text:
Pagamos por la experiencia de lujo que nos ofrecieron, pero fue una experiencia regular, sin lujos.
El lugar es bonito y si uno va decidido a pasarlo bien, lo hará, pero el servicio no es lo que se ofrece.
Las instalaciones ya presentan problemas de mantenimiento, de hecho, nos tocó ascensor descompuesto, lavamanos tapado, fuerte olor a barniz cuando estaban trabajando en pasillos, etc.
Nunca repusieron el minibar sin que tuviéramos que llamar para solicitarlo y sólo estábamos pidiendo agua.
Dejando la mala calidad del servicio de lado, debo mencionar que la mayoría de las personas del hotel eran muy amables.

reviews.author: DLBinne2
reviews.title: I always wanted to try this hotel
reviews.text: I have stayed in many of the hotels in the hotel zone and though I always wanted to try Paradisus I left unsatisfied. It is expensive and it gave me no reason to want to come back or recommend. There wasn't any entertainment to speak of, other than the escape room that we had to pay for, which we did enjoy. The property is very large and hard to find your way around. We were skeptical of the front desk check in that offered us a $92 "upgrade" when we had booked an upgrade with the travel company. The buffet wasn't anything special to speak of and is setup terrible as you are constantly trying to avoid people walking in all kinds of directions. The room wasn't cleaned properly as we found previous tenants earplugs on the floor and I don't know what in the corner, and not cleaned during our stay. The beds were made and was tided up, but those earplugs and I don't know what still in the corner when we left. It was such a production to try to get our 12 year old son his own wrist band to be able to open the room door, which I still don't understand. We were told to go back to the check in desk 3 times in order to check into our room. I had received an email a day or two before that had me check in which I thought was great, but then when I get there that was useless, why even send that email when it doesn't do anything. There isn't any area other than an off track bathroom to change when we get there, why don't you have an area for early arriving guests with lockers or something where you can comfortably change and lock up some valuables prior to checkin? there is certainly enough space for it. When I asked if there is a place where we can change, it seemed like it was the first time anyone asked. Seat saving by the pool and the beach is way too much. We had to walk and walk to try to find something that wasn't saved by 7am. I also don't recall having to pay $15 "tax" before either when I arrive. I am going back to Cancun again in a few weeks and I will definitely see if it is something new or something that Paradisus just decides to charge. Sargassum, wow the Sargassum, so much of it, and no one cleaning it up. On our 3rd day there was a tractor driving back and forth, but wasn't doing anything. We only brought backpacks, so when it was time to get our room they insisted to deliver our bags to our room even though I said no, not a problem we'll take them, then we sit in our room, waiting and waiting for deliverly. So I call down to the desk, and then someone finally comes with our bags. Guess what, they delivered them to the wrong room! The mexican restaurant had taco night, and the tacos were terrible, none of us ate them, and we left. Because the property is so large, you need to have someone that should give you a quick tour because you end up walking and walking around in circles trying to find a place to eat after a long day of traveling. You have to walk through the one outdoor restaurant to get from one side of the pool to the other for some reason, while people are sitting and eating, who thought of that great design, that was uncomfortable. Since there wasn't any other entertainment, why charge for the escape room which was the highlight of the hotel? As I mentioned I have been traveling to Cancun since the late 90's and get there often, but hadn't before had the "Pleasure" to stay at Paradisus, and I was so disappointed. Our stay gave me no reason to go back or recommend in any way. And unfortunately I will have to explain to people that they can find less expensive options with better amenities in the Cancun hotel zone.

reviews.author: Tanya T
reviews.title: FOOD REVIEW! You know there’s a problem when the churros are a huge FAIL!
reviews.text:
I’ll start with the positive. There have been a few hits- sea bass, squash soup, coconut creme brûlée. Alcoholic drinks have been pleasantly strong for the most part.
However, when a Mexican restaurant can’t get Mexican food right…that needs to be addressed! Our visit to their Cielo Mexican restaurant was almost a complete disaster of an experience.
 First, The tortilla chips were completely inedible. Literally speaking!
They were so thick and hard you could not break them with your teeth! Extremely greasy as well. 
The main dishes were mostly pork based and the lamb main dish was actually a broth. 
The starters were extremely tasteless and the soup served cold. 
The desserts included a tasteless very chewy, eggy flan. 
 The biggest disappointment? The soggy, noodle-like churros! They were literally dripping with grease. This is no joke. 

We left and decided to check out the buffet for dessert. Every cheap cafeteria that I have ever been to has excelled compared to this one. We took one of each type of dessert and could not find even one that was passable! They may look pretty but they are poor, poor quality food. Extremely bland. 
Picture a hard, dried out cake-like brownie with the least amount of chocolate possible. I even question if brown food coloring was added to make it appear to have more chocolate content.
We ended up with gelato which was better than ice milk, at least.
Milkshakes and smoothies are an option for breakfast (but not lunch and dinner!) 
No pancakes, French toast, etc. for breakfast. 
Lattes can only have whole milk- no skim, oat, etc.
Breakfast menu and especially the dessert menus need to be seriously re-examined. Seriously…they need to hire a neutral third party to come in and revamp.
 It would be well worth the investment. Why, oh why, would they skimp on the food experience!?
Because the resort is gorgeous! Bali beds and pools are amazing and the staff are helpful. It has the potential to be very worth the $$ and the food is something that with a minimal investment they can make a great guest experience.

No access to the menus before you make your reservations is another big miss. Our concierge has been great but he was only provided old, out of date completely different menus.

This is our third day and I’ll update the rest of the trip accordingly. We are hoping that we have not yet seen the best of Paridisus and the food experience will improve dramatically as we visit their more popular restaurants!

reviews.author: wisetime
reviews.title: Hotel bonito y cómodo, pero con mal servicio.
reviews.text: Mal servicio en general, desde el check in. Las habitaciones están bien pero no las hacen diario. Los restaurantes están bien en particular el Japones y el de Mariscos. El bufette esta muy bien y completo. El bar de la alberca tiene muy buen servicio y son muy amables y alegres. Pero todo lo opaca el mal servicio en general. Buscaré otras opciones para mi siguiente viaje.

reviews.author: farshinz
reviews.title: Do not Disturb…. But was disturbed by staff multiple times
reviews.text: Overall an okay experience, I probably would choose a non all inclusive resort because they staff has better quality service. And you feel less obligated to tip everyone all the time. For me, the worst part was having staff walk into our room when our do not disturb sign was on the door. That was a first for me and a reason I would not return.

reviews.author: LoveTravel600211
reviews.title: Déçu
reviews.text:
Honnêtement très déçu. Nous sommes actuellement au Paradisus Cancun section « réserve » et nous n’avons rien de ce qui nous a été promis. 
Ménage très approximatif. Tasses sales laissées vers la machine à café, aujourd’hui pas de serviette pour les mains ou le visage, uniquement des draps de bain. Aucune préparation pour la nuit. 
Restaurant et buffet très répétitif. Cela fait 5 jours que le poisson du jour est du tilapia. Pour des végétariens c’est un peu rébarbatif. 
Plage sale. 
Bref séjour payé très cher pour un résultat médiocre. 
Le pire hôtel où nous avons séjourné à Cancun.

reviews.author: Navigator737855
reviews.title: Hugely disappointed….
reviews.text: Having stayed at this hotel previously we were excited to return. However, the overall quality and standards in the hotel were very poor, if it was a 3 star hotel they would just be acceptable. We previously stayed in the Royal Service part of the hotel which is now the Reserve. Except for the Reserve pool area and food from Sante during the day, the remaining restaurants now offer a substandard menu in comparison to previous. I don’t blame the staff per se, as this appears to be a corporate and management decision to dial down the quality and then the staff need to operate under this regime which is a shame. For a 3 hotel it would be acceptable. All areas of the operation from cleaning, mini bar replenishment (waters and snacks, not alcohol), menu choices and service in restaurants are significantly below where they were in this hotel.

reviews.author: Sharifah V
reviews.title: Below par
reviews.text: Have been to Cancun several times and always wanted to stay at the Paradisus.  Very disappointed.  To start, there's definitely a roach issue in this hotel.  The food in all of the restaurants was not really enjoyable. Instead of trying to Americanize food, the hotels needs to realize that most guests want authentic food. Rooms need updating. The staff is amazing.  Everyone went above and beyond for everything.  The grounds as well as the hotel are kept very clean, except the roach issue :( At most restaurants there's items that you can purchase, i.e, lobster roll = and extra $27.  First night at hotel a family member who was staying in a different room had a lobster roll for an additional price.  Upon check out the meal was on my bill which I disputed, but that family member had already checked out of their room.  The hotel argued with me about the $27, said they were going to check the cameras and that my signature was same signature that signed for the meal.   Was a bit annoyed considered that the hotel was overpriced to begin with.  Again the staff, with the exception of the front desk staff, is amazing, but it's just not worth the money.  There are so many other nicer places to stay for less.

reviews.author: Katrina C
reviews.title: Do not waste your money at this resort!
reviews.text: I can easily write pages of a review of how horrible our experience was at this resort but I will briefly say that the resort is not a 5 star resort, the food was horrific and we had to eat off property a few night, the reserve is def not worth the money and very few and not so good entertainment options!   Never again and would not recommend this hotel to anyone.

reviews.author: leo300buu
reviews.title: Mal servicio
reviews.text:
Capaciten a su personal pareciera como si sus empleados estuvieran peleados con la empresa . Muy mal el servicio  
El restaurante está muy pobre y si el hotel esta lleno, no abren más restaurantes, muy mal .

reviews.author: Chris
reviews.title: Room smells like mold.  Ordinary restaurants.  Dirty Pool.  Good staff though.
reviews.text:
Room:  A/C didn't work at arrival so called service.  It took two visits to get it fixed.  Room smells like mold (I think the smell comes out of A/C), this explains why they sprayed very strong air freshener in the room which made my fell nausous when we arrived.   Bathroom  needs updating.  Sink was cracked and drained slowly.  The rain showing is a nice feature but not much water comes out of it.  We had to use the sprayer to speed things up.  Hair dryer is the same model seen in the 90's and barely working.  

Ordinary restaurants:  Appears all the restaurants we reserved have similar food compared to the main buffet.  Nothing special.  For example, during our Italian dinner, I asked what ice cream flavors for dessert, the waiter stated it's the same as the buffet ice cream.  Nothing speical about these restaurants so don't expect a lot. 

Pools:  Pool has nice design but was dirty.  We saw brown bubbly vomit-looking substance and garbage floating in water at muliple areas of the pool.  And at certain sections of the pool, you'll expeirence sewage smell coming out of the pipe exhaust.  

Staff:  Great staff in general.  Helpful when they can.  One of the plus at this hotel.

Entertainment:  Decent.  The silent disco was entertaining to watch.  Mayan dance show was good. 

Overall, for over $500/night I expected better, so I gave 2 stars for the value I perceived for this hotel.

reviews.author: Vrodmama
reviews.title: Shady & building disrepair
reviews.text: Shady business practices if it doesn't benefit the resort or Concierge. Buffet food was room temp. Building elevators were broken and fire hazard. Bldg paint chipping, Roof leaks. Travel agent, Otium, was helpful to sign up but got rude when there was an issue and they didn't care after they took your money. Otium tour guides were great as well as the Cabana workers. The buffet waiters work hard and were pleasant. Japanese restaurant had poor service.  The lack of printed menu's was frustrating because you didn't know what you could order if you didn't have your phone with you.  Room was hot and bed linens were hot too. No USB charges in the rooms (rooms are dated), no smart tv's. Showers are old. Sink faucets leaked and drains were clogged. Nice marble, plants, water features, music throughout the facility. A few pleasant interactions with a few employees but the bad ones stood out. Lots and lots of stairs and difficult for disabled to get around within the hotel especially with the elevators not working. Had to take stairs to get to ramps to back of facility/beach area.

reviews.author: Angel
reviews.title: Jurassic Park with Bad Service
reviews.text: We are in Cancun a lot and this has been the least pleasant experience although the most expensive.  The hotel design looks cool, my kids would hum the Jurassic park theme because it looked similar to the pyramid but the open space although cool looking left almost no air conditioning which wasn’t a huge deal except it carried over to the rooms.  We were unhappy with the room to start as it had no bath and we had paid for the privilege (I forget what they called it) level but were placed at the opposite end of the hotel to the privilege amenities (lounge, pool, etc.)  We also learned no kids were allowed at the privilege pool area so all those perks which were supposed to carry over for us to the main pool did not.   Our personal concierge was absentee and acted as if he was doing us a huge favor getting us a room in the area we paid for with air conditioning that worked (basically they added a unit by the window).  The kids club stuff delivered was broken and dirty.  I informed the concierge and he shrugged.  We tipped everyone who gave good service well..the restaurants were great and the service.  We had a lady at the pool who was also wonderful and the ice cream guy tolerated our kids multiple trips.  The concierge actually contacted us after to ask why we left him only $20 per day for the days he actually provided us any service.   We won’t be back.  So many other great hotels with much better service and kids clubs.

reviews.author: kdoonan
reviews.title: Risky Place to Stay - Better Options.
reviews.text:
There were so many things that didn’t go right, and a few that were good. 
The Cons. The facility itself is terribly difficult to navigate and the elevators did not work the entire week we were there. Twice, when it appeared to be fixed, we attempted using it and it was very stressful. The unit jerked back and forth, the doors opened and shut repeatedly and in one case it would not ride to the floor we requested, instead riding up and down. Guests were left with the option of climbing starts, we were on the 7th floor, or taking the service elevator in a closed off part of the resort which was gross, dingy, smelled and in a very unattractive area of the hotel. Towards the end of the week, the service elevator began acting badly.  During rainy days, there was significant leakage in the hallways. Staff was working had to clean it up but there was a lot and there were a lot of caution signs. Luckily, we had not issues in our room with water.  I went with a friend and we requested a room with two beds. We confirmed this request on four occasions and were told it would not be a problem. When we arrived, they only had a king.  The hair dryer in the room didn’t work. I requested a replacement multiple times along with more towels and nothing was ever sent (this happened several times over several days.). We were finally moved to a room with two beds, which was much more comfortable and it had a working hair dryer. 
The food was consistently mediocre.  Malva, the main restaurant was essentially and oversized cafeteria. If you attempted breakfast after 9AM the lines to get in were crazy long. If you don’t care a lot about food, you’ll do a okay. If you’re a foodie, you’ll be disappointed. 
The Pros. The rooms were clean and the beds were very comfortable. The staff servers at the the pool and restaurants were always excellent. The spa service was excellent.
Summary. We made the best of it and enjoyed our vacation, but I would suggest finding something else. There are some serious facility problems that would make getting our there a real challenge in an emergency. The rooms in good shape, but the building itself needs a lot of infrastructure repair, especially the elevators. The food was mediocre. The activities were meh. Personally, I think it’s over rated. It’s near impossible to navigate the 5 pyramids, and that along is a really big turnoff and danger in an emergency. I think for the money you could find something else.

reviews.author: Mayra C
reviews.title: No funcionaba el clima
reviews.text: Nos hospedamos en el hotel, en dos habitaciones, sin embargo no funcionó el clima de la habitación de nuestros hijos, mandaron varias veces a los chicos de mantenimiento, nos asignaron otro habitacion al tercer día sin embargo tuvimos que esperar largo tiempo en recepción para poder hacer el cambio, no es justo lo que pagas si lo básico no funciona bien, a pesar de que les dije que no me hicieran esperar los chicos de recepción dijeron que era el protocolo, no tienen criterio para atender a un cliente molesto en una situación que lo amerita

reviews.author: Maria Jose B
reviews.title: No vale la pena este hotel.
reviews.text:
Para empezar el trato que le dan a los extranjeros es preferencial.
Pedí una habitación con dos camas, tardaron demasiado en darme mi habitación casi dos horas y al final de cuentas me dieron de una sola cama.

Prepárate para  no disfrutar de los restaurantes que te incluye porque nunca hay reservaciones disponibles.
El concierge que me tocaba jamás me busco ni me asignaron uno.

En la comida del buffet me salió un plástico de cuando la cubren y entiendo pero casi me ahogo, 
Fue desagradable el tener que pasar esa situación.

Así mismo cuando llegue al bufete la señorita encargada me dijo que podía sentarme en donde yo quisiera, para cuando regreso con mi plato de comida a mi mesa nos quito una de la mesa una meseras que porque la zona estaba cerrada, entiendo que estaba cerrada pero para evitar eso me hubieran colocado una mesa ellos mismos.

El bufete se inundo el día que llegue y estuvo cerrado y el único restaurante que podíamos comer estaba lleno con una espera de que 1 hora y media..

Nos dijeron tardarían en abrir el bufete 20 minutos
Al final tardaron casi hora y media.
Y yo que había tardado en llegar llevaba 5 horas sin comer y mi bebe casi 3 solo queríamos comer y descansar y evidentemente no fue así.
Los cuartos son muy básicos, no tienen conectores de luz para cargar tu celular
Si es una habitación para 4 personas solo habría un 
conector  para tus equipos, la luz estaba descompuesta en mi habitación y el aire acondicionado hace demasiado ruido.
Ya que me dieron mi habitación habían pasado más de 2 horas y ya estaba agotada, el mini bar no estaba completo y dijeron que iban a pasar para poder llenarlo de nuevo y jamás pasaron.

Cuando fuimos a la alberca desde la mañana los camastros se acaban muy rápido, hay quienes no los usan pero los apartan pero no hay suficiente
También cuando quise ir por toallas me dijeron que no había, tardaron muchísimo en que volviera a haber toallas más de 40 min..

En general para el precio que pagas no vale la pena quedarte en este hotel, Cancún es hermoso y tienen una playa hermosa pero no volveré a quedarme en este hotel.
Es demasiado caro para el trato y lo que ofrece.
No pude disfrutar de ningún restaurante a los que se supone tenía acceso y la comida en el bufete es muy básica. Realmente no había nada que supiera muy muy rico.

reviews.author: samueldooman
reviews.title: Food Allergies not taken seriously
reviews.text:
The resort itself was great (awesome pool and drinks, great beach access) and I thought the spa and gym were great as well.

The reason I I'm rating this so badly is for the food services.  I have severe food allergies, and provided that information to every host/server for each restaurant we went to.  And almost every single restaurant put food in front of me that I obviously couldn't eat.  For example, sushi rolls with sesame after I told them I'm allergic to sesame.  

On our last night, we went to Sal (the fancy steak house) and I gave them my full allergy list: peanuts, soy, sesame, and tree nuts. not only did I get immediately served a dish with nuts in the sauce, but later on I actually ate something I was allergic to without knowing, and had to leave dinner early.  We still don't know what actually caused the reaction, so I had to spend 30 mins monitoring whether I would need to be hospitalized.  Not a relaxing last night!!

This was not a language barrier issue; our party had several people fluent in spanish, and this was an issue with every restaurant except for one.

Also, other members of our party with dietary restrictions (vegatarian, etc) had a rough time with some food options.

Basically if you can eat everything, you'll have a great time.  If you can't, be wary!

reviews.author: dnlmom
reviews.title: Most recent visit disappointing
reviews.text: We have been going to the Paradisus Cancun for a number of years.  Some things remain lovely (most particularly certain staff members and the food) but overall, the quality is diminished.   The entertainment is few and far between and what they have is horrible!  Saturday nights performance in the lobby was ear piercing, teeth clenching loud and horrible.   We couldn't wait to get inside the restaurant where we couldn't hear it anymore.  Pool is loud in the afternoons and the constant booming of the base makes us retreat to our rooms early with a headache.  Bri g back quality entertainment like the three tenors!  Water drips from  a moldy ceiling in the Sports Bar.  Maintenance needs more attention.

reviews.author: Cat G
reviews.title: I Wish They Would They Would Have Told Us
reviews.text:
I would like to start by saying that I do not know the finances behind this trip as another guest on our party payed for the whole trip. Our rating is based solely on the resort itself and not our whole experience. Our review is about the hotel atmosphere, the rooms, the food, and the service, as well as the impact on the other days. 

Day 1: Arrival Day/Check-In
This was the first time we said to each other as a party, "I wish they would have told us," and wasn't the first time we would say this during the trip. When we checked in we first learned that when you book the room, you do not get a choice in the room that you get. They assign you your room and bed type and for most of our party that ended up being doubles even though most of the party were couples and had requesting kings. Only half of our 10 person party got the rooms they wanted. On all of the rooms we were miss booked and they tried playing us in lower tier rooms while still charging us for the deluxe rooms and reserve access. We had all paid for the junior deluxe suites with reserve access and had to bring over the leader of our party to make sure they reinstated our reserve access, which took a lot of arguing. That was the first red flag of our stay. After an entire half an hour of checking in we finally went upstairs to our room with our bellhop and walk in on man in his bathrobe. They had booked us in an occupied room. Luckily my brothers room was a few doors down and when we called and let them know they said we had to go back downstairs and check in again. When we did and they did was laugh at the situation and no one apologized. We went up to our room which was adjacent to the last one and the door would work. The battery of the door was broken. Again we had to call down and it took 20 minutes for security to come and let us in our room. An entire hour just to check in. At this point we had to rush and go to our dinner appointment. But still no apologies and no one ever checked in on us for the remainder of the trip. 

Agua Marina: this dining experience was not only annoying but overall disappointing. In all restaurants in the hotel your menu is the use of a QR code which not only works only half of the time but is also incorrect. Missing descriptions, missing menu items, incorrect description, or just does not open. Getting physical menus took arguing and they would only give 1 for the party of 10 people. Our server was inattentive, did not refill drinks after dinner and never came back to order desserts. I personally did not like my entree could not finish it and was left dissatisfied on my first day.

Day 2: Resort Day
In our first day my partner and I were told if we wanted to get a better room in the reserve area we would have to check on our second day. When we asked about a king bed we were told we would have to check out at 11 and then recheck in at 3pm to see if they was an available king sized room. That would be extremely inconvenient. At the same time we told them our bathroom door would not open and that our AC was not working. It was 80 degrees in our room the whole entire trip. They attempted to fix it twice and once again, never checked in with us.

Malva pt. 1: We decided to sleep in and went down for a later breakfast. Ended up going to Malva and I made a charcuterie plate with a fresh made omelet. We had the green juice for breakfast. I wish they would better labeled the items in the buffet as we didn't know half of what we ate was. Especially the cheeses. The textures were different than what I'm used to and I was surprised that it wasn't cold. Although besides my omelet, the food wasn't hot either.

We booked 5 cabanas in the reserve area for our first day. When we got there discovered they had only booked us for 4 cabanas and had given the other away. They tried moving the other group but we stopped them as that seemed rude to the couple who booked and was incorrectly placed. We had Yamil as a server and ended up being one of the best servers the entire trip. Anytime we walked by he would great us. He recommended their signature cocktail the Mangolele (mango lay lay) which I drank too much of. We had the aguachile and two of the surf and turf platters. I still think it was a wast of $150 for the 2 surf and turf platters and the only think I enjoyed on them was the fried fish. We were very surprised that we came to the Caribbean and they didn't even serve Caribbean lobster for that price. 

We then went to book our spa days for later in the week and learned the second time of "I wish they would have told us" they there was an entire reserve area for us. A bar, a snack bar, a breakfast buffet. 

Malva: this is the main buffet. Highly avoid. I can go into each dining experience. But I'll just say simply, AVOID the cheese and only eat simple proteins. I still have no idea what that "lamb" was supposed to be but it was wrong and gross. At this point in time I am not feeling good at all and consistently had to excuse myself from the part and started having diarrhea. Eventually my partner is having the same experience. 

Day 3: Isla Mujeres
We woke up the next day and almost cancelled our entire day. Both of us feel absolutely disgusting and are still very sick. We were reassured that we would have an easy day. We did not and had to leave the island early. Thankfully our taxi driver was very kind and helpful and drove us to a pharmacy to get Treda. YOU WILL NEED THIS. This saved us. After some rest we felt a lot better and went to our next reservation. The rest of our group stayed at Isla Mujeres instead. At Isla mujeres we found out that another couple had cheese and was not feeling well. Together we decided to avoid the cheese.

Cielo: this was by far my favorite experience although there was a few dishes that didn't excite us we were able to overlook that because of Melvin our amazing server who single handedly helped us feel better about our trip. The chef even came out and took a photo with us and gave us delicious Mexican snacks. I loved almost everything we had except for the elote, because of the cheese, which still did not taste right. Melvin asked if we could review their restaurant and gave us a QR code that linked to Tripadvisor. I was a bit upset because that made me realize as I went through the reviews that they were highly reviewing individual experiences and not the hotel as a whole. Cielo for me gets a separate rating from the hotel with 5/5 stars and would go back just for those desserts. Especially that delicious corn cake!

Day 4: Chichen-Itza
The day starts our by finding our my brother's ordered room service and also have diarrhea. At this point 3 out of the 5 rooms have now had food poisoning from the cheese at the hotel. This was so unfortunate as one of my brothers had a horrible day and missed half of the activities due to being sick. We also ended up missing our dinner reservation to Lemonfish which is unfortunate. My mom got a hold of our concierge and they booked us for a reservation at 9pm at Lunch Box as it was the only place that would take us for dinner. 

Lemonfish: However our other guests that did not go to the ruins with us went and said it's delicious. We called many times trying to make a reservation for another day and were told they do not accept walk-ins and had no reservations available. 

The Lunch Box: first when we get there we find out the concierge messed up the reservation AGAIN and they did not have is on their list. They fixed it and threw some tables together for us but blamed us for the mistake and we're so bitter for the rest of the dinner. Our server was rude and inattentive, we could hear the server and manager talking bad about us behind us. They did not want to provide paper Manus and we were upset when we returned several dishes because they were not as described on the menu. Got made at us because we didn't want to order all the appetizers. Our food came out barely warm. The "wagyu" patty was just a frozen patty you get at McDonald's. 

We ended up being hungry later and ordering room service. I definitely didn't get the wings and got two cheeseburgers... With no cheese. It took about an hour to get it sadly and once again I don't know why they can't make hot food. 

Day 5: Resort Day
At this point I'm time the 4th couple in our family now has food poisoning and we are beginning to learn that there is a lot we don't know about the hotel and what is provided for us. We called again about our AC and were told that if they could fix it they wod move us. After everything we had been though we were not up for moving our rooms 2 days before we were to leave. Again no follow up about the AC and still 80 degrees at 8am.

We went to the spa which was actually amazing. They didn't tell us we needed a bathing suit so I didn't get to enjoy the other parts of the spa, the massage withu partner was nice and we ended up going to the reserve snack area for breakfast. I'm happy we did because this was the first breakfast I didn't feel like I had to worry about

I did the escape room with my mom and she told me that she was now on her 3rd concierge and they kept messing up her reservation. She said we had a reservation for Sal which we were all excited for. You can only go one time included but honestly with the reservation system I can't see how you would be able to go again anyways. 

We went back to the cabanas but we were only able to get 2 out of the 5 cabanas we were promised. You can only reserve cabanas 2 days of your stay but we had difficulty with that. 

Blue Agave: this ended up being my favorite lunch spot. Being able to order individual tacos. I love al pastor and they do it right here. Caramelized with lovely grilled pineapple. Some delicious fresh pineapple. Marco was great and I ended up tipping him $20 just because he was extremely engaging and very helpful and kind. We told the rest of our party about it and they all went on their own time and had a similar experience. 

Sal: Some of our party did not remember the reservation time for Sal. So I called down when they opened and they said our reservation was for 7. We all had thought it was 7:30. My mom calls down and they tell her it's 7:30. The manager ended up being wrong and on their own reservation list it said 7:30 even though he argued with us when we arrived. This was my second favorite meal but everyone else's first favorite meal. From start to finish you cannot go wrong at sal. It is not worth paying extra for the up charged meats or wine. The house wines and free reserve meals are fine but they will try and upsell you proteins by showing you this display of meat until you ask them about how much they are giving you and find out you get 1/4 of the size for about $80 starting point. 

Day 6: Xcaret
We spent the entire day at Xcaret and this solidified that the bad food and rooms was only at this hotel. The food at Xcaret was amazing and so was our experience. We also learned they have resorts on property and if we ever come back to Cancun will stay there and never again with Paradisus or Melia properties.

Day 7: Resort Day
Today the executive chef was here. This was the only day we felt comfortable eating at Malva. However to not risk it we are very simple.proteins, cured meats and simple carbs. Apparently we weren't the only group getting sick as when our fourth couple went in to the shop to buy food poisoning medication they had sold out. 

Cabana day was nice and we ended up having 3 cabanas which was nice. We got Blue agave again and enjoyed some coconut water and fresh coconut. We saw Yamil and by this point knew what we could and could eat at the resort. Try the aguachile in the cabanas.

At this point my mom's concierge called her again and delighted her by saying she got her dinner reservations to Capella. Everyone told her to try Capella at the hotel. However our reservationa were at 6. The last couple who got sick ended up leaving early. This was unrelated as far as they told us so there were only 8 of us. 

Blue Agave: we went here again for lunch with my mom and brother and once again had a wonderful time. I took a risk and tried the lengua, which is something I usually only have at places I really trust and was amazingly surprised they they took care of it. Once again Marco was amazing and also had David with him who was also great. 

Capella: this placed actually pissed me off. So much hype for this place. Again to fight for the menus for our table, our server is bitter and rude. Do not get the artichoke appetizer. It was gross and had the consistency of cat food. The cacio a Pepe salad is just a Caesar with an insulting lack of dressing, when we asked for extra dressing they brought us sour ranch, further confirming our suspicions of the dairy in this hotel. The carpaccio has no acid to cook the beef and we had to ask for limes. Our entrees surprised everyone. Mushroom risotto... With no mushrooms. Pizza with string cheese consistency and no sauce, my pasta didn't have anything I ordered in it. And I told them I could not have dairy and they put cheese on my pasta anyways. The sp called "best" restaurant ended up being the worse. This ended up being the only place we did not tip. 

Room service: we ate half of our food at sal and were left starving by 10. we decided to get room service again. The burger again since it's safe at the "pretzel" dog they didn't have the other night. Again over an hour to get the food. It wasn't till I called at midnight that said its an hour deliver time for food. And hour for a hot dog? Supposedly it was supposed to come on a pretzel bun, sauerkraut and spicy mustard with potato wedges. I got sweetustard, hoagie roll, no sauerkraut and 4 wedge cut potatoes that were inedible since they were still raw? I ate the sausage itself and finalized out last night with further disappointment. 

Day 8: Departure Day
Overall saying in building 3 was loud ALL night every night. They consistently doing maintenance in the middle of the night and we woke up multiple times to the smell of paint thinner and listening to cleaning machines. Those that were in building 4 had a way better experience. 

5/16 of our meals consumed on property did we consider good or edible.

The check out experience was as bad as everyone mentioned. We put a card on file at check in and were told "as soon as you use the card you have to add it again," what does that even mean? We have to add the card to file every time we use the card on file? What a poor excuse. They said that we had to have the servers apply the discounts at each service we used, we never even saw a single check at any establishment. So our party paid several hundred more for no reason. 

We will never stay at a Melia property again and we will never return to Paradisus. If we ever return to Cancun we will stay at a Xcaret property.

reviews.author: Kishore30083518
reviews.title: Over rated. Prepare for some surprises.
reviews.text:
1. The rooms weren’t comfortable. 
2. One restaurant per night to reserve and they had no availability for one of the day.
3. Ground level servicing employees were good and helpful.
4. Front desk was too slow and service desk didn’t address

reviews.author: Spat3873737383
reviews.title: Great Looking Resort, Rooms Need Help
reviews.text: Great main area with the natural look but the rooms and services via operator need a lot of help to become modern. The staff at the pools and restaurants were fantastic but the maids were not. Not a very toddler friendly resort even though it is advertised to be kid friendly.

reviews.author: FC
reviews.title: Resort Is a Letdown Since It Didn't Live Up to Our Expectations.
reviews.text:
We stayed at Paradisus Cancun for seven nights from January 30, 2023. This was our 5th trip to Cancun but first to Paradisus Cancun. I have conflicted views about this resort because it has several redeeming qualities but also a lot of flaws. Two of us were vegan.

Pros:

Communication:
The staff (Cristian Morales) is prompt in communicating via WhatsApp which is a great method of contacting guest services.

Check-In:
Once you enter the main lobby you will be greeted by an impressive atrium-style lobby and bar. The sheer size of pyramid 3 will hit you once you see the main atrium. There is lovely vegetation draped from the ceilings and it gives off some lovely tropical vibes, however, if you prefer open concept and airy environment, then this is not the resort for you.

Restaurants:
Given the scale of the resort, you would think the Paradisus would have a vast food selection, and it does, with 5 ala carte restaurants. The food was quite good for an all-inclusive, however, you could taste and feel the mass-produced part of their culinary offering at times. They should also offer a variety of more vegan-friendly alternatives. There are no vegan desserts here; every dessert contains eggs and cow milk.
Malva buffet restaurant (is small compared to other resorts) offers a respectable small selection; however, it is consistent day in and day out. There is no vegan cheese available for vegans; imagine a pizza without cheese.

Staff:
There was an exceptional staff member in guest services, Cristian Morales! This young man deserves a promotion! He went above and beyond to correct the wrongs we were experiencing.
We had the worst room experience, and after a two day battle with back and forth with check-in and guest services, one room had an excessive amount of AC and no water in the shower for two days. They have available rooms, but they won't upgrade you until you pay more $$$ for a better room. The bare minimum they should do before assigning a room is to ensure everything is in working order.
After the room saga was settled, Cristian arranged to have champagne and chocolate covered strawberry delivered to our rooms. This is one of the many things he did to salvage our experience (Cristian … Thank you so much, and we hope your mother is doing well. You won’t be forgotten.
Also, a special thanks to the following members of staff who went above and beyond to improve our stay:
•	Chef of Capella restaurant, Arturo – He personally came to greet us and made sure we had the chance to sample some of his vegan dishes. Although vegan cheese would be ideal to have on a pizza.
•	Manager of Capella restaurant, Carlos Chay – In addition to introducing Chef Arturo, he went above and above to ensure that our requirements were satisfied.
•	Manager of Lunch Box restaurant, Rafael – Rafael is beyond amazing and great; he deserves a promotion or some sort of acknowledgment. During our dinner at Lunch Box, he brought a cake as a simple gesture of gratitude.
•	Chef of Lunch Box restaurant, Christopher – Rafael introduced Chef Christopher who made dishes that were not on the menu. Chef Christopher – thank you for making the delicious vegan dishes for our group.
•	Manager and Chef of Aqua Marina – Thank you for accommodating our vegan dietary and making us a delicious vegan shawarma.
•	Barista of Nepresso, Edier – He went above and beyond to prepare lattes every evening and Edier is extremely humble and polite. He should be acknowledged by Paradissus.
•	Staff of Guest Services, Rommel Cruz – It was a pleasure to see how he was always willing to help and was very knowledgeable about the resort and gave us tips and tricks of travelling outside the resort. He is a true professional.

Cons
Hotel:
The hotel requires a MAJOR INDOOR construction or renovation; the entire pyramids 3 and 4 are falling apart. The railings in the corridor on the seventh level are disintegrating. I unintentionally walked in a pool of water in the corridor of Pyramid 4 due to the passageway had constant leakage from overnight rain.

Rooms:
Our junior suite rooms which overlooked the lagoon, were seriously outdated like from the 80’s and in need of major renovation. Our rooms (4410 and 3629) had unclean mirrors, peeling bathtubs, faulty air conditioning, counter edges that were falling off, water dripping from our balcony and into our suite and no hot water for two days. Prior to leaving for the beach, we contacted the front desk, sadly no one arrived to mend repairs until the next day. The decor was all over the place and didn’t flow together. It looked like it was designed for a 4-year-old with cheap Ikea furniture.

Staff:
The first individual I had an issue with works at Nepresso, he wears glasses and retainers, and is the worst employee they could have, extremely rude. One evening after dinner, I went and requested for a soymilk latte, but this person lied and said they don’t’ carry soymilk. When I asked him how it was possible that you no longer carry soymilk after our group had it for the past four days, he responded saying he would go get some from the restaurant.
The second individual is Stephanie at Guest Services who thinks she knows everything and lied about our inquiry. When we inquired about playing tennis, she informed us that the tennis courts would be closed for two days due to ongoing maintenance work, and there would be a fee after 6 p.m.
No work was being done, according to our inspection. We are shocked to see her handing out tennis balls to six Spanish-speaking guest and they were heading to the court to play the same evening. Once more, Cristian Morales stepped in to take care of the situation, he informed us that no work is being done on the court, as he resolved the issue.

Charges:
Although this resort is advertised as all inclusive, there are a TONS of extra hidden fees from resort costs, cabanas, drinks, dining establishments, room service, etc. We anticipated that there would be extra fees for deluxe amenities, however, we have never seen so many fees for what we view as “standard”; at other all-inclusive resorts, especially in comparison to our previous visits to the Bahia Principe Luxury, Royalton Hotels, Sandos, Riu Group of Hotels, Karisma Hotels & Resorts which is genuinely a 4.5-star hotel.

Fresh Juice:
We got fresh juices with our choice of vegetables and fruits the first two days at breakfast. The staff member informed the guests at breakfast on the third day that no fresh juice will be made since Ginger Bar and Malva Restaurant share the same blender. Until the manager informed us that they do share machines with other restaurants, we were laughing and thought it was a joke and in realty it was the truth. And because they use a blender rather than a juicer, the juice is very pulpy.

Overall, we had a great time here. We made an effort to ignore the drawbacks and focus only on the fantastic setting and exceptional service, however we will not be returning to this hotel. Rooms 3629 and 4410

reviews.author: Mary Jo B
reviews.title: Poor customer service. Great staff
reviews.text:
We want to express our disappointment with the manner in which our room flooding experience was handled.

On Friday, February 3, 2023, we woke up to flooding in our room, number 3347. The water covered a large area from the sliding glass door,soaking the rug, and reaching to the side of the bed. I got out of bed and my feet were in water. The water also came under the sofa.

We called for maintenance to come to the room. They did come quickly.  We left the room, and stayed out until about 3 pm.

When we returned to the room, it was again flooded with the same amount of water. This time, we went to the "front desk" at the "check" in area. Maintenance again mopped up the water. 

We left the room for about 2 hours, and came back to a flooded room. Again, we went to the "front desk" and reported the problem.

We were really inconvenienced, not having full and safe access to our room.
When we talked with Customer Service, Rosanna Zannino, she challenged that we had any issues with the room. While we understand Melia may have guests that are "difficult", we are good and respectful guests, having stayed at Melia properties for many years.We did ask for some credit for 1 night of charges.

We would have expected more respect from "Customer Service". It was a very unpleasant experience ending our vacation. We may not stay with Melia in the future. This review will also be posted in Trip Advisor

reviews.author: maikewilliams89
reviews.title: Schönes Hotel aber kein Luxus
reviews.text: Hotel ist schön aber der Service lässt zu wünschen übrig . Wir haben den Reserve“ Service gebucht. Leider war kein Unterschied zum regulären zu merken. Restaurant Reservierungen wurden falsch gemacht . Zimmer wurde nicht regelmäßig aufgeräumt usw. Es war einfach nicht Perfect für den Preis. Es wird versucht Perfect zu sein aber es klappt nicht. Auch die Organisation des Concierges war eine Katastrophe und es wurden Dinge versprochen die nicht eingehalten wurden. Also besser nicht den reserve Teil buchen denn es rentiert sich nicht

reviews.author: Eglover68
reviews.title: Won't be back.....
reviews.text: While this resort has amazing room views & some nice amenities (spa, multiple restaurant choices, etc) the hotel seems to be struggling with maintenance issues and an overall lack of staff training and consistency in service. I arrived with a large group of 6 well-travelled couples who are very familiar with all-inclusive resorts. For most places, this would've been an excellent opportunity to go out on a limb and wow us with service...not at Paradisus. Our size made it very difficult to obtain dinner reservations....even though most of the restaurants were almost empty when we managed to book. Concierge was virtually non-existent. Spa scheduling was limited to only 2 at a time. No turn down service even though the porter told us housekeeping would come by twice a day. A few of us (including me) experienced flooding in our rooms from mysterious causes to which the solution was to move out of the room - no bonus consolation offered. I also had a power outtage on one side of my room which I didn't pay too much attention to, but later reported. There was leaking from the rafters outside of our room as well which caused a safety hazard (my husband almost slipped multiple times). Our best foodie experience overall was at Lemon Fish. Capella's was nice, but service was average as the waiter seemed somewhat annoyed the whole time we were there. I personally was very irritated by the hard-sell tactics of resort management who invaded our pool time several times to upsell Melia. I understand they work on commission, but the insistence in having me attend a 1 hour sales session even after I expressed my displeasure was ridiculous. Improve your product before you try to sell me on it. I think this place had once been marvelous, but a lack of attention is certainly creeping it's way in. Needless to say, we won't be back.

reviews.author: Cyndi W
reviews.title: I was forced to stay here.
reviews.text: Stayed here with family for a wedding. I would not have chosen it myself, and would not return. Attention to detail was severely lacking in general and the need to make reservations for every single thing at the property made me extremely anxious — this was supposed to be a vacation, but I felt like I ended up being as over-scheduled as I am at work! We were unable to get reservations at any of the hotel restaurants in groups larger than two people, despite the restaurants looking mostly empty. And there was a bizarre lack of silverware at the restaurants. No silverware was provided at all at Blue Agave, and my dessert at Lemon Fish was served with a bamboo spoon. When I asked for a regular spoon, I was given a tiny espresso spoon for my dessert. Our room was fine but it was a nightly disco light show due to a phone light that would not stop blinking and a smoke detector over the bed that blinked brightly green every two seconds. The steam room at the spa was broken and unavailable, and while I was relaxing in the sauna I got called a “rude b*tch” by two snotty teenagers simply because I asked them twice to close the sauna door that they left open. Why are there even teenagers in a spa?? The reserve pool area was nice, but no one explained to us how to make cabana reservations, and poolside service was hit or miss (best service we received was from Moises at the pool - he had great cocktail recommendations!). This hotel is basically a land-based cruise ship; it’s the Olive Garden of the hotel industry. If that’s your jam, then I would actually recommend it. If not, then don’t stay here unless you are forced to because a family member is getting married.

reviews.author: AV
reviews.title: Poor service for a very expensive hotel
reviews.text:
Currently staying at this hotel and it is a big disappointment. We were here in 2015 and had a blast so decided to spend 5 days here. As it is close to New Year we paid close to $1000 per night for Reserve Ocean Front room.

First 3 days we had no dedicated Concierge. No body came to ask for making our reservations. On 2nd day we went to the front desk and found someone. He made booking for us but then again no communication, no way to find him.

Today went to front desk to explain tomorrow is our last full day and we would like to book Bana bed but got no confirmation. Eventually we received phone chat that someone is assigned and will book it for us.

Most restaurants close before they specify. We went to Lunch Box at 3:30 and it was closed. We went to Malva Buffett for multiple meals and more than half the seating section is always closed.

7 year ago all juices were real fresh fruit juices. Now everything is some sugary drink with probably no fruit in it. No watermelon juice of any kind anymore(I love fresh watermelon juice).

Credit to the people who are still doing excellent work. Our housekeeping, room-service, spa service has been excellent.

Huge disappointment overall considering what we paid.

reviews.author: TatiBerde
reviews.title: Decepción
reviews.text: La primera vez que la pasó tan mal en esta cadena y que no brindan solución al huésped … una cama súper incómoda sin comodidades ! Hubo que reclamar toallas / batas. Me dijeron que reclame por la web.

reviews.author: Jorge
reviews.title: Hotel que ha bajado su calidad
reviews.text:
Un hotel que ha bajado mucho en su servicio, mantenimiento y calidad de alimentos.

Aunque el hotel estaba a la mitad de ocupación, los restaurantes no tenían los alimentos ofrecidos en la carta y el sabor de los alimentos deja mucho que desear (esto en tres restaurantes)

El restaurante Sal, de buena calidad pero si querías repetir, tenía costo adicional.

Habitaciones sin agua caliente - solicitamos corregirlo y se atendió pero ¿porqué hay que estar pidiendo que haya agua caliente en las habitaciones?

Agua cayendo en pasillos del hotel (filtraciones).

Falta de amenidades para jóvenes, quienes se decepcionan y prefieren no regresar.

Lo positivo: el servicio del restaurante de playa de Reserve y del buffete.

Habitaciones que no cuentan con servicios para adultos mayores (barras en regaderas o WC para apoyo). 
Complejo el movimiento para personas en silla de ruedas.

reviews.author: TexasRoadBoys
reviews.title: Not worth it, better options out there
reviews.text:
My wife and I have been to many resorts over the years (Dominican, Cancun, Playa del Carmen, Jamaica, Etc.), while this resort has potential to go from a 2 to a 4, they clearly won’t because of poor management. 

We are in our 40’s (travelled with 2 other couples). No kids.  

We booked the “reserve area” thinking it would be similar to the Paradisus in Playa del Carmen. Well it’s nothing like that from a service level or food level or atmosphere.  They may have the same name but are nothing alike. 

The buffet, is the absolute smallest buffet I’ve ever experienced at an all inclusive.  It makes you wondering if there is another buffet on the resort that you missed (which there isn’t).  I’ve been to Dreams, Riu’s, Sandals, Oasis, etc.  this one was by far the worst buffet lacking everything and I must note, with the slowest omelet making stations you’ll ever experience.  Now, a positive is…a few of the alacart restaurants are really good but they try to “upsell” you on a lot…even if you’re in the highest class room “reserve”.  

The night life…it’s non-existent past midnight. Nor do they have any serving bars open after midnight.  We are NOT the type that needs to be up until 3am every night but shutting everything down every night at 12 is the most ridiculous and oddball thing I’ve seen at an all inclusive resort. Needless to say, if you like “live entertainment”…they do NOT have that here. 

The music at the middle pool is some workers Bluetooth list hooked up to a speaker. The music selection is horrendous.  
The music at the adult only reserve pool is non-existent.  

The butler service for reserve was fine. I can’t blame them…they can’t make the bars stay open longer nor can they fit the buffet or music.

The rooms are outdated. 
The beach area was great. 
Plenty of pool chairs 
Liquor was good and servers good too. 

I would not recommend this place to anyone. Much better out there for this price

reviews.author: Explore668247
reviews.title: Pésimo servicio
reviews.text:
Pésimo servicio 
El hotel no tiene el personal suficiente y se tardan horas en traerte una bebida
No son serviciales ni amables, todo es un problema para el personal. No sonríen parece que están enojados 

Muy sucio el hotel, los baños sucios, no cargan los enchufes en el cuarto 

No es un hotel diamente deberían quitarle ese indicador. Muy viejo el hotel y sin mantenimiento.

reviews.author: Neeraj A
reviews.title: Poor room quality and service for premium prices
reviews.text: The room had a bad smell, bathroom faucets and toilet door were pretty old. At paradisus “all inclusive” technically just means food and stay, all the services (in room food service, laundry, general medical assistance were all separate charge). When we checked in the front desk didn’t tell us that we needed to make dinner reservations at the restaurant. The restaurant’s didn’t have vegetarian food and buffets didn’t even have proper signs for whether the dish was vegetarian or not. Furthermore, when we asked servers or workers at the restaurant whether something was vegetarian we got wrong answers where initially someone said it was vegetarian and later another person said it was non vegetarian. Most of the staff was only interested in selling services instead of helping provide quality service. The room we stayed in was smelly and old.

reviews.author: Nathalie A
reviews.title: Bruit
reviews.text:
J’avais besoin de me reposer…..c’est rater, bruit, bruit, musique trop forte, plage public où le resort loue des chaises donc aucune réglementation donc musique des vacanciers trop forte. Peut-être ai-je été malchanceuse mais la chaîne Melia pour moi c’est terminé, alors que j’aimais beaucoup.
Aussi on a eu un resto seulement, complet on me pouvait pas réserver et pour entrer au buffet fallait attendre de longue file le matin et le soir.
Honnêteté oblige, les employés sont sympathiques et le service est bon. 
J’en ai fait des resorts dans ma vie et c’est le pire que j’ai jamais vue.

reviews.author: Sergey N
reviews.title: Not a 5 Star Hotel
reviews.text:
Would like to start my review with positive things . The hotel stuff is nice and very helpful , especially Christian and Albert at the reception. The views, the ocean, the nature are amazing and taking your breath away, it’s like in the movies . 
But that the end of good things. 
Now, we did see couple of cockroaches at the buffet, also we saw them in the room 3616 and 3618. My mother in law found one at night moving on her hand, this is crazy, especially for hotel and has 5 star rating.

We chose this hotel for our wedding. The wedding coordinator did not answered our emails and when we got to the hotel we were forced to spend a lot of time deciding all the details of our wedding, which should’ve been done way before we came there. As an apology for that, they gave us bridal suite for free and helped us with every little thing throughput the wedding. The dinner at the wedding was so poor and tasted not good. They also forgot to put our dance floor, for which we paid. The good part was that we had very beautiful view, pictures came out amazing. 

Another thing is food. I understand that it might be good for others, but I’ve been to a lot of different places with different types of food, but this place is something, I could not eat this , my mom as well. We got poisoned and had diarrhea , vomiting and temperature couple of days that ruined my vacation big time . I am very disappointed unfortunately.

reviews.author: Victoria G
reviews.title: El hotel no debería de ser de la línea Paradisus
reviews.text:
La verdad que si bien el hotel es muy antiguo está fuera de mantenimiento. Tuvimos desde que llegamos experiencias que nunca imaginé que íbamos a tener ya que en otro Paradisus y ya hace 8 años que vamos es totalmente diferente. 
Se nos inundo el baño, del techo caía agua, del aire acondicionado también donde a mi hija le dio una patada eléctrica porque cayó Justo en la lámpara. 
Salvo la excelente atención del concierge Pavel, TODOS los chicos de kidsdom quien te cuidan a los niños con mucho profesionalismo y cariño, la atención de José del minibar y de la gente que atiende en los restaurantes, no fue una buena experiencia y no recomiendo el hotel. No está a la altura de un Paradisus.

reviews.author: Ryan F
reviews.title: Has gotten poor
reviews.text:
I’ve stayed at this resort a few times over the past 5 years. They have went down hill. My room a/c didn’t work and to fix the situation they tried to downgrade me rooms. However I’m arrival it took an hour to checkin as they were trying to upgrade everyone rooms. They have gotten really greedy. Ask I could hear from midnight to 3am was loud pounding of music from the night club. Anytime staying in tower 4 would hear this. This wasn’t disclosed. They stopped supplying Simple things like maps to guests unless you are in the reserve or medallion class. It’s like they are pushing the staff to just upswell everything instead of taking care of the guests for what they advertised. They also have a cockroach issue s as I saw them on the buffet and on in our bathroom. Thankfully it was in our bathroom the last day or I would have freaked.

Overall I would no longer recommend this resort. I brought 3 other couples here this trip and it let me down.

reviews.author: Andres21216
reviews.title: No fue proporcional en mi caso el costo al servicio en general
reviews.text:
Prácticamente fueron 3 motivos:

1. Habitación.- tenia una tv que ni prendía, si bien es cierto estuve por un evento que llegaba muerto a la habitación esos 15 o 20 minutos de ver tv para mi son relajantes. Tampoco servía la lámpara del medio entre las 2 camas y finalmente el sistema de aire acondicionado es muy viejo.

2.Comida.- solo probé a parte del buffet que le doy 3 estrellas de 5 Lemon fish que le doy 4 de 5 y blue agave que a ese si le doy 5 de 5. El día viernes de mi salida me encontré con una cucaracha entre la decoración de la pared a 30 cm de mi. NO TERMINE MI DESAYUNO

3.- Servicio personal.- es importante que SIEMPRE EL PERSONAL SALUDE CON UN BUENOS DÍAS, en su mayoría parecían huéspedes los trabajadores muy hostiles, incluso me negaron una bebida que nada tenía que ver con mi “pulsera” un jack con coca

Con esto el precio cancelado no tiene nada que ver con el servicio prestado… preferiría ir a los hoteles de grupo palace o secrets

reviews.author: RhiRhi8739
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: I booked Paradisus The Reserve because this is where I stay in DR and I love it.  I was completely disappointed.   The Reserve is building 5.  There is nothing offered in building 5 except a small bar and finger foods with nats flying over them. There is a concierge/butler offered.  I saw her once.  She made dinner reservations at 2 restaurants and I never saw her again.  My traveling companions never met theirs at all.  Building 3 is where you will find all restaurants, the pool and any entertainment offered.   Imagine the walk daily from the upgraded reserve area.  The food was awful.  The beef and pork in the buffet was so tough, we had them make us hamburgers.  One day it was descent/edible.  The breakfast was good.. fresh omelets and mimosas.  The steak house was just ok.  The Italian restaurant was ok but there was no AC and it was very very hot.  I can not tell you anything about the Lemon Fish as we were turned away because we did not have reservations.  The Blue Agave was good however we had to take our menu to the cook and order because we could not find a waiter and I had to literally go behind the bar, go in their cooler and get my own beer.  The only person that provided good service was an older gentleman at the cabanas.  I tipped him 40 dollars because he worked hard to ensure we were taken care of.  Speaking of the cabanas, we had to stand in line to reserve one because our concierge/butler was not to be found.  We had a chilled bottle of champagne left in our room and I thought it would be our night cap only to find it gone when we returned.  I called to see if I could possibly get it back but no luck.  I can say that the place was clean.  I will NEVER book here again.  Completely disappointed and spent a lot of money for nothing.

reviews.author: Belkys H
reviews.title: Very disappointed…
reviews.text: Normalmente durante nuestras vacaciones cada año por más de 15 años mantenemos la línea con Melia Resorts no importa el país. Siempre hemos estado más que satisfechos con el servicio, no ha ocurrido lo mismo en este viaje. El servicio por parte del personal fue excelente, el señor ALEJANDRO  de Nexpresso Café y ALFRED del restaurant buffet se llevaron todo el crédito al mejor servicio del hotel, siempre muy atentos al igual que el resto de los trabajadores. Los contra que encontramos fueron primeramente la temperatura dentro del hotel, DEMASIADO CALOR EN TODO EL HOTEL, solo se sentía el ac en el lobby del front desk (check in/out), las áreas comunes, elevadores, pasillos etc súper húmedo todo el tiempo. El hotel no tiene circulación de aire exterior ya que es herméticamente cerrado, a mi entender el aire acondicionado debería funcionar mejor. La reserva para restaurants horrible, primero solo tenian para muy temprano o muy tarde y luego de rogar entonces aparecieron las posibilidades para la hora que queríamos. El restaurant Aquamarina para el dinner ya no tenía muchas opciones del menú. Las habitaciones el aire acondicionado no trabajaba bien, a pesar de bajar el termostato la temperatura se mantenía en 77 grados farenheits, las reportamos 2 veces hasta que pedimos nos cambiaran porque fue imposible dormir con ese calor. Las siguientes habitaciones estaban bien. El area de recreacion nocturna el mismo problema, nos apenaba como sudaban los muchachos del show de baile con esa temperatura, a pesar de todo también todos maravillosos y muy atentos. Muchos de los huéspedes que tuvimos la oportunidad de conocer sufrían de la misma situacion. La piscina también necesita remodelación , el nivel del agua muy por debajo del nivel del filtro, mucha basura flotando en la superficie. En general no nos sentimos satisfechos para el precio y la calidad a la que estábamos acostumbrados con Meliá y REPITO, estamos muy satisfechos con el trato y el servicio del personal. Pensamos que esta situacion debe ser revisada  por la administracion del hotel con el fin de mantener el flujo de huéspedes hacia su propiedad. Gracias por la oportunidad.

reviews.author: QuEeNyGuRl
reviews.title: Disappointing Stay and Lemon Fish is overhyped
reviews.text:
At $400/night I expected excellent service that Mexico is known for and great local cuisine.  While the resort grounds were huge, beautiful and luxurious, the experience here was just mediocre.  

I'll start off with the pros:

- The location of the property is right in hotel zone, sitting in front of the gorgeous Caribbean Ocean.  We had an ocean view room on the 3rd floor and the view of the ocean was spectacular!  The room came with a balcony so it was nice to relax outside with the sounds of the waves.

- The main pool area was huge and never felt too crowded in the late afternoons.  The pool bar did close early like 5pm.  The pool water temp was perfect, not too warm or cold. There was a cart by the pool serving hamburgers and hotdogs.

- The bar at the Kanna Beach Club had great drink service, I recommend the Sexy Banana blended drink.  This is the bar where it had the swing chairs for your gram photos.   We were the only ones there at 11am.

- Cielo, the contemporary Mexican cuisine restaurant had the best food at the resort.  I recommend the bone marrow with sopes, shrimp ceviche, shrimp entree and octopus entree. Special shout out to our server Noe, who was excellent and was very attentive.  He always made sure our drinks were full and finished plates were taken away immediately.

- The bellmen (forgot his name) who brought up our luggage to the room, provided us tips on what to do at the resort and how to explore the hotel zone via the red bus.  There's a bus stop right outside of the resort.  The buses come every few minutes and are only 12 pesos per person.  We took it to the luxury mall a couple miles away.

- 24-hour espresso bar was nice.  We could get our coffee fix at anytime of the day or pastries for a snack.

Now for the cons:

- At check-in the card reader device was giving an error and saying it couldn't read my card.  I know there's nothing wrong with my card as I had just used it in Mexico with no problems, the credit limit is high, and I already put a travel notice on it.  So it wasn't me.  Plus the error was that it couldn't read it, not decline.  The agent asked if I had another card to use.  My answer was no and do not put the onus onto the customer to resolve your device technical issues.  Not my problem your device is broken.  He looked stunned by my response and didn't know what to do.  I told him to use another card reader and voila it worked!  Annoying that he couldn't think outside the box to solve their hardware issue. Escalate to your manager if you need to, swipe it, tap it, manually enter it but don't put it back onto the customer.

- After check-in, our concierge lady was giving us a tour of the resort and recommended some restaurants, like Lemon Fish.  We were only there for 2 nights and both nights were fully booked.  We just got here and you're already telling us we can't eat at your highly recommended restaurant.  After some back and forth at our displeasure, they magically found something at 10pm the next night.  I understand the reservation system is needed to help manage the crowds and making sure that staff is available.  But it is ridiculous to not have any availability for guests at the property.  

- Blue Agave, the taco restaurant was awful.  We've eaten delicious tacos from SoCal, Tijuana, Cabo and Puerto Vallarta, and tacos here were just sad.  There's a billion waiters but only 1 cook.  4 tacos took like 30+ min to arrive.  The taco meat was bland, dry and lacked any flavor.  Even after drowning them in salsa, it still tasted awful.  My partner couldn't even finish one taco.  How can you mess up tacos in Mexico?

- Now for the big night at Lemon Fish that was fully booked to the grills and everyone is raving about, was a huge disappointment.  I don't know what their definition of fully booked is but the restaurant was 50% empty!  They made it sound so exclusive, high in demand and hard to get into but we were surrounded by empty tables.  There seems to be plenty of staff members too. My theory is that they purposely make it hard for guests to get reservations here because it's considered their more "premium" restaurant and want to funnel guests to their lower tier restaurants like the buffet. Living in SoCal, we've had our fair share of excellent sushi so our standard is pretty high.  The sushi here is joke.  The people who gave this place a glowing review has probably not eaten at a proper sushi restaurant before.  The sushi was dry, rice was hard, and tasted like store bought ones from Trader Joes. Costco makes better sushi than this place.  The meat skewers, had this weird grainy texture to it.  It is partially our fault for having such high expectations for a sushi place in Mexico.  If you're a sushi lover, I recommend you SKIP THIS PLACE, not worth the hype. You'll be severely disappointed.  Or just lower your expectation that is a C grade sushi restaurant.

- For a resort that advertises as a luxury resort, our room was the total opposite.  The decor was all over the place and didn't flow together.  It looked like it was designed for a 4 year old with cheap Ikea furniture.  I've stayed at 3 star Marriots and Fairfield Inns, that had rooms more well put together than this trash.  Our closet doors were just cheap white curtains, the bathroom sink did not drain properly (yes the plug was open) and our couch was missing cushions so it was unusable.  The sink was so annoying, we sometimes just used the shower to brush our teeth. For $400/night this is unacceptable.  The little details matter at a "luxury" resort. 

Never returning to this resort or any other Melia properties.    After the first night at this place, we were already over this place.  Thank goodness the remainder of our trip was at xCaret Arte which was million times better.  ✌️ Paradisus

reviews.author: Captain Ash
reviews.title: Very disappointed
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus Cancun from August 8-16-2022, it was our third visit to the hotel with the most recent one just before Covid. I gave the hotel 2 stars only because the hotel needs a major remodeling and cleaning. It’s way overpriced for what the hotel offers or it is in reality. They sell you Luxury Suite and it’s not even a one star small crowded room.
We planned the trip and book 3 rooms in March 22 to celebrate a family member’s birthday. We booked the Luxury suite Ocean view all inclusive. My only request to the reservation team is to keep the rooms close to each other since we have a lot of excited children, so they added my request to the notes and we expected that.
