When we got to the hotel all the troubles started, we weren’t given rooms close to each other and not even at the same floor, they said if we upgrade the room for 90$ a night per room they will find us something close to each other. So basically they could’ve done it but they didn’t want to. I mean they wanted me to pay almost extra 2000$ on to of the 10,000$ we already paid, that was ridiculous.
When we got into our room the room was crowded with furniture, the ceiling paint falling off, the doors won’t close properly, the shampoo holder broken and the biggest thing for me was mold in the shower. After talking to a manager we were promised a better room on day 2 and we switched rooms, the new room was in the reserve section which is slightly higher end of the Luxury but we found the same issues we had in the previous room on top of that the shower/restroom has no door, I didn’t accept their offer to install a curtain and we switched to Room number 3. The only thing different was the air conditioning worked fine but we encountered the same issues of the previous rooms plus broken mirror in the bathroom.
I decided to talk to a manager and Marisol was aware of all our fiasco and disappointment so she offered us a one bedroom suite at the reserve in tower 5 which supposedly it’s the signature tower of the hotel. We did switch but honestly it was just the same issues of broken items and mold of the previous rooms but we got tired of moving so we settled in that room until the last day.
I did express all my concerns to the manager and how disappointed we all are from the quality of the hotel and it’s rooms.
Not only the rooms though needs a major cleaning and remodeling but the gym the restaurants, the hallways the pool etc…
The food was ok nothing fancy to justify the all inclusive price. No vegan options, also they use a lot of syrup and paste in their cooking, nothing fresh or exceptional.
The only reason I gave the hotel 2 stars and not 1 star it’s because of the employees, they are really polite and nice.
Bottom line it was a huge disappointment and I won’t recommend this hotel to anyone. At least not for the published price. I personally won’t go back there again.

reviews.author: Abdul
reviews.title: Spend your money elsewhere!
reviews.text:
This was my second and it will be my last visit to Paradisus.very poor Customer’s service and the quality of everything went down and nobody cares.My son is vegetarian and I simply asked Julian (the chef) for some melted cheese for his nachos,he looked at me in the eyes and said he doesn’t have any,I found it very odd; a kitchen that big doesn’t have any cheese in it.I was still curious after sitting back at my table,so I asked my waiter which he was amazing ,his name is Alfred,I explained him my son’s condition,the first thing he told me that he has a daughter also and he totally understands and he will try to help me.10 min later he showed up with a bowl of melted cheese and he was able to put a smile on my son’s face,I was very disappointed of JULIAN as a leader and he couldn’t accommodate me for the smallest thing.I saw him afterwards around the buffet and I let him know that I was able to get some help,he had no answer for me.I asked to speak to his Boss and of course no follow up call .
My background is sales at a vacation club affiliated with RCI and I will never refer any guest to Paradisus!

reviews.author: Gspan415
reviews.title: Nice looking property, disappointing experience
reviews.text:
I stayed at Paradisus over the 4th of July Weekend with my wife and our infant daughter (she was 8 months old at the time).  There were some upsides but the downsides just overwhelmed us.  As the old saying goes "Other than that, how was the play, Mrs. Lincoln?"

Pros
There were some.  The property itself is beautiful and located close to the airport and right in the hotel zone.  Because we had a baby, we didn't leave the property to go to Downtown Cancun or anything but it's pretty close if you decide to.  The staff was incredibly friendly and always willing to help out.  The pool was well designed.  It was incredibly long (probably about a quarter mile total) so it could cater to everyone.  There was a family side, a party side, and a quiet but deep side.  Whatever you were looking for at the pool you would find, which was nice.  It was also easy to get a drink, which isn't always the case at all-inclusives.

Cons
IT'S HOT.  And I don't mean hot as in great, I mean hot as in mercury rising.  The property has plant life (vines, trees) throughout the interior.  We arrived at night so didn't notice this at first but the following day, as we walked around, it was noticeably muggy and sticky inside the property in the common areas.  We asked someone on staff why the air conditioning wasn't on (it's July in Mexico) and his response was "because of the plants."  I don't know who made the decision to choose indoor plants over air conditioning at a resort in Cancun but it was the absolute, 100% wrong decision.  The air conditioning in our room worked but very poorly and it never got a reasonable temperature in our room.  We complained about this when we arrived but nothing was ever done about it.  The only place in the hotel that was comfortable was inside the restaurants and bars, where the AC was on full blast.  Anything else doesn't really matter since nobody can enjoy a vacation when they're uncomfortable but there was more.

We opted for the "Reserve" package.  This gives you access to a different part of the hotel and comes with your own "personal" concierge.  We didn't utilize the other part of the hotel because children were not allowed there.  That's not a big deal and obviously we made the choice to travel with a baby.  However, the "personal" concierge was an absolute waste of time and money.  First, ours did not tell us when we arrived that we should book cabanas by the pool right away because those book 2 days in advance. Instead, we were left scrambling to find a comfortable place to sit for the first few days of our trip when we could have dealt with that at check-in.  On the 2nd day there, we were looking for someone who could blow up our baby's floaties for the pool.  My wife and I walked almost the length of the resort before we found someone, but not before we contacted our concierge to ask how we could handle this.  No response.  Several hours later (and long after we found someone to handle this) we got a text saying that he "lost his phone" and that's why there was no response.  On  our second to last day, I asked our concierge if they could just confirm our transfer back to the airport.  When I didn't get a response by the morning we were supposed to leave, I did this myself as well.

I have no problem doing these things myself on vacation but I do take issue with selling people on a package where someone takes care of this and doesn't do the things that matter.  Essentially, the Reserve package gets you someone that will book you restaurant reservations, which I'd rather do myself if that's all I'm getting.

Those are the two major issues but there were some minor ones as well.  Despite being an all-inclusive resort, they didn't restock the fridge daily and I had to call several times to ask they restock us with water, which we needed for the baby's formula.  The fans weren't on during the daytime for the first few days that we were there (despite no air conditioning in the common areas) and I have no idea why.  By the last day they were running 24/7 so I'm guessing they got enough complaints about the heat and humidity.  When we arrived, the sheets were filthy and we had to ask someone to have them come and change the sheets out.  

Overall
The worst part is that the two biggest problems with this place are both easily fixable.  Turn on the air conditioning and don't waste time with the reserve package.  I would have honestly given this place 4/5 if those two weren't at issue.  My advice to anyone thinking about coming here is to come in the winter months and don't bother with the Reserve package.

reviews.author: Sam Mo
reviews.title: Will never return to this “resort”
reviews.text: The whole experience was a disaster. They had us check in in the wrongs area. Made us go to another area and then back to the main lobby. No apologies at all. Food was ok and no help from staff. If we asked if we could get more they would say no more sorry and within two mins another person would bring out more of what we had asked. The rooms needed to be updated with the curtains for closet separation and cutouts of dry wall where maintenance was done. The pools were filthy. Slime and mold were visible everywhere. The grout was chipping away ever where too. Clearly they didn’t put any money toward maintaining the pools or never cleaned them while we were there. Management didn’t care bc they already were pain and good luck getting  towels after 11 am. Practically non existent and never could get fresh ones till the next day. I’ll be sticking to Marriott and Hilton. I’ve never had such a horrible experience in Cancun. I probably won’t be retuning to any of the Melia properties after this.

reviews.author: Aleegli
reviews.title: Sadly No longer a family resort, Kids club not safe for children Unsafe hotel
reviews.text:
I wish I could say my second time around visiting this hotel was great, but I cant.

Sadly this place has changed too much and has lost what made it special.
Reviews are tricky as they can be very subjective.
My expectations were high, because when I was there in 2019 my experience was great, and this time around it was not.

I begged my family  from Texas to meet us there, as we travel from Switzerland with 2 small kids and they had a great kids program via the family concierge, which no longer exist. 

This hotel seems to be moving more towards only adults and feels like they are transitioning.
Do they have a kids club? yes, is it safe for small children 5, 6 and up?
not in my opinion as my daughter almost drowned under their care and I found out about the incident via the kid that pulled her out of the water.
The girls from the kids dome were not even aware it happened and as i found out more details I grew more upset.
There were other issues but really the biggest one was that.

I ended up leaving the hotel 3 days early and got a refund for my last 3 days. 
I was told it was not possible at first but I booked directly via Melia and they had no choice.

So, in other words, if you travel as a couple only adults you might have a good time, but if you have any expectations on relaxing while your kids have a good time at the kids dome, go elsewhere. It is not safe and I wouldn't want your kid to actually drown.

I am still in disbelieve on how much the hotel minimised the situation, I didn't bother to mention the inappropriate behaviour I witnessed from an animator with a 15 year old, or the fact that drugs are sold with in the perimeter of the hotel.

Again this is not a Hotel safe for children of any age, there are better hotels within the hotel zone and better beaches, food and service. If you want any tips about hotels that may be suited for you, e mail me and I'll be happy to share what I know with you.

all the best and good luck. 
  

PS I do Have to recognise Nancy from housekeeping was great, Alejandro from the Nespresso bar (great touch) Sarai Hostess and Teresa waitress  at Malva. 
Other than that, the service mediocre, as was the food and drinks. It really is a shame.

reviews.author: Patricio Piña
reviews.title: No pienso regresar
reviews.text: Las instalaciones me parecieron adecuadas y el servicio de las personas en área de alberca bastante bueno. La comida dejó mucho que desear, el buffet de desayuno era ACEPTABLE, mientras que el de la comida y la cena dejaron mucho que desear en cuanto al sabor de los alimentos. En repetidas ocasiones tuve que solicitar que pusieran más pinzas para tomar diversos alimentos, ya que al haber solo una pinza, la demás gente llegaba y tocaba la comida con las manos. Para los restaurantes de especialidad tienes que bajar a hacer la cita con la encargada (ya que por teléfono no contesta), y estar puntual a las 9 AM ya que de los contrario se agotaban los lugares siendo que en ninguna de las ocasiones ví los restaurantes llenos. Ademas, estuve cinco noches y no está permitido hacer todas tus reservaciones el día que llegas, tienes que bajar cada dos días a reservar, aparte no tienen ahí disponible ni en los restaurantes el menú de cada lugar como para escoger(absurdo, ya se, todo es con código QR y resulta que se desactivan en el día y hasta las 6 vuelve a funcionar el código, podría ir a la recepción pero se supone que se trata de que se fácil y agradable...no que me compiquen las cosas). Lejos de facilitar las cosas, su sistema deplorable te complica la existencia. A pesar de que el restaurante estaba al 25% de su capacidad, no te dan tu mesa si no están todos los de la reserva presentes. El trato y la disposición de la gran mayoría del personal fue muy atento y cortés y su supuesto restaurante estrella, Lemon Fish, resultó ser la menos disfrutable de nuestras experiencias culinarias. No volveria ni lo recomendaria.

reviews.author: Expedition717889
reviews.title: Below average compared to sister resorts in Mexico
reviews.text:
We have visited several Melia Paradisus resorts in Mexico. So far this one in Cancun was below our expectations and compared to the other hotels in the same chain was subpar. The building looks good, but you can tell its aging. The landscape and location is beautiful. Unfortunately that’s where the 2 stars end. 

This is the first time we have visited a Melia Paradisus resort where we did not enjoy the food. The buffet was poorly managed and poorly maintained. I was always a fan of sister Paradisus’ buffet. The other restaurants, Lunch Box, the italian restaurant, use same food from buffet. The design is cramped and confusing. The buffet shares the windows and doors with Lunch Box and the Italian place. Sad to say that Overall the food there was below average. We even ate at their pay restaurant Sal, which was way overpriced. We at two steaks that were labeled Prime cuts (based on my opinion, definitely not a Prime Steak). After asking for medium rare, steaks came out overcooked to well done. Two steaks, two sides and a glass of wine (glass not bottle) 280 US dollars. DONT go to Sal they are still learning how to cook steaks, I hope. Lets talk about the pool. 

The pool runs long and plenty of room to swim. Unfortunately you can tell its age by the tile surrounding the pool wall. Small tile all over were chipping or sticking out and people were cutting themselves left and right, including us. Food and the pool was decent. The seafood bar was great (cook at seafood bar makes sure he pushes his tip towards you to make sure you tip). 

Room: Our room was a master suite with ocean view considered recently remodeled. Two A/C units, one in living room guest sleeping area and one in master bed. The master bed had a clogged air filter and was kinda gross. The master bath was remolded, but the mirror was covering the window without any insulation so when the sun came out, the entire bathroom was REALLY HOT, because there was zero ventilation in the bathroom. The shower leaked water into the floor the entire time and required a ful size towel to pick up all the mess every time we used it. 

Service: first time we have experienced this type of service. Workers in all areas seemed to try and avoid contact with guest. That resulted in confusion, late help or just stress of not being able to find a worker. 

Kids Dom: they are only open from 10:00am-1pm and 2pm-6pm. So very limited time for parents to relax, because you have to stress to make sure you pick up your kids on time and bring them back again in the afternoon. So parents, you will be watching the clock your whole time there if you bring kids. 

Do try: the coffee bar outside the buffet. The taco restaurant next to coffee bar. The seafood restaurant at the pool. 

Please, make this experience better. I know good workers may be hard to get during these times, but train your staff and take care of them. Happy staff = happy guest

reviews.author: Katherine M
reviews.title: Mediocre
reviews.text:
Pretty shocked to read such positive reviews, as we had a completely different opinion.
We arrived and our room was not ready until about 4PM. The blow drier in the room was not working and three lights in the bathroom went suddenly went off. The hotel itself is big, but there is not much to do at all in terms of entertainment. We were actually pretty bored especially at night. We also found a cockroach trying to enter our room, thankfully we killed it before it was too late. The AC in the room is extremely loud and goes off every 5 minutes literally! Also, be prepared to be awake at 6AM as the music outside you can hear it in your room bright and early. There were barely any reservations available for the restaurants so we did not even end up eating at any of them during our stay. We walked by them and they were NOT full, so this was a huge disappointment. Also, I had a simple request since my bracelet was not working and the line in the lobby was about 20 minutes since there was only one concierge working. Would I come back? Absolutely not.

reviews.author: queenyb80
reviews.title: Not worth the price
reviews.text: It’s unbelievably hot in this hotel.  It’s not just the main areas but also the rooms. We are staying in 2 ocean front junior suite and we can’t open the curtains to look at the ocean view because the room gets so hot is unbearable during the day.  We called the front desk but I’m not sure if there is much they can do about it. The AC can not keep up. It runs constantly.  We are staying for 6 days and can’t get reservations at the sushi restaurant which is ridiculous.  They push the timeshares for free cabana rentals or a discount for activities.  So all the pictures of seafood on cabanas will either cost you $200 or you will have to sit through a timeshare presentation.  Also the ocean is extremely rough and dangerous even for experienced swimmers so the only option is the pool.  We have had to call every day to have the mini bar restocked.  The hotel is beautiful and the food at the buffet and Auquamarina have been pretty good.   The staff has been extremely nice but the negatives out weigh the positives. I will never book this hotel again.  There are too many options for what you pay to be uncomfortable.

reviews.author: Fernando Chen
reviews.title: At best a 3 star hotel
reviews.text:
We have been here for less than 24 hrs and we would leave today if we could get a refund. Everything went well with check in. It was quick and speedy. However the staff although very nice did not really explain where everything was and what we could do during our stay. We received a map but that was about it. We unpacked and we’re ready for dinner around 5:45pm. We didn’t know which restaurants were open (not on the map the front staff gave us) but we were aware most needed a reservation besides Malva (the buffet) and Blue Agave. Malva had a sign that showed it was closed and we found out later it opened at 6. We stood outside Blue Agave for at least 10 minutes and no one came to help us. I walked around during that time and finally found someone to ask. The very nice staff went in the restaurant and asked someone to help us and by that time the buffet just happen to open at 6pm. We decided to go to the buffet since we didn’t eat lunch due to our flight. 
Malva buffet was at best a 3 out of 5 buffet. The food did not have much taste and the selection was rather small for a large resort. The eggplant was hard. The top sirloin was over cooked and tough to eat. Even my son who was starving didn’t eat much. 
We went back to our rooms to relax and pull out to sofa bed for my son. The sofa bed must have been at least 15-20 years old and rarely used. We couldn’t even pull it out it was so rusty. He said he was ok just sleeping on it as a couch. The light switches, plugs, etc all looked older than 20 years. The room was not worthy of what one would call a 5 star hotel or even 4. If you’ve stayed at a Holiday Inn Express, that is significantly nicer than the Junior suite we received. 
We stayed on the highest floor (8th) and we’re excited that it seemed to be far enough away to get a good night rest. Due to the open design of the resort in tower 3, at midnight there was a huge ruckus somewhere in the building and it woke us up. Can’t really change the design but be aware that it can get noisy. 
The bed and pillows were actually pretty comfortable. And we ended up sleeping well after that. 
The shower seemed to have been repaired many times. Caulking was done over a bit messy and the tub felt like there was sand on it but there wasn’t (basically a lot of scratches). The shower curtain didn’t even cover the length of the shower. Water would splash out if using the handheld sprayer. The rain shower was just ok. I felt there were clogged holes so the water didn’t come out even. 
The room is much smaller than I expected and it was tight in the bathroom/shower area. 
My wife woke up at 6 to make sure we had a nice place around the pool to relax all day as we planned our massages and excursions. Keep in mind she found a place that had enough shade without moving chairs and umbrellas around. There were 2 umbrellas for 4 chairs. At 10 o’clock someone sits next to us and asks the staff to move the umbrella to her side and he tells us we can’t have 2. What? Fine we had no choice but to oblige. 
My 10 year old son who has been taking indoor and beach volleyball lessons this summer was excited to see the volleyball court on the beach. We found out one of the activities this morning was beach volleyball. He was excited. Showed up and waited over 20 minutes for the staff and guests to finish one game. He asked if he could join and was told it was for adults only. What?!! The activities sheet said “Family” beach volleyball. He is better than most people who were playing. 
Later he went up to the bar at the pool and asked for a drink and it seemed like the worker did not understand him. He came back visibly upset without a drink.  
As we were planning our week, one of the tasks was to make reservations for dinner. I found out we can books them through the Melia app. I register and joined. When I tried to link my reservation it said I needed a reservation number. I purchased the trip through Costco and found out this morning that because it was through Costco I would not be able to link it and take advantage of the reservation system through the app. 
The week vacation for 2 adults and 1 child was almost $6500. For this price I would have expected so much more.  We are member of Palace resorts and decided to trip something new. Oh boy do we regret it now. 
By the way, masks are required which I have no problem with and was happy to wear. And they do provide it if you forget it on your way to a restaurant. 
Overall this resort might the rated 5 stars for the amenities but don’t be fooled. It’s outdated and needs a lot of work (at least the room we stayed in). Oh and there is a restaurant that you have to pay for and a pool area that is “reserved”. The pool area is nice but also needs work. 
Lastly one of the reasons we chose the resort was  because of the area. We stayed at JW Marriott just a couple of resorts up and it was a wonderful clear blue water with white sand beach. The beach here is full of sea kelp similar to where Moon Palace is located. I looked up the coast and sure enough there wasn’t much of the sea kelp to be seen. For this type of beach I much rather spend my week at Moon Palace. 
I really wanted to like this place because of the reviews and the location but after less than 24 hrs at the resort I feel like I’m staying at a 3 star resort. Nothing wrong with that but for the price we paid it’s definitely not worth it.

reviews.author: Rosa M
reviews.title: Decepcionada
reviews.text: Tiene buenas instalaciones pero la comida no es buena , el servicio en habitación malísimo , servicio al ingreso y solución front desk pésimo . Los restaurantes son insuficientes para el número de personas . Tiene buenos meseros otros con muy mala actitud

reviews.author: Myra Alatorre
reviews.title: Never again! It could’ve  been better…
reviews.text:
First times in Cancun. Stayed 4nights5days. Room was pretty but very hot. Aircon not working right. Complained fr day 1 but nothing was done. We did not have an assigned concierge person so the head concierge (Malou)  took over the responsibility. As much money as we paid, We didn’t get the Service we expected.  One night security came knocking on our door saying there’s a fire.  But when we asked again, Head of Security said “Nobody was supposed to be knocking on our door”. So who was that person in hotel uniform that knocked on our door? Was there a breech of security there? Also, Too much stairs to climb outside and Tourbuses cannot go to the front doors. Why not an escalator? Another thing is, avoid any encounter with OTIUM Time share representative Ricardo. He was so rude to our guy Armando. He questioned me not being able to afford paying  $250 US dollars in a demeaning tone. I’ve been to other  timeshare presentations and this was the worst ever. The first time I’ve got  so upset. I’ve complained to the Big Boss Alberto and I hope this gets addressed. 
Don’t get me wrong. Hotel was very pretty, people always served with a smile and always said “My pleasure”. But bottom line is, it could’ve been better. And I hope that guy  Ricardo gets sent to a Customer Service Satisfaction class or something like that.

reviews.author: JohnnyPortugal
reviews.title: Not so Great Hotel. Bad reservation services.
reviews.text:
I`ll try to make the most honest review.

GOOD
Consierge service excelent. Juan made our week so much easier, making all the reservations to the restaurants, responding to every request we made very quickly. 

Jennifer and Max (pool bali beds)
I didn´t enjoy paying the reserve and having to wait until 11:00am to see if i could have a bali bed. We pay extra and dont appreciate have to beg for somtehing I`m supposed to have in the first place.  
If it wasnt for Jennifer and Max being so kind and going the extra mile i´ve would have given up ando go to the other pools. Thanks to both, especially jennifer (she is super friendly to everyone)

All the staff at the restaurant SANTE. They work very hard and are very friendly.

The room was nice and updated.

CONS:
Reception - It was made in the building 5 (The reserve). The reception in the main building feels more luxury than this one, that seems outdated.
We had a major problem with our reservation canceled, and till now the hotel didnt show us (What they told us) the email from our travel agency cancelling the reservation. After a 10 hour flight, we had to call our agent (almost 01:00 am in our country) to talk to the hotel resevations services to clarify things. It was nerve wrecking. We had poor help from Luis at the reception desk. He was more interested in charging 2 nights extra on our credit card, more than in making us more calm and trying to solve the problem (was fixed by our travel agent).
He even try to put us in the building 3, only after we complain a lot (and his co-worker intervention) he moved us to a room in the reserve building. 
In the last day, we couldnt open our room door since the hotel (again) antecipated our check-out onde day earlier (another call to our agent again).
It shows poor competence from the hotel sadlly.

Restaurants
Sante, Lemon fish and capella are good restaurants.
Buffet restaurant only good at breakfast. poor variety in other meals.
The food was not that great. i Have to say i ate better and more spicy food at cancun airport.

Beach
What a disappointment. First I was going to Playa del Carmen, but with the "Sargazo" situation i moved to Cancun. It`s not the same. The sea is always rough and not enjoyable, even with little seaweed.

Shows
There is no good place to watch shows. Didnt like ginger bar at all. If you want to watch seated, forget. There was always someone standing up in front of us. The type of entertainment wasnt that good also.
If you are young and only want DJ parties maybe thats the place for you.
My 2 cents advice. The Hotel should have a place for shows like other Hotels have, with a stage and chairs. There is enough room for that in the Hotel.
Outside entertainment the same. Only a few spots to seat and listen to live music.

GENERAL EVALUATION
I feel bad for the staff (they were great) and made the hotel more enjoyable, but I must be honest and say if i could go back in time i`ve would have stayed in the RIU Hotels in Cancun. I prefer their approach to entertainment and all in general. Its really sad that the Hotel doesnt play music from mexico by the pools. 
The hotel is also somewhat far from the hotel zone (Coco Bongo, malls etc).

reviews.author: Michelle K
reviews.title: If you don’t pay extra for the Reserve
reviews.text: You’ll regret staying here. You can’t get dinner reservations to answer the phone to save your life. I’ve called multiple times and no answer ever!  Eating buffet everyday is not worth the cost we paid to stay here. The beach is awful and full of seaweed. We stayed here in 2016 and now after this visit we will not return to Paradisus. Very disappointed and regret spending our vacation here.

reviews.author: viviana u
reviews.title: Bajo mucho la calidad del hotel, no es cinco estrellas  PESIMO
reviews.text: Bajo muchísimo la calidad de hotel, nosotros habíamos estado en 2019, el check in despues de hacerlo on line como pide el hotel, estuvimos en un pequeño espacio durante una hora para realizarlo, lleno de gente, con dos personas solo atendiendo, la comida en el buffet es repetitiva, todos los días es parecida y con pésima atención, colas para desayunar, esperas para cenar, los restaurantes antes la reserva se hacía por teléfono, ahora , si adivinaron hay que hacer cola para reservar, además hay platos que se deben pagar en los mismos, y la frutilla del postre es que no hay suficientes reposeras y sombrillas para los huespedes, el primer día estuvimos tirados con una toalla en el piso, otro día con reposera sin sombrilla, lo único que quiere  hacer el hotel es vender el premium del hotel, en resumen no es un hotel 5 estrellas, ni cerca, por suerte habíamos reservado tres noches y luego nos pudimos cambiar a un hotel mejor, solo pienso lo que hubiera sido la estadía 10 días,

reviews.author: Paradise320391
reviews.title: Book with caution!
reviews.text:
This hotel is beautiful, has great landscaping and well taken care of lobbying/atrium. However, that is were the compliments end. I found the front desk staff to be unfriendly and check-in to be very slow. Additionally, the hotel was overcrowded (inebriated college spring breakers), getting pool chairs and restaurant reservations were impossible. I was literally told by staff it was “impossible”. I was also haggled about sitting through a timeshare presentation, very odd.

Next, if you enjoy premium liquor or seasoned food this is not the hotel for you. The drinks were watered down and the bar was full of rail liquors.

Lastly, three tips, schedule covid test appointment, food reservation and excursions on first day of arrival, for your entire stay. Covid testing is only conducted from 9am-5pm, make sure to fit timeframe in plans.

reviews.author: Carlos M
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancún
reviews.text: Nos toco una habitación  cerca de una máquina y se escuchaba mucho ruido, no se podía salir al balcón por lo mismo,  los sanitarios exteriores tenían cucarachas y nadie los limpio en todo un día y los trabajadores entraron en varias ocasiones al sanitario.

reviews.author: luisabelle2022
reviews.title: There are better resorts for the money
reviews.text: We traveled in a group. Three of the seven rooms had electrical power issues. When using iron, blow dryer or computer, the circuit breaker trips. We were told to use the bathroom outlet for equipment needing more power. Unacceptable. Also they have very loud music playin until late hours of the nigt in the center of the guest rooms. Anyone wishing to sleep before midnight will find this noise intrusive. We neede ear plugs every night and still were able to hear the music. There basically is no resource personel to attend to any needs that arise after hours...those hours are befor 9am -5pm. Any issues have to wait for business hours. The food is substandard compared to other resorts we have been to. The buffet area is a joke. There is no selection whatsoever and the food quality is mediocre. The specialty restaurants were disapointing as well. The resort itself is asthetically beautiful. Beach is very nice, pools are nice. But the discrepencies seemed to keep adding up and overall we would not return to this resort.

reviews.author: Stay776562
reviews.title: Pésimo servicio
reviews.text:
Reservamos 4 habitaciones para pasar Año Nuevo, al ingresar al hotel se acercó una chica para preguntarnos apellido y posteriormente se fue a recibir a otras personas, sin decirnos donde hacer nuestro check Inn (inicialmente nos acercamos del lado derecho creyendo que ahí era y ya nos indicaron que era enfrente); para hacer check Inn hicimos fila y tardamos aproximadamente media hora, nos dijeron que para cenar era necesario hacer reservación cada día. 
La primera noche fuimos a cenar en Enzo, pésimo servicio del personal, mi prima viajo todo el día y no había comido por lo que solicitamos le tomaran la orden rápidamente a lo que el mesero nos dijo “primero bebidas para todos y posteriormente les tomo la orden uno por uno” le volvimos a pedir que solo tomara la orden de mi prima a lo que hizo caso omiso. Tardó demasiado en llevarnos bebidas, se olvidaron del platillo principal y al llevarlo ya parecían las sobras. 
Para año nuevo primero fuimos a cenar a the lunch box, cada mesero daba información diferente: unos que solo podíamos pedir el menú de año nuevo, otros que lo que quisiéramos, nuevamente el servicio súper lento. 
Despues en la “fiesta” que nos habían indicado que para tener un lugar en el evento era con costo extra, cosa que nos pareció extraño por qué en los demás hoteles que hemos pasado Año Nuevo no te cobran por el evento, al final decidimos pagarlo por qué ya estábamos ahí y queríamos disfrutarlo, la peor decisión que hicimos! Fue un PÉSIMO SERVICIO, pagamos $13,500 MXN que incluía una sala lunch, snacks y 3 botellas, eran las 11:40PM y solo teníamos la mesa, no nos llevaban las botellas, cuando empezaron a ponernos las copas llegó el encargado del evento y se llevó al mesero, en la cuenta regresiva a dos minutos antes de las 12:00 se les fue el sonido y la pantalla, cosa que pudo pasar completamente desapercibida si nos hubieran dado el servicio por el cual pagamos EXTRA, en ese momento los meseros empezaron a entregar bengalas casi aventandolas a la gente y tampoco nos dieron a todos, yo creo que ni a la mitad de los que estábamos, ademas que no las prendieron ni nos dieron algún encendedor, las uvas nunca llegaron, los “snacks” que incluía tampoco supimos ni que eran por qué no nos ofrecieron nada, en conclusión me parece una ESTAFA pagar por un servicio extra y no recibirlo, ya que el evento era gratis y estaba más fácil ir a la barra para tener una bebida. 
Al final de nuestra estancia pusimos nuestra queja con Wen en atención al cliente, quien estuvo intentando comunicarse con Raúl Ayala gerente de alimentos y bebidas para que nos atendiera y el señor no le hacía caso, hasta que Wen se comunicó con su jefe y ya contestó Raúl que en un momento se acercaba, estuvimos esperándolo aproximadamente media hora. Cuando llegó al inicio quiso escudarse diciendo que el evento fue realizado por un proveedor externo y el solo era encargado del personal de alimentos y bebidas, a lo que le dijimos que entonces él era la persona indicada ya que todo nuestro mal rato de los primeros 2 días fue con su personal. Nos dijo que buscaría alguna solución para no irnos de esa manera y se fue. A los 15 minutos le envío un mensaje a Wen ofreciéndonos el reembolso del 10% el cual rechazamos y después ofreció el 15% que de igual manera rechazamos, lo que buscábamos no era una propina; al mismo tiempo escuchamos un incidente que tuvieron la noche anterior por el cual le estaban cobrando daños a un huésped al cual no le cobraron sólo un porcentaje de lo que hizo, entonces por que cuando el error es directamente del hotel quieren escatimar. 
Por último, Rosanna Zannino nos ofreció un upgrade en “the reserve” área exclusiva para adultos para nuestra siguiente estancia, sin embargo, en primer lugar viajamos niños y con la experiencia que tuvimos no dan nada de ganas de regresar a ese hotel, y si aseguran que el servicio será “excepcional” entonces sería algo clasista que por tener ese tipo de reservación nos vayan a tratar mejor, cuando el servicio debe ser excelente para todos sus huéspedes. 

Las únicas personas que hicieron Perfecto su trabajo que para nuestra mala suerte las conocimos en nuestro último día en el hotel:
Osvaldo - Bartender de barra de alberca enfrente de the lunch box
Claudia - mesera por evento en área de alberca 
Samuel y Orlando - Poolbar 
Javier - mesero en restaurante italiano 

Si van a ir a Cancún, les recomiendo hospedarse en la cadena Palace Elite.

reviews.author: Nadia77Mexico
reviews.title: Mala experiencia, bajaron la calidad NO VUELVO
reviews.text:
Las habitaciones están viejas, con humedades, las puertas de la terraza no cierran bien y entra aire en la noche, la regadera tapada.
En varias ocasiones percibí olor a mariguana en la playa y en los camastros de la alberca cosa que me parece preocupante en un hotel familiar.
Escasez de meseros por lo que atienden con mala actitud.
Mala calidad de los alimentos  en especial el restaurante Lemon fish, pésimo.
Los camastros viejos, oxidados, no se reclinan.
El servicio de limpieza a cuartos muy deficiente.
Tienen un nuevo beach club el cual permite a cualquier persona de la calle utilizar la playa y alberca del hotel, lo cual me parece pésimo y peor en temporada alta.

Como puntos positivos destaco:
Excelentes desayunos
Algunos elementos  muy valiosos entre el personal
Buenas medidas Covid
Excelente spa
Pero definitivamente NO VUELVO.

reviews.author: sandraerika2004
reviews.title: Not recommended, Not sure what going on.
reviews.text: The staff really needs to get it together. People were not friendly. Refrigerators were not stocked, nor did the front desk answer the phone many times that we called to try to get a reservation we will try for hours. We seem to eat at the Buffet because we could not get into anywhere. The spa me the experience horrible for us. The staff member was very sick with a horrible cough. Also the day before our departure we had trouble obtaining our Covid test. They forgot to send us my husbands test. The hotel staff gave us a run around and sent us back-and-forth from different sections of the hotel. No one seem to wanna help us. We were very patient and very nice. Until I had enough and then one member was annoyed that they kept sending us from section to section and he called his manager and they help us connect with the clinic. We sent emails to clinic before they closed and after letting them know we didn’t receive our test. We were nervous because we had an early flight.

reviews.author: Paul D
reviews.title: Not a 5 Star - Dated, Corporate, Lacking Amenities and clear communication
reviews.text:
We have stayed at over 10+ all inclusives all over Mexico and this is by far the worst one. We considered a few others in the area as we are trying to stay near the JW Marriott since our friends are staying there and settled on Paradisus

Below are a few pros and may cons…

PROS:

- Sanitation - hotel is doing a very good job abiding by covid rules. People wear plastic gloves for the Buffett, regular sanitation is being conducted and overall place is clean

- views - the view to the ocean is pretty great

- indoor - the inside center section of the hotel is cool greenery and stringed lights at night

Cons:

- reservations - for the life of us.. we can not figure out how to get a dinner reservation. We have downloaded the app, come to guest services and called 5 different phones over different hours to the hotel dinner reservation # and no one has picked up. We ended up just going to the Buffett. It seems the only way to book a dinner reservation is calling an extension number and no one is answering! 

- amenities -  we had no overview of the amenities, concierge, etc. when we checked in. I am still confused where we go for issues or compliments as there are multiple front desks 

- room - we have a lagoon view and the room is very dated (yet spacious - two rooms, one for sleeping and one living room) a few of the lights in the bathroom did not work and our sink drain is clogged / does not drain … we called the front desk before going to the beach and no one came to fix

- check in upgrade - we asked about an upgrade to a better room. Immediately we were offered an ocean View for additional $100/ night or a reserve room for $80… after declining they immediately offered another 20% off and we still declined. It felt very corporate and stingy and almost like an “Igotcha” 

- up charges - the resort is listed as an all inclusive but there are TON of up charges. Resort fees, cabanas, nicer alcohol, room service is $5, etc. we expect their to be upcharges for premium amenities but we have never seen so many upcharges for what we consider “standard” at an all inclusive at other resorts

We still have our stay until January 1st, so hopefully the stay will get better, but overall we can not recommend the hotel at this price point and especially listed at a 5 star. The hotel is a 4 star at best and needs to drop their prices and be less “corporate”

reviews.author: CristinaC
reviews.title: Tiempo compartido club Meliá
reviews.text:
Acabamos de estar en el club Meliá paradisus Cancún y nos hemos llevado una gran decepción ,ha bajado considerablemente la atención y las prestaciones . Lamentablemente no es lo que era . Esta muy antiguo y le falta mantenimiento ,las prestaciones de los tiempos compartidos han desaparecido ,han disminuido los restaurantes para cenar y apenas hay espectáculos solo dj . 
Por decir que ni rastro del
Kids club …..

reviews.author: joaniezn
reviews.title: Not worth it
reviews.text: Too much loud noise at night. Construction in main building creating a lot of dust. Not recommend for family trip. Checkin process is super slow. Restaurant reserve rations not easy to book. Slow service at restaurants.

reviews.author: chtesche
reviews.title: The Reserve -  Serviço de Péssima Qualidade
reviews.text: Mesmo sendo check in "exclusivo" para o serviço The Reserve, foi muito demorado. Uma hora esperando, porque só havia uma funcionária para o atendimento. O nosso concierge Victor não nos deu muita atenção. Não atendeu nossas solicitações e só o vimos na chegada. Fomos informados de que somente poderíamos reservar camas balinesas da piscina exclusive para adultos em dois dias da nossa estada, Como não tem cadeiras/guarda-sol (somente as camas balinesas) fica muito prejudicado o uso da piscina nos demais dias. Na área da piscina, o atendimento não foi nada bom, Privilegiavam o atendimento aos hóspedes americanos, possivelmente por que eles dão mais gorjeta. Os quartos e o hotel em si são muito bonitos e foram o ponto alto. Nos restaurantes e buffet, achamos a comida apenas razoavel. Em suma, achei uma péssima relação custo/benefício e, certamente, não me hospedaria novamente no hotel.

reviews.author: foru2nv86
reviews.title: Bad Services and no accommodations when complaints
reviews.text: The service was not what I expected it to be there was certain restaurants that was ok but the food was poor quality and cold. Also, there was no accommodations once complained about roaches in the restaurant.

reviews.author: Ana Karen
reviews.title: No lo recomiendo, todos los de recepción atienden pésimo
reviews.text: Servicio pésimo, cualquier hotel hasta de 3 estrellas tiene mejor atención que Paradisus, en verdad que pagar más de $120,000 pesos por tan deplorable atención, me ofrecieron quedarme en Hard Rock Cancún y sin embargo decidí elegir este hotel, estoy muy arrepentida. El día que llegamos no nos querían dar 2 camas siendo que se puso una anotación, me decían que por problemas operaciones los chicos de recepción no cooperan en nada, el día de hoy ya fue el colmo cuando llame y me dejaron colgada 3 veces en recepción y ya por fin me contesto una chica con nombre Fabiola que parecía que le estaba hablando a la pared, le preguntaba algo y se quedaba callada varios segundos hasta pensé que ya me había dejado colgada.. mi recomendación es no quedarse en este hotel con atención tan pobre, las instalaciones están perfectas pero preferiría quedarme en un hotel con mejor atención y servicio hacia sus huéspedes, además reservamos 2 habitaciones y nos toco lejos una de la otra, esté hotel no piensa en sus huéspedes y con esos empleados de recepción en verdad que no dan ganas de volver, cero cooperación por parte de ellos, no ofrecen opciones, no buscar ayudarte y lo PEOR es que todavía tenemos que estar hasta el día miércoles, jamás lo recomendaríamos

reviews.author: Tito Mariño
reviews.title: Personal que no ayuda
reviews.text: No recomiendo este hotel en Cancun, se recibe nada de ayuda por parte del personal de recepcion. Se reservaron 2 Habitaciones con dos camas cada una, y no pudieron asignarlas. Ni al siguiente dia de llegada tampoco accedieron a ayudar. Un hotel de 5 estrellas debe de tratar de apoyar a huespedes en sus necesidades, puedo entender que por pandemia tengan restriccion en la disponibilidad, pero hay maneras de poder sarisfacer y entender a los clientes. En ningun momento mostraron interes en solucionar o dar alternativa.

reviews.author: Raúl
reviews.title: Una gran decepción
reviews.text:
El hotel es impresionante, enorme y bonito, sin embargo, el 95% del hotel son habitaciones, cuenta con muy pocos restaurantes de los cuales 1 no está incluido en el "todo incluido". 

El personal es muy amable y atento, pero muy muy escaso, por ejemplo tienen una sola persona para la zona de la playa y, cómo es lógico, no da de sí, pides una bebida y te sale más a cuenta ir a buscarla tú mismo porque se demoran hasta 30 minutos, por tanto esa experiencia "cinco estrellas" se pierde completamente. Remarco qué es "culpa" de la cadena qué no contrata más personal. 

En el terreno actividades y entretenimiento pecan de ser terriblemente aburridos, cuentan con escasas actividades que van de "chick" para nada divertidas, sí no te buscas la vida es muy fácil aburrirse en el hotel. Te enseñan a hacer mascarillas faciales, pintar con los dedos... Cómo veis, todo muy divertido. Podría seguir un buen rato, pero creo qué es un buen resumen de la experiencia, a mí no me vuelven a ver el pelo aquí.

reviews.author: mscherryfan
reviews.title: Theft and poor service.  Stay away!!
reviews.text: When you offer a personal concierge you should be able to deliver on the expectation listed on your website.  When I spoke to other guest they didn’t have a concierge appointed either.  Maybe hire maids that don’t steal would be a start.  My AirPods went missing from my room and there was no help by the staff to get them back even though there is a gps tracker on them yelling me their exact location.  My coffee and water were never refilled after asking everyday.  I don’t drink so that was my only request for the room.  The royal service is a shame, there was theft of my belongings, no help from security or guest services, poor food quality, and no request was fulfilled regarding my daughter birthday.  As a long time Meliá guest this experience has made me switch to Dreams resorts as my number one.

reviews.author: Pedro O
reviews.title: Pésima opción, hotel viejo y caro. “All inclusive” y te cobran todo.
reviews.text:
El hotel es viejo y descuidado. Aunque aparentemente el paquete sea all inclusive, te cobran por usar las camas en la playa o si quieres pedir algo que no sea agua y terminas pagando más de lo que cuesta una noche. 220 dólares por rentar una cama, y nada de lo que quieras pedir está incluido en el all inclusive. La verdad muy mala experiencia. En los buffets todo está frío y es de mala calidad. Y no es un hotel barato pague casi 30 mil pesos por 4 noches. 

Mala atención en el check in, casi no me dejan entrar porque mi acompañante olvidó su identificación. 

En la habitación se escuchan ruidos en el piso de arriba que no dejan dormir. 

En la vida regreso a este hotel, muy por debajo de mi estándar mínimo aceptable y muy caro para lo que ofrece.

reviews.author: vramirez10
reviews.title: Regular Atencion
reviews.text: Estamos hospedados según el hotel con el beneficio de un Conserje, la orientación respecto a las instalaciones excepto por la ayuda de Wen ha sido pobre. No es claro lo referente a reservas de restaurantes, sitios junto a la piscina, cancha de tenis, toallas

reviews.author: Morgana K
reviews.title: DAVID was the ONLY POSITIVE PART of our experience
reviews.text: THIS PLACE IS UNDER CONSTRUCTION BE AWARE! first of all no one told us the construction was going on before we arrived so the entire time the lobby was loud and disruptive. we had the worst customer service I have ever experienced, staff was dismissive, not helpful, and often condescending. one of the waiters even told us to hurry up at the breakfast buffet. when we checked in, no one explained any of the amenities or what parts of the resort we had access to so we ended up accidentally going into the reserve area and being embarrassingly asked to leave because we didn't have the reserve upgrade. they had us use an app to navigate amenities at the resort but it was super glitchy, some of the information was wrong and just sucked as an app in general. we requested toothbrushes and bathrobes sent to our room but we had to ask four different times before anyone brought us our stuff. the food is okay at best, but don't go here if you are vegetarian/vegan you won't have anything to eat I barely ever finished a plate of food once during our four-day stay. when we complained to the management they didn't really seem to care and they weren't able to offer us much. the only staff member that relived any of my stress was David at the welcome desk. he made me feel that my concerns were heard and he was honest and helpful. if anyone from Paradisus is reading this, please consider David for a promotion as he is experienced and great with customers and all the other employees here have a lot they can learn from how he handles guests. the beach was nice here tho that's about the only good thing I have to say.

reviews.author: kacay
reviews.title: not for the price
reviews.text:
we visit the hotel for 5 days ,this was my second time in this place but it was only melia at that time so i had a big expectations from this place and the price.
Checking was slow and with many disinformation ,they send us to a room that was occupied wen we came back to the reception .it took 2 hours to find us another room.
And not information at all about the hotel amenities( she told me go to the hotel app for any information. The room was nice clean the air conditioner was not very cold we called maintenance bu they never show up. if you want good service dont forget to TIP because if not you are going to be invisible .waiters look that they dont want to be bother and if you speak spanish the treatment is going to be different . also the hotel is under construction at the center lobby so be prepare for a lot of dust and noise.the service at the beach very poor only one sever for the entire beach.drinks also poor quality .nobody wear a face mask ,the swimming pool and the buffet very crowded .the have covid test at the hotel for free you have to book it through your phone .

reviews.author: Juan Andres Pérez
reviews.title: Eco hipocresía
reviews.text: Actualmente estoy en este suntuoso hotel LIBRE DE HUMO Y ECO HOTEL DE 5 estrellas y me parece de una hipocresía increíble , estoy en la habitación 1604 y estos días han pintado esta parte del hotel con pintura de mala calidad y hace un olor insalubre y como un hotel eco tiene en sus habitaciones todavía cortinas de baño de plástico. Realmente mi llegada ha sido una gran decepción me esperaba mucho más de este hotel

reviews.author: christak2142021
reviews.title: Room issues
reviews.text: We had multiple issues with all 3 rooms we were given. The last room we decided to just deal with the issues as we didn’t want to waste anymore of our time on the room. The restaurant food was good. The Buffett food wasn’t great other than at breakfast. Two servers at the Malva Buffett made our experience wonderful-Atilano and Gaudencio .

reviews.author: Katiuska2013
reviews.title: Did not meet expectation
reviews.text: I traveled from 9/16/21 to 9/21/21. On 9/16 was my boys birthday and I said on the reservation we were celebrating their birthday but yet  there was no courtesy birthday acknowledgement on their part which of course they don't have to but it would have been a nice surprise for the boys. There are a lot of employees at the reception area but they don't seem to know what they are doing and it takes an insane amount of time to check in. The rooms were not ready so we went to eat and came back. It was already 4pm and rooms were not ready which was odd because the hotel was nearly empty but after waiting another hour they finally gave us the room. By the way the lobby area where the beautiful garden in the center is supposed to be was under construction so no nice pictures or entertainment. Once we got the room it seems they gave us the worst room they had on that floor and the key was not working. I went to the lobby at least 3 times to get it reset and also after giving complaints about the room being too hot, the lock in the bathroom and balcony being broken, they gave us another room which was also outdated, small, the beds are full size not queen, the safe was not working which I informed them about but didn't do anything to fix it, etc. The buffet is all the same every day. The restaurants I did not like any of them. I did not try Sal because it was extra charge and it seemed excessive. You don't get any attention unless you upgrade or buy a timeshare. You have to constantly tip the staff to get some kind of decent service otherwise they don't come to ask you if you want anything while you are at the pool or beach. Junior lagoon suite is jut a room with two full size beds and a mini fridge. Not impressed and will not be coming back.

reviews.author: Lizzie S
reviews.title: NO LO RECOMIENDO, la comida es horrible y el todo incluido muy caro!
reviews.text:
Voy a empezar por lo bueno del hotel, las instalaciones son muy bonitas y accesibles, tienen un control bueno del sargazo e independientemente de que el hotel es antiguo se nota que le dan mantenimiento.
Lo mejor del hotel es la atención y servicio por parte del personal (salvo una excepción que mencionó más adelante), un reconocimiento y felicitación especial a los meseros del área The reserve, en lo personal específicamente a Moisés y a Diego que nos atendieron de lujo.
Recomiendo el restaurante de tacos, que la verdad para ser tacos en Quintana Roo estaban muy buenos, hasta los de pastor que yo no acostumbro a comerlos fuera de la Ciudad de México estaban ricos.

Ahora lo malo (que es bastante):
Introducción: en este hotel se paga un todo incluido diario y por persona de 108 dólares más o menos lo cual me parece excesivo por las siguientes razones.
1- Lo primero, lo peor y lo que me pareció más decepcionante,considerando que se tiene que pagar el todo incluido, fue la comida. En específico la del restaurante “mexicano” Mole. 
-Es muy triste que en un hotel en México, en un restaurante mexicano, sirvan puras cochinadas como las gorditas que anexo en la foto, que más que gorditas eran unas bolitas de masa con un sabor no muy agradable, a esto aumentando que en todo el hotel sirven guacamole hecho con un aguacate que no sabe a NADA, lo cual también es muy triste porque México es productor de aguacates.
-Fuimos también a un restaurante de carnes “Sal” que era con costo extra (aparte del todo incluido y bastante caro) y tampoco nos gusto, la carne se veía que había estado congelada mucho tiempo (o sea vieja), nos ofrecieron carne de Estados Unidos, de Australia y de ¡¡Japón!! pero ningún corte mexicano. El colmo fue que por un vaso de agua nos cobraron 84 pesos… nunca me había pasado que me ofrecieran agua de una jarra en un restaurante y me la cobrarán. 
-En el área de alberca de The reserve hace mucho tenían un menú delicioso y variado, ahora ya no existe.
-En el restaurante italiano “Capella” la atención era pésima, la mesa estaba toda chueca, la comida no era buena y el arroz con langosta que pidió un familiar (con costo extra) sabía a que estaba crudo. Y eso que se tardaron 2 horas en traerlo.
-Nos toco el 15 de septiembre allá y mudaron la horrible comida del restaurante Mole al que estaba más cerca del evento y otra vez tuvimos que cenar eso. No hubo ni pozole y que bueno porque quien sabe a qué hubiera sabido. Estaba mejor la comida de los puestos de afuera, no hubo aguas de sabores lo cual también me parece mal.
-En el área de alberca había unos food trucks que tenían hamburguesas y hot dogs, la carne de las hamburguesas era de esas de paquete que no brillan por su calidad y la salchicha del hot dog también dejaba muchísimo que desear, he ido a hoteles de menos estrellas y tienen mejor carne, el problema aquí es que para lo que cobran de todo incluido tienen pésima calidad.
-Para terminar con el tema de la comida, la menos mala y más variada era la del room service y aún así estaba rara, por ejemplo una sopa de tortilla que no tiene ninguna ciencia hacerla allá no sabía a sopa de tortilla…
Hablando con extranjeros acerca de la comida, obviamente todos concluimos que es horrible pero como mexicanos nos daban ganas de llorar porque la comida mexicana es deliciosa como para que sirvan esas cosas como comida mexicana. Que pésima imagen dan para los extranjeros.

2-La atención y el tiempo de espera en el restaurante italiano está fatal; teníamos reservación a las 8:30, nos pasaron hasta las 9, nos tomaron la orden hasta las 9:30, y nos llevaron el plato fuerte hasta las 10:30, obviamente me parece una falta de respeto con nuestro tiempo y con el hambre que teníamos. Los meseros dijeron que el chef era tardado… 

3-No me gusto la habitación ya que nos toco con vista a la calle y la regadera del baño es de cristal, lo cual quita toda privacidad posible ya que solo está tapada con una cortina transparente, este hecho lo remediaron con una cortina más gruesa, creo que no debería de ser porque no todos viajamos en pareja si no que viajamos en familia y no está padre.

4-Como mencioné pasamos el 15 en este hotel, hubo un pequeño show pero me pareció muy mal que no pusieran sillas ni mesas ni nada, si era para evitar la multitud por cuestión de COVID salió contraproducente porque la gente se amontonaba porque no había lugares definidos y se empezaron a sentar en el piso porque no había de otra.

5-Hicimos el check out en la tarde del día anterior a nuestra salida porque al día siguiente salíamos muy temprano, en el área de the reserve nos dijeron las chicas que al día siguiente, o sea el de nuestra salida, nos iban a dar el pase de salida, que no nos preocupáramos por la hora porque ahí estaban desde las 7 am; pues eran las 8 y media y nunca llegó nadie.

6-Por último y por cuestiones de pandemia pienso que no estaba controlado el hecho de evitar las aglomeraciones, la alberca que tiene el bar adentro y los juegos de niños estaba súper llena, obvio no estuvimos ahí pero lo notamos, y el restaurante del desayuno tenía las mesas muy separadas y todo pero al entrar al área del buffet, que no se ni siquiera porque había buffet cuando es obvio que habrá muchos contagios, estaba llenísima.

En fin, no recomiendo el hotel por lo antes mencionado, sinceramente para mi la comida en un hotel, más en un todo incluido y más en tiempos de pandemia que no se puede salir a ningún lado, es súper importante y necesito que por lo menos llegue al punto de buena. Pero si por azares del destino terminan en este hotel pues ya saben donde comer. No se en que momento la comida de este hotel pasó de pasable a mala porque hace como 6 años fui y no estaba así. 🤷‍♀️

Les doy dos estrellas y no una porque de verdad nos atendieron muy bien la mayoría de los empleados del hotel y ellos no tienen la culpa de las decisiones tomadas y de los chefs que diseñaron estos menús horribles, ni de la horrible comida.

reviews.author: Karla S
reviews.title: Paradisus cancun
reviews.text: He tenido la oportunidad de ir en varias ocasiones y siempre vuelvo xq la calidad del servicio es excelente, en especial en el área the reserve, felicitaciones a Lucas y Javier excelente atención, la comida es una delicia, sin embargo esta ocasión la habitación tenía una toalla manchada de sangre, y el colchón olía demasiado a orines, entiendo que hay niños y que tienen accidentes, o borrachines miones jajajaja pero creo que si pueden darse cuenta y lavarlos o cambiarlos después de tantas manchas, la concierge brillo por su ausencia, recomiendo el hotel por la playa tan bella, x la comida que en verdad es muy rica, las instalaciones son buenas aunque son mejores las de paradisus playa del carmen. Esta ocasión los califico mal porque la cama y las toallas es algo básico.

reviews.author: Christina M
reviews.title: Отель с ужасным сервисом и отношением
reviews.text: Отдыхали в отеле 5 ночей, специально заплатили за опцию The Reserve, которая, как обещает Melia, позволяет получить эксклюзивный сервис. В итоге: постоянные проблемы с бронированием лежаков, приходишь к началу работы пляжа, как уже все занято, когда и как они успевают - не понятно. Наша батлер нам никак не помогала, а под конец и вообще заболела, никого не оставив вместо себя. Постоянно возникали какие то проблемы и никого из сотрудников нельзя было найти на месте. Вода из душа вытекала в комнату, воду приносили только после звонка в рум-сервис. Рестораны для ужина невозможно было забронировать - fully booked, а по факту была куча свободных мест. Зарядные слоты в номере работают только если не выключать свет в коридоре. Ещё один минус - это пляж. Очень узкая пляжная линия, расположенная под сильным уклоном. Ну то есть нормально лежать на шезлонгах невозможно, буквально стекаешь вниз. Море бесподобное, волшебно неонового цвета, просто сказка. Но купаться в нем невозможно -  очень сильные волны, которые с виду кажутся небольшими. Дело в течении. Я зашла в воду и пыталась поплавать, меня за 20 секунд унесло в глубину и я не могла выбраться. Моя подруга стала звать на помощь, но звать было некого, так как спасателей не было, а персонал из ресторана постоял посмотрел и ушёл. Халатность сотрудников отеля в итоге чуть не стоила мне жизни))) По всему отелю приторный токсический запах какого то благовоние. Категорически не рекомендую этот отель. Они оборзели, как и многие сетевые, американцы явно их разбаловали.

reviews.author: Viajeros sin Filtros
reviews.title: Disapointed for extra charges
reviews.text: I would like to inform that I was very dissapointed due to the extra charges you have to pay to get a beach bed, they charge 250 USD for using it... I think this is nonsense because when you search the hotel it seems really confortable, and nobody told us they were restricted, actually it was the main driver for us to come to this hotel.. Never comming back, nor recommending. Also an extra charge for room service. Perennel very kind though!

reviews.author: Arilto Jr
reviews.title: Infelizmente, uma péssima experiência.
reviews.text: Infelizmente, dez anos após a primeira visita ao hotel, encontramos um ambiente muito, muito, deteriorado. Hotel velho. Mal cuidado. Áreas em reforma. Os restaurantes oferecem um péssimo atendimento. Comida pobre, muito aquém do que foi usual em outra época.  As piscinas com muito cloro e tuchos de cabelos sob as aparas das laterais e bordas. Mesmo os restaurantes mais simples funcionam com funcionários cobrando “propina” por um bom atendimento (algo que num hotel “all inclusive” já deveria estar pago). A recepção é um setor muito ruim. Lá precisei trocar duzentos dólares americanos por pesos colombianos. Precisei esperar em uma fila por setenta minutos pois era um balcão para as demandas do hotel, check in, check out e todo o resto, incluindo câmbio. Não há na recepção, quando do check in, qualquer explicação sobre as dependências do hotel ou sobre qualquer coisa. Além do mais, é difícil agendar um restaurante para grupos maiores. É impossível sair sem pagar (😅). Como se alguém que pagasse caro por uma semana “all inclusive” não pudesse pagar por um prato a mais de comida. Ocorre que num restaurante houve um consumo “fora do cardápio” e esta cobrança foi assegurada pelo garçom que seria feita no “check out”. Mas não ocorreu bem assim. Um segurança e o gerente do restaurante me acompanharam até a porta do meu quarto para cobrar-me. Eu disse que a situação era constrangedora, mas que eu poderia pagar com o cartão que estava no quarto (eu não portava o cartão num restaurante “all inclusive”). Na porta do quarto, o gerente,  que a esta altura já era acompanhado de um segurança, sugeriu que minha esposa decesse à recepção para fazer um crédito no nosso quarto e quitar “a dívida”. Eu disse que ela estando em pijamas não desceria e exigi uma máquina no meu quarto para passar o cartão. Infelizmente, passei por essa situação num péssimo hotel. Experiência horrível. Nunca eu deixei de pagar uma conta, nunca deixei suspeitas quanto a não pagar e nunca deixaria de fazê-lo. Mas neste hotel isto foi questionado. A qualidade já era ruim. O atendimento se provou péssimo após esse incidente. Definitivamente, eu não recomendo esse lugar a ninguém.

reviews.author: Kim S
reviews.title: Such a disappointment with a few silver linings
reviews.text:
My family and I visited the Paradisus, Cancun July 27-Aug 2, 2021. We had previously stayed at the resort in 2018 and we were so impressed with the facilities,  the staff and all inclusive features we were determined to come back! Unfortunately,  we were not impressed during our most recent visit.  

Disappointments: 
1. The hotel was under MAJOR INDOOR construction with Jack hammers and all from 10am-5pm daily during our visit. We were not notified of this construction prior to our visit and our rooms were directly across from the construction. We could literally taste the concrete as it seeped into our rooms.  We immediately experienced severe headaches as well.
2. The rooms are literally falling apart. Between 5 reserved rooms our group experienced; leaking roof from bathroom above, flickering electrical,  peeling bathtubs, broken AC, mini bars not being refilled with water after many requests, edge pieces of counters falling off, mini bars not cooling off, broken in room coffee pots.
3. The hotel spa is also falling apart! Only 2 jets work in the large spa. The sauna and steam room were also out of commission. 
4. 3 days of my six 6 day vacation were spent in guest services trying to get the room situations taken care of. our group had to move rooms multiple times. 

Silver linings:
1. The staff is very friendly and communicates best via whatsapp.
2. There was an exceptional staff member in guest services. His name is RICARDO!  This young man deserves a promotion!  He went above and beyond to right the wrongs we were experiencing.  My parents had the worst room experience of the entire group and we were there celebrating their 50th anniversary.  Once we got the room fiasco settled, Ricardo arranged to have a cake and champagne delivered to their room❤. This is one of the many things he did to salvage our experience.  
3. one member of our group stayed on the reserve side and those rooms are a better maintained.

reviews.author: Nabil C
reviews.title: Waste
reviews.text:
We booked 'The reserve' junior suite and  stayed at Paradisus Cancún for a week in August 2021.
If you are someone who likes under 15$ 'all you can eat' kind of restaurants in the US and don't mind waiting in lines and mediocre service you are going to absolutely love this place like other reviewers.
 I felt that instead of relieving stress with vacation we came back with more stress from the vacation. The resort has huge capacity (not sure if they limit it due to covid,  it was always super packed), the amenities are under designed per the number of rooms and they are understaffed,  so all the workers look overworked and stressed. If given a choice to go back in time I would probably book a better experience for my family.  
'The reserve' experience has misleading description on the website, since their own staff isn't aware of what is included in the reserve package and what has been promised to the customers . We had to show their staff screenshots from their website again and again which was very frustrating.
We were met by a 3rd party airport transfer service representative at the airport who was not even holding up the sign and was busy on his phone. We approached him, he didn't even look up or say 'hi' and asked us to wait. After 5-10 mins a driver came and took us to the resort.  At the hotel entrance a personal gave us directions to 'the reserve' reception which had no sign or stroller access. There was a long wait and just one person working at the desk who looked tense. We waited a good 20-30 mins cluelessly if this is the right place only to get a wrong room that they changed later after we disputed it,
The room itself is nice and clean. If you are not careful, be ready to get your fingers smashed by the washroom's sliding door handle which has no stopper until your fingers are crushed between the handle and the wall. Our toddler got hurt a couple of times.
Despite their website claims 'concierge' is not a personal butler but a customer relation officer who checks on you on whatsapp once a day (we got replies for our  queries after hours of waiting). Even for dinner reservations you are better off doing them yourself thru app or at the restaurant's check in counter.
The room service is included in the reserve package which is super frustrating. They will either forget the orders, bring them after an hour of waiting or just bring it wrong.  We provided the concierge the schedule for our baby's milk time, still no use. Same frustration to get room service everyday during our stay. The website says ironing 1 piece of clothing per guest plus shoe wiping is included for reserve customers during the stay but  every time we ordered we had to explain that to them or else they would try to charge us.
If you are a family with kids you can't access the "the reserve" pool area (which is a nice one) so you waste money for upgrades that you never got.  The "Bali beds" in non reserve areas by the beach or facing beach are 'extra charge'. The resort doesn't have a private beach of their own and it has huge rocks in the water (see attached pictures) and seaweed some days. On the resort side paradisus has their beach beds, but food and drinks services are not included and Bali beds are again extra charge. Following hurricane day they blocked access to the beach citing "safety concerns" by their floor manager. However, the guests at resorts left and right of our resorts were able to get to the beach no issue.
Overall Food and drinks service at the kids pool area is good, but still there was an instance where the server forgot our order, we waited for an hour and when asked instead of apologizing he argued he brought the food but 'someone' took it.
Our dinner reservations done by our concierge never coincided with any of the live events. Neither did she recommend shifting our dinner time for the same.
The breakfast and tea time food area has a very limited same selection of food every day. The main buffet food restaurant has decent selections but it's very crowded and no social distancing.

reviews.author: llsmr777
reviews.title: Not coming back better options for sure.
reviews.text:
Check in- there was only 3 people and it was a small area. Took awhile but had two rooms. The thing that I wish they would have done is explained a little more where to get towels, room safe needed a key I had to come back for, how to make dinner reservations, just a simple overview.  You get a bracelet for room key.  Purple for non reserve and red for reserve. 
No one told me when I checked in how to get my appt for covid test. I had to go down the next day to find out. They were supposed to scheduled at check in but u have to scan a QR code and fill out online then they email you appt. appt was fine and was smooth. I went to guest services once I got the results to have them print. 
I met a couple who never was told. The day they left they forgot. Couldn’t get an appt. had to leave really early to get at airport. Yes they should have known but since no one told them they thought the day they leave they could just get. And they were not accommodated and could not get at hotel since they had no appt. 

Rooms - I got the luxury non reserve ocean view. One with king and one with two twins. The rooms are ok. It’s cute but it’s old. They had just painted or something so there was kinda a weird smell. The room itself is pretty small. The view was nice. Two chairs outside. 
Bathroom has big hand soap, body lotion, body wash, shampoo and conditioner. 
there was a leak by toilet. 
There is a fridge with beer, pop, water and chips and cookies. Better and more variety snacks would have been nice. 
My iron was broken the cord wouldn’t stay unwound. 

Hotel itself - it’s pretty run down. I was disappointed that the main forum was under construction and of course didn’t know that was gonna be the case when I booked. So the Japanese place in atrium is closed for a few months. I added pics. Construction started at 7am and was loud. 

The app - so hard to navigate. Would work sometimes. And to make dinner reservations it’s under Gastronomy? I could never make dinner reservations. When reporting was just told no one else reported issues and to just call. Why have the app if I can’t even use it. You can make dinner reservations 2 days in advance btw which no one told me. 

Restaurants - no one told me that I had to make dinner reservations. I knew from reading reviews before I came. So you can through the app which I could not. Or call right at 9am like everyone else. 

Blue agave - only was tacos, chips and salsa and some shrimp soup.  Took long to get just basically street tacos. The chips were corn and seemed stale. Came with some yummy guacamole though. But I wasn’t at all impressed and think the taco trucks at home (Seattle) are way better. 

Buffet - I love buffets. And this one well it sucks. Went for lunch and dinner. Same selections pretty much and nothing was at all amazing or even like really yummy. I don’t even want to go back there the rest of the trip if I can help it. Breakfast tho was totally acceptable. Very busy. 

Enso - loved this place. Sushi and other seafood dishes. Place is outside so it was hot. But food was delicious. This is one of the only places open for lunch besides buffet and there was another only for reserve guests. 

Mole - it was good but not my favorite. 

Fuego - was really good. Lots of seafood options but when we went the second time they didn’t have many of the options available. 

Capella - very good. Nice ambiance. Pizza and pastas. Ran out of short ribs. 
Room service is $5 fee if you are non reserve. Breakfast and late night selection is small. The food isn’t good. 

Room service - food is not good. If you are not reserve it’s a $5 charge each time. 

Entertainment - caught the Mexican dance show which was entertaining the staff did a good job. They do it in small area one of the bars so not too much seating. 
Led show was great. 
Elvis and the acrobat show was good too. 
If you are in main tower expect loud music until at least midnight or longer. I mean VERY loud music. I was okay with it but I would assume there are people who would wanna know this. 

Bali beds. $220 US to rent like what? Comes with champagne and some seafood platter. 
I got one with nothing for $50 but had to wait until no one reserved to see if one avail. And it’s cash only for the $50 option. Beds have a plug. I brought my multi outlet cord so that none of us had to fight on who could plug in. One plug and two usbs. 

People put their towels out early. Came down at 8. No one at pool but towels everywhere. They should really enforce this rule. 
No close bathrooms I’m sure everyone was peeing in the pool! 

Staff - waiters and pool folks were great! Front desk and concierge sucked. I was told I could check out early but still had my room. Because the same place you check in Is where you check out it takes forever! But when I went down they said I was misinformed. And wouldn’t allow me to. Said I had to wait in line when I was ready and so I had to go down 45min early to make sure I could check out in time In order to ensure I was done before my shuttle came. 
Guest services said that because my app wasn’t working they would txt reservations to let me know and allow me to make reservations ahead like the app does. No one said they got a txt. 

All in all. This is not a 4.5 hotel. It’s more a 3. Maybe if you were reserve? No idea. I felt when I asked anything no one knew and I was given wrong info all the time. I wouldn’t come back. And I suggest if you want really great service from everyone not just the hard folks working for tips, then go elsewhere. And again rooms were not amazing. Shouldn’t take 45min to check in and check out period. They should allow calling or through the app or tv for check out.

I have been to Cancun 3 times now. And this hotel isn’t worth coming back to. 
Rooms 3361 and 3363

reviews.author: Carrington D
reviews.title: Ridiculous to say the least
reviews.text: I have stayed in Meliá in Spain, Paris, and dominican Repúblic to say the least but this by far has been the worst. The reserve isn’t worst the money trust me. You pay to wait in line to have your questions answered. I waited in  line because my rooms was leaking form the AC and it wasn’t a good room to begin with and I made a big deal because the regular desk won’t deal with the reserve guest you have to go to a separate wing in the hotel. When you get there there is only 1 person working on checking people in or dealing with the reserve customer problems. I asked to get my room changed keep in mind I’m a Meliá member, I brought my family on vacation, I paid more than my group for each room, my room was leaking from the AC and it was also not a ocean view. It ways it is but from the first flow I have no idea what type of view that it. For the money I was disappointed. From the Meliá standards my wife and I were disappointed. This hotel made all the other Meliá properties we stayed at amazing. Please don’t stay here is if you don’t want to deal with a headache. Or if you do don’t get the reserve program it is not worth it please trust me i travel all the time it’s trash to say the least. I will never stay here again

reviews.author: savagepoetry23
reviews.title: Will not come back
