reviews.text: This was a vacation with my family. Upon arrival there seemed to be a lot of confusion at the front desk we were approached by 4 different staff members who had 4 different responses and answers to our questions. I didn’t like the overall service I felt like at times I needed assistance and staff would turn away from me. I tried to engage in conversations with staff about Mexico and tequila and they didn’t really want to talk much.

reviews.author: Noemie D
reviews.title: Aweful buffet and stinky old rooms
reviews.text:
Paying $330 per night, everyday the buffet is the same, eggs not cooked, one time meat we saw, fried chicken is aweful, there is not good food in the buffet, mcdonalds egg is better than in your buffet, coffee is not good, only one red wine available for not reserve, our room smells old had another but changed it still stink, hot in common areas in the hotel - when we told receptionist we don’t want to upgrade no explanation or anything what or where is in the hotel - we went find out on our own. Oh and the sushi n food at enso is aweful…definitely its a one- time in this resort not coming back and not recommended- u cant even go to the beach its not cleaned everyday like what is being said in the tweet….chicken tenders by the pool is hard n not good wings but we don’t have choice but eat whats available…. Tsk tsk tsk…the drinks they cheat on how much alcohol they put basically drinking lots of sugary drinks!!!
The only good is Ceazar salad and the fuego…unfortunately its not worth it.

reviews.author: Anum Zaheer
reviews.title: An honest review from an American in Aug 2021 - Please Ignore All the Fake “Positive” Reviews that are scams
reviews.text:
We have visited Cancun many times and stayed at multiple resorts (The Royal, Fiesta Contessa, etc.). I have never felt compelled to write a review because the service was usually decent (or even great!) and met minimum standards.  I am very easy going but I am very traumatized from my experience here, as well as all the other families we are traveling with and/or have spoken to. This is my personal experience in a recent stay:

1.  Do not stay at the Reserve on the hopes of ever getting a cabana or for “personal concierge” service.  There are only less than 10 cabanas for the entire Reserve at the main pool - when you arrive, you will be “waitlisted” for the cabanas.  We are on day 4, and like us, your turn will never come for the cabanas.  There are less than 10 available for the hundreds of families that stay at the Reserve.  All cabanas are always “waitlisted” and locals are more able to “luck” into a cabana.  We have spoke to 6 families, all still waitlisted on their 5th day here (some traveling with us and some we have gotten to know here).  Your personal concierge has 50+ people assigned to them (our concierge is managing 3 groups of 20). You can imagine how much service you are getting (spoiler alert: it is zero.) This is not the “personal concierge”’s fault - it is obviously a scam by the hotel management to have you pay extra to “upgrade” for a service they never intend on providing.

2.  This is not a customer-oriented hotel, this is a VOLUME business. I have traveled to 20+ countries, and this is my fourth time in Cancun - not once have I left a review. I want everyone to be aware what they are getting - there are paid reviews by local friends and family to get the hotel good reviews.  I really dont want anyone to pay good money for a terrible property and terrible service.  They depend on a HUGE volume of guests that are one-time
visitors only - their goal really is to get as many people as they can to pay and book the stay, then you will show up and see that 1) for most rooms, the AC is fixed so you can not go below 78 deg F, 2) cockroaches in the rooms and roaming the properties, 3) no guaranty of ever getting any chairs or cabanas (given to locals early in the process), and 4) all dinner reservations are booked and you will be stuck each night with the terrible Blue Agave restaurant or the buffet.  The worst is honestly the AC never cooling the rooms (we have 5 on different floors throughout the hotel - all have same issue).

3.  We have booked 5 rooms and each are completely flooded.  The hotel blames the hurricane, but how does this explain the leaking in the bathroom before any sort of hurricane? The puddles in the bathroom, under the beds next to the balcony.  Bizarre explanation.

4.  Power and AC are going off all day long.  There is no hot water at random times through out the day. If you are coming with kids, please be prepared to give them cold showers. Again, hotel staff says this is hurricane-related, but these issue precede any bad weather.  Very bizarre explanation.

In short, this hotel is extremely understaffed.  They promise big expectations to get a huge number of guests, then they understaff the hotel so they can make a good profit.  Many reviews are paid.  I am 34 years old, have spent about half my life travelling extensively for work and family vacations and have never felt compelled to leave a review until today. I dont want you all to get scammed - this hotel is not for americans and other foreigners - this is really a terrible scam.  We have been looking for early flights out of here because the bars, restaurants, cabanas, beach chairs, ALL REQUIRE HOURS OF STANDING IN LINE AND NO GUARANy YOU WILL GET FOOD, DRINK, or ANY RELAXATION BY POOL OR BEACH.

Terrible service, no AC in the rooms, no reliable power in the rooms, no dinner availability, no pool chairs or cabanas - it really is not a vacation. Last time we were in Cancun, we stayed in Fiesta Contessa next door and it was as advertised. That has been the same at Cancun, Aruba, Paris, Amsterdam, Columbia, Turkey, Pennsylvania, etc. and any other state/country we have traveled to.  We have stayed at cheap hotels (literally $60 a night in Thailand) and expensive hotels, and we know you get what you pay for.  Here, they are definitely over-selling to fill the hotel up after a dip in revenue during Covid and understaffing - if you stay here, you are basically here to fund the revenue lost during covid.

TL;Dr:  speaking from personal experience, and atleast a dozen other families here - this is a scam for american tourists.

reviews.author: sang_maika
reviews.title: Family trip
reviews.text: I booked this trip to go with my family, maybe we didn’t get lucky but the overall experience was not what we expected. Pool was over crowded, so no chairs. Cabana was for special guests and with extra pay. Even if you want to pay it’s full. Beach was full of seaweed. Everyday the same food for breakfast and lunch. Dinner is hard to make reservations.

reviews.author: ivanahdominguez
reviews.title: Mixed Feeling
reviews.text:
All employees work their tails off to make you feel at home with the exception of the Circle employees! Not everyone wants to buy a membership, we are ware that we need to cut the middle man. 

Sometimes we just want to splurge and upgrade, but yet that was impossible. According to the check-in manager we couldn’t upgrade to the Reserve area due to having children yet when we toured the area we saw tons of kids. Mind you all it was also way cooler in that area then in the building were most people stay. If you enjoy technology be aware there are only two areas were you can charge it in your room. Also, make reservations to dinner if not you will get stuck waiting to get into the buffet. During shows arrive extra early to the outdoor ones because sitting is limited! We had to stand, so we only enjoyed a couple of minutes. Silent party at the Ginger Bar was great, but the air does not circulate so it feels like a sauna. Same for Chappella! Management should not allow guest or employees to be uncomfortable due to the environment. The poor waiter was pouring in sweat. In the rooms are tiny with bulky furniture, bugs crawling in the sink area, and air conditioning was horrible until it was fixed by an employee. We were lucky it was working because many still complained about that exact problem at the pool.
I may have sounded like a negative Nancy, but I want you to know that the concierges, photographs, Otium, laundry and restaurant staff will not disappoint you.

I would recommend you to schedule your COVID exam as soon as you arrive that way you can work your tours around that the examen. Them have the Otium staff book your adventures! Always grab extra towels from the pool for your tours. If your wanting a photo session at the beach do the same day as your COVID exam.

reviews.author: Bonnie V
reviews.title: CANCEL IF YOU CAN!
reviews.text:
I often turn to the reviews posted here on Trip Advisor when considering our family vacations.  I am sorry that I didn't rely on the previous reviews more heavily when booking my trip.
We arrived at the resort excited to celebrate our daughter's 16th birthday.  Almost immediately things began to go sour......
Upon check in (which took about 50 mins) two of our daughters were placed on an entirely different floor.  This seemed crazy to me how they would split a family up but being that we booked three rooms with one room on a different reservation I will let that part slide.  Everything else that happened after that still astounds me.
Lets start with the poor system of making dinner reservations and the lack of availability in most restaurants.  There is absolutely no reservations available on day of arrival.  The customer service desk is very helpful but it's still a poor system.  You are asked to call a number that never picks up and its extremely frustrating.  Furthermore...when you go to customer service and they call...miraculously reservations picks right up!  
NEXT...lets discuss the rooms.    The place needs a major renovation including the Air Conditioning which is next to NON-EXISTENT.  Our room thermostat never went below 78 degrees and when i checked our daughter's room it was 88 degrees despite the AC trying to cool the room to our set 65 degrees.  I had maintenance come twice but it never got better.  Sleeping in the heat was so unpleasant and dinners were just as unbearable.  It was only after we arrived at the airport did we feel any relief.  This was the MOST disturbing part of the resort.  How can they not provide adequate air conditioning?????  My heart goes out to the wonderful employees to work in that condition. 
Next lets discuss the pool situation.  The pool is gorgeous...very well kept.  You can enjoy it if you like getting up at 6am to get a chair.  The system is extremely poor.  Our first day we arrived at the pool at 7:50 am.  We were delighted to see nice neatly folded towels on each chair around the main pool area.  We put our belongings on 6 chairs with an umbrella between and took a dip in the pool.  About an hour later a gentleman approached us accompanied by a pool employee saying we "stole their Chairs".  He asked us to remove our things which we said we gladly would so long as they can find us 6 chairs with an umbrella somewhere else.  When an hour went by with no response...we figured they found the gentlman another spot.  There were no belongings on the chairs when we arrived and it looked like every other chair around the  pool.  There is no way we could have known the chairs were taken and there is no personnel around the pools until later in the morning.  We went to grab breakfast leaving our personal belongings on the chairs.  Upon our return some 40 mins later our belongings had been moved to a small table and onto one chair close by.  I was livid!    This is apparently how this place is run....
Luis at the pool tried to accommodate us and did find us another spot but it was so unpleasant.   Set the mood for the day.....
I will say the housekeeping staff was excellent and our rooms were cleaned daily, however, the in room refrigerator was never restocked with water...and trust me you need it with the heat in the room with no air....so that was a huge dissapointment.  Of course you can order room service for a charge (so much for all inclusive) and get water everytime you need it.  What a rip off!
The beaches are nice but the seaweed situation still exists so if you want clearer water you have to walk a bit off property.  Not such a great job of cleaning it for the guests....
The food was just okay....but the waiters were amazing.  They never disappointed us...always trying to tend to our needs.
My only complaint with the restaurants was the issue we had the last night of our trip.  We secured a reservation at the italian restaurant Cappella which is really part of the buffet that they cordone off at night to turn into an italian restaurant.  Its very nice...ambiance is nice.  However.....we arrive at our 7pm reservation ready to celebrate our daughter's 16th birthday and upon arrival they ask our names....we tell them.  They ask if we are celebrating anything...we tell them.  They say....we dont' have a table for 6...but we can put you in two tables near each other!  What the hell????  we are celebrating an occassion!  We made a reservation.  Furthermore.....as I am standing there trying to understand  how this even happens....i watch as the manager escorts a family of 7 to a large table in the back.  So there was a table..just not for us.  After much complaining.....15 minutes later we were escorted to two small round tables pushed together to accommodate us all.  Not the most comfortable but at least we got to eat.  No birthday celebration for our daughter....so asking when you check in is useless....if the message doesn't get to the servers.  The place needs new management if you ask me.
After traveling to this resort.....I am very disheartened with the Melia name......I am not quite sure if anyone is overseeing how things are being done here.  I intend to send a similar letter to the brand of hotel so they can possibly work on fixing the many deficiencies we experiences.  You pay a lot of money to vacation not to mention the time you take from work to spend with family and the last thing you want is to sweat your ass off in a room with no air.    I will say....Paradisus in Playa Del Carman is completely opposite of this.  We stayed there on our honeymoon in 2015 and it was the nicest place I have ever stayed.  So........take this review and reconsider if you have booked already and can cancel...i would say to do it and find a different resort.  I hate to give so many negatives but i really had wish i paid more attention to the reviews that mentioned some of the same issues.  I would have changed my plans....even if i had to lose a little money. 
Regardless, we made the best of it....our girls had fun they went parasailing (across the street...its NOT ON SITE)....and they enjoyed the silent disco and the water aerobics and finger painting at the pool deck.  The staff tries but they are limited to what they can do.  
I hope they can improve the accommodations and take the criticisms and fix the wrongs.

reviews.author: selinakamper
reviews.title: Mehr Schein als Sein
reviews.text: Sein Geld absolut nicht wert, da man sich um alles selbst kümmern musste und keinerlei Hilfe bekommen hat. Das Hotel wirbt mit Bildern, die so gar nicht stimmen. Strand war außerdem auch sehr enttäuschend, da viel dreck rumlag.

reviews.author: Valentine G
reviews.title: Spend your good money elsewhere!
reviews.text:
The customer service is not on par with the physical property.  We travel often and make it a point to heavily tip the wait staff and pool concierges to show gratitude and  also ensure good service:). The pool staff...Luis, Yvonne, Didier and Jesus were amazing!!!  The pool and cabana service were the best part of the trip...now for the bad parts.

We stayed at the more exclusive "Reserve" and were assigned a personal butler who was not as attentive as we had hoped.  Dinner reservations were also tough to procure and we often had to request towels, rags etc.
 
We were also extremely disappointed by the events surrounding our last night.  We dined at Enso to celebrate our father's 70th birthday. The staff failed to recognize his birthday as requested (no huge deal). Unfortunately, at the conclusion of dinner the waiter informed us that he could not charge the room for the bottle of wine we purchased secondary to a "system issue."  

I did not have cash or credit cards on my person as we had previously reserved a card for the room and had used it without incident throughout the trip. Thirty minutes went by as the waiter and manager kept making phone calls and asking us if we could give them cash or if they could charge it to another room.  Eventually, I had to get up and go to my room, with the waiter and manager following me and return to the front desk with previously mentioned credit card to take care of the expense. 

As the manager and the front desk had copies of our passports, our room number and a credit card on file... we were perplexed as to why they couldn't have spared us this great and embarrassing inconvenience and resolved things the next day prior to us leaving.  

I spoke to the manager the next morning, he echoed my sentiments and swore to redeem the poor service with vouchers etc.  Sadly, he did not follow through with this. 
 
All in all, decent place, but poor customer service especially when you paid for one of their high end rooms.

reviews.author: Kyle T
reviews.title: A REAL REVIEW!! PLEASE READ!!!
reviews.text:
I would like to start and say that I am not a picky traveler. Also, we have been to Cancun 9 times so far. My wife, niece, and myself stayed at this resort from 7/6 - 7/12. 

I am not the type to write a review unless I am very impressed or very disappointed.  Unfortunately, this review is provided out of my disappointment for this resort. I did a lot of research and reading reviews on this site. I can not understand how this resort has so many positive reviews! 

When arriving to the resort, we were greeted by hot humid air in the atrium. None of the common areas are air conditioned! This was terrible as there was no relief from the heat! The check in lobby was filled with a strong perfume smell, most likely to cover up other bad smells. We checked in and were given supposedly an ocean view king room as we ordered. When we arrived at our room, we found an outdated room that did not match their pictures and also was facing the other building not the ocean! I immediately went back to the front desk to ask for another room, as that is not what we reserved or paid for. Of course they had nothing else, but they did have a room in the Reserve section of the resort for an extra $650. Because I did my homework, I knew everything that came with the Reserve package and decided to go ahead and make the change. After making the change, I found the Reserve room to be nice and clean. The room in the Reserve was facing the ocean, but the A/C could not keep the room cold. We decided to let that go as we didn't want to waste time over the A/C.

I went to the front desk to find out who our butler was, and was informed that because we upgraded at the resort, that we would not get that service and most of the additional features that the Reserve is supposed to offer. So basically we paid $650 to get the room that we thought we already paid for. Front desk staff do not seem to care about making things right. Realistically they should have just moved us to a better room that we paid for already, but they want to up-sell you on everything. Also, Friday night at 11:30pm the water was shut off to our building for several hours. We just got home from the Coco Bongo sweaty and nasty to find we couldn't shower or use the toilet until the next morning! House keeping did a good job, but failed to stock the fridge with beer, soda, and water daily. I think they stocked it once despite me tipping house keeping $10-$20 daily. As I said before, we didn't get butler, or turn down service, or basically anything you are supposed to get for the Reserve package. This was probably the most upsetting thing at this resort, as we paid extra and still got nothing. The proper thing for them to do was just fix my room situation and all would have been good!

The main pool was old and the water was almost 2 feet under the skimmers. 1/2 of the sitting area around the pool are cabanas that cost $120 a day to use. Most of the beach was this way as well. They had a nice beach club that was extra of course so we didn't go. They had a beach bar, but it as well was extra. There was no music the whole week at the main pool, which was a first for me. Everyone was complaining about that. They did however have music playing at the beach club, so I figure it is a way for them to lure people to the extra pay areas. Our first day there was a fist fight at the main pool between two groups of people. Excessively drunk people throwing up next to the pool was common. They had to wheel chair several people back to their rooms. We only had pool entertainment for one day which was a floating obstacle course. That was fun and they did have music for that. The pool servers were great by the way, and the staff all seemed to work hard. If you can get a pool chair, you will get the best service by the pool.

Restaurants were all terrible. There wasn't one that we liked. This resort hands down had the worst food of any all inclusive resort I have stayed at to date. The only restaurant that looked nice was of course the one you had to pay extra for! The breakfast buffet was so bad that we stopped eating there after the 2nd day. Honestly the best food was the grill by the pool or the food cart by the pool. Drinks were nothing special and I stayed with beer majority of the time. Pool bar service was very slow as well.

All in all, I will personally never return to this resort or any Melia resort as I do not like their sales practices, customer service, and constant up-selling for items that should be included with your initial cost. By the way, this was also the most expensive resort I have ever stayed at. Almost $6,000 for 3 people 6 nights is not cheap in my opinion. This resort was probably only worth $3000. Save your money and go to a resort that cares and doesn't screw everyone that goes to it.

reviews.author: Valessa
reviews.title: Atendimento na recepção péssimo
reviews.text: Cheguei com minha família aguardei 1 hora em uma fila para o checkin, e por mais 5 horas na espera do quarto, e não sendo o bastante, ainda erraram por 3 vezes o tipo de acomodação  … frustrante é cansativo.

reviews.author: scarabrose81
reviews.title: Reserves a HUGE letdown
reviews.text:
Reserve is a complete letdown. I’ve stayed two times prior when the offered Royal Service. This time will be my last. Reserve is a joke in comparison. We did our check in on building 5 which is the reserve pyramid. Then we were taken from that location and placed in building 3 the main pyramid. Nightly shows echoed all the way up every night until 11. Small things that I appreciated before staying with Royal Service are no longer there. There is no longer Thierry Mugler bathing products. It’s dollar store quality shampoo and conditioner on pumps in the shower. Gross.  No note pads or pens in room. I had to call DAILY to get mini bar refills on water. Also butler service was NOT good this time. I had to contact her daily to find out about reservations. Her response sorry I’m very busy. She met with me in person one day and brought her “supervisor” I thought to go over my dissapointment about the room situation. Oh no, he was a time share guy. I told him no I’m not interested while laying in my bali bed with my mother and he came across hostile saying how can I say no when I do not hear him out? Literally blocking my Mother and in until I said we have heard enough goodbye. How tacky!  The pool as mentioned before is showing it’s age also the beach service is not as good as in the past. I’ve in the past referred many friends to this resort but in no way could I do that anymore. Unfortunately my last time at ANY Melia owned resort. 
On a positive the waitstaff around the Reserve pool were amazing and attentive as were the bellboys.  There are too many amazing options in Mexico for resorts so I’ll be moving on which is sad as I try to stay brand loyal. Save your money move elsewhere

reviews.author: David
reviews.title: Reserve service does not exist!
reviews.text:
The Reserve butler service was simply awful and nonexistent. We checked in at 4 pm. It took 40 minutes to check in into our one bedroom suite at pyramid 5. This is despite us doing pre-check in online. There was only 1 desk available and there were numerous guests waiting. Each taking 10-15 minutes. We finally checked in and when we asked about our butler, receptionist say they will call you in 30 minutes. 30 minutes turned into 3 hours. I called the Royal service and again was told that our butler will call us in 30 minutes. Again that did not happen. In the meantime we wanted to go eat at a restaurant and the APP was not working to make reservation. By this time kids are tired and want to go to sleep. The sofa bed had yellow stains, no sheets, no blankets and no pillows. I called room service and asked for 2 pillows and 2 blankets for my kids. 30 minutes later they arrived with 1 pillow and 1 very thin, small so called blanket that didn’t look like a blanket. Again we had to wait 15-20 minutes for a second pillow and so called blanket. I called Royal service again asking for our butler and again they said your butler will call you soon. They also provided me with the email address of the head butler which I contacted but no response in the 4 nights we stayed there. At around 9:30-10 pm, our so called butler, Steph, finally messaged us. We asked for cabana reservation for next day, restaurant reservation and a video game console for my kids. Next day, no messages or updates from Steph. We texted her at and asked if we have the cabana and restaurant reservation. She replied that she will get back to me. 2 hours passed, no reply. I texted her again and she said you are on the waiting list and to check the children pool area. We did and nothing available. So we basically did not have any cabana the first day even though there were plenty of empty ones available all day in the main pool area. 2nd day we asked if she has a cabana for us, she said she did and to check with victor. When we did, he did not have our name or reservation. We then asked for game console and she said definitely for Wednesday. Wednesday comes and again no video game or cabana reservation. This was such a waste of time and money to even talk or have a butler service. She never communicated with us, and we had to message her and remind her and even then her so called reservations were false. It was as if we were her butler. The night before we left, we messaged her and asked her if we can check out at 1 pm instead of 12. She did not reply and not even the next day. 
I really liked the hotel and the personal except the butler experience, and already have a reservation for November. My 4 friends are also planning to join us in November but after this awful experience with the reserve service, I will probably never stay here again and most likely will advice everyone else not to come which is a shame.

reviews.author: August C
reviews.title: Third trip here but will be our last
reviews.text:
We (my wife and I) really, really loved this hotel from our last two visits here, so once travel started opening up again (COVID), we were excited to book another trip back to the Paradisus. 

It seemed like a simple choice: go back to the hotel that we've had so much fun at, enjoyed the food so thoroughly, received excellent service at,  and generally had a fantastic time at twice before.

I'll note that we're still here and have a few days left (8 day trip), but the experience has gone downhill so much, I felt I had to go and write up a review while I have some downtime.

Let's start with the positives:

1) The resort is still a beautiful place, inside and out. The design of it, the decor in the main areas, the insanely impressive atrium with all the live plants and cool lighting - the list goes on. It looks like a high-class place and is fairly well maintained.

2) The pools are still the same as we remember and equally well maintained. They're not the most attractive versus other hotels here but they're in good shape.

3) You get a free antigen test (for COVID) as part of your package (at least for now), so no concerns about getting a test in time for a return flight to the US.

4) They're responsive to any requests to refill the mini-bar, like if you want a bunch of waters, tell them to bring you 6 bottles and they'll be on their way.

That is unfortunately the end of the  positives. Now, on to the negatives...

1) We paid for an ocean view room, one of the recently refurbished units. The rooms we stayed in before were definitely showing their age and had a lot of brown color throughout. The new rooms have a greenish/yellow wall, plus a lot of white, white furniture, and...that might be it. The bathrooms are still old looking and brown in color, not to mention VERY dark. I can't see my black hair enough to style it in there due to the lack of lighting. Our mini-fridge has a loose gasket around the door which keeps falling off, and the door latch catches against the wall when closing it, both marking up the wall and leaving your door ajar (easy to miss - anyone could just come into your room...). Oh, and the pillows... 

2) The pillows in the bed are made from some kind of material that smells so god awful it makes us want to vomit. I'm not exaggerating, they're terrible. We own all kinds of pillows, from different types of foam to down to down alternative, and none have ever had a smell like this. It is truly awful.

3) When we arrived, it was right at the end of week-long storm that brought a ton of rain to Cancun. It was still raining our first and second days - a lot - and we noticed a puddle of water in front of our room's patio door as soon as we got into our room. Meaning, someone had cleaned the room, saw a big puddle (talking 2ftx4ft at least), and thought hey, that's OK! So, I called for maintenance. They mopped it up and...dumped the water on to the patio, the same place its been blowing in through the door from. This isn't the normal tropical moisture you expect in a hotel room down here; the door to the patio is simply not sealed well at all, and we could watch the water POURING in. They left a towel on the floor, and after about 2 hours, it was soaked and we had an even bigger puddle. I added more towels as we were on our way out. Came back hours later to water in the front of the room, close to the door! It had traveled along the wall and puddled up in front of our clothes. Luckily we didn't have any on the floor. Called maintenance who again mopped it up and...dumped it back on the patio. Went to the front desk to complain and was told "it gets wet in the rooms here." This was just the beginning of the decline in service we experienced here...

4) They added a $5 surcharge to any and all room service orders. I've never experienced in that in an all-inclusive before, nor did anything on the website indicate this before we booked. Pretty silly, especially since the room service menu isn't anything stellar and is pretty limited.

5) There's this new Melia app you're supposed to use while you're here for doing things like making restaurant reservations and ordering room service, but i only knew this from one email from Melia after we booked. I figured it'd be explained to us when we checked in, another thing you can do on the app: fully check-in to the hotel close to your departure date, which I did, but then we still went through the entire ~20 minute process at reception of..checking in once we got here...

6) And the person checking us in was as dull and uninterested as he could be. He was silent most of the time, and when he finished up, didn't bother to try and tell us about any changes to the hotel, the COVID restrictions, how/when to use the app, or what's different about the restaurants (they've changed dramatically since a few years ago, for the worst). So, we had the displeasure of fumbling around with this Melia app that is loaded with bugs. Sometimes you can make a reservation, other times it fails to an error, other times it just does nothing when you click buttons. Room service worked once, but then didn't work later and we had to call...

7) Plus the hours. The app indicates hours for restaurants, activities, and ability to book activities, like yoga in the morning. What it doesn't tell you is reservations for those activities actually isn't required, nor does it even work when you try to do it in the app, and most of the hours listed don't match with reality. We found the app to be mostly useless so far.

8) They didn't explain how they're handling COVID when we checked in, but we quickly figured out everyone is supposed to wear a mask anywhere inside, a rule which we never saw enforced. Many guests walk around maskless, including in the main atrium, passing tons of masked staff who say nothing about it. Then there's the "buffet" which was been redesigned...

9) You're supposed to wear wasteful plastic gloves in the buffet to use the tongs to pick up your food since they don't serve you (like other hotels are doing right now). Yet gloves don't really do much of anything for COVID and generate a ton of additional waste for seemingly no reason. And what a hassle to try and take them off and put them on again to get more food - they are so thin they split apart instantly. 

10) I know Mexico has rules about capacity requirements right now due to COVID, but an employee told us the hotel wasn't following them and was currently over 70% capacity. Nice going.

11) Service in the restaurants, even in the buffet, is mostly atrocious. It used to be so good! Staff were friendly and talkative, fast to come assist you; now, they take forever, even to bring drinks, and most are very dry and don't bother chatting with you at all. They ended up cleaning up our plates and silverware at the buffet one day the second we got up for seconds, as if we were leaving, and when I told them to get us new silverware, they brought back our drinks. Like, the same exact glasses they cleaned off our table, with the same drinks inside them. They had been gone like 10 minutes to who knows where and the waiter thought we'd....drink them? What? Disgusting. We left after that.

12) You need to get purple towels from outside for the pools. This was never a problem before; they always had towels either out and available to pick up or someone staffing the hut that holds them very early in the morning. Not anymore. We, and other guests, had to go inside the hut ourselves, open up plastic bags containing fresh towels, and take them for ourselves. I have no idea when staff show up to hand out towels but its after 8am.

13) Speaking of towels, on our 2nd day, while it was lightly raining, plenty of people were enjoying the pool anyway, and we decided to do the same. This was in the afternoon, and we went to the hut for towels only to be told...they didn't have any. What? You ran out of towels on a rainy day with barely anybody outside? Makes sense.

14) The air conditioner in our room doesn't cool the room below 71-72 degrees. It can't, both because our patio door leaks so much air and the filter in the ceiling is absolutely disgusting and filthy I can't believe it pulls any air at all. The thermostat, which you cannot manually adjust, has been set for 65 since we got here - never once has it dropped below 71, and its insanely humid in here during the day.

15) Room service. We had one good experience, one bad. We ordered breakfast today and the rudest man called us to ask a question (after I managed to submit it via the app). On the app, there's an omelet listed as bacon, sausage, or ham, and on the confirmation page, it tells you to indicate what meats you want/how you want your eggs. I specified only cheese and sausage in the omelet. So this unprofessional guy who was clearly annoyed called to ask me what kind of omelet I wanted since it says ham, sausage, and bacon (it doesn't) but my comment says sausage (so why wouldn't you follow my instructions??). He told me I had "two different stories," Ok... So it comes and is loaded up with not only sausage but tomatoes. My wife calls to rectify this and he has an attitude with her about her language (she speaks English, Spanish, and Portuguese; apparently she slipped in a few English words while speaking Spanish and he had her start over). After confirming 3 times its a sausage and cheese omelet, no tomatoes, he calls back AGAIN to confirm. Then the order shows up and there's 2 omelets, so we sent the extra back which they now wasted for no reason. Total jerk this guy was though.

16) The spa. Don't bother! Was our first time checking it out and its a very small space with a really old, not maintained pool where half the jets don't work, tiles missing, the list goes on. It looked crappy. The massages we got were excellent, so kudos to those staff, but the environment was loud (could hear guests talking right outside the massage room - not peaceful at all), and the pricing would indicate you would be getting an upscale experience. Not so much. No hot towels or drinks while you wait, no full treatment of pool, sauna, steam room, etc... Wouldn't bother going there again.

17) Entertainment. This has always been a negative with the hotel. The pool bar opens at 10am and closes at 6pm, no exceptions, and the staff are rude to any and all guests who don't know this and try to order a drink outside those times. They were mean to a little kid trying to order a drink around 9:50am like he should know better about their hours of operation that aren't posted anywhere. Plus, there's either no music all day or some terrible, non-descript music played for an hour or two. That's it. No activities by the pool, no dancing, nothing other than the couple of times they do "stretching" with, you guessed it, more horrible music. It is truly a boring hotel in this respect, and the indoor entertainment is no different. It is always in this cramped little space by their bar in the atrium, so we've never actually hung around to see something to completion due to lack of space.

18) They have a tiny lounge that used to be open at night for adults but its apparently under construction. Had no idea before coming here and of course no one told us when we checked in, so there goes one of the other limited entertainment options. Basically, after 6pm, you'd better have plans to go elsewhere or you're likely to go to bed early here.

19) The food. Not much good to say here. We went to Enso, the international restaurant, and neither of us could finish our meal. My wife had incredibly rubbery octopus, and I had ribs that the knife almost couldn't cut through. They were absolutely horrific. Service was equally terrible. I noticed they did away with any form of a steakhouse here other than the non-all-inclusive Sal premium steakhouse which we won't bother wasting money on since they can't seem to cook meat here in any capacity. Everything is super well done and dry, and if its from the buffet, its cold. Like 90% of the food there is cold. How is that even possible? But its just not good, either. The buffet setup is so stupid, you walk all over to find stuff, like it was organized by a blind person. God forbid you try one of the two stations which never have any real explanation of what they offer, like the ambiguous "pasta station," since you'll wait a good 10-15 minutes per person to have your order made. The only good food we've had is in Blue Agave, the taco place, which unfortunately has about 5 options on the menu, all of which are great. We knew better than to try their new Italian restaurant.

20) Room service food is no better. Cold, soggy stuff, very limited quantity. But breakfast is actually decent.

21) When they clean the room, they don't tend to replenish the minibar, so we have to keep calling for that separately.

22) In general, staff simply are not friendly or interested in helping you. They do the bare minimum, provide the least amount of information, and almost always seem annoyed.

23) Maybe the dumbest thing we've seen here this go around, they've modified seemingly every last lounge chair by the pool so they cannot be adjusted. Basically, you're in a mostly inclined position, take it or leave it. They are the exact same (now, very old) chairs we used here years ago, but they're missing parts, including a pull chain that used to hang from the back, allowing you to adjust them from incline to fully flat. Want to lay on a chair to tan your back? Good luck unless you're under 4ft tall and can fit on the flat part of the chair... Like, what the heck went into THAT decision? Crazy.

24) Our "premium" room had soap dispensers on the wall in the shower. One night, I woke up to a very loud bang which happened to be the soap falling off the wall. They had secured it to the wall with...tape (see picture). Nice.

25) We regret staying here again, pretty strongly, so much so we've been getting day passes at other hotels and having far better experiences. We've also been eating dinner elsewhere and going for drinks at local bars. The drinks here are more watered-down than ever, and the bartenders often have no idea how to make common drinks like Malibu Bay Breezes, nor do they offer up any creative tropical creations like you might see at other, better hotels. Boring and unhelpful sums it up pretty well.

In sum, I do not recommend wasting time or money here. It may look beautiful and impressive but that's where the appeal ends. Bad food, boring drinks, atrocious service, and dilapidated rooms really make you think twice about coming back.

reviews.author: Kelly H
reviews.title: Average to Poor Hotel
reviews.text:
The hotel needs updating! The pool needs to be resurfaced.  We were stepping on sharp tiles that were coming off the bottom of the pool. There was mold along the sides of the pool. The water was below the skimmer, so it wasn't collecting the debris. Our rooms were outdated. Our lights and electrical outlets would randomly go out and come back on.  It was so odd.  They need to remove the high bathtub and replace it with a step in shower.  It was difficult to step in the tub to get a shower.  As for the food, they need more traditional choices in the restaurants.  The dishes are small and the options were fancy cuisine.  The only restaurant we really liked was the Mole.  
There was only 1 day of pool activities that everyone could join in. That day was fun.  There is no music or DJ by the pool with the swim up bar.  We found several people were putting on their own music, and it was loud enough that the music was annoying because it was different music coming in different directions.  They need less Bali beds and more lounge chairs. To top off our trip, the luggage attendant, when we were checking us out, put us on the wrong shuttle! We were almost to the airport and the driver asked our last name.  He started to turn around and we almost got hit by a dump truck  I've been to two other resorts along the Cancun hotel zone and they were much, much nicer and their price was comparable to the Paradisus.  Will will not be coming back. .The only positive experience from our trip was Sergio, our bar service attendant at the pool. He was AWESOME! He worked so hard and he had the best customer service.

reviews.author: ferpat8
reviews.title: No vuelvo
reviews.text: El proceso de check in (sobretodo en hora/día pico), es tan largo y tardado que hasta raya en lo ridículo, 50 minutos me tomó hacerlo, y viene uno llegando de viaje con niños pequeños y no es justo tanto tiempo de espera, la idea del buffete asistido es igualmente ridícula, lo cuál se solucionaría fácilmente proporcionando guantes de plástico a cada huésped al ingresar al mismo y sólo tener un par de empleados que supervisen su uso al tomar pinzas para servirse la comida por parte de los huéspedes, asimismo el volumen de la música durante las noches en el ginger bar es ilógico, toda vez que es imposible dormir niños pequeños en la habitación con semejante ruido, el volumen debería ser limitado.

reviews.author: Maria T
reviews.title: Could have been much better.
reviews.text: Our butler was very inattentive. We had to make all of our own reservations. And he did not do the things we asked him to do. For example, I asked him to get me pricing and make an appointment for a facial and he never did. Also the room with the ocean view was VERY disappointing! The shrubs in the balcony boxes are so high that they BLOCK the ocean view when you sit in the chairs. So to see the ocean you have to be standing!! I strongly suggest a hotel manager go sit in the seats on the balcony of room 5089 and see how horrible it is. Take the bushes out and put in low growing plants! The pool at the spa had so many features that did not work it was not worth using. The room service menu was limited.

reviews.author: Alex W
reviews.title: Not great...
reviews.text:
We just returned from our wedding at Paradisus and overall the experience wasn't good. Here are the pros and cons:

Pros
-The staff is fabulous. Everyone goes above and beyond for anything you need, and they seem to enjoy their jobs. Truly, the phenomenal staff is the only reason I am not leaving a 1 star review. Moises at the reserve pool in particular is WONDERFUL, and Carlos at the Reserve desk was very helpful when we had a sudden issue.
-The food. The food in the restaurants is overall pretty good! Better than most resorts.
-The property is well maintained and very pretty.

Cons
-Check in. We were traveling with a large group of people for our wedding and many had different arrival days. Overall the check in process was an absolute nightmare even though we were in the reserve rooms. The computers always appeared to be "down", and our guests and us had to wait HOURS past check in time (3pm) to be let into their rooms. They also asked me for the total of the rooms and attempted to take my credit card information even though the system was down. Upon check out, Paradisus charged us an additional $240 that I never received an explanation for, other than they had "mischarged" us at check in which seems scammy. Our party was never given butlers despite paying for them, and I am still seeking a refund for that piece of our stay. 

-Management. This hotel seems to have been abandoned by Melia. Anything that needs to happen logistically at the hotel is impossible to accomplish. 

-App. Everything you want to do at the hotel needs to be done through the app which does not work most of the time. 

-Wedding services. While our wedding coordinator was very nice, overall I found the wedding planning experience to be incredibly disorganized and unimpressive. After paying $800 for a "private luxury dinner", we were sent a sample menu that included chicken breast and green salad. Not my idea of luxury. It was only after SEVERAL rounds of back and forth requesting a refund that we were eventually given a suitable option for our wedding menu. Why weren't we presented with this option to begin with? At 10pm the night before our wedding, our wedding coordinator texted me to let me know that they'd be charging me $1,000 in order for my make up artist to be allowed to come on the property. This issue was ultimately resolved by Carlos at the Reserve desk, which we were incredibly grateful for, but I just couldn't believe this was sprung on us at 10pm the night before the wedding when I'd told our coordinator I'd have someone coming from outside several days prior.

Overall impressions: I was disappointed with my stay and I will not be returning. I'm disappointed that a property with great potential is being run so poorly. I would not recommend this resort to anyone traveling with a large party, or anyone who wants a straight forward check in process. It truly felt like there was a different problem every single day and it greatly impacted our special day.

reviews.author: irina_t
reviews.title: A lot has changed
reviews.text: It makes me sad to even write this review since our last stay in Jan/Feb was so incredible. The entire staff has been changed here check in was horrible I did reserve again for this stay they took us into building 5 for check in and didn’t even put me in as a reserve guest even though she told me my butler would contact me in a little full day no butler when we went to our home we then saw they gave us the wrong room two double beds on the second floor of tower 3 right over the pool that is very loud and we couldn’t even open our balcony we didn’t receive a butler so it took us about 30 minutes of walking around the hotel to find our room we than called to let the staff know the room was not correct and were told that they had no other rooms till the following day we talked to the manager who first seemed very sorry and would try to Help us in the situation but that wasn’t the case..they changed our room the following day to building 5 a lot more quite and relaxing thankfully but then we get to the room the safe breaks, no alarm, coffee machine broke and then door breaks 3xs (we were locked out) and the worse part we were coming into our room and were in the elevator when the electricity went out and we start to drop let me tell you I wouldn’t wish that feeling on anyone your heart stops and you have no idea how to react. Once we got out the elevator Jorge the manager was there we let him know what happened and got a very dull response as if it didn’t happen and we were making it up. Long story short 5 days into our vacation and we are still waiting for the manager to let us know what can be done for all these inconveniences as it was A LOT HAPPENING in our first few days there we are here for 8 days. After being fed up I went to talk to another manager Eduardo I believe was his name and expressed how pissed I was about everything he was helpful and tried to make things right they gave us a couple 80min massage free and 40% off of amenities at the end of our stay (it’s all inclusive so kinda dumb as you really don’t pay extra for anything unless you go to the steak house or massage) but I’ll cut it short the resort is not as high end as before the staff is not the same butlers don’t do much at all you pay extra for just access to the adult pool (which many people without the reserve band were in the reserve area so I wasn’t really sure why we paid extra for it if we could have went there anyways) so sadly after rating this resort the best in Cancun it went down to 2 stars after all the horrible experience and lack of care by staff. A few staff that did make it great to come back which were still here from our last trip Ruben Ceaser and Miguel at la palapa Carlos at Mole and at the cabana reservation Max and Lucus I wish all staff were as great as them because they truly work hard and go above and beyond. And David who is from the spa who walks around the adult pool signing you up for massages and telling you the new deals for massages available he’s amazing and even helped us figure out who our butler was (none at that time since they didn’t assign us to reserve) sadly this will be my last stay here at Paradisus so I will miss all these people who did go above and beyond to try to make our stay more comfortable. However I do want to add Jorge did come an apologize for how things were handled and did say it was out of his power to try to make things right so the reason it took him long to talk to us is because he was talking to the main people. I don’t hold anything against any employees however I just was not pleased in anyway.

reviews.author: bprev
reviews.title: Bad resort.
reviews.text:
First I will start with the good. The poolside service was the best thing about the trip. Jesus offered service with a friendly personality and showed great hospitality 

Now the bad,  we had three different rooms. A lagoon view meant that we got to look at dead grass for the first half of our vacation. They changed our room which we had to pay for. This time we had a much better view. If we had gone with a cheaper room would have been able to look at the beach. However, we were not able to appreciate the view. The AC worked very poorly in all three rooms. We made repeated reports of the issue of the air. It never worked. We were told that it was just the way that it was because of the weather. Myself and my husband have stayed in other resorts with the same weather with no issues. We could not open the door to the patio because it would instantly heat the room up. The wind would blow into the room through the patio door even if it was shut. The food was ok but the staff for the most part was friendly. The website has different information for which restaurants would allow kids than what was posted at the resort. There were water outages with no notice. The reserve upgrade was a waste of money if you have kids. The resort also states that it is family friendly but the activities and amenities for kids are very few and far between. I would not recommend this resort to anyone. The only reason I have it two stars is because of the pool staff.

reviews.author: Hopp
reviews.title: Not a resort snob -
reviews.text:
Stayed at one of the resorts before. First time at this one. I do get it because it’s during Covid. But they cannot refill my mini fridge unless I’m in the room. According to my concierge (definitely not worth it). Sounds like some of the people here are really good though (Kinda of disappointed with ours). 
Just an example I attached a photo. Everything I tried to do he tried to convince me otherwise. Even down to reserving the Bali beds. I’m still here for a couple more days. Don’t think the upgrade was worth it

reviews.author: sise i
reviews.title: Mala experiencia
reviews.text: Paradisus by Melia, contratamos la categoría más "exclusiva" que ofrecen en la página y no cubrió con lo ofertado, al parecer por la pandemia, sin embargo, sugiero deben poner información confiable para evitar engañar al consumidor. Agradecería pusieran más atención a sus servicios.

reviews.author: timryanarroyoarsenal
reviews.title: Great hotel, some bad staff members.
reviews.text: I dont want to put a review because I dont want to put a bad name in a great hotel due to some bad employees. The hotel was so great but there were isolated bad experiences due to not well trained employees.

reviews.author: ramfr001
reviews.title: Relación precio - servicio - valor
reviews.text: Alto precio, tipo de cambio excesivo, mala experiencia en el check In y poca flexibilidad en el check out. Mantenimiento de la habitación pobre. Experiencia con el servicio en algunos restaurantes y áreas poco amable y creando diferencias entre tipo de huéspedes

reviews.author: nagendra sharma
reviews.title: Family recreation
reviews.text: Very good beach. Very good hotel. Friendly staff and services. But the ‘all inclusive’ is quite deceptive. Many or the best facilities are exclusively for those who pay extra. This is deception. The website shows all the facilities are available in all inclusive, but once you are there, You are barred to use some prime facilities ie Bar, Restaurants and huts along pool and beach. Quite frustrating and humiliating.

reviews.author: Alice F
reviews.title: Ne vaut pas son prix
reviews.text:
Nous avons séjourné dans une suite vue océan.

Points positifs :
- belle vue depuis la chambre
- bonne literie, confortable
- bonne qualité des buffets
- personnel sympathique et très serviable

Points à améliorer :
- check-in : nous avons effectué un pre-checking en ligne qui à notre avis n’a pas servi à accélérer cette étape. Par ailleurs, aucune information clé ne nous a été donnée spontanément : nous avons dû poser plusieurs questions sur les restaurants, le code wifi, etc. 
- vétusté des chambres : la climatisation était très bruyante et peu efficace et l’eau chaude quasiment absente. 
- mesures covid : le mini bar était rempli de boissons mais nous n’avions aucun verre pour boire mis à notre disposition. Par ailleurs, nous n’avions aucune information de disponible sur les services de l’hôtel dans la chambre. Nous avons téléchargé l’application de l’hôtel que nous avons trouvé inutile.
- hôtel usine : cet hôtel possède beaucoup de chambres et cela se ressent dans les zones communes telles que les restaurants. Nous avons dîné et petit-déjeuné dans le restaurant buffet de l’hôtel et ce fut toujours très bruyant et stressant.

Compte-tenu du prix payé pour la nuit d’hôtel au paradisus (708 dollars en tout compris), les prestations ne sont vraiment pas à la hauteur.

reviews.author: Cássio
reviews.title: Me arrependi!!
reviews.text:
Não gostei do hotel! Sim, ele é muito bonito por dentro e não reclamo na comida, o café da manhã era muito gostoso e nos outros restaurantes também, mas acho que os pontos negativos, para mim, contaram muito!
O quarto em que fiquei, virado pra lagoa, era muito velho, estrutura antiga mesmo, o armário não tinha prateleira para acomodar as roupas. A cama de mola fazia muito barulho. A tomada do meu lado da cama não funcionava (fui até a recepção para reclamar e me falaram que em 5min iriam arrumar... durante os 3 dias que fiquei hospedado não foi ninguém arrumar). Quando o vento batia na janela fazia um barulho um pouco forte (vedação zero). Eles tinham aqueles rádios despertadores de 1980 que ficava piscando sem parar e não dava para desligar pq o cabo não ficava na tomada e sim direto na rede elétrica, a noite aquela luz piscando atrapalhava a dormir. Tem um desnível alto para entrar no banheiro, eu quase caí uma vez que fui a noite por estar escuro, imagina um idoso!! Aqueles espelhos de aumento que fica no banheiro, estava todo solto. Fora a tomada que não funcionava, a outra que ficava na parede da cômoda estava meio solta. Não tinha box no banheiro, era aquelas banheiras com cortina que se usa muito nos EUA, piorado! (Estou pagando por um hotel 5 estrelas e caro, se fosse em um 3 estrelas eu não falava nada! Nem o banheiro de um hotel barato que fiquei em Miami era assim!)
Já na praia tem poucas espreguiçadeiras, se vc não chegar cedo fica sem, e tem muita gente que vai lá colocar as toalhas para guardar o lugar e volta pra tomar café e fazer outras coisas (eu não concordo com isso). Os bangalôs que têm na praia e na parte da piscina são exclusivos para quem é VIP (Royal Service). Quando fui pedir uma cerveja no bar o atendente me falou que só poderia servir bebida alcoólica a partir das 11h da manhã. Nenhum outro all inclusive que já fiquei era assim. 
No restaurante percebi nitidamente que eles tratam os clientes que não são VIPs com desigualdade para com os que são. Isso aconteceu comigo, cheguei no restaurante e fiz o pedido do meu prato e o da minha esposa, depois do pedido já feito, outro casal chegou e sentou em uma mesa próximo à nossa, antes do nosso prato chegar, ele já tinha recebido DOIS pratos principais! E ele não pediu os dois de uma vez não, ele pediu um, terminou pediu o outro e terminou... só aí que chegou o meu pedido. O detalhe era que ele usava a pulseira dourada, dos VIPs. 
Outro acontecimento falando dos restaurantes foi quando pedi ao garçom duas entradas, e ele me veio com uma resposta que eu só poderia pedir uma entrada e um prato principal, depois de comer aí sim eu poderia pedir mais.
Você paga caro por um hotel all inclusive e fica cheio de restrições. 
Já ia esquecendo das bebidas. Nos bares eles colocam as bedidas de marca a vista para todos verem mas na hora de fazer eles pegam umas bebidas escondidas para fazer os drinks, e tenho minhas dúvidas sobre do que tem lá dentro. Não sou de beber, qualquer coisa alcoólica que bebo já fico meio tonto, lá bebi 4 drinks alcoólicos e não senti nada.
Não volto mais nesse hotel!

reviews.author: Lee
reviews.title: So disappointed this time around
reviews.text:
I had high hopes for this place at one point! I left such a great review last year just to be highly disappointed and shocked this year. This resort was my go to, but so much has changed and it has nothing to do with covid. It’s the lack of clear communication, consideration, and the dated rooms that are in such poor condition. I was supposedly upgraded and was put in a room that did not even lock. I could literally push the door and it opened right up (very concerning.) Check-in was extremely slow and it wasn’t even busy. I’m just so disappointed in the customer service more then anything. The concierge is supposed to help you yet I was ignored when asking for help or assistance, because the Meliá app is useless and didn’t work. Melina and Sarai, thank you for absolutely nothing and providing false information and putting me in one of the worst rooms. I was celebrating a special occasion and this stay completely ruined it.

Aside from that, other staff in the restaurants/bars were great and friendly, especially Pascal. The spa was amazing, food was mediocre, the beach was nice with great attentive service. Beautiful and large resort from inside out. The hotel followed all covid precautions/rules and it was pretty clean.

reviews.author: Miriam
reviews.title: Cómo actúan en tiempo de crisis y pandemia 😷
reviews.text:
Tuvimos que tomar nuestras vacaciones obligadamente puesto ya no podíamos postergar boletos de avión y reservas.
El club vacacional del hotel siempre se ha caracterizado por ser excelente, sin embargo justificaron la falta de mantenimiento en muchas áreas del hotel por supuestamente haber sufrido daños por el uracan del mes de octubre; se pudieron obervar detalles como el que el elevador no contaba con luz en su interior siendo que solo debían cambiar la tira luminosa fundida, los pasillos con registros abiertos , en las habitaciones el bidet no funciona, cuando reportamos que el de nuestra habitacion no funcionaban ambas llaves, nos enviaron al chico de mantenimiento y me dijo que no quedarían funcionando puesto todos en general presentan esa falla, incluso no cuentan con la pieza y conforme se iban reportando, quitaban la pieza de otro bidet y lo ponían pero que ya en general no lo hacen porque solo están dejando funcionando el agua fría 😝.
Quitaron muchos artículos de las habitaciones del club básicas como las toallitas para las manos, la cafetera con el café, las botellitas de shampoo, crema, etc., hasta los pañuelos desechables, argumentaron que por el protocolo covid no los ponían y solo los entregaban a petición, son cosas básicas pero que al menos yo no entiendo porque los quitaron.
Se paga la membresía y adicional un mantenimiento anual para que puedas usar solo de 4 a 7 dias solo 1 habitación o hasta 2, dependiendo del tipo , bien puedes reservar con ese dinero en otro lugar si le sumas lo que pagas por la membresía mas el Mantto., como para que siempre el Mantenimiento deje mucho que desear.
El trato como siempre muy amable, aunque el chico que te aparta la cama valinesa pone miles de pretextos para que le des propina argumentando que no hay camas, que no te puede apartar mas de una, que no llegaste a las 7 am y que por eso te la quitó, etc etc, su nombre es Eliot.
Josè nuestro mayordomo de lo mejor al igual que el trato de Betsy.
No exigen uso de cubrebocas en las instalaciones y la limpieza de habitaciones deja mucho que desear.
Por último la insistencia de que asistas a tomar la famosa plática para que te cambien de plan vacacional.
Las tinas de las habitaciones ya estan rotas 😝

reviews.author: juliessan
reviews.title: The reviews are real
reviews.text:
This is an old hotel. It does not even have USB port on the rooms, absolutely neccesary to charge your phone on vacations. The employees are not as attentive compare to other hotels, probably because they are overworked. Seeing an overworked employee during your vacations makes it difficult for your self to relax, you dont receive a good treatment and can feel the stress of the employee. 
The food is not good at all, plus you have to make reservations at the restaurants because if not you wont have anything to eat, there is no a 24hrs restaurant open and everything closes at 10pm.
The price, compare to others in the area is not as cheap and the others hotels looked way better.
They also try to charge me a room service I did not asked for. It made me get worry because I did not knew if it was the hotel trying to charge more or someone was actually at my room at certain point given the room next door was forced during my staying. 
The only good factor is they follow lots of regulations related to Covid-19 but that was all over Cancún, not exclusively from the hotel.
I did saw some “not good reviews” before booking; the same as the one im providing here but I tought “this is just people who like to complain, Meliá’s hotel has always had good reputation”. After this experience, realized all the reviews were true and I dont think I will pick a Meliá anymore.

reviews.author: Kimberly W
reviews.title: 5 Days in Paradise???
reviews.text:
THE GOOD:

COVID safety measures: made us feel comfy in our stay. Mask worn by all. Temperature checks when entering the resort and every morning at breakfast. 
Lots and lots of cleaning. Hand sanitizing stations everywhere. 

STAFF: Friendly and helpful!  Special thanks to Christen for making breakfast one of our favorite experiences during our stay! Atilano, Raul (consierge), Sergio & Laura (poolside) took great care of us. 

BREAKFAST & LUNCH: omelette and pasta dishes made fresh! Green juice and buffet options were plenty!

BEACH & POOL: Beautiful, clean, and not crowded. Hardly any seaweed. Vendors were not aggressive. Spent most of our time at the beach.

ENTERTAINMENT: Great! We really enjoyed the Latin girl band at poolside. Music by the beach daily (on one side). 

THE BAD:

DINNER: left much to be desired. We found the best menu at the Asian fusion restaurant but on the last night, they served me cold food. 
Then I ordered room service because I was still hungry and that meal was ALSO cold.  No bueno.

LEAKS: minor leaks throughly the building. Mostly in the hallway to our room and covered by towels. This was minor for us but worth mentioning. 

BEDDING: the bed is decent but the pillows stink. They are very comfortable but who wants a pillow that smells like burp? Everytime you adjust your head, it unearths that awful smell again. Ugh. I’m  not sure if it’s because of what’s inside of the pillows, but I hope they consider changing this. 

THE UGLY:

The GIANT centipede (the length of my middle finger) that crawled onto my face as I slept in bed the night before departure. It was the parting gift that I never wanted. Lol. Needless to say, we didn’t get much sleep after that. I told the guy at checkout and he didn’t seem to care at all. 

CONCLUSION: This is our second stay at Paradisus. While we loved our first experience at the Playa location via Royal experience, we most certainly won’t be returning to this location.

reviews.author: mehjgmty
reviews.title: Not able to provide adequate service
reviews.text:
The location is beautiful and the architecture is impressive, and the buffet is tasty. However, in the wake of the pandemic, they are understaffed and disorganized, unprepared to handle sometimes basic elements of hospitality under current circumstances. We had a series of problems, and despite reporting them and talking with customer service, they apologized but didn't do much to fix, much less compensate for, the many inadequacies and inconveniences. We did not get what we paid for, and would not go back.

Specifically:
We were given no information when we arrived, not even the wifi. Our room wasn't ready, although we arrived at 4:30 pm. The person who received us couldn't find us on the list at first, so we spent time waiting in line in the wrong reception area until that got worked out (because we kept asking until the staff got it right). 

There were two of us registered for the room, and they gave us just one room key card. The door was jammed the first time we tried to enter; the bellboy had to work hard to open it. We went later to get a second key card, and when we got to the room, it didn't work; we had to go back again to get another one.

There was no information in the room; we had to call reception to find out why (a pandemic safety measure). The app turned out to be the best source for info. However,
the code to activate the hotel's official app didn't work until hours after we arrived because they hadn't finished checking us in properly. I had to call the reception twice to get out activated.

The television was hung crooked, was is a picture on the wall (tilted in the opposite direction). The semi-transparent curtains were not entirely well hung (some of the hooks were off the rails.) The sofa felt saggy and didn't have any cushions for the lower back. The television was not properly adjusted; watching CNN on cable, the image was squashed up. We had to go into the TV settings and fix the proportions so we could watch TV properly. The first morning, there was a cockroach in our room.

The room service doesn't automatically replace the water bottles for free; we had to ask for bottles from the bar, and they are tiny. We were told by reception over the phone that we’d be charged for room service if we ordered water, although the app says it’s free.

The application and enforcement of health protocols was been inconsistent; often, the mats for disinfecting shoes were totally dry, there was almost never encouragement (much less a demand) to use hand sanitizer upon entering different areas of the hotel, and in the assisted buffet area only a few of the attendants enforced social distancing between people and distance of guests from the buffet (as indicated by the markings on the floor).

At breakfast in the buffet, the first day we had to ask the waiter for butter and maple syrup; it took easily 15 minutes to get, and my food was cold by the time it arrived.

On Friday we made a reservation using the Melià app at the Enso restaurant. As there was no map as to where the restaurants are, at the time of our reservation we had to go to another restaurant (Fuego) and ask where it is located; the employee told us, and we headed over. When we arrived, it was closed, with a sign saying “closed: private event.” We went back to Fuego and the person who received us didn’t know why Enso was closed. We tried to make a new reservation at Fuego for four people for 7:30pm (it was almost 7PM and the restaurant was almost totally empty) but he told us he couldn’t do that, and he couldn’t give us a table for four immediately unless all four of us were there, because it was all booked up (he didn’t check). We eventually convinced him to let us have a table for four although only two of us were there; our friends arrived about 10 minutes later (and the restaurant never filled up while we were there, so there would not have been any problem). While there, we found out through a chat with customer service that Enso had been moved to a different space due to the weather. We had a reservation, and were never informed, and the staff at the other restaurant didn’t know either.

On Saturday, we went down to the beach. We wanted to use one of the square “camastros”; the available ones didn’t have the curtains up, but we were told they’d hang the curtains if we rented one. A few minutes later, we did rent one, and then they told us there weren’t any more curtains. The bed was wet and dirty with sand; we were told the staff would clean it off for us. They never did. We ended up asking for more beach towels and hanging them ourselves, instead of curtains, and covering the mattress with them. (Since the mattress is covered with a removable cloth, the right thing to do would have been for the staff to simply change the covering.) There were no cushions. We ordered food, and it took 30-45 minutes for the food to arrive, which is way too long for something as simple as chicken wings or grilled vegetables.

In the evening, we went to the Enso restaurant (which was open and in its place this time). The waiter wasn’t familiar with the menu, and made a series of mistakes in taking our order and in delivering the food to the right person. I ordered ramen soup (the only soup on the menu) and what I got was soup with a totally different kind of noodle (flat and thin) in a very small amount, with lots of pork. Ramen soup should have ramen noodles, and lots of them; the pork and other ingredients accompany the ramen, but the noodles are the main ingredient (hence the name, “ramen soup”). I got the impression that they didn’t want to say they didn’t have ramen, and the cook improvised. The customer service we'd talked to after our problems the previous day, and who made our new dinner reservation, had told us they'd send us a treat at dinner to make up for the trouble; they didn't.

At no time did we get the feeling that the employees were slacking off, rude, careless, etc.; on the contrary, they were clearly doing their best, and they were friendly and attentive to the extent they could be. However, more than one of them told us that there was simply nothing more they could do. We could see that the hotel is currently understaffed, and the workers in some cases have been clearly feeling frustrated and impotent in the face of the situation.

reviews.author: Tamila A
reviews.title: After 10 years of visiting so disappointed now!
reviews.text: I totally understand Covid19 changed so many things for all of us but I never expected to write this review. We came here for beach and we always coming back to Cancun because my family loves waves, I have no idea what request lifeguards received from the management but this is absolutely unacceptable for not letting people to pour their legs into water.. Why we came here??? Buffet is not operational like before, food is cold and it's seems left overs from the previous day. Fridge is not restocked anymore, I have to chase all over resort to find water.. Where is our special crew??? Where is special service? No towels on the beach.. No swimming, no food.. I recommended this resort for years and I couldn't wait to come back and help my Mexican friends as I know the main industry is a tourism.. But wait.. I am working so hard to have 4 days of vacation and look at the sea??? Unbelievable.. Please change something or you lost my family as your longterm client and so many..

reviews.author: Alice Y
reviews.title: Well-maintained facility, poor service and horrible strategy
reviews.text:
I stayed for winter get-away in Feb 2020. Overall, I was quite amazed by the cleanness of the lobby floor, pool and beach area. For a hotel this big with this large capacity, the staff really did a fantastic job. The food was quite good for a all-included resort, I cannot complain about it. Most of the staff were friendly and efficient. However, this is a resort hotel, mostly for vacation. With that regard, I will not return as I did not quite get the vacation-like feeling: worry-free. 

First, booking management is a mess. I stayed for seven days, of course, I do not want to have the same food every day.  Almost all the dinner restaurants require advanced booking due to the small capacity. But their management is such a mess,  two of my bookings did not go through even I double and triple confirmed with whoever over the phone (YES, they do not have an online booking system so I can "actually" confirm my booking). This is sooooo annoying.

Second, part of the hotel's strategy is to sell you something extra. For every day during my stay, I could not find an unoccupied seating next to the pool or beach.  The reasons are two-fold. First, there are NOT enough chairs, PERIOD. The hotel wants you to buy extra service so you can use one of their reserved gazebos. Second, the hotel and the guests foster this culture/convention that as long as you put a purple towel on a chair, you can have it all day, even you are not around. In order to do that, you need to get up at 6 am to get the towel and place it in a chair. Of course, I was not interested in getting up at 6 am to claim a chair. So during my stay, I never had a chance to enjoy the pool/beach lounge chairs even though every time I went to the pool, only 20% of the chairs were occupied.

reviews.author: Lori B
reviews.title: Problems at Paradisus Cancun-They will keep your $$$- Don't book
reviews.text:
I paid in advance in November 2019 for a trip March 18- March 26, 2020. As COVID increased I contacted the hotel and asked if the trip could be refunded or moved to a different date. I was told they don't have a problem and there are no refunds or vouchers for different dates. So we showed went. Fast forward to Friday, March 20th when another guest informs me that the hotel is closing Monday, March 23. No letter under my room door, no phone call from staff, nothing. I go to the front desk and they confirm this and tell me I can go to another property in Playa Del Carmen or get a voucher. I said no, I didn't book a room in Playa and I don't want a voucher, I paid you in November in full and I want a refund for the three unused nights. He tells me that Playa and Cancun are the same city and I have to talk to someone else. Then he blames the Pandemic. I said look, you wouldn't let me cancel or reschedule so I'm here and now you are closing and kicking us out. I then have to convince him to give me something in writing and another contact person. I repeat the same information to [-], Paulina ; [-], Joel ; [-], Miguel
Do not book with these unreputable people.

reviews.author: Theresa P
reviews.title: The food was never warm
reviews.text: This place looks great,  but the food was never warm and not very good.  No pool side entertainment. ( boring) The staff was average until you tipped them well. The rooms were clean but I had jewelry stolen from me from my cosmetic bag in the bathroom. I would not recommend this hotel!!!  Unless you want a  bad vacation.

reviews.author: Davin W
reviews.title: 2nd time staying, we were dissapointed.
reviews.text: We first went in March 2018 and were so impressed with the service, amenities and attention to detail that we decided to come back March 2020. Sadly the resort seems to be suffering financially and started cutting corners, making the experience less impressive. The servers are  less attentive, often you have to get your own coffee and drinks after waiting over 20 mins to be served, they no longer offer the barista who would make cappuccinos or other drinks for you, the hot crepe station dissapeared, the room no longer gives you a welcome souvenir to remember your trip. Bottled water was eliminated and you have to settle for refilled cups which is harder to take to the beach with you. The kids club has 1 or maybe 2 staff trying to look after 10 or 12 kids, and often the parents have to stay with the kids due to limited supervision. The door lock mechanism  in our room broke,  locking us out, and the 5 mins we were told it would take for staff to come fix it turned into 40 mins. We needed a bed for my toddler as we'd booked a room for 3, and it took 2 days for them to bring up the extra cot. The fridge didn't work in the room. The buffet previously had themed nights, even one night was steak and lobster on the last trip.
