This time the buffet had the same items every night without variation, and the a la carte had  mostly buffet items, they were just brought to you instead. We kept having to exchange the beach towels because they would be given out stained. I realize these things may seem silly to some, and of course the beach was lovely. The only outstanding thing was the spa which had incredible service, I'm guessing maybe because its $215 for a massage so they want to ensure the customer is satisfied. I just wanted to point out some of our concerns because it was all the little things that made this resort stand out in our minds. The servers were so quick and efficient on the last trip, the food was amazing, and the resort seemed to go all out with the attention to detail. If this is your first time, you'll probably have a good time. But if you come back for a second time and anticipate it to be same, I think you'll be dissapointed. Unfortunately next year we will try a different resort.

reviews.author: marie_helene_besner
reviews.title: Nice resort but can be improved
reviews.text: Really good service, but the food is bad. The room design is not optimal when you travel with your family. Really clean pool. Really noisy, especially in the restaurants. We tried the buffet and many others it was so noisy we were not able to heard a anything. Difficult to reserve even though the restaurants are empty. For the lunch, just 2 restaurant are open before 12, burgers or fast food!

reviews.author: Javier Q
reviews.title: No compensa precio
reviews.text: Grande expectativa y alto el costo. Considero que hay mejores opciones y a un costo inferior por un all inclusive. Hay zonas: albercas, servicios y lugares donde solo ingresa quien tiene membresia (socio), un camastro familiar (de más de 100 que existen) te cuesta casi 3,000 pesos diarios. Buen servicio si repartes propinas. Buen lugar y atención decente pero no se justifica un costo tan alto como el que pague. No hay ninguna variedad nocturna y pocas y pobres son las actividades diurnas. Si regresaría por la mitad del costo. De otra manera es decepcionante. Si no hay camas individuales en la alberca de tu preferencia no te asisten para conseguir más aunque haya espacio "puede buscar en la playa" fue la respuesta, bastante fuera de lugar para un sitio tan lujoso, y por el que se paga un precio bastante alto.

reviews.author: Tayo
reviews.title: The food is not great and service could be better.
reviews.text:
The dinners were consistently below par and with the exception of a Peruvian gem of a restaurant called Fuego, I  would’ve had no joy as far as lunches and dinners are concerned. 

The second con was the frequent up-selling tactics of some of the restaurant employees.  I feel that they need to be re-trained. They come on too hard and are obvious in being overly eager. 

The last con is that for the first time in my life I was propositioned to buy some cocaine as I was at the beach. I’m not sure what can be done to prevent this from happening as far as security is concerned but it’s a bit scary that there’s nothing in place to prevent that type of person from accessing the hotel’s beach area. In the very least, there are families with kids to protect. 

On a positive note, the hotel architecture and infrastructure are just fantastic. Just a beautifully amazing place to take-in aesthetically.

We stayed at the Royal Service garm of the hotel and so we were provided with a butler called Alex. He was good. He was helpful, knowledgable, resourceful and patient. Funnily enough, I spoke to another couple who also spoke well of him.

The buffet breakfast was always well stocked with a lot of variety. No complaints.

reviews.author: anidda659344
reviews.title: Ne vaut pas le prix
reviews.text: Établissement reste figé dans les années 90. Les chambres ont besoin d’une grande rénovation, les salles de bains sont vétustes avec de vieux rideaux de douche en tissu, les baignoires sont vieilles et sales, pas assez de lumière, pas de prises électriques à côté des lits, les toilettes sont également vétustes avec de nombreuses remontées d’égouts et une odeur nauséabonde qui nous a empêché de dormir ainsi que la musique qui faisait trembler les murs! Nous avons été obligé de changer de chambre et de bâtiment car ce dernier était envahi par cette odeur masquée par de l’encens! La décoration est has been et n’a rien d’un 5 étoiles de 2020. La restauration n’est pas innovante, recyclage des aliments de repas en repas, si vous n’êtes pas VIP vous ne pouvez pas prendre de matelas lits sur la plage sauf paiement de 50 US$ Ce qui est scandaleux quand vous payez la nuit 430€! Heureusement que le personnel demeure sympathique malgré le manque d’effectif qui les paralysent. Il faudrait soit effectuer des travaux pour refaire votre hôtel à neuf soit baisser considérablement les prix!

reviews.author: baga862020
reviews.title: Not the paradisus you are used to
reviews.text: this place was not nearly as good as the paradisus in playa del carmen. Food for below expectation with poor presentation, no steakhouse in 5 star hotel....wow. No life flowers, no theme drinks that were introduced in playa. only 3 types of beer available no corona or modelo, shame. Drinks were very inconsistent at each bar, and they all had maracuia fruit in them. Only good food was at the taco joint, buffet was decent too. Place was clean, and had beautiful beach. bring your own toothpaste.

reviews.author: Joanna K
reviews.title: Not a 4.5 star resort
reviews.text:
We decided to book our annual family trip with Paradisus Cancun after staying at Paradisus La Esmeralda in the prior year and loving it. Sadly, Paradisus Cancun, is nothing like its sister property in Playa del Carmen. This place is a fraud. It is a 2 star motel pretending to be a nice resort. Before I list all the issues we encountered, I would like to praise the staff. They were all very, very nice and professional. If it wasn't for their efforts to make our stay there a bit more bearable it would have been a totally ruined vacation. Leo at the pool bar and Armando at the buffet stood out the most. We are truly grateful for their hard work and positive disposition. 
Pros:
Beautiful beach
Great staff
Comfortable beds
Good pillows
Decent buffet 
Fairly clean
Cons:
Lengthy and disorganized check in
Very limited selection and low food quality 
Theme restaurant are hard to get into and beyond disappointing in terms of menu, service and quality of food 
The bartenders only offer three types of drinks: mojito, margarita and electric lemonade 
Food service station not sanitary (especially the ice cream parlor)
Run down facilities 
Damaged furniture in the common areas
Lack of decorations 
Roaches and mosquitoes in the room
Stained sheets
One electric outlet in the room
No coffee maker 
Poorly stacked mini bar
Hair dryer not working 
Clogged sink and tub
Paint chipping off
UNSAFE CRIBS (called ahead and asked if I should bring my own, told they had proper cribs for infants and not to worry)
....among many many other problems....
Bottom line is that it simply is not a 4 star resort they advertise themselves to be. Perhaps they should learn from their sister property in Playa del Carmen and stop cutting corners at the expense of their guests. I am highly dissatisfied with the brand and just want to warn those who were thinking of staying at the Cancun property. Don't! There are plenty of other choices.

reviews.author: Laurent P
reviews.title: Bad timing ..many resturants were closed
reviews.text: It is unfortunate that we were not informed of renovations ( at least 2 if not 3 restos) . Rooms are noisy. There is about one inch space at the bottom of the door. At least, the beach was nice and the weather was perfect.

reviews.author: David D
reviews.title: Bonita playa , Mala experiencia
reviews.text:
Llegamos para pasar fin de año con mi familia , pague una suite luxury con vista al mar para comenzar el precio no fue barato yo he llegado al Paradisus de Playa del Carmen y me fui con las mejores impresiones.
Esta vez reserve el Paradisus de Cancun para ir con mi familia.
Para comenzar cuando ibamos a la piscina nunca habían sillas disponibles todas tenían toallas encima, en realidad no nos importo mucho este tema solo queriamos donde dejar las cosas.
El 1 de enero dejamos las cosas en un filo de una piscina y ahi la maleta de mi hija de 1 año , cuando cambiamos las cosas para ir al otro lado de la piscina ya no estaban las gafas de mi esposa que las habia dejado ahi .
Reportamos el asunto y a las 2 horas llego seguridad a decirnos que lamentablemente no podían hacer nada porque justo esa esquina no llegan las camaras . 
Muy aparte de que las gafas eran caras , lo que realmente nos molesto fueron las mil versiones diferentes que nos dieron sin llegar a una solucion .
El mismo dia mi esposa fue a la recepción para reportar la situación y luego el 3 de enero dos dias despues subio otra persona de seguridad a decirnos que en las camaras no se veia nada le pedimos que nos deje ver las camaras y nos dijo que iba hablar con el jefe de el para autorizar.
Hoy ya estamos en nuestro pais nunca nos volvieron a contactar.
Luego de pagar por dos inyecciones $500 en el hotel por alguna alergia no determinada  y derivado a una clinica para que me pongan suero de madrugada porque no me podían poder suero y pagar $1300(Luego de un hold a la tarjeta de $1900) más en la clinica por el suero , el viaje se llenó de malas experiencias y dudas sobra como tratan a los turistas.
El personal en gran parte fue muy cordial.
Realmente a este Paradisus no volvería, que pena porque la playa es lo mejor del hotel.
Mi experiencia no fue muy buena , esperemos que los que lleguen tengan una experiencia mejor a la mía.
Suerte

reviews.author: Joanna J
reviews.title: It's a 3-star resort with the price tag of a 5-star
reviews.text: The overall experience was fine but definitely not worth the price tag. Everything is on the schedule. No coffee after 10 am, no coffee maker in the room. Kids and the baby clubs are ok, nothing special and sometimes understaffed. Restaurants are fully booked even if you try to make a reservation a day before. Pool space is limited. Long lines to the breakfast in the morning. No snacks in the room and you can't take any food from the restaurant to the room. There's a delivery charge for the room service. Room service doesn't include alcoholic drinks and is very limited. Activities and shows are just OK, nothing special. There's no schedule to know what is happening and when. Everything would be fine if it was for half of the price. I stayed at the less expensive resorts and got a LOT more in all areas.

reviews.author: InnaVlasova90
reviews.title: Royal service совсем не назовёшь “”Роял”
reviews.text:
Отдыхали в аналогичном отеле в Роял сервис в Доминикане , на те же новогодние даты
и там действительно Роял. 
На новогодний ужин нас записали в 6 вечера , на мои вопросы , что нам рано и у нас Роял сервис и мы хотим на 8 -9 вечера мне сказали - скажи спасибо, что вообще записали 
Внимание!!!! Новогодние сутки стоят 40 тысяч рублей !!!! 
В итоге мы так и не дождались Новый год и пошли спать в 10:( 
Здесь каждый день проблема с Бали Бед( так называемая комфортная кровать около бассейна)  То есть не тот, кто пришёл первый к бассейну и занял что хочешь, а нужно все бронировать, и какую Бали бед дадут - скажи спасибо и за то 
И это за 25 тысяч в сутки???????? Первые 4 дня мне сказали все занято!!!! 
В итоге  Бали Бед давали через скандалы , то есть ты приходишь к бассейну и все свободно - ты говоришь дайте мне Бали бед , а тебе все занято, сорри , ты начинаешь кричать на весь отель , что ты тоже заплатил за роял сервис и тебе к 11 часам дают Бали бед , а до 11 ты просто ходишь и паришься на солнце ( типа не пришли люди , которые резервировали) 
Сейчас у нас есть Бали бед , то есть спустя 4 дня ее начали бронировать , но мы не можем выбрать ее!!!!! А мы приходим в 7-8 утра к бассейну 
Сегодня дали крайнюю Бали бед около зоны с детьми и дискотеки , то есть не до релакса
Еда- на завтрак в Роял сервис не всегда свежая 
Лапалапа работает только на завтрак и обед , а ужин для Роял сервиса в ресторанах «для всех»
То есть если Вы собираетесь в этот отель за те деньги , которые заплатили мы - не советую  
На фото - свежие фрукты , ну мы же в роял сервис))))))

reviews.author: xmvacaflores
reviews.title: Not an Adult Only Hotel
reviews.text: I booked an Adult Only hotel and did not get that experience. Kids are able to access the adult pool area and bars around the resort. My fiancee and I tried to have a romantic dinner and all i could hear was loud music and kids yelling and crying. The Royal Service area and check in was not great. The food/snacks in the check in area did not look appetizing and the bar was just a long table with bottles and a bucket of ice. The man serving the drinks wasn't friendly. I had to wait for the butler to takes us to the room and have it double checked before we entered. A very long wait for no reason. In my hotel room the door that goes to the room next door is very thin and i could hear the conversations and TV from the other room. The walls are very thin. People on the 4th or 5th floor were playing loud music and i could hear the vibration and sound from my room on the second floor. You will find your chips in the mini bar to keep them nice and cold which i did not like. The resort looks nice and some workers try hard to please, but it isn't consistent. I really wanted to like the resort, but i didn't. I stayed at the Adult Only Paradisus in Dominican Republic and I had a better experience there. I won't be returning to this hotel.

reviews.author: Jeff C
reviews.title: Over priced, horrible customer service, poor food quality
reviews.text: There are too many great options in Cancun to waste your money on this hotel.  There service is two or three stars at best.  The food is two stars.  But the price is five stars.  Save your money and try another hotel.

reviews.author: karl527
reviews.title: Stay at another paradisus!
reviews.text:
This resort needs work, staff needs training. Food was hit or miss skip bana sushi was terrible tasted like mush. Red lounge is the only place to get a drink after 11pm and it is very dirty and had low quality drinks. Enso requires FULL clothing at all time, no DRY swim shorts allowed we were told we could not eat there even though fully dressed due to dry swim trunks being worn. Beach is very pretty, well maintained. Royal service is worth paying extra as its the only way to have any peace and quiet. Be sure to get a decent butler, or they do nothing for you. DO NOT USE RECCOMENDED SHUTTLE SERVICE 
OTIUM! Reservations can be hard to get. Skip this resort and go to another paradisus.

reviews.author: Ashley C
reviews.title: Royal Service but not Royal food or Adults Only
reviews.text: We were a bit disappointed in this resort. It was very clean and we enjoyed our pool/beachside experience HOWEVER. This resort is NOT adults only. Only one tower is. We had screaming kids by us at most dinners. The food was okay...not great. Room service food is awful. Beds are incredibly uncomfortable.

reviews.author: ROC2021
reviews.title: Do your research before staying here!
reviews.text:
We stayed at this all inclusive from December 8th, 2019 to December 15th, 2019. Overall we had a good time, OUTSIDE the resort. I'll break it down by category to make it easier.

Check in process: It was long and they try to get you to sign up for some timeshare presentation that they call a "club membership" where you earn "points" by paying a yearly fee that if you don't use you lose. We fell for it before doing research on it and gave them a $20 deposit.  When we realized what the real intent of the presentation was we decided not to show up. I wish I could say that was the end of it but it wasn't. A couple of hours after we skipped the presentation a woman called our room asking why we didnt attend. We simply stated we weren't interested, much to her shock.  Then two guys, Victor (who we originally signed up with for the presentation) and Alfonso, kept harrasing us when they saw us, asking us to do the presentation and earn extra "discounts" on various amenities throughout the resort. It took us having to be stern with them for them to leave us alone. Victor took the hint but Alfonso didn't get it. At various times he would shout our last name and run towards us as we were going about our business trying to enjoy the resort to ask why we wouldn't attend the presentation and what he could do to get us to attend. When he realized he couldn't sweetened the deal for us he began insisting that we go collect the deposit.  When a day or two passed and we didn't go because we knew this was their final attempt at trying to lure us in for the presentation, Alfonso kept bugging us everytime we walked by (literally every time). We skipped the presentation on Monday & on Thursday this guy sees us yet again and gives us the same rundown but this time stating that if we went to collect our deposit we would get 5 times the amount back. Jesus..

Room: Nice, except for the fact that there were two problems;
1. There was a German roach in the room and 2. The room was located literally right above the night club where they blast music at late hours of the night.
Now the second point wasn't that much of an issue because it's a night club & we get the purpose is to enjoy and dance, it's just that the room was in a terrible spot to be right above a nightclub. They changed our room to the other side and that was nice of them to be able to do, however the roach was disgusting & it was never addressed by them. They simply notated that we were moved due to the noise of the night club.

Food: Severely underwhelming. I've been to other resorts on the hotel strip and this by far was the most underwhelming food I've ever had. Everything was bland. Nothing had taste except for 1-2 things on the menu or at the buffet. Not to mention, that the buffet menu was literally the same every day except for 1-2 dish variations. Also, we couldn't eat at all the restaurants offered. We tried to make reservations the day we got there but we were told they were already booked days out, so we didn't even get to try all the restaurants. Overall the food was plain and flavorless. We resorted to eating outside of the resort for dinner almost every night which is a shame considering this was supposed to be an all inclusive.
I will say that Cristian at the Blue Agave restaurant was AMAZING!! Very friendly guy, cheerfull & always made sure we were taken care of! He also provided local recommendations for things to do. Seriously, one of the highlights of our trip at the resort.

Amenities: I honestly feel a little lied to. When I booked the resort there was no mention about there being different tiers of all-inclusive stays like royal service, family concierge, and main. There were certain amenities that we couldn't use. For example, I really wanted a resort with a game room that had billiard tables and such. I saw this was an option in the resort and was one of the reasons I booked it. When we attempt to use it we couldn't because we're not part of the family concierge. What the... Also, the pool did not have enough seats to accommodate the amount of normal traffic they have coming through there. We couldn't use the pool a few times since we couldn't find seats to actually lay down or put our stuff on. To rent one of the available chairs which happen to be an "upgraded" chair with some shade over it, it would've cost us $130.  WOW. Yeah, we're not paying $130 USD for a chair.  For reference, on a beach day we rented a Bali bed for the whole day and were provided a lobster brunch on the beach that cost us $150. It's apparent they don't provide close to enough chairs so you have no choice but to upgrade to the same chair with a straw umbrella over it for a ridiculous price.  Our advice, arrive early as hell to secure a poolside chair.

Verdict: It's a shame because this was supposed to be our honeymoon. We've come to terms that we just can't allow this experience to be our honeymoon so we are planning another trip somewhere else in the future that we can call our honeymoon. We would come back to Cancun in the future for other vacations if we wanted to because the experience outside the resort was nice but it won't be at Paradisus or any of the Melia resorts.

reviews.author: nathanleroy8
reviews.title: Restaurants Closed!
reviews.text: Beware, almost all of the restaurants are closed. Only one or two are open and they serve the same thing. You can’t get reservations at any of the open one anyways. Nobody told us about the restaurant being closed and we felt scammed.

reviews.author: Roberto P
reviews.title: Muito ruim
reviews.text:
Compramos o pacote All Inclusive, no entanto, nos deparamos com uma enormidade de serviços pagos, e não fomos informados disto.
Para conseguir um serviço de qualidade, era preciso pagar por eles, já que os serviços incluídos no pacote All Inclusive eram de má qualidade. 
Os restaurantes incluídos no All Inclusive são de péssima qualidade, com péssimo atendimento e comida ruim. 
Os elevadores cheiram mal, no entanto, a limpeza dos quartos é muito boa.
O único serviço bem prestado foi o do café da manhã do Blueagave, e no bar da piscina, locais onde os funcionários são super dispostos, simpáticos e atenciosos.
As cadeiras da piscina e da praia incluídas no All Inclusive são insuficientes para a demanda, exigindo que o hóspede adquira a diária de um dos bangalôs, que custa 150 dólares. Sendo assim, ou o hóspede adquire o bangalô, ou fica de pé, caso não consiga uma vaga nos locais gratuitos, o que é muito desconfortável.
Por fim, ressalto o péssimo atendimento do garçom do restaurante japonês e do atendente Jerry, das toalhas, que inclusive iniciou uma discussão conosco durante uma negociação de um passeio.
Enfim, se não fosse pela praia maravilhosa e pelas belezas naturais do local, a viagem seria muito frustrante.

reviews.author: Matheus
reviews.title: ********Horrível!!!!!!*****
reviews.text:
Hotel horrível. 
Atendimento horrível.
Comida ruim*
Bebidas ruins, refrigerantes aguados, chop quente em copo de plástico pelo hotel todo.
Tudo é pago.
Equipe mal treinada e você é mal tratado o tempo todo.
Tudo muito ruim.
A praia não tem estrutura nem para metadade do hospetes q tem no hotel. 
A equipe do hotel quer propinas o tempo todo e se não der voce ja será maltratado. Chagamos até a discutir com jerry que entrega as tolhas de banho no acesso a praia.

Somente o atendimento do bar da piscina foi bom.

****Não recomendo!!!! ****

reviews.author: Andrew E
reviews.title: Left feeling cheated.
reviews.text:
I visited Paradisus for the first time in May on a family trip. I thoroughly enjoyed my time the first time around. Big buffet, service was great, couldn't ask for anymore. Only six months later, my significant other and I decided to go to Mexico, and of course, I recommended Paradisus. 

Check-in went great, we headed to our room, it was clean and orderly. We went to the beach for a couple of hours, then back to the room to get ready for dinner. We decided to go to the buffet which left me speechless when we walked in to see the vast buffet I saw just months before, brought down to just 9-10 options. My S/O being vegetarian had even fewer options. We were very disappointed. After a night's sleep, we were greeted construction noise right in front of the pool. They had closed the buffet with no warning and starting tearing the place up. As you can imagine this was a bit of a headache. But we were still open and we're hoping the buffet would be open once more for dinner. To our surprise it was closed, and they were serving chicken burgers and hamburgers outside. My S/O asked if they had any vege-burgers, they didn't. With hour-long lineups at the other restaurants to get any food, we had to order room service, which came with a fee out of our pocket. 

We had a fantastic time at the Spa. Silvestre, the male spa assistant, who was there when I went earlier this year was fantastic. I was very pleasantly surprised when he was there the second time around. We went to the spa three times this time and Silvestre was great each time. Bringing a cold towel and water to the wet sauna. Guiding me through each of the pre-spa steps. Great service, better person.

reviews.author: Nupur M
reviews.title: You can do much better with your money!!
reviews.text:
What a terrible experience this has been. We come to Cancun a lot, always had good experiences. But this place:
Terrible CUSTOMER SERVICE
TERRIBLE FOOD OPTIONS. 
CHARGE A ROOM SERVICE FEE (??) never experienced that before. Save your money and do your research go somewhere else! So many options here.

reviews.author: Emily F
reviews.title: Very disappointed - would not recommend to anyone to waste their money here. I urge you.
reviews.text: I read tons of reviews on hotels in Cancun before carefully selecting Paradisus and was the upmost disappointed. At one point my boyfriend and I were looking at other hotels we could go to for the remainder of our days in Cancun to get away from this lousy hotel. We are NOT picky, but basic things like having pool towels available on a beach vacation and having pool chairs available on a beach vacations are things that cannot go unnoticed in my opinion. It was unacceptable to lay on a towel in the sand when I’m paying for an all-inclusive resort.

reviews.author: Carlos
reviews.title: Não vale a pena
reviews.text:
Hotel bonito, decoração de bom gosto como pontos positivos. 
No entanto, o staff, principalmente o que fica na recepção e no concierge, te atende de mau humor e tem nenhuma vontade de ajudar. 
Não gosto de lugares em que você tem que pedir tudo como se fosse um favor - desde coisas simples como troca de água no quarto, toalhas, até uma consulta médica no hotel (que custa 150 dólares). 
Aquilo que vc compra, como passeios e aluguéis de carro, podem mudar de preço desde a hora que vc pergunta até a hora que vc paga (te falam um preço e cobram outro).
Também achei os restaurantes comuns.
Não recomendo para viajar com crianças pequenas, como é o meu caso, quando o que se quer justamente é tranquilidade.

reviews.author: World Traveler
reviews.title: Not worth the money...better value options elsewhere in Cancun
reviews.text:
My wife and I stayed there last week, and were quite disappointed with our room. It showed a lot of wear and tear, and was in need of an update/maintenance.
We had an all inclusive package, and were also disappointed with the lunch and dinner options. The breakfast was fine, but the quality of the lunch and dinner options were not competitive with the other resorts we have stayed in before in the Cancun area. (this was our 5th trip to Cancun)

reviews.author: Britney V
reviews.title: Bad experience
reviews.text: Overall, the hotel experience was nothing special. The hotels views were very pretty & the workers were professional (not too friendly but definitely professional) and that was pretty much it for the list of positives that I have for this experience. I’ve done my fair share of traveling and was the most disappointed by this all inclusive resort than I ever have been by other all inclusives. The food was absolutely mediocre at best and I did not mind that at first but when you spend a lot of money for a seven day trip, you do expect to have at least one good meal during your  stay. The drinks were COMPLETELY watered down. There was absolutely zero liquor in the pool bars. My group and a bunch of the other groups at the resort were very frustrated considering that we pay so much money for this experience and the hotel was just simply giving us sugar with ice and telling us that it was alcoholic beverages. To top it off, the representative from Orbitz sold us on a package deal to Isla Mujeres and when the day of the excursion came, our transportation that we booked with this representative never showed up to pick us up. After calling the Orbitz representative, there was no response and he decided to text us. He said that the transportation did come but we knew that was a lie. We demanded our money back and he talked us into purchasing a cab to take us to the destination. We booked with Orbitz so that we could feel a sense of safety being in a whole new country. My fiancé and I felt extremely unsafe jumping into a random cab from the middle of the street in Mexico. Overall, this experience was very unpleasant and I would not come back.

reviews.author: Adolfa Soares
reviews.title: Atendimento Pessimo
reviews.text:
Lugar lindo, paradisíaco, com o atendimento péssimo. Percebemos isso já na recepção. Funcionários desatentos, relapsos e alguns até grosseiros . 
É categoria all inclusive, mas com algumas áreas restritas , onde é cobrado a parte para se ter acesso. 
Os restaurantes com cardápios sem variedade e fraco.
Baixíssima relação custoxbeneficios .
Não recomendo!

reviews.author: Alyssa E
reviews.title: Discriminated Against During Check-In
reviews.text: We had a disappointing experience during our stay last week. We arrived at 11am and were told to wait until 3pm to check-in - upon our return we were told that we would be in a double room even though I had requested a king bed when we first arrived. The person at the front desk specifically informed us that because we were two ladies, they had to "prioritize families' requests". As an engaged lesbian couple, this felt incredibly invalidating and discriminatory - that our room would not be accommodated because of the gender of our partner. Unbelievable. Tired of arguing, we agreed to switch out rooms the next day. They had the audacity to ask us to check out at 11 and check back in at 3 - seriously?! We are already being discriminated against and have the inconvenience of having to switch rooms - you want us to have to pack up and not have a place to go all day?! They eventually conceded on this point. When we were finally able to check in to our king room the following day we were placed in a lagoon side room even though we had paid for an ocean view room. Additionally this room was smack in the middle of current construction noise - the bed was wildly uncomfortable and no upgrades or perks were offered. We will not be returning.

reviews.author: SandraD
reviews.title: Aquém do esperado
reviews.text:
Considerando a categoria do hotel, ele é bem decepcionante em vários aspectos. 
É imponente e tudo mais, mas o serviço não é bom. Desde o atendimento de um modo geral (balcão, bares, piscinas, restaurantes etc.) até a parte da limpeza, que é pouco cuidadosa, deixando de repor itens de higiene e até mesmo toalhas. Quando repuseram um rolo de papel higiênico foi colocado um rolo pela metade, sabe-se lá por onde ele andou... O colchão é antigo, de molas, muito desconfortável. A comida só é boa nos restaurantes com reserva, mas é difícil reservar. O restaurante do café da manhã, que é fechado, nos faz sair cheirando a gordura da cabeça aos pés. Vi pouca atividade de lazer na piscina. As espreguiçadeiras são uma guerra para encontrar e até tolhas de piscina também faltam. O atendimento dos garçons, como parece ser em toda a redondeza, só é eficaz e simpático à base de gorjetas. A praia é linda, mas não é convidativa por ser brava (isso não é culpa do hotel, eu sei). Não recomendo e não retornaria.

reviews.author: Aline C
reviews.title: Restaurante lindo, mas atendimento deixou a desejar
reviews.text:
O hotel é lindo, as acomodações são mto boas, vista incrível se vc optar pelo quarto com vista para o oceano, mas deixou mto a desejar. 
Optamos pelo quarto com vista para o oceano e pedimos cama king para casal, ao chegar no hotel nos informaram que não tinha mais quartos com cama grande e apenas a de “viúva”, questionei e o recepcionista do hotel me disse que escolhemos o quarto e não a cama. 
O hotel não serve bebida com álcool antes das 11h da manhã, para pedir comida no quarto vc precisa pagar a taxa de 5dolares por cada pedido. 
Funcionários mal humorados
A maioria dos restaurantes precisa de reserva e após sentar, todos precisam pedir juntos, ngm pode atrasar, se alguém atrasa essa pessoa não pode mais pedir.

reviews.author: marcelo_sech
reviews.title: Hotel imponente, mas o serviço é péssimo
reviews.text:
As acomodações do hotel são boas, os quartos são limpos e a praia e a piscina são tudo o que imaginamos e vemos nas fotos. Entretanto, quando começamos a falar dos serviços, a coisa é bem diferente. Além disso, o all inclusive está cheio de coisas "à parte" e me senti muito enganado. Vou enumerar as dificuldades para resumir:
1) Primeiro que é inevitável a sensação de engodo do "tudo incluído". Ao ver de perto, a opção não é boa. A comida dos restaurantes que não precisam de reserva não é boa, a disputa por um lugar na piscina, na praia ou para uma reserva nos restaurantes é insana e se você não for "royal", você quase tem que implorar para pegar uma bebida ou ter um serviço bem feito. Para se ter uma ideia, há apenas uma opção de vinho branco e outra de vinho tinto (da mesma marca), que para o meu gosto, não era bom. Eu adoro vinho e se eu quisesse algo bom, tinha à disposição, mas era à parte e bem caro. Até para ter um bangalô na praia ou na piscina, tinha que pagar à parte.
2) Há diversas lojas no complexo, mas pasme, fui enganado em uma delas que vendia lembranças de Cancun. Comprei um imã de geladeira. Havia o pequeno, o médio e o grande. O grande custava MXN, o  médio MXN 85 e o pequeno, meu escolhido,  estava sem preço. Imaginei que fosse mais barato, mas ao ver a nota, me cobraram MXN 116.32. Ao perceber, pedi a devolução e fui rechaçado pela vendedora que disse que não seria possível.  Não é por causa do valor, mas sim pela falta de cuidado e por ter me engando. Reclamei no concierge do hotel e até agora ninguém resolveu. Friso novamente, o problema não é o dinheiro, mas sim a atitude da loja e do hotel.
3) Tivemos um vazamento de água no quarto que deixou uma poça d'água na entrada.  Tivemos  que pedir manutenção no meio da madrugada.
4) Muitas das vezes que foi feito o serviço de quarto, não repuseram sabonetes e shampoo. De novo tive que implorar por este serviço.
5) Ainda sobre o serviço de quarto, avisei que não podíamos tomar nenhum refrigerante que não fosse diet. Depois de pedir, aguardamos mais de três horas para que o serviço fosse feito. Nos dias seguintes, deixamos um aviso, escrito em espanhol, pedindo a gentileza para deixa apenas produtos sem açúcar. Foi em vão. Durante TODOS os dias tivemos que pedir a troca. Péssimo. Fiz uma reclamação e no último dia, colocaram umas latinhas a mais, mas já era tarde para qualquer tipo de reparação. Falta de cuidado total com o cliente. De novo, a questão não é  valor, mas sim a atitude.
5) Mais uma odisseia foi pedir comida no quarto. Em um dos dias, saímos à noite e voltamos com fome. Pedimos um lanche no quarto.  Depois de 50 minutos, nada tinha chegado e meu acompanhante já havia dormido sem comer. Liguei para reclamar e me pediram mais 25 minutos. Acho que tinham esquecido e quando liguei reclamando, eles fizeram. Além de tudo, o lanche estava muito mal feito.
6) Todas as bebidas pedidas na piscina e na praia demoram uma eternidade para chegar. Isso quando não esquecem do seu pedido, como foi o caso da comida no quarto.

Poderia incluir mais uma dezena de situações decepcionantes, mas posso o título da avaliação resume tudo.  No fim, achei caro pelo que recebi. Não faria novamente e com certeza não indicaria para meus amigos e familiares.

reviews.author: cassandra357
reviews.title: Not the funnest place
reviews.text: This place isn’t bad if all you want to do is relax. Other than that, there is no entertainment, the food isn’t great and most of all, you will face VERY pushy staff trying to sell you things daily. It’s clear they are told to be this pushy from corporate because they are all this way. At one point we were confronted and the lady said she “insisted” we attend the timeshare presentation! (We fully paid for our trip and were not under any obligation to go to a presentation.) There are other fun places to stay with way better food and fun staff. 7 days felt like a long time at this resort and I’ve never felt that way on a vacation.

reviews.author: 901adrian
reviews.title: Decepcionado
reviews.text:
LO que mas me Gusto fue la playa, tiene una ubicacion y limpieza inmejorable, lamentablemente el hotel carece de capacidad en consumibles.
hablando de alimentos en restaurantes se tardaban hasta una hora en servir y porque le tenias que recordar a los meseros,
la bebida siempre se terminaba al segundo o tercer vaso y te sugerían cambio de marca porque ya no había de lo mismo.
los bares y disco no tiene aire acondicionado solo un restaurant cuenta con ac.

reviews.author: fofomusik777
reviews.title: Comentarios generales
reviews.text:
No volvería a ir a ese hotel,no vale lo que me costó.
Nos tocó un mesero muy majadero en el Mole.
La restricción para fumar tampoco me gustó.
El servicio por teléfono excelente,playa muy bonita y la cama excelente.
El Bana muy delicioso,pero muy caliente el ambiente,uno empieza a dudar.

reviews.author: Candace S
reviews.title: Disappointing Resort Stay
reviews.text:
Hope this review saves someone from having a less than amazing vacation while staying at the Paradisus Cancun. I am not a person to usually be bother or complain on much but the hospitality at this resort warranted a complaint.
The check in process was not efficient and our room accommodation were not what we booked. When asking to be moved into a room in which our booking was made, we were given excuses on how they were expecting a big group and couldn’t accommodated a move to another room on which we booked originally. After a hour of getting sorted out we (group of 5) were able to head to the pool to start our vacation only to find out we needed a towel card to check out a towel that was to be given to us at check in that we did not receive. Food was average, drinks were horrible, no music at the pool or beach and the lounges were not lively in the evenings. Entertainment was scheduled between the hours of 7pm and 8pm which are typical dinner hours for most, and we were not able to make the entertainment.
After returning to our room to get ready for bed my roommate and I both noticed sand in our sheets. Housekeeping did not change the sheets from the previous guest that occupied our room, unacceptable. As it was midnight at the time, we called to complain to a manager we decided to sleep on towels for the night and to have our room cleaned first thing in the morning. The next day we returned to our room after a full beach day at 3pm to find our room had not been cleaned at all. Again, we complained to the manager and she sent for the room to be cleaned. There was a huge disconnect because as we complained it seems like staff was not following up on the request. Even after expressing our frustrations and how the lack of hospitality was putting a damper on what should have been a relaxing birthday vacation, staff did nothing more to go above and beyond to make sure the rest of our short stay was anything less than amazing. Paradisus Cancun really dropped the ball on this vacation and it effected our vacation in a negative way. 
Also, please know there is only a/c in a couple of restaurants and in the guest rooms. Be prepared to sweat while walking through the halls or hanging in the atrium and lounges. It was much cooler outside of the building than in.
The only good things I can complement on this property is that the décor was beautiful, everything at the restaurant Mole was delicious even the drinks, staff was friendly, and the Yhi Spa was amazing.
I travel often and had the pleasure of staying at the Melia Paradisus in Punta Cana, Dominican Republic a few years back and had such a wonderful time. I was completely disappointed with my stay at the Cancun resort.
Overall, I would not recommend this property to anyone. There are so many other resorts to choose from, save yourself the disappointment. 
Melia, you lost me as a customer for any future travels. Work on your hospitality.

C.S.
Travel Dates 10/12/19-10/15/19

reviews.author: mrs_sh_2009
reviews.title: High hopes crushed
reviews.text: Still trying to understand how this place gets so many awards and great reviews. Yes, there are some good things, but they don’t outweigh the bad. Good - overall service was great, Martin and Enzo was fabulous, Lapalapa food was very good, and the beach is one of the best! However, overall the food was not good at most locations, beds were horrible to sleep on, bugs in the room, so incredibly hot in the indoor common areas that we couldn’t bear dinner at Ibana or drinks at interior bars. One evening at Market Place our food never arrived after one hour, we had to leave (kids were hungry) and went to buffet. Food at Mole was awful, beware of cricket salad they don’t warn you about or clearly state on menu. We’ve been to several resorts between Cancun and playa and by far this ranks at the bottom. Sorry Paradisus, we had such high hopes!

reviews.author: angelaclmba7
reviews.title: Expected Better for a Paradisus Melia
reviews.text:
We have been to Paradisus Melia before but to the one in Punta Cana. Wanted to try a different location for a change but we feel disappointed of having choose this one: Paradisus Cancun. Compared to Palma Real at Punta Cana this resort is not as good for many different reasons; before I named the bad let me start with the good: Beautiful Hotel, well-kept rooms, clean and maintain during the day. Kids can get unlimited ice cream. The beach is awesome! Very clean and beautiful water. Daybeds next to pool and beach are great! 

But unfortunately, we feel there are more negatives than positives: Common areas don’t have AC; not even the stores or cafe; the humidity level was awful and to make it worse the Japanese restaurant is right in the middle so you feel like you are being cooked… and we heard it gets worse during the summer. There should be either air conditioned on these areas or a lot of ventilation and fans; but you have none of the 2.
We spent 7 days at this place and felt like it falls short in customer service… except some people like our butler (George) and our waiter (Ernesto) & his team at Bana… they went the extra mile to try to make us feel comfortable and happy! Besides them we can’t really say anything about the rest of the staff… too many rules and too many NO’s… we are not used to that in Punta Cana… for example you can’t grab a plate of food from the buffet and take it to the pool daybed but can’t either seat at the buffet (that’s next top the beach and the pool… if you are wet… not dripping just wet!)…
The worse besides the heat and service was the food… mediocre at its best… one night we went to Market Grill and asked for Queso Fundido… very disappointed to not be able to enjoy this Mexican dish in Mexico! At the Taco place tacos were not what we expected… visiting with a Mexican friend; she was able to confirm that the food was not what she expected either. Visited Mole one night (The Mexican restaurant) my husband hates goat meat and we asked repeatedly to make sure they did not bring him goat… and he got goat meat; very sad.
We ended up going out to eat dinner 2 nights… out of the hotel… and there we had great food! Rosa Negra and Puerto Madero. Highly Recommended!
If you are planning on staying at this hotel, I recommend not to get the all-inclusive package, just the hotel and maybe try it for a day before you commit to a longer stay and be disappointed.

reviews.author: Arsham H
reviews.title: Below average, disappointed
reviews.text: Day 2 of an 8 day stay and the experience has been well below average, many negative interactions with staff unwilling to help, although we’ve certainly has some pleasant experiences. Overall,  below average food, and service.

reviews.author: ViriCorona
reviews.title: Decepción.
reviews.text:
Es mi cuarta visita a este hotel y con tristeza he decidido que será la última. A pesar de ser un hotel grande y antes lindo, lo están dejando decaer mucho. Esta viejo, las habitaciones descuidadas. El servibar con apenas dos botellas de agua, dos cervezas y un jugo. 

La alberca a medio llenar da una mala impresión, el area de la playa esta súper abandonada, no hay servicio de meseros, los camastros están arrumbados en una esquina dejamos unos minutos nuestras pertenencias y cuando regresamos ya habían robado las sandalias de mi esposo. 

La calidad en los alimentos no es mala, es TERRIBLE. Sus restaurantes de “especialidad” son una muy mala broma. Por ejemplo el de sushi, ni siquiera tienen yakimeshi, o si quiera arroz al vapor. El grill, donde se supone hay carnes ni siquiera son preparadas en parrilla. 

Y lo peor, su mentado club Melisa, si me estas leyendo y piensas visitar este hotel, cuidado no caigas en la trampa. Cuando llegas y haces check in, te dicen que te explicarán sobre los restaurantes y cuando menos veas ya te anotaron para un desayuno al día siguiente donde perderás 90 min de tu tiempo (el cual podrías estar disfrutando en la playa), y te intentarán vender un tiempo compartido. Cuando digas que no, te insistirán por horas hasta que termines harto y se ponga violenta la cosa. 

En conclusión no vale lo que cuesta la estancia en este hotel.

reviews.author: camanram
reviews.title: Insatisfecho
reviews.text: Mal mantenimiento, no servían los elevadores, fuga de condensado del aire acondicionado en el baño de la habitación, alimentos no de la calidad que se espera de un hotel 5 estrellas, eliminen el servicio de reservas en restaurantes solo genera insatisfacción, cuando reserve no me dijeron que 3 restaurantes estaban en mantenimiento y estarían cerrados

reviews.author: Daniel p
reviews.title: Manque de climatisation
reviews.text: 3 etoile ,pas plus.Complettement a renover.chaise partout dans les restaurant sale.Pas asser d’eau dans les piscines.Thermostat barrer.Veille porte patio et fenetre.Seulement 2 restaurants avec disont un de climatisation barrer qui sont mexicain.

reviews.author: CareyC
reviews.title: Construction everywhere
reviews.text:
First - check in staff are not trained. Mistakes mistakes mistakes. We had to go back and forth 3 times to get to the right room. We even had to tell the bell desk to take our luggage back from the wrong room which is already occupied by other guests. 

Second - construction EVERYWHERE!! Majority of indoor restaurants closed for construction. We were sweating almost every meals except that one dinner eating at Mole.

Third - facilities chipped and cracked. The hotel looks nice from far away but when you actually use the facilities, you see chipped and cracked everywhere.

reviews.author: off2thekeys
reviews.title: Not anywhere close to perfection
reviews.text:
Walking in was very lovely with a smell and vibe of a spa inclusive of cold fragrant towels to wash your face upon arrival. We were taken to the check in the area until that our room would not be ready until three. They went over the policies of the resort and then you meet with a resort planner to tell you about the restaurants and such. It was at this time that we found out that three of the restaurants were closed.  They asked if we were celebrating anything so we share we were celebrating my birthday which is this month. 

We went to the taco/quesadilla place for lunch only to find out that if you’re vegetarian your only choice is cheese. They only offer pork, chicken or beef. The beans are not vegetarians he cannot have that.

We looked on the site before coming here and there is zero mention of any renovations or construction. But I’ll put arrival we found out that three of the restaurants we could’ve used are closed for renovations. When we spoke with Margarita she told us that it was on the website which we went back on the website to confirm that it actually was not listed as having any construction she was quite defensive with us and kept telling us that it was posted on the website but in fact it is not. 

When we finally got to our room the door was broken into the balcony so hot air it was flowing in as well as water. We tried to have air-conditioning compensate her but it was impossible. We call downstairs six different times asking to be changed to a different room. Keep in mind we were told a check and that they were only at 40% occupancy so we know that there are other rooms available. They sent to people from housekeeping and one person for me except they never shared with us what was happening. Finally during the six calls we spoke to said she would get somebody to move us in 45 minutes. At that hour we called and they were told that they were on our way it was another 15 minutes before anyone showed up. Unfortunately couldn’t do much on the resort because we needed to wait to get to our room and get everything settled.

The new room was bright and well appointed with perfect air-conditioning. There is a small step to get into the bathroom   This is a major fall risk and horrible trip hazard. 

But we had wasted three hours of her first day which was not appropriate. When we went to talk to Margarita about it, she made it as if she did it a favor to ask by changing our room. We explained that we paid for with air-conditioning and so really just change our room was not doing us a favor. It started to get a little heated which was also inappropriate.

She asked what we could do for us and we asked if we could have dinner in the upscale restaurant and we were told that it was not for us only for private guests. We tried to explain that we we’re not asking for a discount in the room; she didn’t even offer an upgrade or a free massage or a free cabana on the beach or anything just to make the reservations for dinner that night in a restaurant that was included. She offered an upgrade towards the end but at that point we had already moved and did not want to do it again.

We went to the sushi restaurant which was not good and then went to moly the specialty Mexican restaurant. I’m sure if you eat some of the items there it would be great but if you’re a vegetarian it’s very limited. Also on the vegetarian menu is grilled grasshoppers. And my book that is not going to work. We ended up going to the buffet which was lackluster.

The next morning we got up had breakfast in the downstairs restaurant which was buffet style but good. Of note the omelette has a large selection but be careful to ask for a little cheese otherwise you will have an enormous amount. If you like that then you’re in the right spot. There was no cocktails offered at breakfast which was strange being in an all-inclusive resort.

We came out to the pool looking for a towel service as we had that cards to get towels but could not find where to get them. Once we finally figure that out we asked where there was a bar. There is no bar open before 11 AM. You have to go to the buffet and ask for a drink there. I guess this is one of the ways that they save money by not having to serve alcohol. I’m not saying you need to drink your entire day away but on vacation having a bloody Mary, Mamosa or margarita in the morning would be nice. But that is not available here.

We were approached by someone in for a massage telling us that it’s normally $140 for a 50 minute massage but today only you could get it for $90. Since there were three of us we asked to get it for 80 each. She came back inside now. Again not trying to be cheap about it but if you’re telling me you only have 40% occupancy and that you have tons of openings then work with us or say hey for the $90 we can throw in an extra five or 10 minutes but they do nothing of that here.   We have been to Moon Palace, Nizuk, dreams and they are significantly better with food, service and beauty. 

We were told Market Grill was open for breakfast it is not. It is open for lunch.  

Manuel has been the best service person here. Very attentive and friendly. 

There is a gelato place but it closes before 1000pm. Really??

Overall if you were looking for a budget friendly, clean hotel this is it. If you’ve been anywhere else that is truly five start this will not meet your standards. I would give it a two star.

reviews.author: PJ Arden
reviews.title: Unsatisfied
reviews.text: Issues from room, requested king got 2 single beds, went to ask a change told no. Took some convincing then got room with mold (maintenance guy painting in room even though room was suppossed to be ready. Beach closed at beach resort at 8pm and pool clised at 7pm

reviews.author: Amy V
reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text:
PRO: The rooms, grounds, restaurants and pool area were kept very clean.  The staff were also welcoming and nice (if you tipped) - a special thank you to Flor at the pool and Guadencio at Blue Agave for their help! So attentive! The drinks were very good, not watered down at all. The other pro would be the check-in process was quick and staff were polite at the front desk...which leads me to the cons. 

CON: Although check-in was quick we were given an ocean view with two double beds when we booked a king. We were told we could switch to a ground floor room with a king bed 2 days after check-in (no ocean view) or switch to an ocean view king 3 days after check-in...which wasn’t helpful since we were only staying 5 days. Disappointing since this was a celebration trip for my birthday and our friends anniversary. The same thing happened to our friends but they were able to switch to a king the next day after check-in. We were told they just don’t have the rooms available and a big group was coming in and they got priority?!? I feel as if I had upgraded to Royal Service or thrown a fit at the front desk they would have accommodated us - but I wasn’t interested in getting upset and putting a damper on the rest of the trip. 

Another con is that they’re doing a lot of construction which limits their restaurant and buffet availability. Our group ended up going off the property for dinner so we could get a better variety of options (and air conditioning) - by day 4 we were done eating the same thing over and over. 

RECOMMENDATIONS: Before leaving the front desk at check-in make sure you have the correct room that you originally booked. Make reservations at the restaurants you want on day 1 so you can get in at a decent time, especially if you have a large group. Make sure to get to the pool early to grab a spot under an umbrella. Finally, I recommend staying somewhere else. Other all-inclusives I’ve stayed at service was better, they had more food options, and staff was friendlier...and I got the room I booked!

reviews.author: Gabriel Jota
reviews.title: GRAN DECEPCION EN PARADISUS CANCUN
reviews.text:
Todo empezó mal desde el check in porque Nos asignaron una habitación con balcon mirando a un parqueadero y lo prometido era mirando a la laguna .
Lo peor de todo la mala calidad de las comidas en todos los 
restaurantes verdaderamente decepcionados esperábamos más variedad y mejor cocina .

reviews.author: yeojinc104
reviews.title: Spoiled my vacation
reviews.text: I went to paradises Cancun last year and I really enjoyed it which was why I decided to go back. This year, the experience was totally opposite. The check in was difficult because the guy at the front desk kept refusing my husband’s signature. He said it didn’t match with the signature in the passport 100%. I got so sick by the third day because I ate the yogurt which was served warm. They never keep the food at the right temperature at breakfast buffet, warm food is cold, cold food is warm. My favorite restaurant was being renovated and they didn’t mention it on the website. I was forced to eat somewhere else, the experience at one of the restaurant near the beach was horrible because each one in my family got 50+ mosquito bites while we were eating outside. It is hard to avoid bugs outside but they could’ve provided some insect repellent light/sensor near each table. I reserved the hospitality room when I checked out, the shower drain was clogged so badly I felt i got more dirty by taking shower at that room. In the middle of the shower, with shampoo on my hair, I had to switch the room. Overall I was really disappointed.

reviews.author: Gerardo M
reviews.title: Muy decepcionado...
reviews.text:
A este hotel le URGE un “refreshment” está atrapado en los 90’s y todo el lo grita...

Mi estadía: 03 de sep 2019 al 08 de sep 2019

Si bien esperas que un hotel de la cadena Melia sea un hotel de altísima calidad, la verdad es que declaró que de su nivel ha sido el menos agraciado de los hoteles visitados ( y vale decir que he visitado decenas de hoteles de 5 estrellas y gran turismo del caribe mexicano) su oferta gastronómica regularmente ofrecida con tu reservación “todo incluido”  es muy pobre, por ejemplo: su restaurante Agave Azul sirve comida estilo mexicana y te ofrece tacos de terrible calidad, quesadillas que dan pena.

Su opción de Restaurante estilo Rodizio, creo que es la más baja opción de calidad en sus carnes, todo parece estar hecho solo para cumplir pues, cuando vez llegar las espadas a tu mesa casi prefieres pasar de largo, la que mejor pintaba..... cruda!! 

De las bebidas ni hablar nada más lejos de ser Premium en su oferta tradicional y sus barman en general mal entrenados por lo que las bebidas, la que me digas... de regular calidad en su preparación y presentación.

El único restaurante que promete.... TEMPO BY MARTIN BERASATEGUI ..........NO ESTÁ incluido en nada y vaaaaaya que es caro.

Vamos a lo mas importante La habitación!!!!

Nos dieron una habitación en donde pensábamos que recién había salido Mauricio Garcés!! Muy descuidada en todos los sentidos y lo peor de todo el baño, sentado en la taza literalmente podrías tomar agua del Bidé. Lo tienes a 20 cm. Terrible.

Conclusión, quedó cordialmente invitado a no volver, con tanta calidad ofrecida en Cancún este, será siempre la última opción como hotel en este destino.  Pa que me entiendas, de lo malito que está quise salir antes y ni eso pude hacer jajajaja.

Pero que se yo de hoteles si solo viajo 25 semanas al año .....

reviews.author: Irka143
reviews.title: Very disappointed
reviews.text:
When you first walk in, it Looks amazing.  The lobby and the reception was very pretty with amazing decor. Very modern n relaxed feeling. Waited 3 hours for my room,  finally we got to our room and issues began, the Ac was not working, the safe was not working, the tv was not working, the mini fridge was dead. I spent 3 hours in my room while different workers came to fix each thing.  3 hours later they were not able to fix ac or the safe.  Poor customer service with all these problems I had to call n argue about getting moved to a new room. Finally they agreed to move us to the only available room,  originally had a room with a king size bed had to move to a room with 2 twin beds, that was day one. 

This is not the service you expect at all inclusive Meliá hotel. The rooms are very dated and need major improvements. There is no ac inside the hotel or several restaurants. When you dress up and go out for dinner be ready to sweat. I must the say the only meal me and my family enjoyed was breakfast at the only restaurant that has descent air conditioning. 

I don’t find the hotel kid friendly at all, they don’t even serve kid friendly food at a buffet, and the buffet hardly has any choices of food, very limited options. No kids entertainment. The shoes are very dull and boring. My kids ages 14 and 6 were so bored. 

The pools are great in the hotel and the pool staff is amazing. I would not come back to this hotel.

reviews.author: Hessam M
reviews.title: Melia Group has abandoned this resort
reviews.text:
No AC, money scamming, and filthy. Visited the resort August 19th with Family for a family retreat. Lobby was inhumanly hot. Concierge family is a total tourist trap ordered by Melia to defraud guests. They purposely lure you to chose concierge and confuse you by different wrist band colors. You ultimately pay for nothing extra as all the amenities are outdated, broken, and filthy. They tell you there are classes none of them either happen or gets cancelled. Food is below average. Most restaurants are under renovation and the Sushi bar is worse than middle of the road gas stations. 

But if you think this is the end of my complaint, you are all wrong. Listen to this:

1- We signed up with another resort to participate in a 90 minute timesharing in return of a boat tour to Isla Mujeres Island with transportation to and from our Hotel. When we tried to leave the resort when the individual from the other hotel was picking us up. The hotel staff didn’t let us leave. They said we will accommodate what you have  and match it with better. We listen cancelled the other guy and participated in their “90” (5 hours instead) time sharing scan. Melia group is actively pursuing guests in this resort. They did all sort of gimmicks to lure you into buying a membership in Melia Club, for $25k to $110k in return for a joke of a hotel chain. Anyways, when we finished the 5 hr long session, they sent gave us a ticket for a ferry instead of the boat from a place 40 minutes far from where we stayed and no transportation. It was so far that we even decided not to participate and let the ticket expire. 

I keep the best for the last though,

2- At time of check in, you see a beautiful lady with open smile, making sure they get every dime in your pocket from you. They get all the charges at first and run your credit card. At check out, however, you see Pablo: who is Pablo? Pablo is a tall Mexican man making sure you will not leave the resort unless he gets what he wants. How? I tell you:

We booked Family Concierge for 4. At check in I asked if any ocean view room is available. They said yes for the day after. So, we moved to our main room the day after. At check out they put a $400 charge in front of me and I complained that this charge is illegitimate. Pablo in return says: 
A. Managers not at resort at 8:00 Am and he wont call for the manager. 
B- He wont let me leave the property unless I pay in full. 
C- He will call security if I I ask for manager. 
D- He says that the charges are for family concierge upgrade, which we already got included in our package. 
 
A manager anyways arrives out of no where and after 45 minutes internal discussion in spanish, lady comes and say that Pablo was wrong and charges are not accurate. 

So, my question is this: who asked Pablo to add those charges and under what reason they decided to remove those charges. Again in my humble opinion Melia has abandoned Paradisus and Mexican runs the place Mexican way. A guy like Pablo should not work at Family Concierge and instead must work as a bouncer for a strip club downtown. 

And to Melia Group, while you are very busy luring people to invest in your club, it would be beneficial to have the AC run and the rest of the resort also and not only your timeshare office. We know you want our money to build more hotel for the father and son, but at least let the water be steady in the rooms and not shut off every other hour. 

By the way, if you need to contact me to see the proof of my statements, I will be ready to send them to you. 

Extremely disappointed customer. Instead of building new Hotels Melia, fix the ones you are already own.

reviews.author: Claudia
reviews.title: Family concierge / pésimo
reviews.text:
Estuve en familia, contratamos el servicio family concierge ... vimos a Elsie, el conserje se supone, 2 veces en una semana. Su función solo reserva de restaurant y reenviar por wasap actividades.( creo que nos tocó la peor.. )
El servicio un engaño. La balinesa solo la puedes usar 1 día de toda la estadía.. nos dieron información siempre incompleta y confusa de lo incluia el servicio( no se acerca a lo que dice en la página) no vale la pena contratar el servicio para lo que realmente es. 
  El hotel en remodelación.. cucarachas en las habitaciones . Nadie te advierte que están en remodelación para no perder cliente otro engaño. Nunca vi en otros all inclusive fila para entrar el único buffet del hotel. Pobre en variedad de comida ...  NO LO RECOMIENDO EN ABOSLUTO. solo rescato a Martín garzon del buffet que siempre nos atendió excelente .
Zona de piscinas... reposeras siempre ocupadas .. pocas piscinas para tanta gente . 

Lo mejor del viaje conocer chichenitza . La playa mucho oleaje y zargazo . Me quedo con punta cana lejos !

reviews.author: Sanchez_Cecy
reviews.title: Desilusión Total
reviews.text:
Realmente me siento muy decepcionada del hotel,
Hemos estado en Paradisus Playa del Carmen y no hay punto de comparación. 
Durante nuestra estancia en Paradisus Cancun, según avanzaba nuestra estancia era mayor lo pésimo del hotel, yo tengo cáncer y por lo tanto tengo cierta discapacidad, pues no hay rampas para llegar a la playa, no pudimos estar en la alberca porque no hay suficientes sombrilla, la comida del bufete sin variedad, la Reservación de un restaurante de especialidad no la tenían, en fin jamás lo recomendaría 
Pongan atención viajeros, no se dejen deslumbrar por la calificación que aparece aqui
Saludos

reviews.author: Tom
reviews.title: Enttäuschung in vielen Aspekten
reviews.text:
Leider stimmt hier das Preis-Leitungsverhältnis nicht! Getreu dem Motto: you get what you pay - das wird jedenfalls mein erster und letzter all-inclusive Hotelurlaub sein! Ich schätze es eher als ein solides 3 Sterne Haus als 4,5*
Dir Anlage ist ganz gut in Schuss, wenn auch einige Bänke im Restaurant gut abgeranzt sind!
Alles was unten nicht explizit erwähnt ist war soweit in Ordnung. 

Zimmer:
Junior Luxury Ocean View Suite ist ein stinknormales  (kleines) Zimmer mit zwei Betten. Nicht größer oder kleiner als die anderen Zimmer. 
Unser Zimmer war in der Hauptpyramide. Dadurch hatten wir jeden Abend bis 23 Uhr live Musik - fand ich persönlich nicht sehr entspannend. 

Pool:
Die Liegensituation (mit Schatten) ist völlig unzureichend, auch wenn nicht reserviert werden soll. Man kann aber gern für 150++ USD pro Tag ein Bali-Bed reservieren. 
Grundsätzlich ist der Pool aber groß und schön. Ab 11 Uhr ist dann allerdings Dauerbeschallung angesagt. Für Ruhe muss man an den Strand umziehen. 

Essen:
Bitte keine kulinarischen Highlights erwarten. Ich habe allerdings in 2 Wochen México zuvor deutlich besser gegessen!

Naturschutz:
Die Schildkrötennester am Strand erfahren keinen besonderen Schutz. Da sollte man sich ein Beispiel an Tulum nehmen. Auch fährt hier morgens gern mal ein Traktor über den Strand. Ich bezweifle dass dort Rücksicht auf die geschützten Tiere genommen wird. 

Insgesamt keine Empfehlung!

reviews.author: Sjenn
reviews.title: Not happy unfortunately
reviews.text: I’m currently staying at the Paradisus Meliá Cancun All Inclusive. My family and I were super excited for our vacation at this resort but was quickly disappointed when we got here. The AC is non existent throughout the resort, only in 1 or 2 restaurants and the check in area.  NO AC in the club smh.  In addition, my first night here my bath tub water did not go down and I was taking a shower in a pool of wAter smh. The AC in my room barely worked. I expected so much more based on reviews and got the complete opposite. I really hope my lastnight here is enjoyable with my family. Disappointed client. I wish Paradisus Cancun would do something for my family and I to make our lastnight here better.

reviews.author: 720DENNISE
reviews.title: cero recomendable
reviews.text: El check inn más larguísimo (ni una bebida te ofrecen) y todo ese tiempo ya está parado atrás de ti un vendedor del hotel para poderte "explicar" el funcionamiento del hotel pero claro terminan con las cortesías para vender, yo sé que es su trabajo y claro si no te interesa pues dices que no y ya pero que al menos esperen a que te instales, después que la habitación asignada estaba ocupada, después que siempre si pero que la estaban limpiando, total que yo tenía años de llegar y seguía con mi bebé dando vueltas, la habitación muy fea, me queda claro que no pagué una habitación con vista al mar, pero si una habitación con vista  a la  laguna y la que me dieron daba al estacionamiento, sin surtir el mini bar, o sea que ni agua potable para poder hacer el biberón del bb, no hay suficientes camastros ni lugar con sombra alguna en las albercas, más de 4 horas para poder obtener una toalla, el restaurante del desayuno el peor, huele a humedad, poca variedad de alimentos y de mediana calidad, el de los tacos está pasable (tanto servicio como alimentos) el de las espadas está sabroso y el servicio mejora y así por el estilo todos los demás excepto el  Fuego, ese si es súper rescatable, sobre todo por el servicio de Memo y su equipo, que diferencia en trato y calidez! el Tempo la publicidad es ambigua, pues dice que puede aplicar cargos, pero no claramente que no está incluido y que tiene costo, no dudo que sea bueno pero si ya vas a gastar, hay mil opciones igual de caras en todo Cancún

reviews.author: Excursion491465
reviews.title: Lo no incluido en un todo incluido
reviews.text: Hotel que no es lo que parece. Pagamos un todo incluido pero llegando hay muchas cosas desde bebidas a zonas dentro del hotel por donde muchos pasan no incluidas. Desdén desde el inicio de el apartado informar de manera muy clara lo que uno va a encontrar

reviews.author: Ernesto Moreno
reviews.title: Melia or Motel 6?
reviews.text: Was that a Melia or a Motel 6? We just came back from the hotel in a more than dissapointing vacation. The hotel is old and needs a renovation, A/C units don't work, we could'n sleep in 3 nights, changed rooms and didn't make the difference since A/C didn't go south of 74F. Food was tasteless and lacking variety. The staff was the only thing that raised to the occasion, Orlando Bello at Naos restaurant and Saul, Keren and Carolyn ant the Kids Club were superb and made the difference. Very far from Melia standards.

reviews.author: Rajni L
reviews.title: 2nd Trip - VERY UPSET/SAD - Management went down the drain
reviews.text:
This was my 2nd trip to Paradisus. We stayed 3 years ago with our 4/2 year old daughters and had the best time ever. The hotel, food, kids club, pools & service were so great!  After 3 years we wanted to take our 3 month old son with us alone. A hotel so kid friendly - we absolutely had to choose Paradisus.

We paid for an Ocean Front King Size. When we got there - the checkout at 3pm (theirs shifts change at 3pm) there was only 1 person working and the line took us 45 minutes to get our turn. The room they gave us was a lagoon room - we went back to the reception where another couple was yelling at JUAN (manager).  We were next to speak to him and knew he wasnt going to do anything to help us - since he seemed less forgiving to the couple before us.  

We spoke to him and he said the hotel has nothing for us - and the only other option is a OCEAN FRONT on the 5th floor but its double beds.  This is our 10 year anniversary we are celebrating. We had no choice but to take this room - dissapointed with the service provided by the manager. 

The pools were dirty this time - people had thrown up in it and there was too much food in the pools. They werent cleaned everyday you could tell.

The entertainment has now moved to the pools. It used to be at the AVENUE BAR inside. Yes, its a smaller section for shows so they decided to move this to the pool.  The negative to this is that the pool they choose that night closes early and you cannot swim in that pool. 

One day they had MEXICAN NIGHT and they decided to build "stores" for shopping by the pool and in front of our bali bed they put these large wall paper stands.  Literally 2 feet from our bali bed; our view became the back of these wall papers. We could not believe it. The staff said all other beds are taken and at 4pm we had to leave our bali bed and just go inside. With our 3 month old we couldnt sit in regular lounge chairs (no shade).

The MARKET GRILL restaurant at lunch time used to serve yummy Italian food. It now is part of the buffet but just extended outside.  So this was a bummer.

The only options at lunch is the buffet (NAOS), the market grill (just another buffet) or  this taco place they have inside (REALLY NICE) but you cant eat lunch there 5 days in a row. It's beyond annoying.

Dinner options were good. MOLE was the best for us. It sucked because the reservations only avail every night were 6pm or 10pm. Really you either leave the pool at 4pm to shower/get ready for dinner at 6. Or you wait until 10pm. With a 3 month old we only ate dinners at the hotel 2 nights. We left the hotel to go to other restaurants more accomodating to our 3 month old's schedule.

We asked the room be changed twice - no one offered us an alternative solution.

The SPA - I made an appt at 9am. They asked me to come in at 8am for 1 hour before relaxation. Spa opens at 8. DO NOT BOOK A 9am and get there 1 hour before. NO ONE WAS THERE. The door was open. I had to get a manager and they called the staff.  Then I finally got to go into the relaxation room (which wasnt set up) the water was from the day before and not changed. HOT WATER wasnt ready for the tea. And a lady came to clean the wood floors at 8:30am.  I sat there to relax and a lady brought a bucket and a bowl. And she threw soapy water on the floor with the bowl and then scrubbed and wiped each section in front of me. The entire place smelled like BLEACH.  I was beyond annoyed.

The massage was alright.  For $130 it wasn't worth the experience at all. They have beautiful selection of teas.  I took 20 packets for myself to take home. Again, I was annoyed i Couldnt enjoy a cup there.

THe service overall LACKED in the hotel. 

The pool servers were too slow; they definitely need more staff at the pool. Getting ice regularly was annoying. I had to go multiple times with my bucket and just get it from the bar myself (which was no problem) but the bali beds came with service.

HEADS UP - if you want a bali bed (just the bed and no champage/shrimp/lobster combo, its only $30/day US dollars. Thats dirt cheap for you being in the shade. It's sooo worth it. There isnt much shade elsewhere.  And for $30 a day it was SOOO worth it.  

They have 10 beds by the wall for $30/day. The other beds closer to the ocean by the pool are $150/day and the difference is that you get MOET CHAMPAGNE/lobster/shrimp with it.  

You can get your own bottle of champagne from your room. Ask them for a bucket with ice and help yourself. We did that all 3 days. 

The bottle of champage was complimentary for our 10 year anniversary and they just kept bringing one everyday to our room - so cheers to that!!!  And we didnt have to pay $150/day for it.

When we left they asked us how our experience was and we told them we will NEVER stay at this hotel again. The service and experience were horrible. THe manager, ANGEL, said he agreed as they are having administrative problems right now and many people are complaining. 

We felt at peace a bit hearing that towards the end of our trip. I thought we were just struck with horrible bad luck every single day in different locations; but the management has gone down the drain.

They now have water bottles in GLASS BOTTLES. THey did this on purpose so people dont take their plastic water bottles outside of the hotel when they leave for their day trips. A great way for them to save costs; but its horrible. You cant even take a bottle water outside of your room. Who is going to carry a tall glass bottle.

You can ask for plastic bottles of water but they keep them at the concierge hidden and they give you only 1 unless you tell them 3 please. It's annoying.

The SUNSET GRILL (the burger/nachos place) outside by the pool - they will only give you 1 serving per person. Especially on the wings. 5 wings per person. I couldnt get 2 plates (one of me and one for my husband).  They had me put my plate away (i walked 5 feet away and set it down on the table - walked back and asked for another plate). Seriously at an all inclusive for 10 wings. It was insulting to say the least.

I wont stay here with kids ever again.  I'll try another place.

This place used to be so good; its horrible now.  And the management agreed when we checked out.

If you want service - dont stay here. If you want a manager to bend over backwards just to accomodate something - dont stay here.

Cancun rocks and is inexpensive - but these hotels are getting horrible.

reviews.author: gsolo
reviews.title: 5 star prices for 2 star quality of food
reviews.text:
First impression at checkin is excellent, great service, attentive, good bilingual communication. Lobby and central patio are impressive and certainly attractive. So is the pool and beach area.

Hotel was built in the 80's and needs significant remodelling. Rooms are aged, only one working electric outlet in the entire room, none next to beds, other outlets were used for TV or nightstand light. Air Conditioning never dropped below 78F (24C) even at 3am.
Very small step into bathroom can be a killer at night. Mirror is rusted and at checkin water was out, it came back an hour later.
Fully stocked refrigerator, but another member of our convention drank the chocolate milk and got food poisoning, later realized it had expired a while back.

Breakfast at Naos is excellent, lots of options for adults and kids. Service is good.
Other restaurants have great presentation of food, but very poor quality, wine is very cheap, I was unable to drink it, and meat is tough, after trying meat dishes at three restaurants, I went to chicken and pork for the rest of my stay. Drinks are served to the minimum, and had to request refills often, rather than giving you a good amount.

The entire hotel has an air conditioning problem, most rooms are warm, even the conference rooms. In a city that is so hot, you want a convenient 72-74F (21-23C) room temperature to cool down.

reviews.author: Culture468639
reviews.title: El hotel muy lindo pero la comida no va con el . Necesitas mejorar en el área gastronómica
reviews.text: Para el precio del hotel está bien si mejoran la comida y variedad. Los meseros no todos fueron amables. El aire Acondicionado de la habitación casi no enfriaba. Pasamos calor. El desayuno era lo mismo todos los días y poco variado.

reviews.author: LuisG
reviews.title: Don't book a room here... very disorganized place
reviews.text:
The hotel seems to have enough people but looks very disorganized. 
- In the check in process, I was asked to moved 3 times to different "front desks"
- I wasn't given any towel cards in the check in so Day 1, I had to go back to front desk and ask for it. Then it was obvious that they had ran out of cards and took ~15 min to get some. 
- Day 1: No towels in the pool area. Even after checking twice in the first 2 hours - nothing. We couldn't enjoy the pool or the sea since there was no towels to get dried afterwards. 
- Day 2: Again no towels in the pool area. I was told "complain to the supervisor because they only send me 200 towels". I had to go to front desk and ask for a manager and the answer was "he is not available because he is on a meeting".... pathetic... I had to push back and ask the lady to get the manager out of the meeting because a customer was complaining. Finally she left and came back with a front desk supervisor which personally gave me the towels and committed to solve the issue at the pool.
