- We were kicked out of the "adults only" pool. When we got in, an employee asked us to leave because it was Royal service only. I asked what "Royal" was and where does it say that the pool is for Royal because the letter at the entrance is big and clear on the door (adults only). I was explained then that there is a small sign on the floor (bottom left at ground level) which is absolutely not visible unless you are walking with eyes at ground level. The big sign is on the door itself and it only reads "adults only". We didn't receive any briefing when we checked in warning us about off limit pools. It was very unpleasant to be kicked out with my wife.
- We checked out at 4:30 am in the morning. Called front desk for someone to help with the baggage and also get the valet parking to prepare my car because my kids were asleep and I wanted to get them in quickly (both requests were accepted by front desk lady)... Then not only the car was not even moved from the parking lot (employee told me that can't move the car without the ticket) but also had to call again twice for help because the person was taking too long to get my luggage. 

I've stayed in many hotels in Cancun and this was for sure bottom place in hotel experience. By looking at the work-space of the front desk employees one can tell a lot... they work in a very disorganized area with big stack of papers and lose items all over the place... keeping a professional image on their workplace

reviews.author: Toni R
reviews.title: Mager für Meliá Verhältnisse
reviews.text:
Haben soeben unseren Urlaub beendet. Ich muss sagen, recht enttäuschend v.a. Hinsichtlich SERVICE. War in mehreren anderen Melia Hotels aber dieses fällt hier ab. Massenabfertigung und der Kunde ist nur zweitrangig. Check out dauerte 45 Minuten und war miserabel im Service. Freche Antworten von einem inkompetenten Mitarbeiter. Nach diesem Urlaub bin ich Platinum Member aber Gratulation an Melia. Die haben soeben einen Kunden verloren. 
Einziger Lichtblick war Pablo Machuca vom CUSTOMER Service. Er hat sich wirklich eingesetzt. Herzlichen Dank

reviews.author: agsmex2019
reviews.title: No fue lo que esperaba
reviews.text:
No hay infraestructura pensada en los niños. El
Menú está pensado en su mayoría para el turismo extranjero, la comida mexicana insípida. El personal muy atento. El hotel es demasiado grande y confuso, no es recomendable para adultos mayores porque hay que caminar mucho dentro del mismo hotel

reviews.author: umutp441
reviews.title: Insgesamt enttäuschend
reviews.text:
Von einem 5-Sterne Hotel würde ich einfach mehr erwarten. Verglichen mit den Hotels in der Türkei, die sich in dieser Preisklasse befinden, ist das Hotel unzureichend. Für Kinder gibt es eigentlich kein besonderes Angebot, weder in den Restaurants, noch im Freizeitbereich. Das Essen ist relativ eintönig. Es werden zwar 5-6 Restaurants angegeben, aber richtig zufrieden waren wir mit keinem der 3 besuchten Restaurants. Um Salz muss man kämpfen, da es für 50 Tische nur ein Satz Salz und Pfeffer gibt. Getränke werden  z.T. mit verchlortem Wasser ausgegeben. Am Pool gibt es einen Mangel an Sonnenliegen und wie erwähnt auch keinen richtigen Spielbereich für Kinder. 
Wir hatten zwei Touren gebucht und haben nach der ersten Tour festgestellt, dass das körperlich zu anstrengend für meine schwangere Frau war. Daher wollten wir die zweite Tour stornieren. Es gab keinerlei Einsicht oder Kullanz bei dem ansässigen Touranbieter im Hotel. Als wir das Hotel um Hilfe baten, wurde uns einfach nur gesagt, dass wir uns selber darum kümmern müssen. Einen riesigen Dank nochmal an die Chef-Concierge Paulina, die das alles nicht interessiert hat.
Der Strand war leider aufgrund der Algen nicht benutzbar, aber dafür kann das Hotel ja nichts. Grundsätzlich ist das Hotel nicht für deutsche Touristen ausgelegt, da anscheinend nicht viele deutsche Anbieter vorhanden sind.

reviews.author: beliiic
reviews.title: No cumplió mis expectativas por el costo
reviews.text: Teníamos habitación con vista al mar, falta de mantenimiento del balcón. Las habitaciones eran súper ruidosas, se sentía como pasaba el carrito constantemente todo el día. Jamás encontramos reposeras ni en la pileta ni en la playa, deben aumentarla! Por la cantidad de personas allí hospedadas es imposible. Jamás limpiaron la playa del sargazo, se acumuló día a día. Los restaurantes temáticos muy pobres, la verdad les falta más. No hay variedad de comidas y bebidas de México, todo muy orientado al EE. UU. Deberían incluir sus sabores locales. Los shows nocturnos muy pobres comparados con otros hoteles. Siento que pague de más y esperaba encontrarme con algo muchísimo mejor.

reviews.author: Op4
reviews.title: Decepcionado
reviews.text:
Me siento decepcionado del hotel, pues se venden como hotel de lujo, sin embargo en mi estancia de 4 noches, logre encotrar baños extremadamente sucios cada dia, No solo eso, además viejos. las puertas carcomidas.
El servicio 'Normal' aunque uno esperaria ser tratado mejor, especialmente por lo que cobra el hotel.
La 'Junior suite' en verdad que es muy pequeña. 
La comida bien.
La concierge no la volvimos a ver una vez que le aclaramos por 4ta vez que no nos interesaba comprar el tiempo compartido.
No volvemos a Melia, una pena

reviews.author: Ashley H
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun has went Downhill
reviews.text: My family has stayed at the location several times. Our last visit was very disappointing. There is no air anywhere in the building except rooms. I understand why the lobby doesn't have air, but even the restaurants were miserable. The ladies making omelettes in the mornings were sweating terribly. One of the women actually used her hand to wipe the sweat from her face and stuck her hand right into the cheese for the omelette, with no glove on. The pool tiles were falling off all over which made the pool sharp. Part of the actual swim-up bar broke off while we were there and landed on our friends sons foot. Dinner reservations were almost impossible to get and any restaurants that didn't require reservations, besides the buffet, required a lengthy wait. We booked a "luxury" room which is advertised to have turn-down service, a pillow menu, robes and slippers. None of this was actually in the room or happened. When we had finally had enough and sat down with the "manager" Margarita, she didn't care about our concerns what so ever. She was very defensive and had an excuse for everything. When I told her our room wasn't as advertised she actually argued with me that those things were not included in our room, so I pulled up the Melia website, where we booked, and showed her what was advertised, and she said well I will have to verify the website. This was their website and even after letting her know that we paid to upgrade and weren't receiving anything that was supposed to be in the upgrade, she did nothing to fix it. We were informed that there was an election going on while we were there so for two days we could only get alcoholic drinks while eating inside a restaurant, even the pool bar was closed down. This is something that should have been told to everyone when booking an ALL INCLUSIVE resort. 2 days without drinks that people already paid for is ridiculous. They weren't even serving virgin drinks or waters at the pool bar, it was completely out of commission for our last two days, which happened to be Saturday and Sunday. When we arrived in our room our fridge was broken, everything was warm and smelly, I am unsure how this wasn't noticed before our check in. No matter how many times I requested 4 towels and 4 wash cloths, we continued to get 3 towels and 2 each cloths, even with 4 guests registered to the room. Our air conditioning in our room leaked while we were sleeping and we awoke to an enormous puddle of water in front of the bathroom, that our daughter slipped and fell in, on her way to the bathroom because she didn't see that it was there. The food was only good in a couple restaurants, and the buffet was terrible. The coffee shop and gelato place is open for only a few hours a day at times that are not convenient. The App never had up to date information on it, as far as the shows/entertainment go. The snack bar outside was constantly out of wings and it was a long wait to get food. The resort has done away with bottled water. Room service now has a $5 charge. We have stayed at this location several times and other Melia resorts as well. This was by far not what we have experienced in the past. Between the bad experience and the terrible treatment from the manager, our friends, family, and I will be staying elsewhere in the future.

reviews.author: timb0b66
reviews.title: Disappointing Resort
reviews.text: This was our second stay at a Melia property, with our first visit to Nassau in The Bahamas.  The hotel in Bahamas was nice, so we decided to stay at Paradisus in Cancun.  We stayed for a week.  My son had stomach troubles on Day 3.  My wife and I developed stomach troubles on Days 5 and 6.  The food quality was bad.  The breakfast at Naos served eggs that were runny and meats that were wet.  The bacon was undercooked.  Coffee was hard to get without sitting down in the restaurant, even if you weren’t hungry.  Shower wall leaked and we had about a 1/4-inch of standing water in  our living area. Probably won’t be returning to another Melia.

reviews.author: Eddie V
reviews.title: Bad customer service and slow response!!!!
reviews.text:
They need better customer service. I had a situation with one of the employees. They moved our stuff from our chairs without permission and they lost few items that I had on top of the pool chairs. In addition, I had no electricity in our room for about 50 minutes and they took forever to visit our room to verify the issue. In addition, the AC was leaking water inside the room and for consequence was a lot humidity inside our room. I reported the issue but I was never contacted. 
I previously stayed at Paradisus Punta Caña twice and my experience they have better customer service that Paradisus Cancun. I will never go back to Paradisus Cancun. Melia just lost another customer.

reviews.author: Luis H
reviews.title: Hotel todo incluido
reviews.text: Como siempre los hoteles todo incluido cada vez son más que nos obligan a este tipo de servicio ya sea por placer o negocios tu viaje, lo que no podemos seguir soportando es el pésimo servicio que nos dan en los alimentos tipo bufete y el malinchismo en los supuestos restaurantes de especialidad que aún cuando uno sigue las políticas de reservación siempre salen con argumentos de que no hay espacio disponible y te quieren obligar a sus comidas bufete, no se diga el pésimo servicio en el tema de las bebidas alcohólicas incluidas, si bien Te va te llevan 2 en toda el día!!! Además insoportable la mala actitud de ciertos empleados como Fernanda y Christian en el restaurante de sushi ya ni hablar de las instalaciones viejas del hotel, nunca regresamos a este hotel

reviews.author: Sightseer32929156662
reviews.title: Food and service was very poor
reviews.text: If you enjoy good food and great service, then book another resort. Towards the end of our trip, our air conditioning stopped working and I requested for maintenance, but they never came. They also charge a $5 room service fee, even if you purchase the all-inclusive package. The food had no flavor and they have very limited choices. The only friendly and attentive staff we met was Martin who worked at the Market Grill. Everyone else was rude and acted like they didn't want to help you.

reviews.author: survivorfan
reviews.title: Expensive Disappointment - READ before booking
reviews.text:
UNDISCLOSED FEES, CHECK-IN & UPSELLING:  Website said all taxes included, but charged an extra $1000-ish for taxes.  Front desk only offered to 'upgrade' our view for our extra $1000. Upon arrival someone tried to upsell us for 90 minutes. 
ALL-INCLUSIVE ISSUES:  Website says room service is included with all-inclusive rate.  This is FALSE because there is a fee.  Daughter sick & they told us we could not take food to her in room. The resort had a New Years Eve Event, but were told we would have to PAY TO SIT DOWN inside the ballroom. All other bars in the resort were shut down so we had no other choice due to time. 
CHILD CARE:  Adult told 9 year old daughter she was a "stinky" child, when it was the babies with diapers that were stinky.  She had taken a shower 15 minutes before and her hair was still wet. I reported this to management and they never got back to me.
BARS:  The pool bar is decent but there are no artificial sweeteners.
POOLS:   The main pool with music & bar was frigid cold. Chairs were a challenge to find together. Other pool was meh.
RESTAURANTS:  The food was overall pretty good; Organization lacking -- bowls/spoons aren't beside soup/cereals.  No water on buffet. Not enough salt/pepper shakers.
CHECK OUT:   They would not let us take a cab of our choice to the airport, sent our cab away & made us wait for a cab from their preferred company. 
OVERALL: They nickel and dimed us even after we paid big $ for all-inclusive.

reviews.author: Navigate694440
reviews.title: Servicio decepcionante
reviews.text: Estuve 2 días alojada por asistencia a un Simposium; al final decidí permanecer 2 noches más de las cuales me arrepiento; me cambiaron de habitación a una con vista al mar; que no se ve nada porque las bardas de los balcones son muy altas; la tina de hidromasaje demasiado sucia, con restos de jabón o no se de que; la cafetera no servia y los contactos de luz infestados de hormigas. Eso si el precio como si fuese perfecto. No regreso, ni lo recomendaría. Muy mal 👎  👎

reviews.author: Meng Hsuan L
reviews.title: Not worth it
reviews.text:
First time i checked in, I spend 30 min to wait in the line, a lot of people keep cutting into the line and the staff don't care, after I reach the front desk, they said the room is not ready, it's fine I get it, so we hand out around the hotel, after, they told me I have to wait in the line again, so it took me almost 1 hr to check in to get the room key.
need to pay for a lot of things even I am all inclusive
outlet on the wall won't work
bad smell in the bathroom
poor light
So hard to log in to the wifi

reviews.author: Mark H
reviews.title: 3rd trip to Paradisus Cancún
reviews.text:
We have stayed at the Paradisus Cancún multiple times. We really enjoy the Melia resorts, they are usually a go to for our family when we want a luxurious resort. Our recent stay at the Paradisus Cancún was somewhat disappointing. We invited a family to join us on vacation. Below are some of the problems we ran into. 

1. We get here and our room accommodations were a mess. 2. We were not able to make dinner reservation 3. We had to move rooms due to bad accommodations which was frustrating because we had emailed several times in advance 4. Our fridge was not working 5. We had ants 🐜 in our room and on me when I woke up! 6. the AC was not working in the restaurants 7. The hotel is a mess where are the fish and turtles? Some parts of the hotel are in desperate need of updates 8. The pool is seriously falling apart. Tile from the pool fell on one of the kids and injured his foot. Also the pool was dirty in some areas the water didn’t appear high enough to reach the filters. Repeatedly stepped on broken tile at the pool 😡 9. They were not serving alcohol on Saturday or Sunday! 10. No turn down service that was supposed to be included, no pillow menu as advertised. 11. No room service! Without paying a fee every time you order. So much for all inclusive 😟 12. We could not take advantage of the restaurants, most of the time when we tried to make reservations they were full. 13. The app never has the right information. 14. The ocean and beach was full of seaweed. Not much the hotel can do about that but it’s annoying. 15. They don’t really have anything for kids from the ages 12-16 in the evening.

What we liked

The staff was really nice with the exception of the manager who didn’t really seem to care about our experience. The servers at the pool bar and restaurants did a great job. The grounds are beautiful. In general the hotel is clean. We like how they changed the entertainment locations to accommodate more people. The location of the resort is very convenient. A complementary bottle of champagne was sent to our room to help us celebrate our anniversary. 

In our opinion the Paradisus Cancún has lost its luxurious touch. We would suggested trying other resorts for a luxury experience.  We had a great experience at other Meliá resorts. We stayed at the Esmerelda last year and it was very nice. Also the facility in Punta Cana was very accommodating.

We would recommend checking other resorts for a luxury experience like the Palace resorts, Riu Palace, or some of the others. Spend your vacation worry free and living the good life.

reviews.author: Alejandro Guízar
reviews.title: Define "Europeo" como cero servicio a un precio excesivo.
reviews.text:
El hotel se encuentra en una etapa de remodelarse o caer, algunos de sus acabados ya se ven viejos, gastados u oxidados, los baños tienen sarro y las regaderas son todo un rompecabezas que descifrar. 
Es un hotel gigantesco con todos los servicios que uno puede esperar en un lugar así, la comida es buena y tiene gran variedad, sin embargo, si visitas el hotel en modalidad "Europea" te espera una de las peores experiencias hoteleras en general; No habrá agua potable en tu cuarto, ni un frigobar lleno al cual hacer el cargo, y no hay forma que la administración proporcione una botella de agua de cortesía bajo ninguna circunstancia, aunque el huésped esté deshidratado. El costo de un desayuno buffet en esta modalidad es de $390.00 MXN más la propina del 15% que esperan todos los meseros.
El WiFi, fue imposible de conectar con tres diferentes claves, culpando al dispositivo con el que se estaba intentando realizar la conexión, aparentemente un iPhone X es demasiado viejo para sus estándares.

reviews.author: Jose Gomez
reviews.title: Horrible food and no Entertainment!
reviews.text:
For a 5 star hotel the buffet food was horrible and the restaurant food was moderate. If you wanted good food you had to leave the hotel.

There's no Entertainment past 10pm in this hotel, which for a 5 star hotel is very bad and yet again i had to leave the hotel to for entertainment. You might say is ok but at Majestic Hotels they had live shows until 12am.

My major problem with Paradisus was the sales pitch to be a Member of Melia club, it being and absolute waste of money. Please id you go to this hotel DO NOT GET THE MELIA CLUBS IS A SCAM AND YOU WILL LOSE A LOT OF MONEY.

NOW FOR THE GOOD PART, the beach was beautiful and the pool was awesome. Lots of booze for you to drink on and the staff nationals are amazing people.

reviews.author: Larry S
reviews.title: Return to an older property
reviews.text: The Resort is old, some of the rooms have been upgraded and others have not, this was a return trip for us we have stayed here many times in the past prior to the all inclusive days. The temperature in rooms and hotel area was warm which gave the impression of air handler problems. The food at buffet was tolerable but temp control was an issue for many of the selections. The service was fantastic, the people ther are wonderful and eager to help.

reviews.author: Nick M
reviews.title: Mixed bag, overall not awesome.
reviews.text:
Mixed feelings; 

Property 4/5: Rooms are beautiful, well appointed, and modern. All rooms are junior suite or above, we had a Royal Service Lagoon facing room that was very nice. Our room was lacking a few things when we arrived (like washcloths). All the venues I was interested in (like pool bars) close very early (~6pm). Property has large pool areas. Regular pool area has private Bali beds and swim up bar. Exclusive Royal Service adults only area has the same, plus an exclusive restaurant (more to come on that)  

Food 3/5: Really  a mixed bag, breakfast at the Royal Service restaurant (La Palapa) was great, and Valeria provided great service (more to come on that) we had dinner one night at Blue Agave (Mexican food) which was awful, tacos were super greasy and too much weird cheesy sauce. We had dinner at Enso (Asian fusion) which was delicious. I ordered a red curry with Chicken instead of their menu option shrimp. Nicolas provided great service (again more to come on that). We ordered snacks from our Bali bed attendant that came from La Palapa which were pretty good. 

Service 1/5 (with some bright spots): I'll start with the negative. They have a ton of people at this resort who have their number one goal being to get you to attend one of their time share (called Club Melia) presentations. We were hassled at least twice per day by people practically begging us, and offering us huge perks "just to attend" this seminar (which was 30 or 60 or 90 minutes depending on who was trying to get you to go) PSA, time shares are almost always a rip off. Since I know these things are totally bogus, and read numerous reviews about club melia before coming. I politely declined all of the 8 times I was asked in our three night stay. Nevertheless they persisted. We had some really bright spots, Valeria at La Palapa was prompt, pleasant, and helpful. Nicolas at Enso gave us the personal attention that we really wanted, and yearned for from our extensive experience on cruise ships. Overall though, they seem understaffed compared to a ship, and everything takes longer than I've come to expect. Considering my total outlay was ~$400 per night for our room in Royal service, I did not expect the hard sell around every corner. 

Verdict 2.5/5: would I come back, not sure. Tons of money spent to attend what ended up feeling like a club melia side hustle.

reviews.author: Passport26485481318
reviews.title: Not what I anticipated
reviews.text: I thought I purchased a trip with a great room but it ended up being old outdated and just the worst. I was absolutely upset the entire time. Even worst, I found my luggage being carried into someone else's room.

reviews.author: Jet18237863072
reviews.title: Not horrible but not the best
reviews.text:
I will start by saying that the staff there is amazing. Everyone is so friendly and nice and willing to be of service to guests. I was disappointed in our room(s). Our first room was directly next to the elevators and the noise was constant and so very annoying. So upon our request we were switched to a different room however this room did not have a view of the water only of the tennis court. So again, upon request, the staff gave us a Bali bed at the family concierge pool for the week as a concession which was great. But our 2nd hotel room first we lost all electricity when I plugged in my hairdryer to blow-dry my hair. This was repaired. The next day started leaking in the bathroom from the ceiling. The leak was fixed but the bathroom really kind of smelled like sewage the rest of the week. 

I was also disappointed with the pool experience. It is near impossible to get chairs and towels poolside. You have to wake up at 6:30 in the morning on VACATION if you have any hope of getting a chair. There just aren't enough of them for the number of guests that stay at this resort. What there is enough of are bali beds for sale. I've already paid thousands of dollars for a vacation please don't nickel and dime me at the pool. I just want a chair and an umbrella so I don't get sunburned. The towels are situated at the activities desk so if when you stop by to get a towel you also get a sales pitch on different activities that you can pay for. And even after you endure the sales pitch you're not guaranteed a towel because they are always out of them. Very very frustrating. Poolside food is a little lackluster too. The grill had extremely long lines every day.

reviews.author: Ricky R
reviews.title: So many better options
reviews.text:
We really wanted to like this resort. My family and i travel to Cancun roughly 5-6 times per year, typically staying at the Finest Resort. We decided to try Paradisus for the first time in Cancun since we had been to their resort in Dominican Republic and had a great time. Big Mistake

The biggest issue with this resort is the management and the food. The food was barely edible in ALL of the restaurants. All of our meals came out cold, bland tasting and poor presentation. At the buffet, the menu barely changed from day to day. Two people from our party spent 1 full day sick & throwing up because of the food (we travel 5-6 times yearly to mexico and never have gotten sick)

Please do not ask management to do anything outside of their wheelhouse, they will look at you confused and try their best to not accommodate. 

The best part about the resort were the servers at the restaurants. Even though the food was pretty horrendous, the servers made our time worthwhile with amazing service and some good laughs. 

Rooms are ok, what you would expect from a 3 star hotel. Room service food was terrible. 

All in all, we will not be returning nor recommending this hotel. For a seasoned all inclusive traveler, this does not fit the bill.

reviews.author: Roam26357778796
reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: Rude staff, empty trays at the buffet all day long, not enough umbrellas by the pool, pool chairs not adjustable, very weak drinks, very slow service by the pool, too many disruptive events by the pool, unexpected taxes at check out, not enough mexican food choices. The only good thing was the beach. Absolutely beautiful.

reviews.author: Miriam
reviews.title: Be clear on what is included in the "all inclusive" before you commit and come prepared to spend an extra 30%
reviews.text:
Let’s start with the positives. 
1.	The hotel is very beautiful.
2.	The beach is nice and on the strip. 
3.	The service is for the most part attentive. 

The negatives.  
1.	The pressure to up-sell starts right at the door. The first question we were asked on reaching the hotel was whether we wanted to upgrade our room.  This continued throughout our stay. For an all-inclusive hotel, the included items come from a pretty short list. People want to get away form pressure sales on holiday, not have it pushed down their throats at every turn. 
2.	The room was neat and clean but the very second day of our stay the bathroom over ours leaked into our bathroom. There was water all over the floor and we had to call service late at night to fix it. 
3.	The instructions on the safe had worn down and we could not read it. It’s a $2 fix to print out new labels for the safe.
4.	The second day in our room, the card keys would not work. I thought it must have got de-magnetized and went downstairs to have it fixed. After much ado security let us in to our room. Two hours later we were again locked out. So, this time they changed the lock battery. Next morning, we tried to use the door, we were again locked out, so they changed the lock itself. It must have been a total of 2-3 hours wasted because the room locks don’t work, to say nothing of the inconvenience and irritation.  Irritation that was exacerbated by the fact that there is only one elevator for an entire wing of 8 floors, so it takes considerable time to go up and down to reception.
5.	There is a shortage of chairs by the pool. To get one of the “Tahiti beds” you have to pay extra – again this perk is “not included”. Since there are not enough chairs for the number of people requiring them, the only way to get one is to reach the pool area before 7 in the morning. 
6.	The food was unimaginative.  My daughter thought that Costco frozen entrees were quite comparable. We had a couple of dinners at the reservations only restaurants, for the most part it was the same food as the main restaurants but served in smaller and prettier plates. The wine served alongside was truly appalling.  Of course, it goes without saying that not all the restaurants are included in the all-inclusive price.
7.	The alcoholic drinks do not have alcohol in them. At least nothing that can be detected by anything short of a sensitive laboratory test.  As the cocktails were basically flavored sugar water, I asked for a glass of wine. That turned out to be a mistake. If you want a decent glass of wine, you have to – yes guess what - pay extra! Here’s an idea for management … LIMIT the number of alcoholic drinks served but actually serve decent ones instead?
8.	 My daughter ordered a snack at the taco restaurant. They bought half the order and forgot the other half. When she reminded them, they asked her if she still needed it!  
9.	The computer printers in the business center didn’t work. I couldn’t print out my boarding passes and there was no one to help.
10.	There were never any life guards on the beach though there is a life guard platform, I never saw anyone there. 
11. They provide you a bunch of coupons when you arrive which allows you to discount $10 off some extra service that is already three times the cost you would normally  expect to pay. And you can only use one coupon at a time.  More high pressure selling. 

My guess is that this hotel is either  managed by a sales guy rather than  a customer satisfaction guy, or that the sales team has a disproportionate say in the way that the hotel provides services.It leaves the customer stressed out.

reviews.author: SpreadSparkle
reviews.title: Not up to expectations this trip :(
reviews.text: We have stayed with Paradisus 4 times now.  The first 3 times we had Royal Service, which is amazing.  This time, it was not available so at the time of check in we asked if by chance it was - they said it was and upgraded us for a fee.  However, they said the rooms were not available in that area, so we would still be in the main building which we thought was fine.  First of all with Royal Service, the check in is so quick and easy in the past.  This trip, after a long day of travel we stood in the check in line for 1.5 hours!  It was CRAZY!  The desk clerks were not friendly as they usually have been in the past either.  That aside, we were still excited to get settled in our room.  We had booked an ocean view junior suite.  We walked in to look out to a large roof with very loud air conditioner and the sound of clanking plates and dishes (we were right above a restaurant).  The worst part is our king sized bed - it was slid up against a wall with no access on one side.  I have NEVER seen that.  We both had been sick and this was not going to do as we needed easy access to the restroom in the night.  We visited the front desk and stood in line again to be told nothing was available, but tomorrow at noon they could move us.  The next day at noon we stepped into the office and were told AGAIN nothing was available, no notes on our account.  Very unhappy at this time, but just went to the beach and ignored it for now.  The 3rd day was a little rainy so we had time to visit the front desk again - this time to be told they had a room but only 2 double beds, nothing else.  So needless to say, we had had a few bad nights of climbing over each other to get up in the night, we took the double beds.  At least we now had an unobstructed ocean view that we paid for. Disappointed as all other 8 travelers that were with us had beautiful LARGE rooms with an extra sitting area and they all booked and paid for less than we did.  On another note:  The dinners:  We had to call every day to book a reservation for dinner.  Only ONE night were they able to accommodate a dinner time for us, everything else was booked.  We were only able to eat at one reserved restaurant and the other nights had to go to the buffet, which was very disappointing. DO NOT book Paradisus unless it is Royal Service - it is definitely worth it.  We were so disappointed in the treatment/dinner reservations and our room this trip.

reviews.author: Manuel M
reviews.title: Pésimo servicio
reviews.text: Pésimo servicio al cliente, sobre todo si es all inclusive y comprado con Expedia, pareciera que tienen consigna a darte la habitación mas fea o darte el peor servicio, si no les gusta el all inclusive no lo ofrezcan, pero si ya se pago den un servicio mejor.

reviews.author: Richnyc
reviews.title: Run down
reviews.text: Their receptionists and management are not welcoming - they make you feel like simply a number. The workers at the pool and restaurants are hard-working but you get the sense they don't get treated well by management. Our rooms on the lagoon  facing side were run down and old. At night, the shows are so loud that you feel like you are trying to sleep inside a night club. More than half the resturants on our last night there - a Wednesday- were closed. They make getting restaurant reservations really hard unless you pay extra $$ for their royal or family services. I don't know if other all-inclusive are similar but I would stay away from Paradisus unless you want to feel like a 2nd class citizen in your vacation.

reviews.author: MG4489
reviews.title: Average
reviews.text:
Check in is a disaster. Waited 45 mins for this and was told to go and speak to the concierge for further details. The concierge redirected us to the luggage man who was probably the most helpful staff member throughout this process but had basic knowledge on what was included/ not. 

Rooms are very outdated 

Food is average but what is to be expected for mass produced meals 

Everyone appears to shot gun all the loungers so effectively little space to sunbathe 

Th activities are actually very good (but no one tells you about these) and the majority are complimentary 

The staff inside the restaurants are very pleasant but i will not be coming back here and thought it was overpriced for Mexico which is a very beautiful and pleasant country if you leave the resort

reviews.author: E-Rick
reviews.title: Very disappinted in Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: We went over Christmas vacation a few weeks ago and had a very bad experience from check-in issues to bad food and service.  We have been to several other resorts - Paradisus and others and this was the worst overall experience we have had.  In short, we did the all inclusive and the food was poor - cold and just bad in most places.  Had a few good meals, the outdoor pool bar was probably the best aside from NAOS.  Didn't find the staff overly attentive or pleasant to deal with.  There were not many activities being run during the week.  Got in to arguments with 2 different workers at restaurants.  Had issues with rooms, tennis equipment old and broken.  We are club melia and had family concierge and had issues on what was included with what.  We spoke to someone mid-week about everything going on and never was contacted by a manager or anyone else to discuss.  Honestly, after 2 days we were considering leaving to go home or find another resort but decided to just deal with it.  I could probably keep going but I think you can get the gist from here.  We have been to the carribean several times and at other Paradisus resorts and had extremely good experiences.  Maybe it was just an off week but I don't think so. We were told that melia bought this hotel 4 years ago and has been working on transitioning to Paradisus - doesn't seem like they did any work/improvements and can't understand why it would take so long to get things up to speed.  Just seems mis-managed and there are probably plenty of other resorts in Cancun that are better.

reviews.author: You Call It Love
reviews.title: 음식맛이 형편 없습니다.
reviews.text: 직원들은 친절하고 유아를 위한 프로그램과 호텔 시설, 환경은 좋습니다. 다만 올인클루시브지만 먹을수 있는 음식이 거의 없습니다. 6일내내 시리얼, 우유, 오믈렛, 과일만 먹고 왔습니다. LA, 라스베가스, 올랜도, 마이애미, 샌프란시스코, 칸쿤 일정으로 여행을 했는데 미국에서는 음식에 대한 불만이 하나도 없었으나, 파라디수스는 음식때문에 다시는 방문하지 않을것 같습니다. 웨스턴, 멕시칸, 일식, 중식, 동남아 음식, 한식 등등 왠만한 음식은 가리지 않고 잘 먹습니다. 그런데 여기 음식은 전혀 못먹겠더라구요. 호텔을 나와서 칸쿤 공항에서 파는 음식은 정말 맛있었습니다. 그만큼 호텔 음식이 형편 없습니다. 예를 들어 오리엔탈 퓨전 음식중 '팟타이'는 생김새 뿐만아니라 맛까지도 전혀 팟타이와는 다릅니다. 음식이 개선되지 않는한 다시는 이 호텔을 방문할 생각이 없습니다.또한 에어컨에서 곰팡이 냄새가 납니다. 습한환경이어서 그런것도 있겠지만 좀더 적극적인 에어컨 관리가 필요합니다.

reviews.author: Rob Bravo
reviews.title: Untrained Unprofessional staff. Beautiful Hotel
reviews.text:
We stayed there from December 22-26. Group of 9 with 4 adults 5 kids. Booked via Melia. Got the upgraded family concierge rooms. With this you get a butler who is supposed to help you out through out the stay. The reason I am giving 2 stars is for unprofessional service and limited food choices. First for the unprofessional service.

The day we got their we informed the butler we would be celebrating a birthday for my son and requested the cake on 24. She said it was all taken care of . On Dec 24 I reminded her 4 times to make sure the cake was available after dinner. At the time of dinner the hostess refused to seat us telling us that the butler did not reserve the table for 9 of us , she only reserved space for 6. After 30 minutes of explaining she said" She will oblige us with a table" . Once the dinner was done, we asked for the cake. There was no cake, the butler forgot to put the order. While trying to the hostess to figure out what happened , She told us to leave the table asap and waled out of the room because we were wasting her time and she had other guests waiting to be seated on that table. We walked out and asked for the manager. A guy showed up after 1 hour at family concierge and said all he could do was send the cake to room now ( this is around 10 pm). We agreed to get the cake. At 12 midnight there was no cake in sight. We called again and the cake arrived at 1 am when every one except 2 of the adults were fast asleep.
Next day after complaining, we realized the staff is unapologetic and offered us massage for 4 adults for all the troubles the staff had caused. Which we accepted.

Now for the food: Choice for vegetarian foods was extremely limited. After we ordered food most of the time half of the food would not arrive because the server forgot the order. All in all I would never go back to this hotel.

reviews.author: Passenger45339050364
reviews.title: Sub-par all-inclusive experience
reviews.text: Half the restaurants were reservation only. So for a 3-day stay you only get to experience those restaurants once. If theres a big party then your time will get pushed. Elevators took forever so everyone took the stairs the entire time.Alcoholic beverages were watered down. We tried different and they were all the same. Directions were poor so we got lost a few times. There are no clear signs and nothing seems to be connected.Check-in experience was bad. For a trip that was pre-paid, the need to bring the same credit card was an inconvenience. So I had to charge the entire stay to another cc since I didn't bring the one I paid with. Had I left all my cc at home I wouldve been out of luck.The gym was pretty good. I enjoyed the beach! Very clean. However, the beach chairs didnt recline all the way.The rooms were nice and comfortable.

reviews.author: Roving34960023420
reviews.title: Mediocre vacation in an overpriced resort
reviews.text: The resort itself is nice and we would give it a 4 stare. Landscape is beautiful and neat. The rest of the resort lacks and need much improvement. The food variety and quality is poor, some staff is makes rude comments around none Spanish speaking guests, rooms have awful smell in bathroom because they are old they said. The baby club is horrible and staff gives inaccurate feedback on children. If you have kids we not recommend to families but it seemed if you were there without toddlers/young children it was a better overall experience.

reviews.author: Ana A
reviews.title: Do not stop taking a look!!
reviews.text: We are partners for six years it took us a long time to decide to buy something that offered us a special vacation ... During this time everything went well but on this vacation we found that everything has gone up and that the administration wants to charge for everything. Use of Polynesia 54 dollars, room service 8 dollars. That perhaps we do not pay a very expensive maintenance, it is crazy to get to pay this kind of thing, they have to stop this unnecessary and excessive collection. They really are good do not spoil it

reviews.author: Carlos A
reviews.title: Malos alimentos y filas para todo
reviews.text: Mala variedad y calidad de alimentos. Filas para todo, camastros insuficientes y muchas camas balinesas de cobro (186 usd). Bebidas regulares. No hay lugar nunca para reservar para cenar en restaurantes de menú

reviews.author: Po Fu C
reviews.title: Family Concierge Not Worth It
reviews.text:
Booked a family concierge junior suite for 4; me, my wife, and 2 kids ages 4 and 8.  Booking was made over 8 months ago, and the reason I opted for the upgrade to family concierge is advance dinner reservation by the assigned butler.  As any parent can attest, it is hard to keep the kids occupied if you had to wait an hour in line for a table.

During check-in today, I was advised that the advance dinner reservation service has been discontinued, and I must wait in line for a table even with family concierge.  I was not informed of this change in advance or offered an opportunity to cancel my reservation (which I would), nor was I offered any upgrade or price adjustment to reflect the diminished level of service.  I was assured that the wait for a table at any restaurant would not exceed 20 minutes, lo-and-behold every restaurant has a 45 to 60 minute wait around our normal dinner time of 7:30 p.m.  In short, I paid for premium but received just regular level of service, which made the extra charge for Family Concierge a complete waste of money.

It is a shame that the management at Paradisus Cancun would just arbitrarily alter its service agreement without concern for its guests’ interest.  The employees are friendly and the resort is actually quite nice, but this is definitely not a property I would come back or recommend to anyone.

reviews.author: EZ_Pickins
reviews.title: Big Changes, Big Disapouintment
reviews.text:
Resort: We were here at Paradisus in February and noticed a big change. We checked in at the Family Concierge lounge which was quick and efficient. We were introduced to our butler who gave us a brief  description of the hotel and the benefits of the Family Concierge level. We were not given any informational pamphlets of the resort as we had on our first visit. We had to go back to the lounge and ask for the information about restaurants and entertainment at which time they printed out a single sheet with that information. The grounds are still beautiful, and well maintained. We spent our days at the beach. The music at the main pool was too loud for our taste. 

Accommodations: We had booked a Family Concierge Junior Suite Ocean View. Our room was in building three on the first floor. The room was overlooking the pool but still had a good view of the ocean.. The room was a good size, clean and the bed was comfortable. There was the same problem with wash cloths this trip. The bathroom was stocked with four face cloths when we arrived but were not replaced when used. Bath towels were replaced. We called our butler the second day to get additional wash cloths and he did deliver them promptly. Housekeeping stopped by the room in the evening for turn down service and we would ask for more then. Sometimes they had them, more often not. When we arrived we found that the circuit breaker for the bathroom outlet was tripped and had to call for maintenance. The shower drained very slowly to the point that it overflowed into the bathroom. A call to maintenance did little to help the problem.

Food: Disappointing. The Fuego and Naos restaurants were closed. We ate breakfast and lunch at the Enzo buffet, Bana and Market Place. Dinner twice at Market Place where one night was good and the second was not. (Salad was lettuce and dressing, nothing else)  Dinner buffet at Enzo was just ok. There was not the selection or quality of food at any of the restaurants that we had experienced at Naos.

Staff: The staff is exceptionally nice and helpful. You are greeted by every staff person you meet in the resort with a smile and a happy greeting The service was great at the restaurants and the beach. A special thank you to Ignacio Vazqez at the Market Grill restaurant. He remembered us from our visit there in February and as before provided exceptional service.

The Paradisus Cancun resort is a beautiful resort only minutes from the airport. The staff is friendly and attentive but due to the problems with the room and the disappointing dining we will not be coming back to this resort

reviews.author: SkillCan
reviews.title: Disappointing Experience!
reviews.text:
Been going to Mexico all inclusive resorts annually for the last 10 years.
Hotel - is a nice looking hotel.
Rooms - basic and smaller than other resorts. No liquor in room. Basic fridge drinks and beer.

Food - 3 restaurants closed....as a result, there were bottlenecks and lineups. Why would you close 3 restaurants at the same time? Waits were at least an hour. And this was low season. They give you a time but still wait was longer than that.
Food quality was poor except the Royal Service restaurant. Food is important and I have to say the worst of all the other all inclusive experiences we have had. Pic of fish and chips attached - pretty sad!

Ice cream and coffee place - open few hours in the afternoon, and closed during  mornings and evenings. We found this bizarre as the resorts we have been to were open all day long till late night.

Royal Service - don't get it if you have kids. Kids are not allowed in Royal Service restaurant and pool.
Service was inefficient, long and by the time you received the beer / drinks, they were warm. Staff not attentive and hygiene wasn't great either. 

Definitely won't be back and same for our friends.

reviews.author: Cbraegger328
reviews.title: Rather disappointing...
reviews.text: First off, the people were great.  Everyone we came in contact with at the resort was pleasent ( minus the pushy time share guy) . The rooms were nice, updated great amenities. There were 3 restaurants closed the entire time we were there. The food was sub par, nothing great at all and the selection minimal. Most everything was buffet style, not to mention i askes for more guacamole from one server and qtches him bring me some from an empty table that someone hsd just got done with.  The pool closes at 7 pm every night and there is very minimal activity to do at night at the resort. I would not book here again.

reviews.author: M.G
reviews.title: Expensive for nothing
reviews.text:
I don’t recommend it at all, it’s not worth it to go this resort, you can go another one and pay less and enjoy more, the pool there is disgusting, I had a white swimsuit turned up to green, we found food people threw it in the pool , food is same every day NO SEAFOOD at all repeatedly items every day, location is very good close to shopping centre and this s the only thing we enjoyed it
Beach is amazing but all the resorts on the same line have amazing beach, so it’s better to choose another place in ZONA HOTELERA , you will get good location and great beach, but don’t pay at this resort

reviews.author: Tracy T
reviews.title: Bait and switch
reviews.text: We arrived 10/30 with hopes of getting an ocean view family suit instead of the lagoon view. When we purchased our hotel deal, the lagoon and ocean view were the same price, but the ocean view rooms were all sold out so we had to book a lagoon view instead. Our travel agent had spoke to Melia reps multi times, up until the day we checked it to see if we could get an icean view room. Of course when we checked in, there was an ocean view room available for $100 extra a night. After talking to the check in people who then spoke to the manager Leslie Galindo, it was down to $80 a night, then $60 a night. What a rip off!!! After waiting an hour of my vacation trying to plead with these people, I gave up. Our travel agent also spoke with Leslie Galindo and was given the same BS about paying $60 extra a night. I’m so surprised a hotel would not upgrade people to ensure there stay is amazing!!!! This is our second time staying at a Melia owned restore and it will def be our last!!!

reviews.author: BoardingPass776945
reviews.title: Beautiful resort but not worth it
reviews.text: Resort was beautiful and very clean. Pools were great and beach was gorgeous Stayed in royal service did not feel it was worth the extra money. Service was pretty terrible and food was awful. My husband eats anything and he even complained about the food. Our room wasn’t cleaned for 2 days after we asked numerous times for it to be cleaned. The staff members by the pool were very attentive but anywhere else good luck. Very rude and couldn’t be bothered. Also, felt like we were trying to be sold on everything. The minute you check in someone approaches you about attending a 90minute presentation to buy into a timeshare and they don’t take no for an answer. Needless to say we won’t be coming back.

reviews.author: Al d
reviews.title: Decepción
reviews.text: Llevo esperando 2 semanas mi factura y nada, hablo y me dejan colgado en el teléfono, incluso por enésima vez mande mi datos fiscales y nada. La supervisora de turno Guadalupe Rodriguez me la prometió y nada, el director de room division Abraham Franco me mandó un correo vacío y siguen sin contestarme, al igual que en contabilidad con Eliana Suastegui nadie me da respuestas. Mi cuarto 4202 al llover se le metió el agua, quieres reservar en los restaurantes y están llenos, y en mi estancia solo abrían 2 por noche, la mayoría de las noches tuve que cenar en el bufete. Ya no es lo mismo que cuando era Gran Meliá hace 8-10 años. Mil veces prefiero Le Blanc o Gran Velas, gran decepción. Seguiré esperando mi factura eternamente. Ah y te quieren forzosamente meter caballo para los tiempos compartidos desde que haces check in.

reviews.author: PricklyPear18
reviews.title: Just OK
reviews.text:
We just returned from 5 nights at the Paradisus where we were part of a wedding party.  We've been to a number of all-inclusive resorts in several different places in Mexico and found the Paradisus to be underwhelming.  

Check-in unfortunately includes a sales pitch for a "club" membership (don't call it a timeshare, they'll correct you endlessly).  Almost every member of our party was told that their room wouldn't be ready for 20 mins at check-in and given various degrees of pressure to purchase a "club" membership.  Magically, as soon as the sales people gave up, the rooms were ready every time.  This is not how I wanted to start my vacation.

We stayed in a lagoon view room and it was fine.  The room itself was quite.  As it was low season I can't be sure if there were people in the rooms around us but I'm a fairly light sleeper and wasn't woken up once.  The bed was OK but the pillows definitely needed to be replaced.  The elevator by our room was broken during our entire stay which was a little inconvenient.  

The highlight of our stay was the service.  Every single person we interacted with was kind and generous.  People really went above and beyond consistently (this was also true of the servers at the wedding who were particularly amazing). We had several members that went the Royal Service route and the butlers were great.  The staff is 5 star all of the way.

The beach is also very nice but the ocean was very rough every day we were there and was technically "closed."  We still swam briefly but this location is better suited to sitting out than swimming.  We had no problems getting chairs on the beach or by the pool but I could see it being difficult in high season.

The lowlight would be the food.  At check-in we were given a list of all of the restaurants   and their hours of operation.  This turned out to be consistently wrong.  We tried to go to Blue Agave numerous times during our stay but only found it to be open one time.  The same was true for the sit down restaurants.  We would try to make reservations only to be told that the restaurant wasn't open that night, the next night, etc.  Look, I get it's low season and that could cause you to reduce operating hours but there's no reason you can't update the sheet so we know what our options are instead of wasting time trying to figure it out.  Additionally, the sit down restaurants took very few reservations.  The couple of times we succeeded in making a reservation, the place was more than half empty but they were turning down additional reservations.  We also consistently struggled to get reservations for larger parties.  The two times we were successful, the restaurants insisted that we do family style and made the food selections for us.  We were told that they would bring everything out but this didn't end up being the case and I was disappointed that we didn't get to try some things.  The food at Blue Agave and the sit down restaurants were pretty good but the buffet was bad.  

Overall, for the price there's better to be had.

reviews.author: jaxmaxdad
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun gives the Melia group a bad name!
reviews.text:
Our family of 10 stayed in Club Melia for a full week. Our same group had previously stayed at The Level at Melia Caribe Tropical in the Dominican Republic (see that review in my profile Aug. 2016). This time we had a completely different experience and will not go back!  

Our Hostess Claudia should not be trusted to make any arrangements for you.  On more than one occasion she told us she had made us dinner reservations only to find out when we arrived at the reception desk that they were not aware of our reservation!  One time we had to settle on going to the buffett. The second time we experienced this after questioning Claudia and her telling us it was a misunderstanding an apologised to us we inquired further.  We were told she does this regularly?? This is mind blowing and I really did not want to believe it but it was true.  

Food was ok, Rooms were ok, Staff were ok just not the same mindset from the resort staff as our previous Melia experience. My sister received a written apology  from  Melia.

reviews.author: Camila N
reviews.title: Sumiço de objetos...
reviews.text:
Ficamos hospedados no local entre os dias 8 e 13 de agosto, suite 4304. O hotel possui uma estrutura impressionante e fomos atraídos pela propaganda de hotéis “de luxo” de Cancun. Pois bem, na chegada fomos recepcionados por uma das atendentes que nos explicou os serviços disponíveis. Fomos acomodados no quarto e já saímos para aproveitar a piscina. Para o nosso desapontamento, os bangalôs das piscinas são pagos por dia ($130) e passam a maior parte do tempo vazios. Com isso, as espreguiçadeiras do local ficam entupidas de gente, e que reservam com toalhas assim que amanhece. A estrutura para almoço é razoável, conta com bem menos opções de restaurante do que na janta. O jantar é atendido por alguns restaurantes mas precisam de reserva de pelo menos 24 horas de antecedência, mesmo assim, em um dos dias que reservamos um dos restaurantes, fomos surpreendidos com a informação de que a reserva não existia. Por sorte conseguimos ser atendido em outro restaurante do local.
O local é bem bonito. A estrutura do hotel impressiona, um dos maiores da rede hoteleira. Mas muita estrutura é velha. Banheiros com limo, torneiras soltas, elevador muito mal cuidado (mal cheiro), alguns dos restaurantes estavam em reforma. 
Mas até aí , tudo bem. O descontentamento foi absurdo quando me dei conta que a minha almofada de pescoço de viagem simplesmente desapareceu do quarto. Liguei na recepção perguntando por uma possível “perda” de objeto, mas sem sucesso. Além disso, o meu cabo de carregador de celular foi trocado !!!! Eu tinha um cabo de iPhone novinho e apareceu um cabo todo estourado no lugar, fios aparentes. Extremamente desanimador você confiar suas férias em um local que não podemos deixar nem um carregador de celular fora do cofre! Cuidado!

reviews.author: wanderlusting2008
reviews.title: Would not waste my time
reviews.text: The food here is HORRIBLE!!!! I mean disgusting!!! not even edible. The rooms were just ok.  You could tell that some of the repairs to the room were cheaply and carelessly done. The resort itself was nice.  Would not recommend anyone stay here unless you like wasting money

reviews.author: Global638449
reviews.title: Poor quality food!
reviews.text: I recommend to not do all exclusive unless you upgrade to royal service. It's cheaper if you dine out. Everything else was fine. But tours outside of hotels, they charge you more.The beach and pool were nice

reviews.author: kajol
reviews.title: Never ever again !!!
reviews.text:
Being vegetarian food is a big struggle.
Very few people understand or speak English not only that when we spok in Spanish help with google translator still could not get through to them.
Very bias attitude all around if your are not Spanish you don’t get service.
Very loud music starts from 10 am to 8pm so please don’t get sea view rooms.after bringing to management attention nothing changed.
Very rude and argumentative staff in bento restaurants .
Breakfast and lunch buffet is rapetative same food every day and very little selection of vegetarian option. Vegetarian food together with non- vegetarian dishes.
Poor presentation of food. Staff are very intimidating.
Good service provided by Enzo resturrent and mole with excellent food.
Room concierge service is superb.
When these issues brought to attention of manager through concierge manager as he was too busy to talk he offered certificate to stay free night. Which is a joke as I made it clear that we can not wait to leave from here and not coming back.
If you love your drink and pool side food then this place will suit you.

reviews.author: Thaise Z
reviews.title: Avaliação
reviews.text: Hotel com uma infraestrutura impecável, mas atendimento/ alimentação e bebidas com muita diferença entre os tipos de acomodações (pulseira preta e dourada), funcionários só atendem bem se receberem proprina

reviews.author: Jane A
reviews.title: Go Elsewhere
reviews.text:
We just checked in today, and we are desperately trying to transfer hotels. From first impressions, the interior is lovely. The hanging vines are a nice accent, and the beachfront is beautiful. 

The check-in process itself was fine. We waited online for a bit, and then went up to the rooms. The arrangement of the rooms is very spread out, but if your room is closer to the elevator, it's not bad. The two rooms we have both smell of chemicals. One room only slightly, the other is unbearable. I can't tell if it is paint, or insecticide, but it's impossible to occupy the room. 

The hotel staff has tried to be accommodating, but it seems futile. Edgar was very understanding, and took us to several rooms, but we still haven't been able to find two adequate rooms on the same floor. While we were spending over an hour at the check-in we overheard another guest complaining about the bathroom in his room. Our friends recommended this place, but we wish we had stayed at the Hyatt Ziva instead of Paradisus. 

After looking into the other disappointed reviews on here, and I'm so upset that it's exactly the same experience for us. From what I can tell, I think that it really depends on where you are put in the hotel. Maybe if you call ahead, and book a room that does not smell, is not by loud construction, or super far from the lobby/concierge/restaurants/pool, then it can be fine.

reviews.author: Tutti T
reviews.title: Old room with many issues
reviews.text: Our room was very old and dirty. There were issues from the moment we checked in. We were entitled to an upgrade, which we didn’t get because they claimed rooms weren’t available. I looked on their own app and plenty of rooms were available for the duration of our stay. The AC failed. There was a hole in the bathroom. The curtains had mold. The toilet seat was disgusting. Oh, and then the ceiling started to fall apart. Things were not addressed until our last day there. It was too late at this point. The staff was nice though and food selection was OK. They need to clean the moss off the walls by the pool. It was gross.

reviews.author: Yaquelin
reviews.title: Bad Experience
reviews.text: The hotel didn’t meet my expectations. The bed and pillows very uncomfortable. The check in process extremely slow and lack professionalism. We reported a cockroach in our room and they changed room without offering something else as courtesy. The only thing good at the hotel was excellent service provided by staff at the Naos international buffet from Christian and Florencio , oustanding service, thank you

reviews.author: Aline C
reviews.title: Not a happy experience
reviews.text: I am here and constantly irritated at this resort. Ever since we got here it’s being upsetting as only to check in we were waiting in line about 15 minutes. Every single time I come to the reception for anything it takes a long time to even be helped. I try to change dólares to pesos and every time they don’t have it and ask me to come back later, but the other side of the resort has them... when I go to the other side to change money then I need to take my passport or a copy because the two sides apparently don’t communicate. The room gets hot in the middle of the night and the AC can’t keep up. I swear at night and I have complained multiple times and nothing gets done. One time someone came over and re set the thermostat system and then the other times I complained nobody even came or followed up with me. The beds are comfortable and they did upgrade us to a bigger room since it was 3 adults and 1 child, but now every time I am asking for something or not satisfied with something they make sure to mention to me we were upgraded out of the goodness of their heart, as if I should be grateful and quiet. They did try very very hard to pressure us to pay $500 for the upgrade and I told the we had already spent so much money and I just couldn’t. Let me tell you that I spent over 3000 dólares in airfare and hotel for me and my 5 year old son for 6 nights, then we added my brother who met us here from Brazil for $142 a night and also we added my boyfriend for 2 nights for another $142 a night. We get here and everything is either for “Royal” or “family concierge”. Basically we are not paying enough to get the vest service you know. We go to the bar at the pool first night and it was 6pm. The bartender tell us he is only serving “royal” at that time. I was very upset because basically he was telling me I was not paying enough at an all inclusive resort to get a drink at the pool. Now I know also that the bars at the pools close at 5pm which is absurd to me. The beach is full of sargassum a type of nasty algae and just not good at all, but even if it was, they offer a special area for people with family concierge upgrade with lots of comfortable. For the regular folks only some not so comfortable metal chairs and tables and umbrellas. Also not many chairs, umbrellas and tables at the beach or pool. I asked for reservations at the 4 restaurants allowed to us regular folks with no upgrade. I received only 2 reservations. I was upset because my boyfriend was only staying two nights and I really wanted him to try one of the restaurants. I complained but nothing was done except the next day I received one new restaurant confirmation, however we left the room for the pool at 3:30pm not returning until 6pm. The reservation was put under my door for 6pm. Like really? The buffets have some good food and it tastes very good, however there isn’t much variety from day to day  so it’s the same stuff you are eating unless you are blessed to get reservations at the restaurants. A lot of people say on the reviews they experienced some amazing service here. A lot of people are very polite and friendly but a lot of them are also not trained well and don’t know correct information to give. I was told when we got here that they didn’t offer any beach umbrellas or chairs unless we upgraded. I was furious and then the guy asked around and informed me that they do offer that service. The reception has this very very strong soapy smell which gives me a headache every time since I always have to wait for help there. All in all I am just not happy because I spent way too much money to be served like this.

reviews.author: Yaoob J
reviews.title: We Chose Wrong
reviews.text:
Maybe we were unlucky, or maybe we had higher hopes than most. I will give you a summary of our experience first and if you wish to read onto details, please do. I do recommend researching other hotels before booking here. 

Summary of the Good:
Nice pools
Exceptionally Nice Staff
HydroTherapy was cool
Cleanliness

Summary of the Bad:
Fake Alcohol
Bad Food
Unswimmable Ocean Beachside
Fiance was Drugged!

Details:
My fiance and I booked an all inclusive here for 5 days based on previous reviews and had really high hopes here. After check-in, we were greeted by a staff member who will pitch you discounts and deals upon your stay IF you agree to attend a 90 minute breakfast and presentation the following morning. The deals looked appealing so we did that. We met the following morning with the hotel/ Melia representative, had breakfast, and listened to her pitch. Basically, they ask you to invest $30,000 USD and receive 50 years of hotel exclusives all around the world that Melia caters to. We politely declined as we planned to because..... $30,000 are you kidding me?!?! We still received the discounts and freebies. 
The room was nice, although it took a good 5 minutes to walk to the lobby and restaurants everyday. The plus side is that our room was close to the adults only pool. The pools were clean with friendly staff offering you anything you wanted (food, drink, towels, etc). We wanted an all inclusive because we expected to drink a lot. After my first scotch, I noticed something wrong. It wasn't real Johnnie Walker Black Label (which I adore). I tried a Jack Daniels on the rocks... Still not what I expected. After the first two days I stopped drinking completely because I knew the alcohol was tainted with water or something else. On this topic, my fiance can drink me under the table and after only three drinks the entire evening, she had to go to the room and vomit. She was vomiting for a good half hour before she blacked out and I had to carry her to the bed. I was dumping water down her throat all night trying to get her to drink. She couldn't even move and I was to the point of calling an un-trusted doctor until she broke through. The following day was lost. We stayed in the room all day as I took care of her. Making sure she drank a lot of water and pepto throughout the day. She told me she almost felt like dying. Recent reports of people blacking out in Cancun due to the same thing serviced yesterday as I type this, some even dying due to drugged or tainted drinks. Reading this made me sick to my stomach.

There are about 9 or so restaurants in the hotel. We tried about 5 of them throughout our stay. One of them is not included in our package and requires a $200 USD per person fee (no thanks). All of the food we tried was terrible and tasted the same in every restaurant as if there was one kitchen for every restaurant. Sushi had a drop of fish in a mountain of rice and the chicken was rubbery. Our last night we decided to go to Rosa Negra across the street and pay for good food. Thank God we did that!

We wanted to swim in the ocean, however we couldn't. There were vast amounts of seaweed all over. Some resorts we were told clean the seaweed; Paradisus does not. The beach is un swimmable, but the sand is nice to lay out in if you're about 40 yards back from the shoreline filled with seaweed.

I will say throughout our whole stay, the staff was the best part of the trip. They really are hard workers and were so nice to us. I definitely tipped them everyday until I was broke. 
Some bad weather forced us indoors were we tried out the HydroTherapy included in our package. Sauna and steam room felt great for detoxing the terrible food and drinks we had. Giant whirlpool was extremely relaxing as well.

In the end, we were two youngsters wanting ocean, good drinks, and good food. We received none of that here. However, I did give my girl a ring during this trip so this place is somewhat special to us. A place we will travel to never again.

reviews.author: Joseph M
reviews.title: My 40th birthday
reviews.text:
This trip was my gift from my girlfriend for my 40th which is today as I type this and our 2nd day here on property. My gf's work associate has a time share with club Melia vacation which he pays good money for. He offered it to her to help her with this trip. He told us what to do and where to eat at the places he likes to go. He also told us that if we wanted to, there is a pay per day option for all inclusive.

When we arrived yesterday at check in we were hit with sort of a mental brick wall. According to the bellman and check in desks our bracelets we get for Club Melia are pretty much worthless and get us nothing but property access. Which I'm ok with but that also meant, according to them, NO RESTAURANTS OR BARS would accept us because they dont take money. The only thing we had as options were the McDonalds across the street,(yes you heard me correctly and I took that as an insult) Buffet or two on site restaurants that were basically $100 per person each dine. Or......We can pay the $100 per person, per day for all inclusive with a minimum of 3 days($600.) 

Now we dont have much money. My gf took this vacation to help her with her budget. It's not really even about the money to be honest. It's the fact its pressured upon us to do this just to enjoy ourselves. Not being able to pay a bar for a drink or two or go eat on the resort paying for a meal without having to do it in a packaged bundle is kind of ridiculous. 

Not to mention as I sit here and type this my drain in the bathroom is being snaked because while my gf tried to wash out the tub to draw a bath the drain next to it started overflowing with water all over the bathroom floor. Coupled that with the flying ants that are everywhere in that bathroom this hasn't been the best start to a 40th birthday. 

I came here for a getaway from any issues and stress. So far only Pasqual at the buffet has been the most helpful and the most sincere on this trip. I feel like the staff here at check in were very misleading and are trying to get more money from us. Asking around and talking to other guests we've come to know that there are places we can go eat and drink that accept cash/credit cards. The all inclusive shakedown was a ploy to get more money from us.

The thing they dont realize is that I work in the Hotel Industry. I've been in the Hospitality business for almost 15 years. I know service. I know what to expect from service too. So far in 2 days we were hit with 2 people who gave us false information and our room I feel like was known to have these issues but was given to us because we didnt take the all inclusive package. This section of the 2nd pyramid (there's 5 total I believe) looks worn down.

I'm hoping the next 4 days here go a little smoother with less water on our floor and with actual service without false information. As of now I wouldnt recommend this property unless you have the money to get all inclusive or Royal Service. In my opinion a hotel stay or EXPERIENCE shouldn't depend on the color bracelet you have.

reviews.author: Maureen V
reviews.title: Underwhelmed.
reviews.text:
The hotel decor was beautiful in the main area.  However, there were a lot of hazards walking around, i.e., slippery floors, no handrails, dark hallways, etc.  It was very difficult to get dinner reservations.  My 12 year old son really did not like it at all.  Pool appeared clean, however, when we had a mask on you can see all sorts of stuff floating in the pool! Yuck!  
Some people in our party thought the wait service was terrible.  We have been to other Melia's which were much better (Punta Cana, NYC)

reviews.author: Javier E
reviews.title: Esperaba mucho mas!!
reviews.text: Fue mi primer viaje con hijos pequeños, pense q tendría muchas amenidades para niños pero esta muy pobre, tiene una alberca simple bajita y un mini cuarto para niños! La comida por la mañana y la tarde es muy repetitiva,  en la noche se cena rico en los diferentes restaurantes que tiene. Los bartenders de la alberca te atienden en base a la propina q les des y siempre con mala cara! El colchón que me toco, horrible, una inclinación de unos 30 grados (3349), las persianas caidas y bueno el sofá cama ya se lo imaginaran! Sinceramente no vuelvo en mi vida a ese hotel!

reviews.author: brengon10
reviews.title: No es la calidad Melia acostumbrada
reviews.text: el hotel esta muy deteriorado, falta de personal en plena época alta. Haces reservación con meses de anticipación (4 habitaciones de la misma tarifa y características) y te entregan 4 habitaciones totalmente diferentes entre ellas. Una reserva era de 3 adultos y la habitación solo tenia una cama... creo que esperaban que el tercer adulto durmiera en la bañera, en medio de los otros dos o no tengo idea.

reviews.author: Jason L
reviews.title: I wouldnt come back
reviews.text: I was very fustrated with this trip and felt like i was scammed. I paid for royal service which includes bali beds and butler services. Even after gettinf my butler to book bali beds and restaurants 3 days ahead we still got denied. The bali bed day of we went to pool and we never got our bed. Restaurant day before we get a text from our butler saying reservations was denied but when i walk by restaurant at my supposed time the place had like 4 empty tables but wouldnt accept walk ins. Whats the point of going to an all inclusive when i am forced to eat buffet for breakfast lunch and dinner bc i cant get into any restaurants.

reviews.author: Debra C
reviews.title: Done with Melia
reviews.text:
This was our 2nd time visiting this resort and we are loyal members, booking a couple trips with Melia a year. Well after this visit we will place our bets elsewhere next time because every day there was an issue of extreme inconvenience, especially traveling with a toddler and baby. We did not book Family Concierge because last time we came here did pay for it and our concierge was nowhere to be found the whole time! 

Pros:
-Service at restaurants and bars: Most of the staff are so friendly and the service is great. Francisco at the stadium lounge was amazing, remembered us and took great care of us. Compared to Dominican Republic (the Melia there), the service/people here is by far 10 times faster and more pleasant. We made sure to tip most of the time, especially the beach servers who are always back and forth running drinks in the sand all day! 

-We had a stunning ocean view in pyramid 3 on the 6th floor. We always like to stay higher to be situated away from the loud restaurants and everything below. My husband woke up early to reserve good shaded seats and make our dinner reservations for the night. 

-Kids Zone & Baby Zone: nice place to let your kids unwind after a lot of sun and there is a calendar full of activities. The girls working are super sweet and helpful. I would suggest DO NOT leave young kids alone there, we stayed with ours and multiple nights it was only a few girls to up to 20+ kids. On multiple occasions we saw older kids being mean/pushing younger kids and it even happened to my son but luckily we were right there to stop it right away. I would suggest management to have extra staff on call at times of high occupancy. Asunción played soccer on the beach with my toddler boy everyday and he absolutely adored her!  

 CONS:
-I talked my friend and her family into coming here only for them to get a room infested with black mold. Staff gave the runaround and did nothing to change their room right away, they have a 6 month old baby! This alone will make me NEVER come back here. The front desk has no care for your safety or well being. Only after WASTING more of our vacation time the next day did they finally agree to move them (with no resort credit or compensation of course), the lady at the front desk in guest services says moving them is inconvenient because she has no one to fill that room after. What?!!!!!! Bye Melia! God forbid something bad happens here to your or your kids you’re screwed. 

-certain parts of the hotel smelled extremely musty, did not have this issue when we came here before and you could tell they try to cover it with incense everywhere. We’re all back home now with severe respiratory infections, my baby is on antibiotics and I had 2 breathing treatments/ chest X-ray/steroids through an iv yesterday. If certain rooms and sections have black mold issues, you bet it’s pumping through their hvac system. 

-roach infestation at the stadium lounge

-every night my son’s sofa bed was not made! Called down again and again while he fell asleep hunched in the stroller. Came hours later and woke us all up! We even tipped the lady to do it and it was not done, are you kidding. 

-Drinks WATERED down. All you get in your room is cheap beer, no wine or bottle like almost every other all inclusive gives you. Even the Melia in Punta Cana gave us a bottle of rum in our room. Food was better last time and has gone downhill. Do not eat at Bana, you get 20 times better sushi at Whole Foods! 

-rooms are outdated and there were tiny ants all over the buffet table which got on our baby’s things! Multiple days our room was not clean aka NO towels making us late for dinner and setting back our night!!! 

-my four year old son drinks milk and we called down SIX times for it. Outrageous. I ended up going all the way 
downstairs and finding a kid (thank god for the nice service workers) and tipping him. 

-elevators are so slow you will spend hours of your vacation playing the elevator game. 

-our key cards stopped working and we were locked out of our room on the 6th with our arms full of wet children and beach bags. I think the incompetent front desk checked us out early by mistake. 

-I went downstairs to inquire how to use our Melia reward points we never used. Been here 4 times and we have a whopping $85 what a joke. And no I don’t want to go to the overpriced spa...85 for a pedicure, yea ok! Anyway the Asian girl at front desk is texting on her phone and rude, passes me off and 20 minutes go by no one comes back. 
I literally inquired with 4 guest services workers who had no answer. The incentives and perks as a member here are full of lies and give you runaround. 

-finally, we only used $29 worth of our “reward points”. My husband goes to check out at the front desk. They tell him he owes $50 for the items that our points should have covered. What?!!!! He pays because they’re wasting his time and giving him the runaround. At this point I AM DONE here especially with “Guest Services”. Thankfully, the last lady I dealt with was actually very nice and immediately refunded us and ADMITTED that my husband was overcharged ($50 for $29). I know how this place is so I retained all of paperwork. The first time we came to this resort they had to cancel our reservation and recharge card again. SHADY. Keep all your documents in case you need to contest any charges with your financial institution. 

OVERALL, I’d estimate all of the runaround we dealt with on a daily basis wasted at least an entire days time of our vacation.
