All they care about is your money here, for an all inclusive it’s not that inclusive. We need a vacation from vacation. Their slogan is “the place you want to be” more like “the place you don’t want to be for too long before you lose your mind”

reviews.author: Gabby O
reviews.title: Family Trip
reviews.text:
We were very disappointed by our recent trip to Cancun, Mexico. We arrived at the Paradisus hotel tired and hungry on July 11th with 4 kids and my 70-year-old mother in tow not to mention myself and my husband. Despite having paid for two ocean view rooms, we were informed that they would instead assign us 1 ocean view and a second "lagoon" view. We made it clear that it was not what was arranged with our travel agent, nor was it what we had paid for. We called our travel agent, Johnny Holvik, after we realized that no matter how much we pleaded with the hotel check-in clerks, we would not get the rooms we had paid for.  After close to an hour of negotiations between the hotel, Mr. Holvik and ourselves, we finally relented to a promise by the hotel to re-assign proper rooms by the next morning. Since at this point, all of us, but especially our kids were desperate to get settled into a room (any room) and were agitated from hunger, we accepted there offer. Needless to say, we never got the upgrade that was expected after we went to check if the issue was resolved. In addition, the rooms we did have had ceiling leaks not only the rooms but throughout the resort, presumably from the daily storms. We never felt comfortable and the hotel personnel were of no help to accommodate us with respect to getting the rooms we had paid for in advance.
We had vacationed in Cancun three separate times before making arrangements at the Paradisus hotel - we have never had an experience like the one we had at Paradisus before.

reviews.author: Brian G
reviews.title: Great food but terrible service and rooms.
reviews.text:
Overall, this hotel doesn't care about service and will not go out of it's way to help you.  I am honestly surprised at how many great reviews on service this hotel has.  We have been to numerous hotels in Mexico over the years that are all inclusive, this one was the worst we have experienced.

I will break my review in to a few parts:

Rooms:
We booked family concierge level rooms and were traveling with another family(separate reservation) who also booked family concierge level room.  Not only did we get a room with double beds and not a king, but the other family was upgraded to a suite with a separate room for the kids to sleep in.  We questioned the resort on why they got an upgrade and we didn't and they stated it was because of the travel agency we used who does a large volume of business with them, yet still didn't give us an upgrade.  We were told that you have to request ahead of time but our travel agent was distinctly told we have to request when we arrive, which we did.  Bottomline, we were stuck, they gave us options to move rooms to a king bed but we would have had to wait and were going ot be put on the other side of the resort away from our friends so we declined.  The rooms themselves, for being a concierge level room, are just average.  The bathroom has a shower curtain in the shower, not exactly what I would call 5 star.  The rooms are small for what you are getting and aren't the cleanest.  Our bed skirts had stains on them and we were missing furniture that are shown in the pictures on the website and the concierge manager shrugged it off.  Last but not least, the beds just aren't comfortable, again, not what I would expect from a place that was 5 star rated.

Food:

This is the one area I will say is why they are getting 2 stars from me and not 1.  The buffet is average as to be expected, but the restaurants themselves had amazing food.  Honestly, each restaurant had phenomenal food and was top notch and would be the one area I would say does not need really any improvement.  I would recommend getting concierge level as getting reservations without it seemed impossible.  If you are a foodie, you will be in good hands in this area.

Concierge Butlers/Hotel Service
They were just ok, nothing really to write home about.  I had to ask them numerous times for things and sometimes they would just ignore us or take forever to get back to us.  For me having to pay extra for Family Concierge, it was a rip-off in my opinion because the butlers really didn't do anything other than book me reservations and bring cookies once a day.  It was just very forced, not personable and honestly they just didn't seem that in to their jobs.   Again, we  have stayed in other resorts in Mexico and usually service is top notch, but this place didn't have that.  You might get a server or two(Orlando!) who are pheonmenal but mainly the service here is terrible.  In other Mexico resorts, you are treated very well, and have consistent service.  The Pool Bar is severely lacking as well, and really needs to some treatment on the service side.  Takes forever to get a drink, you have to constantly flag someone down, even with giving a tip, and they just aren't interested in being there.  Side note as well, the pool bar is really run down, chunks of tile missing all along it and it needs renovating.

Overall:

Overall, this place was a let down for us, I forgot to mention we had two things stolen from us at the pool while there, this was likely the other patrons and not the staff as the quality of people in this place was pretty low, likely because it is cheaper.  I would recommend paying a little more and staying in Playa area as this was my first experience in the hotel zone and I won't return, just wasn't really impressed with it.  The service is not good, no idea how people are saying they had great service, the concierge lounge is trashed, pool table is destroyed and there is not entertainment options for kids who likeened the kids zone to a prison.   During the day, all the entertainment options were for adults only  so just not much to do for kids or teens at all.  The manager of the hotel was supposed to call us while we stayed there but never showed and all in all, just was not a good experience.  Spend a few hundred extra and stay at a Playa resort, this place is run down and really needs some work.

reviews.author: Elicia B
reviews.title: Made the best of a poor experience
reviews.text: My cousins stayed at this hotel last year and loved it. They bragged about the crepe station, doughnuts, seafood night and all of these awesome amenities. Because of this service, one of these cousins recommended the hotel to her brother-in-law, who got engaged last year, and the couple booked the resort for their wedding. We were invited and made this our family vacation.The welcome staff are great. They are very friendly, but it seems to go down from there. All of the great amenities were not offered. There were no crepes and doughnuts. My room was okay, but needed to be updated. We also found roaches in some of the rooms and in the lounge area on the second floor. The buffet basically served the same food all of the time and some of the staff who worked in the buffet (Martin and Victor) were not friendly and would sometimes get an attitude when asked for service. The only person who went above and beyond was Christian. Also, they need to have someone monitoring the buffet because kids would put their hands in the food, which is extremely unsanitary. The other restaurants were good. The best were Mole and Erso. The staff around the pool area were very friendly and accommodating, especially Sofonio. He would always bring us drinks and check on us while we were there. There also seemed to be a lot of poor communication in mgmt. We were told that the manager was different from last year and noticed that the services were not up to par. Other guests had a lot of issues with their room or staff. Complaints were made to management and cabanas were given out as a courtesy, but they have one person handling 10 or more cabanas. Bathrooms around the pool area were filthy and they ran out of running water right before the wedding. Their gelato and coffee stands were delicious, but only ran for a couple hours a day. They should be open in increments because people seemed to really enjoy it. Overall, I will not revisit this hotel. They need to make too many improvements and there are other places that I can stay.

reviews.author: Al R
reviews.title: Es más un Jardín Botánico que un hotel ,muy mala la comida
reviews.text: Preferimos este hotel por las fotos de su lobby y áreas exteriores pero no regreso a el , el primer día se fue la electricidad en mi habitación por más de una hora al momento de la comida solo se podía en el buffet por q el check in es a las 3 no se podía reservar en ningún restaurant a esa hora y fue la peor comida de todas las vacaciones en mi vida terminamos comiendo hamburguesa hasta mi niña de 2 años , el segundo día de rompió el aire de la habitación y estuve toda la tarde esperando q decidieran q hacer querían limpiar el coil a esa hora por supuesto q no lo permití termine en la recepción pidiendo q me cambiaran la habitación, termine comiendo ese segundo día en el centro comercial La isla por q ese buffet igual estaba horrible , me prometieron q alguien de atención al huésped iría a verme para ayudarme con lo de los restaurantes por que viajamos con mi hija de 2 años y no come comida mexicana “nunca fue nadie, si tratan todo el tiempo de vender el tiempo compartido es horrible como molestan , en fin termine pagando por comida fuera y no se los recomiendo es mas un jardín botánico que un Hotel.

reviews.author: HectorRG
reviews.title: Segunda oportunidad... reprobados
reviews.text:
Por motivos ajenos a mi, regresamos a este monstruo vacacional.. llevándonos un mal sabor de boca peor que el de la visita pasada..

Parece que no leen los comentarios aquí  descritos, empeoraron en casi todo.

Bienvenida, pésima, ya ni el agua de bienvenida te dan, el de recepción nos dio un cuarto con características que no habíamos reservado, a lo cual contesto que no había disponibilidad... osea háganle como puedan...

Mi cuarto con vista al mar si, efectivamente la vista era hacia el mar pero no contaban que en medio pusieron una palapa y solo veíamos el techo de esta y unas plantas peores que las de una vecindad.

Camas, almohadas, colchones, baños...viejos, no descansas, amaneces torcido, el baño sucio, con mensajes de los huéspedes anteriores en el espejo cuando se llena de vapor el baño... bueno esto solo el primer día, por que así como así, cortaron el agua caliente.

En los restaurantes te niegan las reservaciones, siempre esta todo reservado y los restaurantes siempre están vacíos... eso es no querer dar el servicio.

El restaurante Naos, un asco... todo esta pegajoso, los vasos huelen a huevo de lo mal lavados, quedamos asqueados del olor a fritangas...

Mal, muy mal, no volvemos nunca, los huéspedes del piso de arriba con su fiesta y nadie los fue a callar...

Por que no ofrecer un servicio de calidad? Limpieza! Entrenar a los de recepcion para solucionar problemas, que sean amables al dar respuestas, cambiar colchones y baños que parecen ser sobrevivientes de 3 huracanes....

Solo pudimos cenar en uno de sus restaurantes, el Enso, que fue como compensación a su error en la reserva... 

No lo recomiendo, pasa uno tantos amargos sabores desde que llega, que cuando llega uno a la playa,ni lo disfruta.

Renuévense!!! O véndanlo y que alguien más a tienda y de buena imagen al turismo.

reviews.author: Szyq2018
reviews.title: Room for improvement
reviews.text: Spent last week at Paradisus Cancun. From check-in the trip was problematic. After we were dropped off we wandered around the main lobby until we found a door that I assumed was check in. There was confusion about which building we were in, then once that was clear they had to send for someone from royal service to bring us over. Once we found the right area check in was easy, but after the flight and arrival stress we were immediately approached about sitting for a presentation about purchasing a time share. Many incentives were offered, which we agreed to revisit. The butler showed us to our room, waited for a tip and that was the last time we saw him. We had asked about dinner and bali beds, and were told everything was booked for that night and the following day. The first two days left a bitter taste in my mouth and we decided to speak with the royal service concierge. This is where we met the woman who turned the trip around. Melina at the royal service concierge is an asset to this company, hearing our concerns she tried to help with dinner, bali bed and class reservations. We were ready to leave, it was that bad, and this kind professional demonstrated the utmost competence. Melina even helped get us towels and maintenance, because the sink was stopped up and we did not have housekeeping services for a couple of days. The third day in we met Jose the pool concierge and along with the pool staff made us feel truly pampered. The classes were wonderful, we found Edgar the bartender every night just because he was worth it. The entertainment crew Omar, Hector and Luis made every days events enjoyable. Then came the tropical depression. The hotel leaks, all over. My daughters room flooded and the yellow caution cones became and obstacle course. I can honestly say that the service staff makes this hotel, it would be nothing without them. Due to our experiences we decided not to sit through the time share presentation, and we feel this may have contributed to the lack of "royal service" that we paid for. A note for people who dare to stay here; tip everyone regardless of how much gratuity is included in the price. I would also like to give special thanks to the crew at Blue Agave, we ended up eating here every day because the tacos are the best dinner option here.

reviews.author: alexsiemsen
reviews.title: Not what we expected.
reviews.text: Was not pleased with my stay the second time around. Due to construction that was going on next to our room and the fact we were placed in a handicap room, we will not be coming back to this resort on our next vacation.

reviews.author: Gaelle P
reviews.title: PUNAISE DE LIT, CAFARD, INONDATIONS, STAFF MEDIOCRE !!5* ?????
reviews.text:
Illusion pour les YEUX, oui le site est beau... MAIS 
Pas pour les familles' escaliers partout quelques rampe pour poussettes, restaurant mauvais sauf le BANA, MARKET GRILL et NAOS.. Hotel qui vieillit et fuit pendant les orages... 
Chambres PAS DU TOUT AUSSI BELLES que sur les photos. 
PISCINES PAS ADAPTÉS pour enfants, trop profondes  et entretien passable. QUASI aucunes installations pour les jeunes enfants, juste petite balancaire et glissade  !

ANIMATION très inégales, activités rares ou mal annoncées., pas de theatre cela se fait dehors devant les piscines à vous de trouver laquelle et d avoir une paces entre deux arbres. 
BABY CLUB , super staff! sauf que les enfants de 0- 4 ans ne sortent pas dehors!
ET VOILÀ LES GROS SUJETS

PUNAISES DE LIT !!!!!!!!. piqures partout... dans les 2 chambres que nous avons eu PYRAMIDE 4  !!!!!!!!!!!!!!

CAFARDS ENORME dans les salles de bain !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

CANALISATIONS D EAU a cassé lors de l orage tropicale 5 cm !!!!!!!!! d eau dans toute la chambre !!!!!!!!!!!!!! UNE VRAIE PISCINE !!!!!!évacuation à 4h du mat, risque d hydrocution ! aucun dédommagement, aucune aide pour amener nos enfants avec nous dans une autre chambre, aucune aide pour laver notre linge mouillé et sale  pour l inondation ... si proposition du service valet de linge pour 15$ par article à laver !!!!!!!!!!!

malgré nos allers retours et demandes à la direction  aucune aide, traitements, discount, geste commercial,  RIEN RIEN RIEN !!!!!!!!!!!! SERVICE SOURIANT mais ZERO ACTION !!!!!!!!

C EST plus un centre COMMERCIAL qu autre chose, pas de palapas si tu ne payes pas, pas d animations pour les adultes le soir, 
SERVICE de gardiennage d enfant en chambre pour 25US de l heure puis 35 $ uS de l heure passer 23h !!!!!oui  oui rester boire un verre dans l hotel " tout inclus"  en ayant les enfants la haut... te coutera 100 $ us 

les magasins sont horriblement chers pour des articles de très mauvaises qualités 

LES photos de famille, super photographes et belle seances... mais les tarifs des photos !!!  25 $US la photo, 17 photos 350$US ou si tu veux la seance au complet 810$us !!!!!!!!!!!
 Tu veux dormir tranquille sur la plage sur les jolis lits qui prennent 1/3 du site ??? parfait 180 $US et tu as tout de mem ton repas servi... my god ! 

Circulation dans l hotel affreuse, tu montes et descends tout le temps car pas de main line entre les pyramides... en poussettes et avec jeunes enfants tu as l option d ascenseur... lent, long et toujours pleins ! 

le service de table est toujours bon et super ! 
 Jamais de serviettes de douche prête dans les chambres pour te doucher vers 18h30...alors que la chambre a été faite. 

reception inefficace, toute demande est éconduite, grand talent pour te faire tourner en bourrique ! 
Malgré les notes et les notes ércites pour la direction RIEN RIEN RIEN ,,, et bizarrement le lendemain avec une autre personne au bureau.... toujours aucune note n est inscrite au dossier....sur les plaintes... on efface et on attend que tu partes... pour éviter les problèmes et te payer !  PABLO, CECI, ELIANA etc... toujours inéfficaces mais polis !

 PARADISUS..... JUSTE POUR LES YEUX !!!!! plage superbe, eau cristalline, soleil merveilleux  et buffet délicieux ... staff animation sympa, baby club gardienne adorables , serveurs attentionnées et efficaces !         

au moins y a ÇA

reviews.author: Maysworld
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
My friends and I came to Cancum to celebrate my 40th. Please do not try to plan anything in advance because they do not respond to your emails in a timely matter and no one really comprehends the Englosh language to properly assist you. It was 15 of us who came to celebrate my 40th birthday. My assistant and I tried several times to contact them to set up a welcome dinner, breakfast brunch, cabanas, photographer and etc. Nonetheless, they kept giving us an email that did not work. I had to go on social media and ask for someone to respond to me and when they did nothing was ever confirmed or followed up on. The hotel is well kept and beautiful. The staff are very nice and pleasant. However, from the 15 of us 8 of us go sick and experience diarrhea after eating at the Sushi restaurant. Yeah we shouldve known better. At first we didnt figure anything of it until 2 of my friends flew back the next day and went to the Urgent care and was told they had a bacteria infection. They shared with the doctor that a few were still in Cancun and was experiencing the same symptoms. Doctor told us to only eat bread, banana and drink water.  We booked a tour to go to the ruins. 1 of my friends could not attend because she had diarrhea the entire time. I was experiencing discomfort in my stomach but still attended the ruins. We tried to explain to the gentlemen that she couldnt attend due to illmess. He going to tell us that we need a doctor note to get our money back... Expected us to pay $135 to see a doctor in their hotel to state she was sick for a refund. Wow! Once we figure something wasnt right because too many of us were sick. I spoke to someone at front desk and explained to them the situation. She stated that she will tell the general Manager Andrew and he will call me at 7am in the morning. She also kept saying they didnt have no other complaints and that they needed more complaints. I was like ma am it is 15 of us right here in the lobby sick as hell and your asking for what again? We are all present to file the complaint. That night of my bday we went to a resturant outside the hotel. We got to the resturant which was beautiful. We order drinks, appetizers and placed our entree. Guess what mone of us could eat. We spent over $760 and barely ate. Who didnt feel like they had to throw up, the others had to go to the bathroom. The waiter asked us why wasnt we eating and we explained the situation. He felt bad that we werent eating and left all the food behind. We explained it wasnt the service but we couldnt eat or take the food back with is because there were no microwaves in the rooms. The next morning no call from the general manager. I go back downstairs to ask for the general manager and they say he wont be in till 2pm. Im like excuse me I leave ay 1pm and you guys are not going to rreat this matter lightly. They kept giving me the run around until they got a lady who is a manager for the family center... eitherway she got me to go with her into another area so I can explain what occured. Then I had to write what happen, list the resturant and etc. She tried to say we went to the restaurant so we got sick from there. I said no we were sick from before and I filed the complaint before going to the restuarant. She said the general.manager Andrew or Andreas whatever his name would contact me. Yeah its been a week later and no contact or follow up. I came back home and went to urgent care and was also diagnosed with a bacterial infection. Dr stated that whatever we ate was contaminated by someone who prepared the food and because we ate sushi there was no serious cooking needed to kill off the germ or bacteria. Simple as someone using the bathroom and not washing their hands and prepared the food. We ate it and got sick and some experience diarrhea. I lost 4pds bc I wasnt able to ate and had diarrhea for 4 days straight. We also had issues with their transportation. We paid in full for round trip and their transportation agent told us we had to pay again. We kept going back and forth for an hr till they said it was corrected. We showed them the emails and they sent us confirmation. We go upstairs for them to call us and tell us that we will jave to pay 35 again for transportation. How? We again had to dispute this till they finally got it right. The photographer at the hotel is good. Tool great pics. I Selected my pics and paid for them. I spent over 375 for pics. For them to then tell me they will send them to me in an email. Hello! Come again. Why wasnt this told to me up front. The girl told me that they will print them out and to pick them up at 9am the next day. Guess what happen at 9am they werent printed. And the guys is going to apologize to me
 No sir it doesnt work like that I was told one thing and you guys are doing whatever. So I figure they are quick to get your money and whatever you get you get. The only place we didnt experince any issues were at the 2 cabans that I rented. I gave the girl the decorations and they were not put up in a timely matter. Although at 8am I went to her and she said no problem it will all be done. It sure was done after 11a... the final straw was this... my friends ordered room service for breakfast. 1 is allergic to shell fish. Why after eating her food she experience an allergic reaction. In which I called and ask for the female Manager and they transfer me to her and she came upstair and saw her face. She had a shock look and asked them what they order. All of this and NO ONE FROM PARADISUS BY MELIA jas contacted me. I left my number and email address... we gave them our business for 15 ppl and their was no follow up. You shouldnt waste your time or your money at this resort. These are serious matters that can lead up to legal actions...

reviews.author: muguimono
reviews.title: Paradisus una decepcion
reviews.text: Muchas, estrellas y costo para lo que te ofrecen. La comida mala.No pude bajar las fotos que nos tomaron con mi esposa. El restaurat peruano, no se parece, ni de lejos. Primera y unica mala experiencia en hoteles Melia.

reviews.author: brehanmaul
reviews.title: Old, outdated and poor practices.
reviews.text: Very disappointed overall. Had to spend an additional $1000 to salvage our experience. Old outdated rooms and hotel. Food and reservation system were very poor.  Service staff was the one bright spot.  If you go just spend the extra money and rent the cabana at Coco's every day.  Expensive but the only thing that made this tolerable.

reviews.author: 주연 배
reviews.title: Never come back with the family
reviews.text:
I am staying currently here but I am too disappointed to this resort and never come back here.

Rooms : too many problems so I cannot even write all of them. Airconditioner was not working properly and the light next to the bed were not working. The water was not drained in the bathroom. The water was dropped from the ceiling in the bathroom. And I never see this kind of sofabed. It's too uncomfortable and I am sure that no one can sleep here. I complained all to the reception and they turned my call several times to the other one with no explains. Finally my room is fixed now but I had to call to the serviceexpress everytime I figure out the problems. I don't know tomorrow what problem I would have again. And the outlet on the wall doesn't work properly but I don't want to call them again so I use the other ones.

Check-in : the process took so long. I had to stand in the line and wait more than 30 minuites carrying my baby and my mother who sitting on the wheelchair.  

Restaurants : Don't forget to make a reservation. And don't forget to bring the baby's own water bottle. The waiters don't offer straws so your baby might not to drink water if they are young. Those things are ubderstandable even it's not comfortable. But I can't understand why they don't have enough high chairs for kids. I have never expect that the waiters are always running to seek high chairs to the other restaurants. They can't get the chairs easily so I and my baby need to wait until the other family finish their food and leave.

Don't go to this resort with the baby. I will never come back.

reviews.author: Ho Hyun C
reviews.title: Food variety/quality so-so, butler so unprofessional.  Not worth the $$
reviews.text: If you had stayed other Paradisus locations, this probably has not as good food quality.   And the butler was so unprofessional.  Staff at the front desk was not fluent in English, slow and not friendly.

reviews.author: blyndastephens
reviews.title: Day one and already a disaster!
reviews.text: Today we kicked off our family spring break vacation and with lots of excitement through the planning process; we were feeling super confident that the Paradisus Cancun was going to be wonderful... today on our first day here, we realize that this place is HORRIBLE! The hotel presents itself as beautiful and modern BUT wait until you see your room. Disgusting, Disappointing, and most importantly Dirty! We’re traveling with a 2yr old, an 11yr old and upon arrival to our room housekeeping just finished “cleaning” it. It was GROSS, the bathroom is filthy with dried poop stains around the toilet, the shower tiles and fixtures are mildewy and moldy. The bedroom linens are dingy and literally look like they were used already... I went to complain at the front desk and was told “this hotel is +30 years old, what do you expect? Uhm, are you serious?!? I expect cleanliness at the very minimum and i expect all the photos that you have on your website to actually represent exactly what is on premise! I am sitting outside of the resort writing this in tears because I have to put on a Happy Mommy face for my children& my husband so that the next 5 days for them are enjoyable. Where is Management? Every time I have gone to the front desk I’ve been directed to a different “manager”.. I haven’t even told you all about the food or lack there of, or the scam regarding pricing upgrade to the Family Concierge or the day rate for the Bali Beds— everyone that I have interacted with has a different price for theses things.. Paradisus Cancun how disappointing! .. this place deserves to be a 2 Star from what I’ve experienced so far and we arrived today at 3p!

reviews.author: potosina
reviews.title: Expectativas no cumplidas
reviews.text: Yo no elegi el hotel. Fui a éste por motivo de congreso. El hotel se nota una edificación vieja con un mantenimiento regular los elevadores no tenía aire acondicionado las habitaciones están bien conservadas..pasable. Lo que no me gustó en Absoluto  es la comida  de los restaurantes más concurrido para desayunos y comida El Naos y el Market Grill. Es bufett. El sabor deficiente.  Arroz quemado. Sopas insípida. Carne asadaen grandes volúmenes...mala cocción. Muy dura. El servicio de losmeseris extremadamente deficiente.  Si usted busca calidad y servicio...elija otro. No lo recomiendo. Ni volvería

reviews.author: HappyNomad7
reviews.title: Old, tired and busy
reviews.text:
This was my last visit ever to an all-inclusive resorts. The price is insanely high and what you get is an old hotel, tired rooms and food & drinks so bad we ate nothing and went to eat at a restaurant outside the hotel. We had one drink during our visit--a Gin tonic--and it was mediocre. We wanted wine but the house wine is worth $3 cost a bottle (yes, a bottle, this is not a joke) and we just couldn't drink it.

When we left, the line up at the checkout counter was at least 30 people, and since it's an AI and we consumed nothing, I just left only to be stopped at the door because I didn't have permission to leave until the checkout counter gave me a stupid little paper so we had to walk back in and wait. And wait. I think by that point smoke was coming out of my ears.

Anyway what this all means is: if you've ever been to a real hotel (i.e. not a AI) and enjoyed it, you will not enjoy the Paradisus. It's just a different world where they charge you a fortune for third rate quality.

reviews.author: Alex M
reviews.title: Not worth it. Sneaky charges and rude reception staff ruined a very nice stay.
reviews.text: This would be a nice hotel, with decent infrastructure, beautiful beach and great restaurants, if it weren't for their sneaky charges. I had a three-day business conference scheduled at this hotel, so I decided to bring my family to stay the full week. The room was paid for during the three nights of the convention, so I contacted the hotel and asked for a family rate and was told $450 a night for the four extra nights. When I arrived they said it would be $600 a night, since the $450 was a single occupancy rate. I was slightly upset since I clearly mentioned three other family members, but I attributed it to miscommunication. Then at check-out I was overcharged again. They said that during the convention only my food was paid for, and I had to pay for the food for my three family members. I was again upset by the surprise charge but accepted and assumed the difference would be $150, same as the difference from single occupancy to quadruple occupancy. But they said no, the food charge during the convention is actually $300 per day! I asked why, since the food available to us was exactly the same during the convention and after. They said that was the agreement between the hotel and the convention organizers. I said that was unacceptable, I cannot be liable for an agreement between the hotel and the convention, and that someone should have told me that at check-in. They said "Sorry, but that's it. If you don't pay you cannot leave." I was furious, I have stayed at plenty of all-inclusive resorts and have never seen this type of sneaky, underhanded behavior. To make matters worse, I wrote Melia customer service, they said they would get back to me and never did. Not worth it, plenty of better options in the world.

reviews.author: Nico C
reviews.title: Estafa Club Meliá
reviews.text:
Desde el viernes esperamos respuestas ... el mal trato fue enorme. Todavía esperamos al gerente !! 
Es una ESTAFA el CLUB MELIA. 
DESTINATIONS Y TODO ROBO
Terminamos llorando en vacaciones.
Nicolás Claros.

reviews.author: Rachel J
reviews.title: Stay Away
reviews.text: The place is nice, not at all like the pictures makes it appear, but I wasn't expecting a palace. I could write a lot about the leaking water from the ceiling in our room, or the  lackluster quality of the room service food, or the fact that it was the least inclusive "all inclusive" resort I have stayed at,  but none of that is relevant because the maids will steal your money. The cash I brought was intended to be used for tips for the staff members who were doing their jobs, but was instead stolen by their greedy coworkers. Thankfully, I only brought about 80 dollars to be stolen, but I'm confident if I weren't a poor graduate student and had brought more money, they would have stolen much more. Stay away, folks.

reviews.author: Marsha G
reviews.title: Disappointment in Paradise
reviews.text: Been to Mexico every year for the past 5+ years for daughter's school break. First time at Paradisus.  The beach was beautiful, less windy than the Hyatt Ziva, however that is about it.  Room smelled like smoke and had no hot water.  Moved rooms, it was better, however, it was so loud, as was everyone else's (we had a group of 9 adults and children).  It was Spring Break Central including observing and assisting a twenty something girl pass out and vomit and choke....thank goodness we were traveling with a nurse..  Day 3 couldn't get in pool due to vomit.  We were spoiled at Hyatt with cleanliness, food and coffee bars.  The procedure to make dinner reservations was also a huge pain and of course our reservations were misplaced on night 3.  There were guests partying until dawn every day we were there, never been so loud and we got about 2 hours sleep each night.  NOT conducive to a family vacation.

reviews.author: david p
reviews.title: Realistic Review - Currently NOT a 4, 4.5 or 5 Star Property
reviews.text:
Attempting to write a realistic review that your average traveler can relate to.  Nothing is worse than reading a review that starts off how your terrible your hotel was because your airline lost your luggage or your flight was late!  

This was our 15th trip to Cancun having stayed previously at Hyatt, Westin, Marriott, JW Marriott, Secrets and NOW properties.  The Paradisus has always looked attractive from the outside and has an outstanding beach location that we were familiar with being next to the Marriot, JW and Secrets.  You can't beat the beach.  Unfortunately the property currently does stand up to a 4, 4.5 or 5 star resort rating.  The rooms are very tired, worn and in need of major refurbishment.  The bathroom needed a major revamp and cleaning (not to mention it is pretty small).  The bed was pretty tired - every time you moved or even climbed in the whole bed and frame moved and bumped against the wall.  The drapes in the room were on their last leg as far as being able to pull them open or closed.  The overall feel of the room was drab and dreary - windows need cleaning, in need of some fresh paint and in general just freshening up. We walked through the main pyramid on several occasions and saw rooms with their doors propped open for cleaning.  What a difference - rooms APPEARED to be bright with fresh paint and new furniture.  HOWEVER, it was only in the main pyramid. 

The restaurants for the most part do not meet the standard of a 4 star hotel.  Exceptions are Blue Agave and Mole - both were excellent.  The main buffet had either a strong fish smell or strong oil/frying smell. You need to make reservations for dinner (Normal for most all inclusive resorts), but good luck as this was always a challenge.  You can make reservations up to 48 hours in advance.  We did that, each day adding a reservation for 2 days out.  Reservations would always be shown as "Pending" and never confirmed.  The day of we would have to call and inquire, be told 'no sorry' and by the end of the phone call told 'ok you are confirmed'.  Show up at the restaurant and run into the same - sorry we don't have your reservation - host calls someone, 10 min later they do have your reservation.

We did us the Spa for a massage and included hydrotherapy treatment.  The massage treatment was excellent and good quality.  The spa IS NOT.  Tired, worn, needs major refresh and not on a par with a 4 star hotel or resort. I would get a massage again, but just expect an overall poor spa experience compared to what it should be for the hotel.

Service - have to say service was outstanding.  In general the staff goes out of their way to be accommodating.  Both beach and pool area had attentive staff that were always checking on you, bringing water without even requesting etc.  You never had to look for someone to order a drink etc like some other all inclusive resorts.

All and all the hotel SHOULD be better than what it is.  Pictures and physical location make it look great.  Service is great.  However, behind the scenes it is a 30 year old hotel (true) that is need of major refurbishment and cleaning.  When you compare dollar for dollar you can find a true 4 or 4.5 start property for same price.

reviews.author: Clyde S
reviews.title: Paradisus but for...
reviews.text: Four of us traveled here together to attend a private wedding involving only 20 people.  ALL four of us became victims of “Montezuma’s Revenge.”  As we were leaving I learned others there for the wedding suffered similarly but to different degrees.  We didn’t all eat or drink the same things.  The only thing we had in common was we never left the property.  So who knows the cause, but it had to be food, water, ice?  It’s like the stories you read about cruise ships where a few people get sick and it spreads through the whole boat.  But for the revenge, I’d be giving this place close to 5 stars.  EXCEPTIONAL service, great facilities, great beach, beautiful rooms etc.

reviews.author: maqz99
reviews.title: Great stay - Terrible Follow-Up Service
reviews.text:
Stayed at Royal Service Paradisus Cancun from late December to early January to celebrate the new year with my girlfriend. Everything was great, except for leaving my coat and gloves. Called the hotel in which they stated they still had them and I needed to pay for a label to return my items to me. This is all fine however they never responded back to me after 5 attempts via email with no follow-up. 

Would never stay here again after this.

reviews.author: Kihwan Hong
reviews.title: so so
reviews.text:
if your room arrange  first floor of piramid 3, don’t use and request other room. Because the smell of room is barbecue from the kitchen.
Especially room numner is 3125~26. The front desk staffs were not friendly.

reviews.author: anon6987
reviews.title: Do Not Trust Melia
reviews.text: We booked a family vacation, made the prepaid reservation which was a little less expensive.  When In received the confirmation, the amount was 20% higher than the rate I booked from the website and much higher than even the rate which could be cancelled.  Called customer service, they would not let me cancel since it was prepaid but told me the steps to contact billing and get it corrected.  Two weeks later they refused the change and I was stuck with airline tickets and this fraudulent charge.  Thought it was best to discuss live at the hotel with the backup customer service had asked me to provide.  Instead, I was told that my family and I could not leave the property until we paid the higher rate.  Be wary of this company and this hotel, dishonest.  I will never stay with Melia again.

reviews.author: Experience321430
reviews.title: FANTASTIC service but WORST food
reviews.text:
I don’t normally write reviews but I can’t help it this time! I really don’t understand who wrote those great reviews! We are a family of four with two college-age kids. Yes, we know what good food is but we also know what is totally pre-made-then-frozen-then-microwave food is. The so-called passion fruit refresher coffee has sour milk flakes floating on top, the sushi was ceviche-thin served at “room-temperature”, the Asian flare was nothing but a joke, the buffet looks and tastes like those 6.99 all-you-can-eat at a joint off the freeway, the Spanish tapas was made with frozen octopus then reheat, so come on, they can’t even make Mexican food right! The only thing they did right was the fresh fruits; yes, they are real and fresh. Oh, also the fresh grilled lobster on pineapple, yes, that’s real non-previously frozen lobster. So the food is a “half star”.

The staff on the other hand was fantastic. The place is decent, and the beach is beautiful. If it’s not because of the service and the nice staff, I would give it “one star”. 

I have absolutely no idea who would write those high flying reviews on its food except the management!

reviews.author: Lina N
reviews.title: Ok for one night.
reviews.text: We decided to take a night at this all inclusive for the last night of our 3 weeks vacation In Mexico. We came from a smaller beautiful all inclusive in Playa del Carmen. The Paradisus looks good at first sight, but it is not a cosy and friendly hotel. The staff is doing their job, but nothing more. When we came all the restaurants where full booked, so we paid for this all inclusive  but  wasn’t really able to use it in the way we would like to. The atmosphere is a combination of children and party, not really what I prefer on my vacation (that is my personal opinion). Breakfast was good and room was nice (we had the junior suit). For me, this hotel is way to crowded and I honestly felt more stressed after this night. I had higher expectations and I think the visit was to pricy. The first thing that I was told by the staff was: welcome to the best hotel in the world. Well, we have different definitions about that!

reviews.author: Tai B
reviews.title: Not a wow experiences
reviews.text: Long queue at check in. We checked in at 1500 local time, but had to wait an hour and a half for the room to be ready. The smell inside the elevator at royal service was unpleasant. There was a construction going on so it was a bit noisy. However, staffs at Japanese restaurant were very friendly and attentive, but the quality and the freshness of the food required improvement. Valet service was good.

reviews.author: Morgan U
reviews.title: Nothing was ever easy
reviews.text: Would absolutely not go back. We had Royal Service and nothing was ever easy. They definitely don't follow the customer is always right model. We were there for 8 days and were told by Jose, the pool staff, that he would make sure we weren't able to reserve a bali bed for the remainder of our stay.

reviews.author: Samantha R
reviews.title: We had higher expectations
reviews.text:
My fiancé and I️ stayed 4 nights at this resort. When choosing between paradisus and royal we decided to go with just paradisus as none of the royal amenities were necessary to us and we just probably would have liked to experience La Palapa.  Upon check in no king was available as requested. They searched about 20 min to find a room for us and they said we can switch tomorrow. We went into the room to find it filthy dirty. Went back they put us into another double bed room. Next day switched us to king right above the buffet area where we smelt food all day and night long when the balcony was open. The safe didn’t work, there was no slippers or robes or beach bag like the other two previous rooms. Only received turn down service one night. Dirty bed sheets with holes. The property is in serious need of renovation and updates. At night inside pyramid 3 it’s gorgeous with the lights and bana in the middle.  The buffet food was always cold and lacking variety, proper labels and also clamps for certain dishes which made it difficult for someone with food allergies. The main pool was nice and service was good, the smaller pool was heated which was a plus but full with kids mainly which we didn’t care. Beach had very strong waves but as always gorgeous turquoise water which is what keeps us coming back. Laying on the beach in the Lounge chair the service was great, all the waiters and waitress went above and beyond. We always tipped a few bucks goes a long way.

Dinner reservations we only were able to get in around 9:00-9:30 which was late but oh well. The food was below average but better than buffet. Fuego we waited an hour before even receiving an appetizer. Mole was decent. Bana we did not try or Enso. Blue agave which was one of the Lunch places had a awful smell when you walked in which just really turned us away.

All in all the people work really hard at this resort. My main disappointment was with the room situations and the front desk staff. The food was poor quality 4/10 stars and I’m being generous.. which was a huge disappointment, otherwise we tried to make the best of it as we were in nice weather. 

My advice is try a different resort for the $$ with better food options or more food options. Upgrade to the royal service for more attention if it’s not much more $$. 

We stayed at the grand oasis pyramid in January as VIP black bracelet no reservations required for most places and much better food and updated rooms.

Entertainment is same as most all inclusive resorts pool show, Michael Jason show, circus ... pool entertainment was low also not much fun

reviews.author: Lígia
reviews.title: Decepção
reviews.text:
Fiquei hospedada durante 5 dias, em uma viagem à trabalho, e parecia que a cada dia surgia uma nova decepção. Posso citar algumas delas:
- Meus colegas de trabalho e eu chegamos às 10h no hotel e não houve nenhum esforço para conseguir ao menos um quarto como early check-in, para tomarmos um banho e trocar de roupa. Ficamos de 10h às 12h monitorando um possível check-out e acabamos desistindo. Quando minha colega chegou ao quarto, por volta das 16h, havia uma mensagem de boas-vindas às 10:50h da manhã (será mesmo que o  quarto estava ocupado quando chegamos pela manhã?).

- Dias depois, quando fui solicitar um late check out, fui informada que eu poderia fazer o check out no meu horário normal, aproveitar as amenidades do hotel (piscina e praia), que depois eles cederiam, por 30 min, um quarto para eu tomar banho e trocar de roupa. Por que essa opção não foi oferecida quando eu cheguei? Tenho certeza que os funcionários perceberam o interesse que eu e meus colegas tínhamos após uma longa viagem.  

- A comida do restaurante buffet, no almoço e janta, tem uma qualidade muito abaixo do esperado de uma rede Meliá e os demais restaurantes requerem muita antecedência para reservar. Em algumas ocasiões, preferimos fazer a refeição fora do hotel.

- No nosso primeiro almoço, tivemos que solicitar 4 vezes ao garçom que trouxesse guardanapos à mesa. Na última, ele informou que não tinham mais guardanapos disponíveis. Somente quando perguntamos se não tinha nem de papel, ele conseguiu alguns.

- No último dia, minha colega matou uma barata no quarto. 

O hotel possui uma arquitetura muito bonita e piscinas/praia muito agradáveis, mas em termos de serviços existem pontos a melhorar. 

Espero que os demais hóspedes tenham uma experiência melhor que a minha.

reviews.author: Paola G
reviews.title: No es lo que parece
reviews.text: Fuimos a buscar un lugar relajante y donde pudiéramos disfrutar de los 4 días que nos quedamos en Cancún pero no sucedió, primero nos dieron una habitación a lado del antro que tienen dentro del hotel, no nos comentaron nada hasta que La primera noche por obvias razones no pudimos descansar al otro día fuimos a reclamar y lo único que pudieron hacer fue cambiarnos a otra habitación con dos camas !!! Mostramos nuestro enojo pero no hubo más por hacer, Otra cosa que no me gusto fue la comida falta variedad y si quieres hacer plan para cenar en algún restaurante y llegas después de las 10.00 am ya no van a tener lugar. Creo que le falta mucho para poderse llamar paradisus y de verdad es súper incomodo que vayas a descansar y te estén ofreciendo sus “platicas de 90 min” para afiliarte al club, antes deberían dejar que la gente se enamore y convenza del hotel. Lo que puedo decir positivo es la amabilidad y servicio de meseros, botones y en general la gente que trabaja en los restaurantes muy bien!!

reviews.author: Linh V
reviews.title: Worst travel experience so far
reviews.text:
When we arrived, it took us a total of 1 hour to be checked in. We were told repeatedly that the hotel was fully booked and did not get the rooms that we previously requested through Expedia. Both my husband and I were tired of explaining so we took the rooms that were given. Our room was literally flooded after the rain during the first night. My parents’ room was wet but we were told that was normal after the rain even with the Ritz Carlton down the strip. We then asked to switch our room only (because after checking it out even the concierge agreed that it was bad in our room) and we mentioned for the second time that since we travel with a toddler we’d like to be on a higher floor away from the noise. Amazingly enough, we were put in a different room right on top of the hotel’s night club. Obviously we did not notice this until the evening. I am currently writing this review at 1:30 am and the music is blasting away. My husband did complained with the hotel management at around 11 but since my daughter is already sleeping we cannot/don’t want to switch to yet another room. We have been trying to turn the AC down so that the noise from the AC might help with the loud music. I am very disappointed at the way Paradisus treats its guests as the staff are nice but things seem to be broken somewhere. We talked/raised our concerns with hotel staff but there appears to be limitations on what they can do to help. 

I am totally aware that this review won’t affect Paradisus’ business as Cancun is a very popular destination and the resort is conveniently located. During this stay, both my husband and I think that due to these factors, Paradisus doesn’t really have to please its customers. We try to enjoy ourselves here and I have to be fair saying that the wait staff are very nice and attentive; however, it’s safe to say that we will NEVER go back here or choose another hotel run by Melia. 

For people who will be traveling with kid(s), maybe try the Family Concierge option. I initially did not book it as on Expedia it says that the option for ocean view is limited to 2 twin beds which doesn’t work for us. Try to get a room away/several floors higher from the night club and allow yourselves at least half an hour for checking in.

reviews.author: Chad R
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun (beautiful place bad service)
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancun is a beautiful resort once you leave your room. Everything outside our room was great but the room service sucked. We stayed all inclusive but had to call everyday to get our fridge refilled and the snacks refilled for our kids. We even had to call to get new towels for the bathroom because they never left clean ones. We even had to call 3 times one evening to get our snacks for the kids refilled and by the time they actually brought them our kids had fallen asleep because it took 2 hours. Ridiculous. We even are Club Melia members which they are supposed to go over and beyond for you as a member. We will never stay in Cancun again. The Plya del Carmen Paradisus is way better.

reviews.author: Emerson S
reviews.title: Paguei caro num restaurante ALL inclusive!
reviews.text:
Fui em um restaurante e o garçom ficou "empurrando" um vinho meio seco tinto. Tinha pedido um branco e nem avisou que não estava incluído.
O vinho custava $136.
O vinho mais caro da minha vida é horrível.
Lamentável.
Pior experiência que tive no hotel.

reviews.author: A.G.
reviews.title: RUNDOWN RESORT
reviews.text:
The lobby is gorgeous... But that's all.
Check in lady is very unfriendly  (belive her name is Karen )charged us twice for the room, even though we told her we've already payed.
The ROOMS are very outdated, and smells like mold. 
The materass is old and uncomfortable,
The toilet is inside a closet
 the tub/shower is very old 
The KIDS/BABY zone is very dirty and unsanitary.
The BEACH  is not stroller accessible.
NO KIDS POOL
The SERVERS are very nice and polite, that is the only reason why I'm giving 3 stars otherwise I would have given 1.
THEY SHOULD PUT THE SAME EFFORT IN UPDATING THE PLACE AS  THEY DO IN PUSHING YOU TO BUY A 50 YEARS MEMBERSHIP.
ABSOLUTELY NOT A 5 STARS RESORT! MORE like A 3 STARS RESORT.

reviews.author: Bryan K
reviews.title: Used and Abused - Okay if you like big crowds and buffets
reviews.text: Spent five days at the Paradisus Cancun resort. Stayed in a king size room on the 8th floor in building three. Hotel appears like it gets used and abused for Spring Break. General touch points; furniture, bathrooms, and pool seem tired. The restaurant reservation policy is a joke. Forget making a reservation at a reasonable time or more than a day in advance if you're a "general" guest. When we did have reservations for prime-time dining, the restaurant sat half-empty. Lots of time-share folks running around too. One even told a family member during the sales pitch that general guest are treated like a number and that being a member is the only way to get quality service. Wow! Overall way too many people for our taste. As usual, the hotel staff were exemplary, but the hotel reservation policy and condition leave much to be desired.

reviews.author: FernandoVillagran
reviews.title: Cucarachas, mala mantencion, lo mejor la calidad del personal
reviews.text:
Llegamos a este hotel y nos recibieron muy bien, sin embargo nos tuvieron una hora ofreciendo un plan de melia, despues de un largo viaje en que solo quieres descansar. Una vez que llegamos a la habitacion desempacamos, fuimos a comer y a la vuelta nos econtramos con cucarachas en la habitacion. Fuimos a reclamar y nos respondio la gerenta nocturna: ESTO ES NORMAL. Posteriormente nos dieron otra habitacion en la cual estaban haciendo reparaciones, y cuando fuimos al baño nos caia agua desde arriba, asqueroso.
Lo bueno es la playa, los servicios, la comida, y su personal que es muy alegre y amable. Lo cual compenso en parte los malos ratos sufridos con las habitaciones.

Estos problemas no deberia suceder por el alto costo que cobran, y uno va con tiempo limitado de vacaciones, y con ganas de descansar.

Subi fotos de las cucarachas y goteras.

reviews.author: Ana Isabel G
reviews.title: No esperes mucho.
reviews.text:
Nuestra reservación fue del 19 al 24 de julio. Reservamos este hotel por la buena experiencia que tuvimos hace 2 años en el ME by Meliá. Al ser de la misma cadena pensamos que sería mejor, pero no fue así. 
Aquí les dejo varios puntos a considerar:
1. RECEPCIÓN: Llegas a recepción y nadie te dice dónde hacer el Check-In (que no es el lobby típico de los hoteles que están en la entrada). Una huésped tuvo que orientarnos. 
2. HABITACIÓN: Buena habitación, amplia, cama está confortable. Baño poco viejo pero normal. 
3. DISTANCIAS: Es un hotel MUY grande, desde que llegas nadie te dice cómo moverte. Nos perdimos muchas veces entre todas las Torres y restaurantes que hay. Si no te gusta caminar, este no es tu hotel. Muchos escalones y mucho caminar. 
4. RESERVAS EN RESTAURANTES: Hay muchos restaurantes pero tienen demasiada desorganización en las reservaciones, nos decían que ya estaba lleno y después volvíamos a hablar a otra hora y ya nos permitían la reserva. 
5. COMIDA: No es nada buena, muy básica y general, repetitiva. Bufete con temperaturas nada agradables, las comidas calientes estaban frías y las frías calientes. El único rescatable es el MOLE, por su comida y por su atención. Mala experiencia en la comida. Sin contar que el Bufete es súper pequeño para la gran cantidad de huéspedes que se hospedan. Había que hacer fila para encontrar una mesa. 
6. ATENCIÓN: Pésima atención y servicio. Personal muy mal organizado y nada agradable con el turista mexicano. Pocos meseros con buena actitud. 
7. PELIGROS: Mi esposo se cayó en el hotel dado que los pisos están resbalosos y la gente se mete con arena y mojados, no limpian seguido los pisos y no están al pendiente. Otro peligro son los escalones de la ALBERCA. Mientras estuvimos ahí en la alberca, 3 personas se resbalaron y se cayeron feo, porque no limpian la alberca y está llena de arena de la playa. 
8. ALBERCA: Alberca templada, agradable la temperatura (si te gustan las albercas muy frías, este no es tu estilo). Alberca con MOHO, 3 trajes de baño se nos ensuciaron de lo verde que estaba. NO le dan mantenimiento ni limpieza. Reportamos esta situación pero nada más fueron a una orilla a limpiar basurita. Esta alberca necesita LIMPIEZA PROFUNDA.
9. MAR: Algas, le faltaba limpieza por parte del hotel. Mar con oleaje fuerte pero eso pues no depende del hotel. 
10. SHOWS: No hay nada, es un hotel aburrido que para después de cenar ya te tienes que ir a dormir. 

En general, no me volvería a quedar en este hotel, por el precio puedes encontrar otro de mejor servicio, mejor calidad, mejor comida como la cadena de los RIU.

reviews.author: Rita D
reviews.title: all "inclusive"
reviews.text: I have to say I was not impressed with the Paradisus Cancun. Upon arrival we met with our concierge, he informed us that we would have to book restaurant reservations 24 hours prior to our desired dining time. That meant I had to set my alarm for 7am to get a reservation for the next evening! I called as i was told and requested certain restaurants  and they were always "booked".My husband and I went to the restaurant that we wanted anyway to see how busy they actually were and we noticed many available tables. We asked if we could sit and they again told us they were booked. Oddly they never filled the tables as we sat and had a drinks at the bar. This happened all week! We met some other vacationers at the pool and they told us upon their arrival they made reservations for the week at all their desired restaurants! So which is it? I think is a scam so you are forced to eat at the buffet. I also felt the in hotel staff was not overly friendly which I have never encountered before in Mexico. I will not be returning to a Paradisus!

reviews.author: Partyof10
reviews.title: Nice staff...awful outdated rooms!
reviews.text:
We researched family resorts in Cancun for months! We settled on Paradisus after reading reviews and looking at pics online. The resort and the Melia hotels websites do an awful job of accurately describing their rooms and the size of their so called SUITES.

We paid extra for the family concierge option, which is really a waste, unless you totally love getting the dollar store type goodies provided for the kiddos upon checking into the room.  Again...I want to stress that the staff is nice but there's not much use for the family concierge option...at least not for us.

We booked family concierge junior suite expecting to have a large comfortable space for a family of three and I swear the junior suite is the size of a standard room at any random hotel. Small.  Suite should not even be apart of the title.  There are 3 small dresser drawers in the room so be prepared to partially live out of your suitcase.  

The rooms are not very clean either. I found stains on the floor, the curtains, the shower curtain, the chair, etc. The hotel has a lot of obvious messy paint jobs. The hardware in our bathroom shower was full of hard water or soap build up. There is an unnecessary bidet in the bathroom that takes up 50% of the toilet area.  Our bathroom stall didn't even have a handle to exit the bathroom.  Same for our patio door...a latch on the inside but no handle on the outside. 

I was almost in tears when I saw the room.  Our inlaws traveled with us with their adult son and they were crammed into a double bed room...NOTE: the double beds are not queen sized.  They are probably full sized at best. 

Also...don't expect a ton of entertainment at this hotel.  The pool closes at 7pm. They have one club that has no air conditioning and really not much to do but wander around.  I also noticed lots of rust and wear and tear on lamp shades in the restaurants.  The chairs in the NAOS and Market grill are disgusting! It is obvious these chairs are never cleaned!!! NEVER. Also note: the Market Grill part of the main restaurant is outdoors.  There are lots of birds landing on all of the tables, chairs, and dishes all day long. They flock there to grab left over food on the plates on the tables.  Really gross.

On the flip side, the beach is nice and the pools are nice. There is only one swim up bar and the liquor is very watered down.  I receive ONE really good real drink and that was in the restaurant Fuego...it was Baileys.  Everything else was flat.

I would never recommend this resort to anyone.  This is my 4th time traveling to Cancun and it is my first time being disgusted with the condition of the rooms and two main restaurants.

The other thing that upset me is that we sat through a 90 minute timeshare and the Melisa hotels reps took us to another part of the hotel with absolutely beautiful suites!! But they expect you to pay a ridiculous amount of money to become one of their members to have access to those rooms.  Melia should be ashamed that they are clearly capable of having beautiful rooms in this resort but are choosing to leave their paying customers in cheap and tattered rooms because apparently we do not deserve nice rooms if we can't pay thousands of dollars into a timeshare.  Shameful.

Food is meh at the places where you don't have to book a reservation (which by the way needs to be 24 hours in advance -- ugh).  

The pics of the Kids areas make them look way better than what they are. Those areas are also stained and not well kept.

I could go on but the last thing I'll mention is that there are probably only 2 television channels with shows in English!  Totally ridiculous with the number of English speaking patrons that frequent this resort.

MANY OTHER OPTIONS IN CANCUN! Stay somewhere else.

reviews.author: andrewbL3010NY
reviews.title: Underhwelming
reviews.text: Food was not good. Air conditioning in hallways, restaurants and common areas was completely insufficient. The check-in and check-out required a wait in a long line. The staff could not answer our questions or provide proper directions throughout the resort.

reviews.author: Josh M
reviews.title: Worst Trip I've Ever Been On Hands Down
reviews.text:
Just got back from 6 days at Paradisus Cancun. To say I’m disappointed is an understatement. I either need another vacation to anywhere else on the planet or need a time machine to have never taken this vacation. To put it in perspective, my wife and I have enjoyed probably 30 all inclusive vacations and I have never left a negative review. I rate the Flamingo as a 3.5 star hotel. We stayed at the Paradisus in both Playa and DR and they were great. This was a tragedy by beach vacation standards. 

Lets start with the room. Dated. No big deal. Beds are hard and really wore on both of our backs (I’m 39), still, no big deal. The air conditioner sounded like a diesel engine, just crazy loud. It got the room cool, when it was on, when it kicked off, immediately to humid. Door is paper thin, more on this to come. Best part of the room was not 1 but 2 sets of blinking green lights. A set in the middle for the router and a set for the smoke detector which was literally on the ceiling above right where your faces go. 2 sets of blinking green lights. All week. Is this some sort of experiment? It appeared a prior subject had placed a band-aid over the lights at some point. One band-aid remained but no-longer covered the light. I had no band-aids. Bring duct tape or blinders. 

The hotel is beautiful, with lush landscaping on the inside. Be prepared to sweat, because almost nowhere is air-conditioned in any real way. The lobby, the bars, the hallways, the restaurants, you will sweat. The gym was pretty decent but hot as the mouth of hell. 20 minutes on the treadmill and I looked like I ran Kona.

The main buffet is a joke, and a cruel one. Normally the main buffet is a throw-away meal on your first night where you bump in because you don’t have reservations, but it’s normally quick and easy. Not here. Line out the door with a wait for a table. Once you’re finally inside, it’s a zoo-like atmosphere where people with plates are bumping into you at every move. If you want a second drink (or at breakfast a first glass of water), bring it yourself. Yet, even with this traffic, the food manages to be luke warm. And the line was at every meal, including breakfast. No idea why because the restaurants requiring reservations had an abundance of open tables at all times despite telling you they had no reservations.

The beach is gorgeous, the water is clear, the view is great. There is no breeze from said beach reaching the pool due to a glass wall separating the pool from the beach, no fence or other structure allowing the beach breeze to hit, just solid plexi. The result? Unbearable, humid stagnation. I’ve been to Cancun, Playa, DR, Jamaica, Cabo during the same weeks and have never felt such breezeless misery. Then there is the pool. Do they actually heat this? Minimal relief and you stand up to your neck. So basically to get any relief you spend all day all the way up to your neck in a pool just short of body temp. Never experienced a pool this warm anywhere at any time.

The Thai restaurant was just OK. We ate there twice due to the claims of no reservations. On the 3rd night I got food poisoning from something and vomited so much and so violently that I hurt for 3 days. Not sure where I contracted this ill. It wasn’t from the Tapas restaurant, which was also just OK, because I was already sick when I got there. You sweat there too. And bring a second drink if you think you might want one.

On the 4th night at about 2:30 am we were awoken by guests talking loudly outside the room. They had around an hour long deliberation about whether they were going to “hook up.” There was much concern over whether one of the guys did or did not have a girlfriend. While the hotel is not responsible necessarily for this, it showcases how thin the walls and door is. Plus, I give this place credit for the ocean, which is literally nature, so I can take off for this.

The last 2 nights we were awoken at 3 am by a guy using a power buffer on the floor in the hallway. The first night this happened it was right outside the room. Like, I saw him through the peep hole. It was loud. I can’t believe anyone would think this was OK. It went on for over an hour. At 3am. We called. Nothing. I tweeted, nothing. I posted to their Facebook, nothing. Just cruel. The second night he did the next floor up at the same time of night. Since the whole place is open, it might as well been our floor again. The only refuge was the diesel engine of an air conditioner kicking on, since it’s loud enough to drown out a power buffer. I went through the same charade. Nothing. Just lying there looking at the blinking green lights and waiting for the air conditioner to drown out power tools. 

My kid liked the kids club. I question the safety and supervision of the place but she’s alive so we’re all good. The Blue Agave restaurant was the best. They have a choice of Tacos or Quesadilla. Really. That’s your choice. Still the best restaurant.

This would have been disappointing at 2k for the week for 3 of us. At 4500 it’s nothing short of hands-down the worst vacation I’ve ever had anywhere. I would absolutely recommend this experience to my mortal enemy.

reviews.author: Tiffany S
reviews.title: Just don't.
reviews.text: Look elsewhere. The check in check out process is a joke and takes a lifetime. Meanwhile employees are just standing in the back of the room with iPads. Don't know what they're doing. You might think all the plants on the inside are cool. Not so much. It's musty and there is no air flow in the lobby at all. The hotel is dark and dated and smelly. They burn insense to cover the smell. Makes it worse. I don't think there is an air conditioned restaurant in the entire place. They have this whole royal service that if you opt out you're treated like a peasant.  I've stayed at many hotels in Cancun and only stayed here for a wedding. Would not stay here again.

reviews.author: lizgrant1
reviews.title: Mixed emotions
reviews.text:
I know people have different taste and we have been on vacation every year and we have done a ton of all inclusive and I will say we will will not be coming back to Paradisus Cancun. 

We stayed in the Royal Service for the first 2 days it was great but then the rain came and they closed down the restaurant and the bar on our side. So the forced us to go to the buffet for breakfast and lunch and we did not pay the extra money to eat at a buffet the food was cold. They need to invest in heat lamps they are not heat lamps they are using so the food is sitting under lights. Room temperature food is not what I enjoyed. For the days that we did eat at the Royal Service restaurant it was the best place in the resort so every day when we went down and they said it was closed I was depressed knowing I would be eating my next 2 meals at the buffet. We did eat at the Taco place one day for lunch it was good. I will not comment on the other restaurants I like american food to be honest but the food was good and different. 

Our room was nice but when it rained for 3 straight days the a hallways were getting flooded with water through the walls and the ceiling. The floors became slipper my husband did slip because of the slippery floors. We did meet a couple at the bar one night and they were in building 3 and there actual room good water in it and it had mold they were on the 3rd floor but when we were walking over to the 3rd building early that day we seen them cleaning a room on on the 2nd floor so I'm guessing a lot of rooms had water and mold very concerning. 

Now if you like things to do this hotel does not offer a lot of things - there is no water things offered on the beach (except jet skies that you pay for) so if you are looking for that you have to go out of the resort and across the street. They lacked a lot of activities to keep people entertained and the worst part if it is going to rain for 3 days the resort should have stepped up and go things together for the families to do. If I had young kids I think I would have gone crazy with them. At night the only thing that was offered was a 45 minute show nothing before and nothing after. You have to get to the area about an hour and half before to get a seat there is not enough room for everyone to even see the show we sat behind the show the one night and seen nothing. After the show there is nothing to do except a small night club. There said you would need to go down on the strip. If you are paying for all inclusive then why would I need to leave! 

We did a timeshare presentation just to get 2 free massages to waste time when it was raining. I told the women all of my concerns and she agreed and said she would recommend the other resort Paradisus in Playa Da Carmen but that did not help us we were staying at this resort.  

I spend a month on the trip advisor reading all the reviews and I was excited but I was not happy at the end.

reviews.author: Evan T
reviews.title: Be careful when getting in taxis
reviews.text:
The trip was great. The only issue was that, when it came time to go to the airport, the hotel staff put me in a taxi with a driver who had been sleeping. Normally I wouldn't mind, but this guy was nodding off during the taxi ride and his eyes looked completely closed the entire time. I had him blast his horrible music at 5am (the last thing I wanted to listen to) but it didn't help. He continued to drive in the middle of the road, swerving from lane to lane. I don't know if it was lack of sleep or drugs, but you would think someone would be able to wake up after five minutes or so and stay in his lane. He almost hit a man in the middle of the road (to his defense, I'm not sure what the guy was doing in the middle of the road), and I had to repeatedly tap his shoulders to make sure he was still with us. It sucks that we didn't have the option to just have him pull over and let us out. There's nothing good going on in the streets at that hour. Anyways, we somehow make it to the airport, my girlfriend is terrified, and the driver has the audacity to pretend he only has 150 pesos when I asked for 200 pesos back. I left him the equivalent of a $4 tip (since I only had USD) but in reality, he deserves to be in jail. I blame the hotel concierge for this one as well. 

Also, turn down the lobby music on weeknights. I'm in my early 20s and I couldn't even stand it, I can't imagine how a 45 year old couple must have felt.

reviews.author: anmafra1
reviews.title: El mantenimiento del lugar muy pobre, habitaciones muy viejas y almohadas pesimas . El aire acondicionado tenia problema
reviews.text: El mantenimiento del lugar muy pobre, habitaciones muy viejas y almohadas pesimas . El aire acondicionado nunca prendía si se ponía en automático el calor no nos dejaba dormir, tenía que ponerlo todo el tiempo a correr y el frío ya era insoportable. La zona del kids club sin ventilación y sucio, las niñas del kids club con el uniforme roto y zapatos sucios, mal olor y poca ventilación en los pasillos De la Torre  3 que me tocó . No fue una muy buena experiencia!! Lo único muy bueno fue la comida eso sí nos gustó mucho

reviews.author: jessicarE5625LE
reviews.title: So many issues!
reviews.text: The "hotel tour" is actually a sales presentation, and doesn't last for 90 mins, but instead lasts for 2 hours and 15 mins, your entire morning. You're told you are getting a VIP breakfast... you just sit at another table but go through the buffet like everyone else. You are told you're getting a free return trip, but they don't mention the activation fee as well as the $88 per person you have to pay when you return for your stay for the "All Inclusive Package". You are also told you will get a 50 min massage, it is actually 40 mins. Just a ton of BAIT AND SWITCH. Many of the couch cushions are torn, electric candles are out, when it rained and leaked, they just threw towels on the floor. There is very little effort to get adults hanging out with each other. On the 2nd day of our stay, we were woken up at 8 am by construction going on in the room next to us, loud banging and terrible odors. The hotel moved our room, but made ZERO effort to compensate us for this inconvenience. It was just a poor stay.

reviews.author: Carolina S
reviews.title: Vários hotéis em um só (nem sempre todos bons)
reviews.text:
O hotel nos proveu sentimentos duplos. A primeira vista, fomos extremamente bem recebidos, em horário anterior à nossa reserva. Nos foi oferecida comida e um local para troca de roupas, ótima primeira impressão. 
Fomos recebidos por uma concierge que após nos alimentarmos nos apresentou o hotel e os passeios que ofertavam. O local impressiona, muito bonito por dentro. Ponto positivo pro hotel, a vista também é linda. 
A coisa começou a ficar estranha quando fomos à piscina. Era final de semana e simplismente não havia lugar para sentar. Vimos hóspedes deitados no chão (na grama) tomando sol, e os funcionários simplismente diziam que não havia espaço, tranquilamente. Vimos uns bangalôs e pensei "ok, tem lugar aqui", foi quando nos informaram que deveria alugar por meros 160 dólares/dia. 
O sentimento de "eu paguei mais de mil reais a diária para tomar sol no chão?"começou a tomar conta de mim, e não foi embora a viagem toda. Parecem dois hotéis diferentes, dentro e fora, onde fora pode ser classificado como terra de ninguém. Fomos à um hotel de praia no caribe que não fui à praia pois não havia cadeiras, ao menos que eu quisesse deitar na toalha, na areia ou pagar um bangalô dos vários vazios que ocupavam aquele espaço. Inadmissível isso, principalmente a naturalidade como os funcionários tratam o fato de não ter lugar. 
Voltando à pontos positivos, a comida é muito boa, todos os restaurantes que experimentamos foram bacanas, mas a espera das gorjetas incomoda, principalmente pelo preço da diária, sei que é uma prática local mas a espera incomoda.
No primeiro dia, prepare-se para sentir-se uma cifra ambulante, vão te oferecer mil passeios mil vezes, além de uma apresentação de um clube que se é bom não sei mas foram tão insistentes em nos vender que nem se fosse de graça eu entraria. Após você recusar tudo que querem te vender, você se torna menos interessante e só falam o necessário com você. Isso foi bom, pelo menos sentimos paz. 
Agora vem o ponto mais grave... Estávamos na piscina quando aparece um homem com um pequeno macaco e uma pessoa do hotel com uma câmera, onde iam até as crianças, colocavam o pequeno macaco super assustado em seus ombros (querendo voltar ao tratador) e tiravam fotos para vender depois, onde proibiam os pais e as outras pessoas de tirar suas próprias fotos. Pode me falar que era um tratador legal, que estava dentro da lei, mas eu e meu marido vimos o desespero daquele macaquito de ombro em ombro. É inadmissível que uma rede como o Melia apóie este tipo de prática, animal tem que estar no espaço dele, protegido, não sendo explorado assustado em troca de venda fotos. Pode ser uma prática legal e local, mas não justifica ver aquele animal indefeso assustado. A piscina, eu relevaria, a espera das gorjetas e tentativa de venda, também, mas explorar um animal assustado, não dá! Tá aí o motivo da nota baixa, que vergonha Melia, tomem providências...!

reviews.author: Hzorzi
reviews.title: Procure outras opções de hotel em Cancun!!
reviews.text: Foi o pior hotel all inclusive que já estive hospedado em Cancun. Infraestrutura antiga, funcionários mal educados - inclusive no Royal Service que era para ser o serviço mais exclusivo. Não recomendo!

reviews.author: ruben_i_a
reviews.title: todo con propinas
reviews.text: Nos ha resultado decepcionante la estancia en el hotel. El entorno y las instalaciones hacían presagiar una buena estancia, pero el personal se encargó de torpedear la experiencia. Lo peor de todo la zona de la piscina: SOLO te hacen caso si vas soltando propinas a diestro y siniestro, en caso contrario las hamacas te las buscas tu.

reviews.author: alex26082015
reviews.title: Rehenes del club melia
reviews.text:
Excelente comida y limpio, pero 2 situaciones terminaron por deteriorar mi evaluación.
1.- Ya ha pasado un mes y aun espero que me envíen las fotos que contrate,
2.- Fuimos rehenes del "club melia", no había día que no me  invitaran a conocer este "proyecto", la mitad de las vacaciones las pase dando explicaciones que no me  interesaba, que no me llamaran a la habitación, me regalaban el cielo y la tierra! en fin!!!  en resumen los últimos día ya no preguntaba nada para pasar desapercibidos (entre los vendedores del aeropuerto y los del hotel no había ninguna diferencia)

De verdad espero que mejore esto en el futuro y si alguien me puede dar un correo de un gerente del Paradisus Cancun para intentar rescatar mis fotos,  lo agradecería mucho.

reviews.author: carolinah977
reviews.title: Mi peor experiencia en un Meliá
reviews.text: El hotel es realmente muy viejo, las habitaciones son muy viejas, las camas matrimoniales no son para dos adultos, sino dos niños o un niño y un adulto. Todo el hotel está viejo lo q hacen es pintar pero encima de lo viejo y se ven las puertas de madera todas feas y golpeadas y por encima pintadas. Realmente es un hotel q requiere inversión para renovarse ya se ve muchísimo el desgaste.

reviews.author: Tania DB
