reviews.title: Great Ocean View, Hotel not so great.
reviews.text: The hotel is old, that's why they have a lot of things that they need to improve ASAP. The rooms doesn's have enough electric conections and it's very small, we ate buffet food in pool area, we get sick haha, but ok no problem. On the beach, there's 2 kind of people, normal guests & royal service guest (they paid upgrades, extras) if you are normal be ready for being ignored by waiters and for watch how 4 waiters are takin' care of just 1 royal service guest, trying to sell it 1 more bottle or a massage, but ok no problem. My only problem was that the doorman/valet parking saw that we were mexicans and his attitude changed it all, anytime we need to in or out with my car, he just ignored us, that's discrimination, I'm a local girl, I stayed in a lot of Riviera Maya Hotels, and this is by far the most depressing experience I ever had. But, let's be honest: his enormous garden in lobby it's amazing! If you are crazy plant person, you will like it and ocean view is spectacular, that's all.

reviews.author: Gabriel M
reviews.title: Nos sentimos defraudados
reviews.text:
Ante todo , debo decirles que soy socio Melia Rewards y asiduo huesped de la cadena.
El hotel está dirigido enfáticamente y en forma abusiva hacia los huépedes de habla inglesa.
Todos los shows nocturnos diarios son el el idioma inglés.Realmente es muy desagradable para los huespedes de habla hispana.No existe ni antes de los shows ni después de los mismos, alguna actividad dirijida donde la gente pueda bailar, escuchar música, o simplemente reunirse al rededor del bar viendo a los demás haciéndolo, etc.Es un hotel realmente aburrido ,sin animación. Ves el show, cenas y a dormir!!!!!! un desastre.
Si bien la comida es de buena calidad, no así la variedad.
No existe en forma diaria, islas de pastas, salmon rosado, langostinos, camarones , caviar de distintos tipos ,langosta, etc. como en otros Melia de igual nivel.Nos sentimos realmente defraudados.
A razón de la verdad , debemos destacar la atención de los mozos que fue realmente muy buena y totalmente amable.
Tuvimos también un problema que no denunciamos por no amargarnos mas la estadía y es que nos faltó un poco de dinero (U$S 25) que no habíamos guardado en la caja fuerte y lo dejamos arriba del mueble donde estaba la TV.
Conclusión , no volveríamos al Paradisus Cancun.

reviews.author: Lisa C
reviews.title: Far better places to stay for the price!
reviews.text: This is not the place to stay. Only upside was beach proximity and good drinks. Everything else was sad and tired. Entertainment was poor. Food was mediocre. Décoré and room cleanliness was poor. Had to call everyday about cleaning, towels, bar fridge, and toiletries. Room quality left a lot to be desired. Balcony tub never cleaned. No hottub in pool area. Nice pools but nothing spectacular. Spa service was good but facility was lacking- many things didn't work. I have been to Mexico several times. This was rated a 4.5. At its best I would give it a 3. That's being generous. Do your research far better out there for the money.

reviews.author: Maria del Carme... C
reviews.title: Baja recuperación de Clientes Insatisfechos
reviews.text:
Me asignaron una habitación doble para mis vacaciones de Aniversario, me cambiaron a una superior pero estaba usada y sucia. No me pidieron disculpas solo me dijeron que no había otra y que tenía que esperar 1 hora. Esperamos 1 hora y la limpieza no fue la mejor. Minibar usado, Jacuzzi exterior sucio. El amenitie de aniversario no llegó y lo solicité y me hicieron sentir que fue porque yo me cambié de habitación sin embargo en la 1era no estaba y sabía que iba a llegar en la 2da noche. Era la tercera y me lo llevaron pero a mi solicitud. Como no me lo tomé esa noche se llevaron la botella cerrada! 
Muy poco espacio en la piscina y en la playa, todo separado para royal servie o Club Melia o hay unas camas que debes pagar por ellas. 
Es un 4 estrellas.

reviews.author: Paula E
reviews.title: Bravo to Bust
reviews.text:
I travel often and have plenty of experiences to measure this place against. It’s a nice place with a great beach and delicious food. Most of the staff was wonderful...except for a few unfortunate events. 

Night one of our stay was interrupted at 2 am by intoxicated college kids who got confused and came pounding on our door trying to get in thinking it was their room. The entry attempts happened several times. Then, there was fighting. I finally had to call security to diffuse the situation, but not before one of them threw up against our door (while staff members were there with them). The hotel floors are marble so it made a giant messy puddle against our door and entry. The staff could have cleaned it up at the time but left it until morning. My husband and I tried to leave for breakfast at 8:45 am and it was still there. We called front desk to resolve the issue and they said they would send up someone right away. DIDN’T HAPPEN! An hour and fifteen minutes later it was still not cleaned up. We couldn't jump over it so we were forced to step in it. Quite disgusting. I understand it was not their fault that it happened, but it was indeed their fault it was not cleaned up in timely manner. There was plenty of opportunity to do so. To make matters worse, when I went to the concierge to discuss it with them, the concierge manager quickly angered and said it was "out of their control that it happened" and that clean-up "was being handled". By this time it was 10:15 am. Too little too late in my opinion, with no sympathy nor apologies given whatsoever. We felt very unimportant as guests. 

Then, night two we were woken at midnight by a knock on our door from several staff members telling us our smoke alarm was going off. It wasn’t going off in our room so we were apprehensive to open the door to discuss. Through the door we told them things were fine in the room and they left. A strange way to handle a concern in my opinion. Why not call? It made us uneasy and caused night #2 of interrupted sleep. What started out to be a good experience turned into one that left us with some hard feelings. I would rather give my money to a place that values their guests feelings and takes better care of them. There are plenty of great choices out there.

reviews.author: Miss Gigi
reviews.title: Esperaba más...
reviews.text: Nos alojamos dos días luego de pasar una semana en Playa del Carmen y me da pesar tener que poner un comentario no tan favorable. Hicimos el chech in a las 13hs y como la habitación no estaba lista fuimos a almorzar a Naos. Destacable servicio del mesero que nos atendió, lamentablemente no recuerdo su nombre pero tiene el sector que da al ventanal hacia la piscina justo al lado de la entrada principal. La comida excelente y gran variedad para todos los gustos. Ahora lo no tan bueno, regresamos a las 15hs a buscar las llaves de la habitación. Nos dieron dos habitaciones en sector 5, no nos explicaron ni como llegar, tuve que preguntar en Consejería y para mi grata sorpresa me entero que me habían dado un upgrade a Royal Service. El conserje ni nos miro, le pedi un mapa y pretendía pedirle algunas recomendaciones y mostro muy poco interes, todo el tiempo chequeando el celular. Nos fuimos solos hacia la habitación y cuando llegamos una de ellas estaba sucia del huésped anterior. Volví a recepción para que me la cambien y ahi me comentaron del upgrade porque consulte. La habitación que me asignaron después era mas chica y menos moderna que la sucia. Luego el maletero me comentó que algunas estaban remodeladas y otras en proyecto de remodelacion. Desde recepción no avisaron del cambio de habitación por lo cual el equipaje nunca llegaba. Tuve que avisar a service express quien en vez de tomar mi pedido y ocuparse me transfirieron al bellboy para que les explique la situación. Ya habia pasado una hora desde el check in. Faltaban las pantuflas y el baño estaba mojado al lado de la bañera. Avise que iba a salir y que podían pasar, cuando regrese a las 18hs el baño seguía mojado y ni noticias de las pantuflas. Tuve que reclamar otra vez. A la mañana siguiente me encuentro un mensaje del concierge de royal service (no sabía que teníamos un concierge ahí) que tenía que regularizar mi cuenta. Resulto que no habían registrado el pago de mi habitación que habia realizado al check in. Por suerte tenia un recibo. Fuimos a la playa y tampoco sabíamos que se podían reservar los camastros con el pool concierge, nos enteramos al ver uno con nuestro apellido ocupado por otros huéspedes cuando ya nos regresamos al final de la tarde. Preguntamos pero nunca entendimos bien el proceso de reserva ya que no tuvimos información de nada. A esta altura ya no me importaba porque al otro día me iba y era el único día de playa que tenía. Entiendo que era un fin de semana de alta ocupación y que nos dieron algo mejor que lo reservado, pero la sensación no era de que estaban colapsados sino de falta de interés en el trato. Lo destacable, el lobby que es impresionante, la gastronomía y la atención de Gloria del servicio de fotografía, super amable.

reviews.author: DebBoo
reviews.title: This all-inclusive needs some help
reviews.text:
I am fortunate enough to have visited many resorts around the world, and I need to report that the pool and beach lounge chairs are the most uncomfortable I have ever experienced.  They are either completely broken or in terrible disrepair.  

Additionally, there are several meal options and restaurant choices on the property.  However, I found too many "fusion" choices for dinner. Why not have one serve Italian food?  There were nights I sat down for dinner and found nothing on the menu I could eat.  

The only exception was the phenomenal Tempo restaurant.  The service was impeccable, the food presentation was unique and the meals delicious! 

One more thing that concerned me was, as a handicapped woman, I found no ramps for beach access... only stairs.  This limited my use of the beach and swimming in the ocean.

Sitting around the pool was fine, except for inconsiderate guests blasting music from personal speakers.  The resort needs to address this by asking people to use personal headphones. I moved several times each day to avoid loud music. It certainly was not a peaceful experience!

reviews.author: schellmas
reviews.title: Could be so much better!
reviews.text: Average food quality, poor service at dinner & watered down drinks made me very frustrated.  I would have paid extra for a decent glass of wine but only bottles were available.  Rooms are dated and mattress was sunken.  Had to get up early too book dinner reservations if yo want to eat before 9:30.  Also had to save chairs by pool before 8:30.  Coffee shop doesn't open until 10 a.m.  Great yoga teacher but no blocks available for the class. Would not go back.

reviews.author: mariangeles_10
reviews.title: Viejo
reviews.text: Estuve hace 20 años en el hotel y me encantó, cambió varias veces de nombre , pero esta igual que hace 20 años... quedo viejo, la comida no es buena, las habitaciones oscuras. Lo que si hay que destacar es la buena atención de todo el personal, siempre de buen humor y con una sonrisa. La playa es hermosa , pero muy difícil conseguir una palapa después de las 10 de la mañana. No volveré a este hotel

reviews.author: mandywlai109
reviews.title: Just ok
reviews.text: We just return from Cancun. We stayed 4 nights here and it was just ok. I've been to Cancun 4 times, and this hotel is just average. The service at the restaurants were average. The service at the front desk was below average, they are usually very eager to help but I didn't feel that way. We booked two rooms, we expected both rooms to be at least on the same floor. needless to say, we did not get what we wanted. I had to take a handicap room just to be on the same building as our friends. The problem with the handicap room is every time you shower, the water spilled over to the hallway. The food sucks except fuego. The beach is very nice though, but will not return again.

reviews.author: Wolf P
reviews.title: Poor quality of the hotels!
reviews.text:
Let me start off with the positive:
The beach and pool is beautiful and the pool is kept very clean. There is alot to do and it's fun and relaxing. The ocean is beautiful too. The food is excellent, nice hotel, housekeeping is clean, there is alot to do, good and helpful staff.
Now here is why I am writing this review. I had only made a TripAdvisor account because I wanted to write a reveiw.  They had put us in a first floor room, no problems, but the thing is we wanted a hotel with an ocean view. So, we stayed in the first floor room one night, and the next day we had arrived in the next room with the ocean view. Whoever was in that room before us left it disgusting... The walls had spit stains on them, ethier from spitting alcohol on the wall, or something. Second, the floor was dirty of footprints. We had entered the room, it had reeked of vomit. Not children vomit, but someone had vomited from being drunk or something, because the smell was that strong. Not only that, but the bathroom had stains on the counter and the light switches had brown liquid stains on them. When we'd asked for them to clean the room, they said the vomit smell was just the "paint" on the walls and it's nothing, but they were going to clean anyway. So, when they finished, the light switch still had the same stain on it, the floors were cleaned, and the vomit smell was still there. It was so unbearable that we asked to switched rooms. We could not get settled, so we were very angry. Third room, was fine the first day. But the thing is, we had no hot water. None. The maintenance guys came and did absolutely nothing to get it working. The hotel was clean, but no hot water! They couldn't get it working, so they had offered for us to shower in a "new room". The shower water was hot in this room. However, the shower was not clean  at all. The shower had yellow stains in it which appeared to be urine, so I wore flip flops in the shower. The second day, our family had to take showers in cold water! And not only that, but since the building is so old, and the sewer systems are so slow, some parts of the day we would be able to smell sewer in both of our bathrooms. We had to shut both doors. And they couldn't do anything about that, because the sewer systems are "slow". And it eventually goes away, but if you did leave the door open the whole room would smell! I recommend you stay somewhere else. We are not happy with our stay so far.

reviews.author: EduardoJulio
reviews.title: NOS ENGAÑARON
reviews.text:
el primer lugar describiré el hotel luego les comentaré que nos sucedió.
El hotel el muy grande con tres  bloques... RECEPCION  (check in) : multitudinaria no cordial ...tuvimos problemas.
Los restaurantes no son buenos ...solo se destacan Vento y Fuego. El desayuno es aceptable Y multitudinario... El almuerzo tipo buffet es muy abundante pero de baja calidad . SI LE GUSTAN LAS PASTAS..NO HAY solo un día y por supuesto incomibles.
Las habitaciones son solo adecuadas... CON ALMOHADAS VETUSTAS...y el aire acondicionado no permite ser regulado ....le falta la calidez que tiene por el ejemplo el hotel PARADISUS DE PLAYA DEL CARMEN .. !!! QUE ES EXCELENTE 
La playa es buena ...pero recuerde que CANCUN tiene mar abierto y por lo tanto mucho oleaje y es poceada por las corrientes bajas.
La música  a alto volumen no le permitirá relajarse..le parecerá que esta en una disco-
Los bares son buenos le recomendamos AVENIDA.
¿Qué problema tuvimos?:... habíamos reservado y pagado en su totalidad en septiembre en el ME CANCUN.. en el que nos habíamos alojado en dos oportunidades y nos agrado mucho. En diciembre nos informaron  que por refacciones estaba cerrado y podíamos optar por el PARDISUS CANCUN... nos costo trabajo (4 llamadas) y la reserva estaba OK ...sorpresa el 20 de enero nos informaron que estaba cancelada....  largas discusiones y se resolvió.... pero como se había anulado el pago debimos pagar nuevamente y nos cobraron un precio superior... a pesar que hacia 4 meses que habíamos abonado todo. 
NO VAYA A ESTE HOTEL...  no es bueno.... VAYA AL Paradisus Playa del Carmen solo está a media hora mas desde el aeropuerto que este... ME LO VA A AGRADECER.

reviews.author: Liz F
reviews.title: Honeymoon disappointment we can never get back
reviews.text:
Terrible food except for breakfast buffet. Good service but was always wanting tips (spent $300 in tips for 4 days) and felt like that wasn't enough.Their was NO honeymoon 
experience which was promisedto us. Check in not greated by a drink, had to switch rooms due to construction of next hotel . Then pushed 2 beds together to form a king.  No apology.  
good.

reviews.author: regorzz
reviews.title: Service was so bad we wanted to come home.
reviews.text:
We stayed here for my wife's 50th birthday and i though with the luxury room and royal service we would have the time of our lives.  I was mistaken about that tho.We  were in the hotel for over a hour and had to beg for some water(no cold cloth or refreshing drink on arrival). Our room was just a regular room and not the luxury room we booked. When we talked to someone about the situation they moved us to a new room up one floor(good joke on us the had a party on the top floor that did not stop until  4 30 am.)
Called the front desk 10 times about the noise but was finally told that the convention payed more than us and to suck it up for the night.
That was the last straw for my wife and she asked if we could just go home.
Made me so mad that this trip for my wife's birthday turned into a big problem(how do you recover from a lost night of sleep)  made the last 3 days not much fun.

reviews.author: BulaBula1
reviews.title: Horrible experience, would never return.
reviews.text:
I stayed here with my family in December. 
By the end of the trip, my husband was in bed 2 days with stomach cramps from the buffet, and I came down with a horrible cold, which I'm sure had something to do with the odd smell in our room, and the chemicals being used to cover up these smells.
On the plus side, I will say many of the workers meant well. And the staff at Coco's Beach, and throughout the beach, were attentive. Their beachfront was nice, and the view from our rooms were nice.  Finally, Mole restaurant staff made us feel special, and put out a lovely spread for us.

Here are a few of the problems I experienced:
1. Checking in took over an hour, and was a complete frenzy. Totally ill-equipped to handle the people checking in. They wound up giving out free shots of tequila to the crowds waiting in a huddle. 

2. Our room was in the central tower On night one, we wanted to go to sleep early, and their evening entertainment was BLARING from below. So so loud, shockingly loud. Our rooms were directly below 4th rate nightly entertainment. They were truly horrible performances. A D-rated Michael Jackson show dancing to Thriller is not what I'm looking for when I go to a resort in Mexico, and being 3 floors above the stage really sucked! After night one, we just made sure we were out of our rooms between 8-10 pm at night.

3. The food was truly horrible. Really sub-par. I didn't know you could make inedible guacamole and salsa, but now I know you can. My husband and I were excited to go to the airport to eat airport food when we left. Look at some of the reviewers food photos.

4. And the service--at Enso in particular--was some of the worst I've ever experienced. Really clueless--like they pulled someone off janitorial duty and had them start waiting on tables. All of the male waiters wore hair nets at the buffet at Naos....odd.

5. The perfume scent they spray throughout the hotel and elevators was so cloying. I read about this on Trip Advisor before I stayed here, but just shrugged it off, I've smelled scents at hotels before. This one was gag-inducing.

6. Room smell & how management handles issues at this property.
There was a smell in the entryway of my room that smelled like a mix between nail polish remover and rubbing alcohol and I don't know what harsh smell you could include in the mix. I don't know what it was. At first, I thought it was chemicals that the maids were spraying in the room. My brother in law thought it was a spray they were putting in to cover up mildew in the a/c unit? On day 4 of our stay I asked the maids about it. They speak zero English and came back with a spray bottle of the scent that they spray in the elevators and sprayed in throughout my room. Day 5 they bring maintenance in who decide it’s a problem with the a/c and puts something in the filter. Day 6 the smell is still there, I wake up at 4 am with the smell so strong, I open the patio door all the way--in the meantime there's no screen--and take a sleeping pill to fall back asleep. At 9 am I go down to the front desk and ask them to send someone up to my room to check on the odor. I stay down at the beach the whole day. At 3 pm come back up to my room, and the stench is still there. No note, no message, nothing. Only when I called the wholesaler that I booked this trip through, was real attention given to this situation.

The manager Mario called my room. I tell Mario the situation, and he asks me about the smell--I told him, come up to my room. He says no, there's a chain of command, first housekeeping, then maintenance, and only after that does it become his issue. WHAT? I told him I already followed his chain of command. I couldn't believe he was saying this. Then a crowd of people come to my room; the 2 maintenance guys and 4 housekeepers. Spraying, dusting, mopping, spraying more. And then and only then will Mario come to my room. He says he doesn't smell anything so what's the problem? I tell him one of the problems I had is that I'd asked at 9 am to have someone check on my room. I come up at 3 and there is no message, nothing. He says they don't follow up with guests. They ask their staff to check on issues, but they don't then follow up with the guests. HUH?!?! He offers to have me move rooms, we were checking out the next day. OR offers a free $100 massage....FORGET IT.

Never again.

reviews.author: csp24
reviews.title: Look Elsewhere
reviews.text:
After travelling around USA and Mexico from Australia, it is obvious people in this part of the world are easily pleased. There is no way some of the rooms in this resort would warrant such a high Trip Advisor rating, so I will assume it comes down the restaurants, alcohol and location. 

Our stay at Paradisus was unique in the fact it started off terribly and ended positively. We were re accommodated due to construction taking place at ME Cancun Resort. Upon checking in to Paradisus, we were given a terrible room with two twin beds (we are a couple). The room was dated and even had light fixtures falling off the walls. We paid nearly $1000 USD for three nights so we really expected more, and were often mistaken/dismissed for being part of a large tour group which we were not. The cleaners came to push the two beds together and overlap the sheets, resulting in a terrible nights sleep in addition to a pulsating white fire alarm light directly above the bed adding to our discomfort! 

After much deliberation back at reception, and persistence on our part, we were finally upgraded to a better room for our second and third nights. This new room was in the Royal Service tower and was a trillion times nicer. Perhaps recently renovated. 

The restaurants at Paradisus were very good, and service was great. However you are expected to wake up at 7am to book early, as two restaurants were completely booked out. When we were dining at these "fully booked" restaurants, we noticed a large number of empty tables, especially at Mole Restaurant. Ridiculous! 

My advice: take considerable note as to which room type you are booking, as there is a SIGNIFICANT difference.

reviews.author: Karen C
reviews.title: Pésimo servicio
reviews.text: Se tienen que buscar a los meseros para que te atiendan, hay un trato sumamente diferente con personas extranjeras cuando el costo por la habitación es exactamente el mismo y no encuentro razón alguna para el trato

reviews.author: aju12334
reviews.title: Preis/ Leistung miserabel
reviews.text:
Vorsicht! Die tolle Beschreibung lässt zu viel erwarten. 
Ich habe für sieben Tage 5000€ (eine Person mit Kind ) bezahlt nur Hotel ohne Flug. 

Vorort kamen nochmal 150€/ Tag für "Kinderbetreuung " und Service dazu. 

Von der Betreuung ist nicht viel zu merken. An jeder Ecke lauern extra kosten. 
Das Hotel ist alt. Es stinkt selbst in der Eingangszone nach Schimmel. Die Zimmer sind alt, stinkend. Die Klimaanlage ist so laut das man kaum schlafen kann. Verzehr von Speisen und Getränken am Strand kostenpflichtig.  Service am Pool ist kein Service. 

Die Hotelangestellten sind sehr bemüht aber können nur aus dem etwas machen was vorhanden ist.. das ist zwar viel, aber alles alt und im schlechten Zustand.  Ergo viel schlechtes ist noch schlechter.

Es wäre ok wenn das Hotel mit 3 Sternen beschrieben gewesen wäre aber für den Preis und 5 Sterne erwartet man einfach was anderen und hinzu kommt das die Beschreibung bei ThomasCook zu viel versprochen hat. Ich empfinde es als Täuschung denn das ist mir mit ThomasCook schon mehrfach passiert.

reviews.author: 671nat
reviews.title: paradisus , not a paradise
reviews.text: although the location is amazing and restaurants are very good, overall we had a terrible experience. There was some private event scheduled(powerdisus) and there were crew working in front of our door for 3 days non stop for setting that up. we had trouble getting in and out especially with a toddler and a stroller. a portion of beach was also cordoned off for the set up of the event. we should have gone somewhere else , for some peace and quiet.

reviews.author: Golnar L
reviews.title: Would Not Plan Wedding Here!
reviews.text:
Anyone thinking about having their wedding at Paradisus Cancun.

We just came back a couple days ago from having our wedding at Paradisus Cancun Resort and I felt as if I needed to share our experience for anyone who is planning on doing the same.  The experience and service is not what I expected compared to other destination weddings that we have attended. It was clear from the moment we checked into the resort that none of the staff cared to make the time memorable for you.  The wedding and resort were great. The pre and post behavior by hotel staff ruined the experience. We brought 100 people to resort and spent close to $30k for this event. 

-No one greeted or congratulated us in the 10 days we stayed at this property.
-When we asked for an upgrade on our room to have more space for wedding preparation, we were told there are no other rooms available. Yet, two of our guests were upgraded to suites hours after because their rooms were not ready when they arrived at the hotel for a couple hours. Which made no sense. 
-After paying for our entire wedding during the first meeting with our wedding coordinator Donavan. We were told that the hotel could not find our initial $4300 deposit that we paid to their Miami office in May. We supplied them with credit card statements clearly stating the charges and were told that wasn’t good enough. That they wanted the confirmation code that was given to us over the phone by their office when we made the payment.  They insisted that I pay this amount again or supply them with their confirmation code, or they couldn’t move forward with the wedding. I was shocked that they would tell me this 2 days before the wedding and once my 100 guests arrived to the hotel. If they were missing anything, they should have contacted me while I was home and not at resort.  I spent over 10 hours on the phone with my credit card company tracing the account the payment was sent to. This is something that their accounting team should have taken care of, and not me. The next day while on an excursion with my family and friends the other wedding coordinator Melina called me 6 times in 4 hours to discuss the issue. Mind you I told her that were were not on the property and that I would contact her when we returned.  At this point I was completely agitated and requested to speak to the hotel manager. This never happened. Instead I received a bottle of champagne and 3 strawberries. They treated us like we were trying to rip them off the entire time. 
- Our wedding coordinator Donavan made a dinner reservation with the food and beverage manager at Naos for 30 people. When we arrived, we were told that this wasn’t guaranteed and that there wasn’t space for us. We basically argued for 15 minutes, before one of the other servers came and told us that it was clear they just dropped the ball and forgot about our party. 
- There was no cocktail hour set up even though it was included in our package. We were told it was because they were expecting rain and couldn’t set up outside. There were no alternate plans. Our guests ended up going to pool bar for drinks after ceremony. Why were we charged for something we never received? If weather is a factor then they should have a back up plan like every other hotel.
-Our flowers were delivered 2.5 hours late by the hotel vendor Alquimia. This delayed our photos and time with photographer.
- After I checked out of hotel, this is 6 days after the wedding. I was stopped/ basically confronted by one of the front desk workers in front of one of my guests stating that I had not paid for my wedding and that I still owed money. Naturally I got upset asked to speak to hotel manager. A few minutes later the front desk person came back said oh sorry our mistake. I immediately called the wedding coordinator group and spoke to Melina. She stated that she would have her manager Pilar call me back. This never happened. 

This is the short version, 1/3 of the things that happened during our 10 day stay and wedding at Paradisus Cancun. I think that Donavan our coordinator really tried hard to help me have a good wedding. However, I would have expected that either the hotel or wedding department manager Pilar would have taken 1 minute to call or meet with me considering that I requested to speak to them several times, and the repeated failures on their side. You really can’t expect your team to care about guests and experience if you don’t. 

A little less than a year ago, my cousin got married at a Barcelo property and spent half the amount of money we did. The staff made one little mistake and the hotel manager immediately contacted her and apologized in person on their behalf.  Given the number of people we brought to the Paradisus and money spent, I would have expected a call or at least an email from a manager acknowledging we were at the property.

It’s a lovely hotel for guests or a holiday stay, but I wouldn’t plan my wedding or event here if you’re expecting good service. Our guests that had the royal service were treated better than the bride and groom who brought all the guests there. 

Again, I think it's lovely hotel if we were on vacation, but they failed and continued failing throughout our event planning and stay.

reviews.author: lostpenguine1011
reviews.title: First morning here...not impressed so far
reviews.text:
This is my husbands and my 5 year wedding anniversary and we frequent all inclusive hotels. Let's start with check in... the bell hop was super friendly and our first thought was "this is going to be amazing" then check in happened... the couple in front of us got offered drinks but we didn't, we waited in line for what seemed like ever and then we're rushed through getting our room. We were not asked if we wanted an upgrade or offered an upgrade like every other person who has reviewed this hotel and we were not given our resort credit so i had to go down later and ask how it worked... its not resort credit, its coupons where you have to spend more money to use them.Nothing about the hotel was explained (it's rather large). 

When we got to our room there were rose petals on our bed which was so sweet. We changed and freshened up (the bathroom has a small step up to it which I have stubbed my toe on, fell and my husband has also miss stepped and fallen from this sneaky step). When we got downstairs everything was closed, there were no towels and not one person asked to help us or get a drink. We were brought a bottle of champagne in the evening but it was late and we were tired and had no idea it was coming so we were both had to throw cloths on quickly as the gentlemen kept knocking at the door. I would have rather it just been waiting in our room upon arrival as we didn't open it because we were so tired. Then about 40 min later the maid service started knocking to see if we needed towels and we just wanted to rest.

We went into the blue agave restaurant for some food and waited 40 min for our tacos... not sure why when everyone around us was getting their food.

This morning I have been by the pool for an hour and not one person has asked if we would like a drink... I have never been to a resort that is this hard to find someone to get you a drink. The coupon book...or umm resort credit as it is advertised (wish they would have just said it was coupons and not a resort credit. The Palace resorts have real credit and they are amazing). Anyway the coupon book is  joke. You probably won't use any of them as I was just told the bali are 160 a day and you can only use 1 coupon of 20.00 off. I was so looking forward to the Bali beds, they are my favorite at most resorts.

So here I am, morning 1 of a vacation and I feel lied to, misinformed, and well, like the hotel doesn't care about my buisness. Ohh and apparently there are supposed to be beach bags in the rooms you can use during your stay... our room doesn't have one.

In short, if your not in the royal section don't stay at this hotel. The palace resort is just down the way and you will be treated like royalty no matter how you booked or what room your in. 

I'm still hopeful this trip gets better though, at least I'm on a beach in the sun.

reviews.author: ralmel519
reviews.title: What a dump of a property, and atrocious front-desk service
reviews.text:
The hotel stinks... I mean literally ... there is a food smell everywhere. But that is not the worst part. The customer service is absolutely atrocious.... I have never been treated worse anywhere in the world. And I travel a lot. These guys need to really shape up. 
Their website also stinks...This time figuratively. of course. Extremely poor English website, very misleading in terms of the offers suggested, and the front desk staff do not honor what is stated clearly as offered on their website. Will not be using any of Melia's hotels ever.
The only positive about this hotel is that the food is actually not bad.

reviews.author: livelarge2016
reviews.title: Poor Royal/Butler Service
reviews.text: This was my second trip to the Paradisus. The first time I would give it five stars.  This past trip in November was not so enjoyable. The butler service was not up to par from the first visit.  The wife and I were very upset and disappointed. Although the hotel and staff and grounds were great and beautiful. The Royal/Butler service was just not there.

reviews.author: J7322QAjesusg
reviews.title: Malo
reviews.text: Cuando llegamos había un grupo de jóvenes de una empresa que la verdad demeritó mucho la calidad del hotel. Creo que debería de ser más estricto pues uno busca descanso y paga esas cantidades para tener mejor vacación. Además la atención de muchos trabajadores fue muy descortés. Y para completar la baja calidad del hotel, el tener una zona clausurada enfrente no es nada bueno.

reviews.author: acharita
reviews.title: Muy regular
reviews.text:
El hotel ya está muy viejo! El servicio es bueno, la gente es amable pero nada más! 
El servicio de alberca para comida es excesivamente caro! Una bolsa de papas Sabritas chicas la cobran en 50 se me hace un robo!!! 
La verdad no sería un hotel el cual yo regresaría

reviews.author: Thiago M
reviews.title: Férias
reviews.text: Cancun é um lugar maravilhoso, mas o hotel Paradisus deixou a desejar. Na minha chegada já tive problemas com o quarto sujo, vou postar as fotos. Cabelos no chão do quarto e urina no chão do banheiro. Tive um problema com dinheiro também, certo dia fui ao cocobongo com 500 dólares no bolso do shorts e em meio ao dinheiro estava minha cédula de identidade. E então no outro dia mandei esse shorts para lavanderia e acabei me esquecendo de olhar os bolsos. Horas mais tarde pessoal do hotel retornou ao meu quarto devolver então as roupas que eu havia enviado para a lavanderia e juntos com essas estava a minha cédula de identidade. E então que me lembrei do dinheiro, e então entrei em contato com pessoal da segurança que me passou com a Sra Guadalupe que era a chefe do setor. Que no fim das contas não resolveu nada e meu ofereceu uma massagem no spa do hotel. Obviamente que não aceitei, pois eu queria apenas meu dinheiro que sumiu na lavanderia. O passeio em cancun foi maravilhoso mas a estádia no hotel foi péssima e eu não recomendo.

reviews.author: oscarfurfaro
reviews.title: Poor customer service
reviews.text: The hotel positions itself a a 5 star resort, but fails do resolve a most simple problem. We have been loyal customers of Paradisus brand for 5 years now, always choose them over another hotel in the Caribbean. Now will have to reconsider, and because of an stupid ignorance on behalf of the superwiser. We had an airport transfer booked to pick us up after the checkout and bring us to the airport. We came down at 10am, as we were told and stood by the door with our 3 carry-on luggages. Came over the bellboy, telling us to put our luggage into storage and go sit in the lobby area to be called when transfer arrives (pointed out exactly where). We tried to protest: the luggage was more then manageable and we had no problem waiting by the door. Apparently that was not an option, so we went. Half an hour later I got alarmed, no transfer. Went to the concierge to inquire - they seemed absolutely indifferent, put me the transportation company on the phone, where I was told: the driver came at 10.05, bell boy told him no ones here to be picked up and the driver left. And that now we need to take a taxi on our own. I went to the check-in stand, explained the situation. They went to look for someone in charge. The manager came out saying that the bellboy looked for us and could not find us! We were the only family leaving at that moment, where was he looking?! We said that no one came looking, however the manager made it clear - if her employee said so - that has to be the truth, no matter what we were saying. I asked if there is a car who can take us to the airport. Apparently, the huge resort as they are has no transportation, at all. And after we have prepaid the transfer we now have to take the taxi. I told them it was their fault we were not picked up so they have to find the solution. The manager, Guadalupe, was absolutely indifferent and at times plain rude. We were late for the flight, so we took a taxi and with that left. I understand that problems do happen, but resolve them as a high class resort you pretend to be when you solicit to become a club member. That was not a solution.

reviews.author: Matilda S
reviews.title: Necesita mantenimiento
reviews.text: Este hotel se encuentra en muy buena ubicacción solo que está algo descuidado y necesitaria un mejor servicio en toso los aspectos, por lo demas normal, precio asequible y buen desayuno, servicio de habitaciones nulo.

reviews.author: C9838ASjosea

reviews.author: ylove02
reviews.title: rude service.
reviews.text: i had my  wedding there and my wedding planner, i don't know if she was new or just didn't care, but there was a huge lack of communication. she always managed to find me when i needed to make a payment but i could never seem to find her. and no im not a bridezilla! when your guest come up to you to tell you she is on her phone and not attending there is a problem. when you are told your all white party   will have  things you paid for and don't it is a problem. when you give her a head count and there are still chairs missing for the wedding ceremony its a problem and when you should be directing  people to where the cocktail hour will be but instead again you are on your phone (pointed out to me by many guest)  its a HUGE problem. my maid of honor even brought some of my fustrations to her attention at  the white party bbq and yet at the wedding you are on your phone the whole time. this hotel isn't cheap i spent a lot of money, my wedding party consisted of 50 people not a small party of 10. i have called and emailed and have yet to hear anything from them. (my wedding was july 1st) ylove02@gmail

reviews.author: 773maegant

reviews.author: Moreliney78
reviews.title: El hotel esta excelente el servicio también mi calificación es malo porque son muy pocos y súper pequeños los restaurant
reviews.text: Jamás pudinos comer en dos de los restaurantes ya que son con reservación y desde las 7 de la mañana ya estaba llenos.. reviews.author: jtiran
reviews.title: Bad choice: Search for a better hotel for your trip....!!!
reviews.text: Overall service is limited. Everybody gives you a warming welcome, but are unable to deliver great service. It would seem employees are not so happy to work here, they appear over exhausted, but they still try to help. Rooms are old, beds not too comfy, TV and cable has many issues like bad image, lost signal, etc... and they are unable to fix it. Security boxes inside the rooms extremely old and don´t work properly. Food is average as also drinks, not good relation between what you pay and what you get. The best part is the beach as with any other hotel in Cancun. And don´t even dream in trying to speak to the manager, he or she will never show up or work to make your stay improve. We left several messages to address our problems, we never received any kind of contact back Even though there is great people working here, management is terrible.

reviews.author: christopherlavin
reviews.title: Service not as it has been in the past
reviews.text:
Been going to the Paradisus for the past 20 years started out as the Gran Malia,
Service this year was no where near what it has been in the past. We had a personal concierge, Carlos, who was not easy to contact and did not return request so I am not really sure what he does. The spa was not clean, and the food by the pool was below average.Ice machines did not work, were locked or empty. Kids pool was not clean  If you go to the Paradisus  the service and staff are not up to the standard you would expect.

reviews.author: Chantalle B
reviews.title: Poor Front Desk Service
reviews.text:
We (kind of) stayed at Paradisus in an ocean view junior suite.  I wanted to give Paradisus a good review, but two encounters with the front desk left me with an overall bad impression of our stay. 

First, I will say that the staff in the restaurants, the nespresso bar, and pool side were always amazing and treated us wonderfully. We ate at Bana, Fuego, and Market Grill for our reserved dinners. Fuego was our favorite meal and was made all the better with service from Daniel and Gabrielle. Fuego is the seafood restaurant and all of our dishes we tried were amazing. Our second favorite was Market Grill, which is the Brazilian/Argentinian restaurant. Unfortunately, I don’t remember our main server, but all of the staff was really nice. There is no menu for Market Grill. They bring dishes around and ask you whether you would like some. In our opinion, the later dishes were tastier than the earlier ones, so try not to fill up on the earlier ones. Also, if you are a vegetarian, it would be difficult to eat here. The main dishes are different kinds of meat with some side dishes such as salad, rice & beans, and some vegetables. Lastly, is Bana. Bana is the sushi restaurant. Bana was good as well. It was a standard sushi restaurant, but was made better by our server, Claudio. 

On our first full day, we rented a cabana by the pool because we were too late to get chairs with an umbrella. When we signed for the cabana we were told that we were receiving a promotional price for celebrating a special occasion at the resort, which we were excited about. However, this later became a problem with the front desk (see below). Our day renting the cabana was really fun. The poolside server, David, was a hard worker and kept checking on us. 

Andres at the Nespresso Bar was an absolute joy. You could tell that he loved his job. He treated everyone with kindness and was genuinely happy. 

As for the front desk, unfortunately we had two bad encounters. The first was when tropical storm Earl blew in. The storm cracked our balcony sliding glass door completely across the bottom, slightly in the middle, and across the top. After maintenance checked it out, they thought it was best that we switch rooms. After waiting two hours for the whole ordeal and several calls to the front desk, someone was sent to give us our new room. The new room happened to be the room next door to us, but was two full size beds when our previous room was a king bed. They offered to put the beds together, but we didn’t want to fall in between the beds in the middle of the night and it was not what we paid for. We had to go to the front desk and they gave us an alternate room. However, the alternate room was not an ocean view, which is what we paid for. We went back to the front desk and the attendant refused to give us any accommodations (money back or services to make us for the loss) even though the majority of our stay would be in a room that faced their other pyramid building, not the ocean. 

The second encounter with the front desk was at check out. We had an early flight and checked out a little before 6:00 a.m. During checkout we had to pay for the cabana that we rented. The attendant ran my significant other’s card and it didn’t work. We thought that our bank put our cards on hold thinking it was fraud. Therefore, our only option was cash.  We had enough cash to pay for the cabana, but we did not have exact change. The attendant informed us that he did not have any change and could not give us any money back. Not only that, but they were charging us the full amount for the cabana, not the promotional price that was offered to us. When I informed that attendant about the promotional price, he said that he could not do anything about it because they didn’t give me a receipt! This is absurd because the front desk knows there is a promotional price – they were the ones that informed us about it! Therefore, we were stuck overpaying for a cabana because we didn’t receive the price we were guaranteed and the attendant didn’t have change for us to pay for the cabana!

Overall, based on the service I received from the front desk, I would not come back to Paradisus in any of their locations. Furthermore, I will be posting my review on any website that allows me to so I can warn other travellers about this ridiculousness. I’m not a person to complain about these things, but I did pay a substantial amount of money to go on vacation, not to be taken advantage of.

reviews.author: gilbop
reviews.title: Not What We Had Hoped
reviews.text:
My wife and I stayed at the Paradisus from July 4 – 11.  Unfortunately, the weather was quite hot and very humid, which limited our beach activities, leaving us to the hotel and its amenities.  I had hoped to return to write a glowing review of what initially appeared, by other Trip Advisor reviews, to be a perfect oasis.  It was far from it, unfortunately.
We had upgraded to the Royal Service, which entitled us to a “personal butler”, who was to attend to our needs and make all of our dinner reservations.  This was a HUGE failure.  Our butler, Cesar, never once got our reservations correct, never saw to it that our room was prepared correctly, and was Missing in Action for most of the vacation.  Hardly worth the $$$ upgrade.  On our first day, I left a tip for Housekeeping on the bed.  When we returned to our room at 3:30 p.m., the room had still not been made up and the money was gone.  I reported immediately to the Royal Service front desk, who contacted Security.  Security came and spoke to us and said they would return in five minutes to ask us additional questions.  After waiting for a half hour, we returned to the room and, after 6 more days, were never contacted.  
The hotel itself is very large and difficult to navigate, but the views were quite spectacular and it was very clean.  The rooms were large and the bed was quite comfortable. The highlights of the trip were the wait staff who went above and beyond to make our stay enjoyable.  Special praise to Marco in the Naos Restaurant, who greeted us warmly by name every morning and saw to all of our needs; to Daniel, the manager in the Mole Restaurant, who took over our dinner reservation issues from our “butler”, fixing a variety of errors, treating us warmly and respectfully, and providing the best food of any of the restaurants.  Manuel from the Swim-Up Bar made the best Cadillac Margaritas!
(There is no logic whatsoever for having the Swim-Up Bar in the Family Pool and not in the Adult Pool.  Little children took up the majority of bar stools.  The adults were drinking, cavorting, and swearing around the children and the kids were splashing all over everyone trying to relax and enjoy an adult beverage.)
We have been to Cancun at least 8 times, staying at a variety of hotels.  We are least likely to return to this one.

reviews.author: KatieMay822
reviews.title: Paradisus, My Time All Inclusive
reviews.text: Check-In process was horrendous took a very long time for something that should be easy and quick when you have reservations.  All common areas of the hotel do not have air condition!!!  Room service takes a long time 1 to 1 ½ hours. Housekeeping is inconsistent with leaving enough clean towels in the room.  Had to call more then once.  Air condition in room didn't work at times.  Nowhere refreshing to cool off besides the  Carribbean Sea.  Even the pool water is warm.  Lots of stairs without safety handrails,  very dangerous, flooring slippery in spots at time.  I did like the fact that all the flooring was tile but there should be railings especially in the middle of the wide staircases.  I witnessed a few people wipe out,  thank god no serious injuries.  Carpet in this hotel would be just a Petri dish for germs!!!  Thank god there was no carpeting!!!!  There are a lot of plants in the center of the hotel with vines hanging down from all the floors above;  I was told this is why there is no air condition inside the facility.  There are no flowers on these plants, they were pretty but I feel a different decor with air condition would do this hotel/resort better. Alcohol drinks were watered down.  When I ordered my drink with double alcohol that's when it tasted like the drink I ordered.  I'm not a drinker so when I drink 2-3 frozen strawberry margaritas and do not feel the slightest buzz I think the drinks were watered down.  The wait staff in all the restaurants where very helpful and pleasant.  The spa was nice, although the therapy pool had some components not working, also the steam room and sauna were out of order.  My massage was wonderful!  When I went to the changing room my clothing was soiled with wet paint.  They shouldn't be doing maintenance during spa operating hours.  No signs were posted that the changing room had just been painted.  The spa staff scrubbed the paint off my clothes and sent my clothing out to be laundered free of charge.  It was just an inconvenience one shouldn't have to deal with on vacation.  I wouldn't stay there again unless this hotel has an entire HVAC overhaul!!!

reviews.author: OscarStanislavsky
reviews.title: Muy mal servicio
reviews.text:
En el Paradisus Cancún, hemos tenido una mala experiencia, la reservación la realizó la Empresa en que trabajo, para que pueda descansar, el mantenimiento de las habitaciones es deficiente, en una tormenta se nos inundó la habitación, cuatro veces tuve que llamar a la telefonista diciendo lo que pasaba, para que manden alguien a ver, se nos mojaron las maletas con la ropa dentro, estaban en el closet, como se mojaron con agua sucia, hubiera correspondido que la laven y planchen, no lo hicieron, solo las secaron, y entregaron todo arrugado con olor a agua sucia, cuando reclame, contestaron con evasivas, que no las lavaron por qué tenían miedo que destiñan, esto no lo puede contestar un hotel con lavandería, pedimos cambio de habitación, y nos mandaban a una habitación donde caía agua de los techos del pasillo, entonces nos quedamos donde estábamos, dos veces tuve que pedir cambio del control remoto del televisor, el lavabo estaba tapado, y la taza del baño perdía agua, no nos explicaron a que restaurante teníamos derecho, cuando volví a México, el director de la Empresa al ver lo que nos pasó, llamó al hotel para quejarse, y nunca le dieron respuesta.
Fue una situación muy lamentable, me extraña que la cadena Meliá haya caído tan bajo.

reviews.author: David P
reviews.title: Mr David Palmer
reviews.text: The rooms were in terrible shape. I came back from beach maintenance was at my door said they had to do some work I told them I wanted to take shower. They told me they had to run a cable right now. So I had to wait for them. Also It took at least 30 minutes to get a beer at the pool.

reviews.author: abksy
reviews.title: Worst stay ever !
reviews.text:
I am in the hotel at the moment 
We are a family of 16 we booked 6 family concierge room let me describe every aspect 
1- rooms 
Are extremely run down average cleaning 
2- hotel interior 
Is full of plants for that it is extremely humid so sitting or walking in the hotel is like walking outdoors
3- food
Quality is below average breakfast is a torturing process it takes you 30 mints standing for an omelet  quality of food from bakery to cheeses are below expectations 
I tried checking out the management refused for reservation polices , compensation wasn't even in consideration from the management !
Bottom line this is a 3/2 stars hotel 
For the rooms I booked I thought I will have a beach cabana but that was not the case I have to pay 160$ every day my room fridge isn't working , AC has aloud sound . 
I crossed the ocean to visit Cancun but unfortunately ,This hotel changed my perspective of cancun

reviews.author: Farshidgoleh
reviews.title: Don't get fooled with their bogus photos and bogus good reviews! I honestly would not recommend this hotel !!!!
reviews.text: I hate to give negative reviews but I have to do it. We stayed a week in Paradisus Cancun with my family and a large group of friends. The beach was beautiful, pool was okay but I have seen better! The moment we stepped into the hotel the experience was mediocre at best. Our room wasn't ready at the promised time. The rooms were very small and outdated, light switches were broken (Nothing as seen in the photos!!) The beds are super small and uncomfortable and pillows are super flat! My room bathroom had water leaks from the ceiling directly above the toilet. Our bathroom had only one sink that wouldn't drain well! Our room A/C was too loud! The hotel facilities were old and had several severe leaks including the ceiling collapsing near us where we were sitting in the buffet dinning area! The main hotel area was not air conditioned! (hottest lobby ever!) I am not big on food but the food quality and selection was mediocre.The staff were friendly but unable to answer simple questions and it felt like they just wanted tips all the time. The hotel was boring and very non-entertaining. There was not much to do in the evening. There was no night shows! There are no activities for kids. They really need activities around the pool areas! (pool areas was just boring!) No snack bars were available and the buffet restaurant took 1.5 hours between breakfast and lunch. It was all-inclusive but there were extras they wanted to sell you. They show photos of cabanas in their website but you had to pay $100 to get a cabana at the beach or pool! You had to buy a bottle of wine or a cuban cigar or order $20 hookah just to sit on a couch at the Coco's bar (the ONLY bar being opened outside the lobby area!!) There was no sport activities or table games. They only had one pool table but you had to be a member of hotel chain time sharing program to use it! Overall I give it a 2.5 star hotel at the best. This hotel is fairly expensive and I did not see the value. It's really boring, old and nothing to get excited about. Just not what we expected! I would not recommend this hotel specially to a younger crowd! I would not stay here again. Too many better choices in Cancun!!

reviews.author: alfredo c
reviews.title: No volveria
reviews.text: Este es el tercer hotel que visito en mexico y el que menos me gusto, tenia falencias como por ejemplo goteras de los aires acondicionados, mucha gente se resfalo en la piscina por no tener antideslizantes. Muy baja variedad de comida.

reviews.author: Armando M
reviews.title: Poor service and poor quality of food
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful.  Entertainment is plentiful especially for kids.   Service and food quality has dropped tremendously from our last visit  a year ago.  Making a reservation on any of the restaurants was a terrible experience.  Room quality is very poor.  Appliances don't work well.

reviews.author: Solsearch1
reviews.title: Customer Services
reviews.text: This is my 9th time in Cancun, and this hotel is the worst one I've ever stayed at.  The head waiter in the buffet disrespected our kids and I didn't found out till the next day when he tried to disrespect me and my group.  I really don't know what his issue is with Asians but he expects us to know how everything works at this hotel.  There are always two sides to the story, so I just want to get to the point with the situation.  He can just ask the hostess to see if she let us in and then confront us, but NOOO, this guy just came over and tried to throw us out of our table.  My point is the hostess showed us our table and he came over and tried to make us leave.  I'm writing this review at four o'clock in the morning on my vacation because of how mad I was and lost my sleep over the incident.  To the management team, if you're reading this, I don't want your apology because it is too late.  I believe the staff needs to be trained to prevent any incidents from happening in the first place.  This hotel is more focus on the Concierge upgrade services.  If you don't want to pay for the services , you are a second class in this hotel.  You should be first class when you are on vacation especially in Cancun....

reviews.author: JGen_can
reviews.title: Not worth the Money you pay for.
reviews.text: Nice property. Could not take the harrassement from Guest service to attend their presentation to sell vacation. Ask one for directions and they will give a talk about selling, even if you said youre not interested and you already heard the talk. Avoid them as much as possible. Food in Naos was good but they need to improve sanitation. Like using disinfectant to wipe down tables. Saw workers using same rag to clean tables for eating and food surfaces to serve food in buffet. Also, my first chicken meal had cling wrap piece in it and my rice had blond hair. Mexican entertainment night was great as well as the Lex astronomy activity. No mosquitoes in the hotel. They have smokers for mosquitoes all around which is great! Enso restaurant needs improvement. Then you are in mexico so better stick to the national cuisine. They also need more chairs or daybeds along the beach. And showers by the beach were barely working. Airconditioning in our room didnt go down 25C . Complained 3 times and was checked 2 times and nothing happened. Workers seemed knowledgeable but didnt really pinpoint the prob. No compensation was given. Concierge was encouraging us to checkout at 8am to avoid long lines. This is bullcrap. They just want to free up your room which is an inconvenience. All in all... wont come back here.

reviews.author: danvK6146YI
reviews.title: Bad experience leaving. Treated like crap.
reviews.text: My daughter and I had found a cell phone on the beach the second night of our stay. There was no one at the front desk to turn it in. We called security . They did nothing so we turned it in the following morning . Then two days later at check out the front desk had accused us of stealing the cell phone and we were treated like crap the whole time at check out. We had a later flight and they told us we could use  guest lounge to shower and freshen up before we left as we had to check out 6 hours before our flight . Then they shoved my wife , 8 year old daughter and I in a locker room to shower with other people. We spent good money and the trip was good until the day of check out and it ruined the whole experience.

reviews.author: Michele000
reviews.title: Ehhh, expected more!
reviews.text: Didn't feel pampered. Didn't like how I had to ask for things that I was supposed to just get. Service wasn't above and beyond. Drinks were good, appetizers were good at restaurant near pool. Room service was good, also.

reviews.author: HectorRG
reviews.title: Vacaciones con olor a buffet!
reviews.text:
Sin duda el hotel ya tiene sus años y lo han mantenido en buen estado, el servicio que los anfitriones te dan es bueno a medias, nada que destacar, eso si, todos muy saludadores, la decoración de las plantas es muy buena por dentro, pero las plantas del exterior, de los balcones  malísimas, secas y uno tratando de tomar la foto con vista al mar pero sin que salgan las plantas... 

Al llegar al hotel te recibe el olor del aroma del hotel, pero mas adentro, el olor a fritangas y huevo te acompaña, abres la puerta de tu cuarto hacia el pasillo y huele, abres el balcón con vista al mar y ese olor a huevo característico del desayuno te acompaña y empaña la gran vista que tiene. La comida y limpieza en el NAOS nada que resaltar, yo diría que muy mala, la muchacha de los omeletes muy veloz, pero el chavo de la otra estación super leeeento,  los demás restaurantes siempre están llenos,  no puedes reservar y las mesas están siempre vacías.. Hay que insistir mucho... Y la comida ni tan buena...

Los show muy sin sabor, nada interesantes y el lugar en que los presentan bar avenue, supe incomodo, muy reducido. Continuare mi búsqueda del buen hotel familiar donde la limpieza, atención y servicios tengan un buen equilibrio para viajar en familia. No volvería, no hubo nada que me diera las ganas de regresar..

Del cuarto, excelente presión de agua, el tipo de regadera, los suministros de baño, el frigobar con refrescos y cervezas, se nos metió el agua de lluvia  y rápido lo solucionaron.

Pésimas almohadas, las camas ya les toca cambio... En mi cuarto faltaba un sillón y una mesita que estaba en reparación.

 Recomendable: el suchi del Bana, el Café de Nespresso, las salsas de los tacos del restaurant a lado de el Mole, la increíble playa....

La playa es la que no tiene abuela, las mas bella del mundo... 

Y no te mojes después de las 5 de la tarde por que ya no hay toallas!

reviews.author: K3298IPsteve
reviews.title: Second trip this year and disappointed.
reviews.text: We have such conflict writing an unfavorable review, but are compelled to share.  We spent a delightful stay at Paradisus in January as our review reflected.  Again last week we were not disappointed by service, facilities, food, or staff; however, I tried to express my concerns about a Bedbug infestation in our room, and was pretty much blown off at the check-out desk.  Unfortunately, this is not our first experience with these creatures while traveling in the Caribbean, and discarding clothes, luggage, and sundries wasn't an exciting prospect in revisiting that experience. I mistakenly believed that the hotel manager would be interested in our plight but he evidently was busy with another client.  I'm really disappointed!

reviews.author: mary b
reviews.title: I would not stay here again.
reviews.text: I could not wait to go.  I have never been to an all inclusive but have cruised a few times.  I would have rather gone cruising.  The food was not very good and the drinks did not have any alcohol in them.  There was not much to do in the evening at the resort.  I wish they would have had a band or something out by the pool but the pool closed early and the entertainment they had in the resort was very non-entertaining.

reviews.author: ramy s
reviews.title: Poor Service
reviews.text: This is our second visit to Cancun.. But our first visit last year was much better.. Poor service for the price we paid.. Most of the staff not friendly and they don't smile.. Have to wait forever till somebody shows up to get out order.. Not coming back next year for sure to Paradisus

reviews.author: 598lorenzov
reviews.title: Not the greatest
reviews.text: This was supposed to be our anniversary trip but did not go well. Bed was not very comfortable. Bali bed management was terrible and wanted to charge full proving for 1.5 hrs. Beverages were not cold!

reviews.author: Michelle M
reviews.title: Very average
reviews.text: We went with 25 people last year for my daughters high school graduation (all family)  anyway, we opted to get the upgraded family suite and butler.  Thank goodness we did otherwise we probably would of never gotten a reservation at the rest.  Our room was fine but many people we were with had a/c units not working and missing furniture from their rooms.  The food was ok at best it all tasted the same for the most part.  There are no activities for kids.  It wasn't the worst place I've ever stayed but I would not book again it was fairly expensive and I did not see the value.  Oh and by the way we never saw our butler.  We did however use the concierge office.

reviews.author: Anna P
reviews.title: Not a paradisus level of experience
reviews.text:
We recently returned from a week-long stay at this resort.
We travel as group of 8 adults and 8 kids ranging from 4 to 9 y.o.
It was our 5th stay at Paradisus resorts. We loved our previous 4 stays at Paradisus Esmeralda in Riviera Maya but decided to try this location. HUGE mistake.
Our whole experience wasn't comparable to the prior Paradisus stays experience.
This includes amenities, food and service.

Hotel:
A very old building.
Some parts of hotel look like they are falling apart.
Every day throughout the stay there were towels in the hallway on our floor since water was dripping from the ceiling and there was a pool of water on the floor.

One day as I was bathing the kids, water just stopped. There was NO water at all for about 10 minutes (you can only imagine screaming of kids with shampoo in hair and on the face). Then finally HOT water started running. And finally (after I was able to wash off faces with bottle water), water supply was restored. it was explained to us that since it is an old building "piping problems are to be expected"

Bathrooms are pretty filthy/old as well. There were cracks in the sink. And moldy patches on walls and ceiling. Paint peeling from walls and ceiling as well

Rooms
VERY small. There was barely enough space for the rollaway bed for the kids. No sofa. Just one armchair.
No furniture on balcony as well
Very uncomfortable mattresses and pillows. My husbnad who never gets back pain woke up every morning with back pain that required Advil.

Kids experience
All I can say is that it is NOT a kid friendly place
There are so many levels/staircases that you just can't get anywhere with a stroller.
Our kids used to love kids club at the other Paradisus resort.
They didn't care for it here. They wouldn't go during the day and it was a struggle to get them to go in the evenings. Besides kids club which closes at 8:45! That means that you can't really have an adult dinner and have to leave in the middle to pick up the kids.

On the first day we took kids there we were informed that while dinner was on the program they were not going to feed our kids dinner since we didn't make reservations in advance. They actually fed all other kids while our kids were sitting and watching.
They wouldn't let us bring food or order food because it is against policies!

Service
It is just not a 5 star hotel
And you feel it everywhere.
Even though there are no towel cards, they let you have one towel per person only.
Who cares if your towel got wet! In that case you have to beg and explain why you need a replacement.

On the check in day I had to call 6 times to request a rollaway bed for my kid. Nothing happened till I went to front desk at 10 pm and raised hell.
 
It also took multiple calls to make sure we have 4 towels in the room so that each of us could have a towel.

Bars
Very few and very slow.
One of the lobby ones opens at 10 pm only (prior to that it is used for actors who perform in shows to change!)
The pool one is crowed and very slow as well even if you tip generously.
Takes up to 20 mins to get a drink
There is also a bar at the beach but we were asked to order something at $75 or more to be allowed to seat there!

Food
Pretty good buffet
Restaurants are very difficult to get a reservation at since they are tiny
There is no feel of a sitdown restaurant - feels like a shabby dining room with nicer food selection (furniture is all scratched and leather peeling)

Beach
Very close to the hotel which. Is a plus
Beautiful
No problem getting a shade
Very strong waves throughout our stay

To summarize, it may be a good hotel for young adult couples or for people who haven't experienced anything better.
But it doesn't live up to Paradisus/Melia standarts.
Will never go back to this particular location.

reviews.author: Carla G
reviews.title: So Sad..Not what we were expecting
reviews.text: Not at all what we were expecting.  The hotel itself is nice and clean, rooms are spacious  What I am stuggling with is the lack of consistency with their service practices.  To start, the hotel was clearly not at full capacity.  We had asked for adjoining rooms, the only ones they had required an upgrade..so we paid for the upgrade.  The front desk took American dollars for this..nowhere else in the resort did they take American dollars except for tipping.  Getting change was challenging the first day we asked 3 different staff members and finally got one to make change.  From then on, we were always told that they didn't have it..We were looking tip their waiters, pool staff, etc.  On the last day the concierge opened up a drawer at the front desk (which is where we went to ask on several occasions) and had a large roll of American dollars.  Our second issue was the dinner reservations.  As I mentioned it was clear that the hotel was not at full capacity, yet when we called for a reservation we were always told that the restaurant was booked until later in the evening.  On our second day, I received a call from a staff member asking me about our stay.  I indicated that we were frustrated with the lack of ability to secure a reservation at the restaurants.  She said she would call back when they opened at 6:00 to see if there were any cancellations.  We waited until 6:30 and did not receive a call back, and when we went the the restaurant it was empty..not a table was in use.  We then asked the hostess if we could have dinner there.  She informed us that they were booked for the evening..so we said that surely there must be cancellations, since there were empty tables everywhere..she gave us a table and we had a very enjoyable meal with a nice waiter by the name of Roberto.  This happened again at the last night.  We went to the Brazilian restaurant and we were told they were booked.  In the hour that we were there for dinner there were no less than 6 tables of 4 empty, a few larger and a few tables of 2 empty..so why give your guests such a hard time.  It seemed like although the restaurants were not full they were always hesitant to give a seat to someone else..trust me when I say no one showed up looking for their reservation.  My thought was either they don't have enough staff in the nicer restaurants or they want everyone to eat in the buffet area..because let's face it..that is where the leftovers from the restaurant go.  This was extremely frustrating.  My last concern and my final impression of the Paradisus was when we were leaving.  We did a late check out, due to our flight being changed.  We were in 2 rooms, but only needed one room for the late check out.  I had handled this through the reception area when we checked it.  (There is a charge for this too, $10.00 per person per hour).  When I went to check out of the later room, I was given a card and told that I needed to hand that to the doorman on the way out.  I gave the doorman the card.  Our taxi arrived late and as we got in the car, he came up to us to ask for the card.  I explained that I gave him the card.  He said he didn't have the card for the 2nd room, I told him that we were already checked out of that room and that they didn't give me a card for that room to hand to him.  Here we were 4 adults being treated like they had done something wrong.  His behavior towards us was reprehensible...he gave us a hard time and told the cab driver that he was not allowed to have us leave until he received the other card.  I don't understand the process here, but let me tell you this was extremely frustrating as I am unsure what he needed the card for, we had closed out the room.  In addition to having the card well before the cab driver came, if there was something that he needed he should have handled it then..not at the point of departure.  I'm sorry that I don't have his name, because they should be aware of how your staff treats your patrons and there is no way he should be on the front line.  I have been to Mexico several times..and have stayed at many different hotels, most notably the Hard Rock and the Beloved.. have always enjoyed my time, and never had a problem.   I have also stayed at the Paradisus in Puerto Rico (many years ago) and the Melia Tropicale in Punta Cana..I have never had such negative things to say about a resort until my stay here. This was horrible and left me with a bad taste.  Sadly, it was my friends 1st time to Mexico and she said she wouldn't come back.

reviews.author: AMIT P
reviews.title: Family Concierge Service not worth it
reviews.text:
We went for 4 days with a family concierge suite. The service level was not as expected as we were never able to easily get in touch with our assigned butler. For example on the first day we were early to get access to our room, but we were given a cell to get for them or us to get in touch with each other. They actually never notified us that our room was ready and we tried to contact the service desk four times without being able to get a connection (just a busy signal). We were given the room after we complained to the "manager" who said that it was our fault that we didn't call them. She accused us of not telling her the truth about not being able to connect, and then checked our assigned cell.
I showed her the calls and she just dismissed it. After we were given access to the room the butler was rude to me. I asked him to replace my cell because I wanted to see if another cell would work out better for us, and he yelled at me, 'Speak to me normally!'
This was our first impression. After that we would randomly pass by our butler or the manager throughout our stay and he ignored us. When we tried to reach him a couple other times he apparently would be gone for the day. I just think that if we are assigned a butler, we should probably know their schedule. And if we have a room ready to be accessed, especially on the first day, when people usually are tired from getting up way early to fly in for vacation, we should be notified.

Also I just want to mention we decided to come here because we stayed at the Level in Melia Caribe Tropical Punta Cana. The service and experience was fantastic and I am returning in July because we liked it so much. Its definitely recommended!

reviews.author: CHICAGO TRAVELER
reviews.title: Food and the room service is not worth the money!
reviews.text: I hate to give negative reviews but I have to do it. I go to cancun every year and I had a better experience at ME(Melia Hotel).First of all room 3332 has water leaking from the roof in the bathroom on directly above the toilet. I told the front desk about it and nothing was done. Second, we did not receive any face towels, call room service but they never came.Third, I called down to the front desk to ask where a microwave was at and they told me they would send someone to warm up my pizza that I Bought from Papa Johns (Paradisus uses hot dogs as their sausage on their pizza) and some guy either from room service or maintenance knocks on the door takes my pizza and never comes back with the pizza. I went down to the front desk to ask where my pizza was at and they made a couple of phone calls but couldn't figure out who took my pizza. One guy even laughed about it. Stayed 4 nights and the Food was not as good as hotel ME, breakfast was ok but the restaurants to me was like one of thoses all you can eat joints. Im from chicago so i do know what good food is.The pool and bar area was clean and vallet parking was pretty nice but besides that I would not stay here again. Also dont waste your time with the 90 minute seminar, they will promise you discounts for activities if you go but we did not receive anything but  waste of time especially when they are asking for $1700.00 a month to be a part of ""Melia Club"

reviews.author: Francisco S
reviews.title: Was not as good as I thought it would be
reviews.text:
Stayed from May 14-May 20. Resort is clean, spotless always smelling nice. People are Amazing. Workers are the hardest working and nicest people I ever met in my entire life. The food was OK. I felt like I was eating the same things everyday. Not much variety at buffet. Did not like the hindu food at their buffet. Their buffet Naos has a different theme every night. Hindu was one and it was awful and smelled pretty bad made me nauseous. The seafood buffet on weds. Was great. Fuego, bana and blue agave was our favorite. Sunset grill was awful. Room service was great and free. When we did not want to go down for breakfast they had it brought up to us which was great. Our check in was not smooth. We ended up checking into the room an hour late because they were still cleaning. Apparently the guy before us checked out late and did not advise the front desk. Front desk manager Francisco is first class and extremely professional, i can not thank him enough. Him and his staff and everyone else at the hotel can go to any hotel in the world and make it better. They are a very well trained staff and they are experts in hospitality. He made up the late check in by hooking up the bali bed for half price which was nice. The resort credits was very confusing. We thought we had $550 to spend in whatever but its just coupons worth $550. Each slip clearly says that the beds are for a certain price and does not specify it is 10$ off if you spend a certain amount. I know this because there are other slips that say if you spend a certain amount its 10$ off. I paid 40$ over for the bali bed($50 with the "discount").
