I tried to get them to give it for 10$ but they would not. Im very disappointed that other guests were able to get the bed for 10$ but the coupon did not apply for me. The room key did not work once so we had that fixed. Upon arrival every guest gets a schedule of when every restaurant is open and that schedule that was given must be outdated because there were times we wanted to go to certain places and it was closed. Another complain is the swim up bar and closes too early. Swim up bar closes at 6 and pool closes at 7. If i sign up for an all day excursion and i get back at 5:00 i have an hour to enjoy a drink and I have 2 hours to enjoy the pool. Pool should be open until 8 and the bar should be open until 8. At the earliest. Another complain was the service from the agents inside the hotel. BD TRAVEL  andrea and mikael were very rude and disrespectful to my wife. They represent that company poorly. You can buy excursion tickets for cheaper directly from the company online and you get more because there is no commission you need to pay. If you wanna go to senor frogs or coco bongos do it thru the website. Again, you get more and pAy less. Go to aquaworld for all water sports. Or book at hotel by pool area with Diego. Another complain was the ocean. Its beautiful and blue but the waves are too rough. Couldn't even go in the water for more than 5minutes. But thats not the hotels fault. The ocean is too dangerous for kids but maybe its more calm in different months? Another complain is that it is way too hot in the hotel and in the room. The ac is poor. Could barely sleep at night. Was sweating entire time. Another complain is the lack of space for the shows at night. Its disrespectful to the performers who do a great job and uncomfortable for patrons.   Over all. Beautiful hotel even better staff. But i would not stay here again. I dont feel i got my money worth because of all my complaints. I expected more. But the staff was amazing. The waiters are hard working and super friendly and so is all the other staff. I do not recommend this hotel to other people based on there was more cons than pros. 

Pros: 
Blue water nice to look at... (But cant swim in it to rough ????)
Free safe
Free semi working wifi
Amazing friendly hard working staff 
Clean 
Smells nice 
Close to airport

Cons: 
allows smoking at pool wouldnt bring my kids around that trash
Pool closes early
Poor resort credit usage and clarity
Poor AC 
Restaurants closed often does not correlate with schedule
Sunset grill (pool rest.) is awful 
Can't swim in rough ocean 
Poor space for shows 
Pool closes too early 
Swim bar closes too early
Key did not work(common theme among guests)

reviews.author: Michelle C
reviews.title: Tuve una boda y el servicio no fue lo que esperaba
reviews.text: Hotel con respuesta de no se puede, no me agrado tendiendo tantos hoteles en Cancún y playa, lo más importante es el servicio, ojalá y mejoren, porque es un hotel bello, pero los colaboradores se ven cansados y des motivados

reviews.author: anastasiahunter
reviews.title: Too many little things
reviews.text:
Nice resort, rooms are all tile and pretty, service is good people are nice. But there are many little cons that would keep me
from returning..

Lounge chairs with shade (umbrellas) are reserved early in the morning, but there are usually lounge chairs available without any shade. Sad for the kids or people recovering from their sunburns. Very few chairs have umbrellas and they are taken right away. You can rent the bed for the day ranging from $50-$100 per day.  The "good" or "fun" pool is the one with the swim up bar and entertainment, the other pool has nothing, no entertainment, no bar, and only one server that makes her rounds as often as she can.

There is only one bar outside. 

There are limited bars inside. (I only found 2). One in a restaurant and the other on the second floor. 

*there is a nice nespresso bar, where the barista very cheerfully makes you cool flavored coffee's or macchiatos etc. all made "with love". 

You will not get drunk. You are drinking water in that cocktail all day. Stick to beer. 

There is no room for your clothes. Might be OK if there are only 2 of you. Otherwise you'll be living out of your suitcase. (Junior suite, lagoon view) If you ask for more hangers and squeeze it all in the closet you might be ok. (5 small drawers and a small closet) 

Balcony is nice. We got 2 chairs outside of ours and our family got 2 lounge chairs. So if you prefer one over the other you should ask for it. 

Lounge chairs have 2 positions, flat down or halfway up, no in between. And they're very uncomfortable. (Same chairs wherever you go including royal service.)

We had a chance to check out royal service. Nothing special except a butler and top shelf liquor. No entertainment and there's one or two separate restaurants otherwise you share the restaurants with everyone else. You can pay $75-$100 per day for the perks of Royal service without the room change. 

*Room service is all inclusive. That was a big plus as all hotels don't offer that. They do not bring cocktails to the room but food is included. 

Mini bar is ok. Water, beer and a few snacks. Our minibar had only 2 Mexican beers and our family had Heineken. No coronas to be found anywhere unless you buy outside of the hotel. 

I don't like to comment on food because everyone has their own taste. I don't like the buffet at all, including breakfast, the eggs are strange, but so far the restaurants have been pleasing to me.

All in all, for the price of this hotel, I would not return.

reviews.author: Federica I
reviews.title: i bambini sono fastidiosi per la responsabile della" spiaggia vip"
reviews.text:
viaggio fine marzo 
...siamo al mare per stare ...al mare.. in spiaggia, ...non essendoci mai  posto a sufficienza per tutti gli ospiti (!!??!!??da un albergo del genere !!??  5 stelle!!?? non te lo aspetti !!) sulla spiaggia con ombrelloni e sdraio, ci siamo spostati nella spiaggia attigua (3 mt) degli ospiti "vip"(!!??) occupando un ombrellone e due sdraio...non l'avessimo mai fatto...!!!!!!!!!! la responsabile della spiaggia ci ha cacciati letteralmente e in malo modo come fossimo ladri, sotto il sole con un bambino di 8 anni,adducendo che davamo fastidio agli ospiti che non volevano bambini, per altro mio figlio e' educatissimo e non ha mai disturbato nessuno in 8 anni di vita.....!!!!!!!!!
dopo avere pagato tale struttura, per una settimana, per tre persone, ci aspettavamo un trattamento piu' solerte ma soprattutto piu' educato, ...certe persone non dovrebbero essere lasciate a stretto contatto con il pubblico, ma fatte lavorare in cucina a parlare con le pentole...,o altrove ????!!!...se devono essere trattati bene solo coloro che pagano "vip" e non hanno figli, non fate un albergo anche per gli altri comuni mortali con figli!!!
sconsiglio a chi ha figli e soldi di soggiornare in questo hotel...!!!mi rammarico anche che la direzione del personale collochi certe persone come responsabili ... maleducati e per niente diplomatici ...soprattutto incapaci nel loro lavoro...che sarebbe rendere indimenticabile il soggiorno a tutti coloro che sono ospiti...indimenticabile lo sara', perche' in questa struttura non tornero' e soprattutto come ho gia' fatto non la consigliero'!!!
da chi viaggia spesso e si sente presa in giro da chi non sa fare il suo lavoro!!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: KeithPom
reviews.title: No follow through on stolen shirts
reviews.text:
My wife and I just returned from a week at the Paradisus in Cancun.  We stayed in room 3229 which is in the center building on the second floor, ocean view side.  It is unfortunate that my subject line is what it is instead of great stay at a pretty resort...

I am an early riser, so my routine at this resort was the same that I have done at other resorts in Cancun, Riviera Maya, Aruba, Jamaica, Bahamas, and St Thomas over the past 6 years.  I get up around 4:30a to 6a and I reserve 2 seats around the pool by placing a towel and a shirt on them.  I did this at the Paradisus each day starting on Monday April 18 through Friday April 22.

On Friday April 22 I went out at 5:15a and put 2 towels and a blue Columbia shirt and a white Columbia shirt on the chairs underneath the 3rd tiki thatch umbrella at the main pool.  This location is almost the center view of the security camera that overlooks the main pool by the swim up bar.  My wife and I stopped by our chairs around 8:15a only to discover that my shirts were gone.  I talked to a couple of the workers outside and needed someone who spoke English a little so the scuba instructor helped translate to ask the workers if they had put my shirts in lost and found.  They hadn't, so my next stop was the guest services desk right inside the doors by the main pools.  A nice lady there took my information and said she would contact the concierge staff, lost and found, and security for us and contact us.  So we went out for the massages we had scheduled and came back hoping they had reviewed the security footage and had figured out who took my shirts.

It was about noon now and we found the lady we had reported the theft to and she said it had been entered into their computer.  She asked if anyone had contacted us and we said not yet.  She said she had alerted lost and found, the concierge staff, and security and someone would contact us.

Fast forward to 7:30p.  We stop by the concierge desk and ask about the shirts.  I point them to their computer system for the details.  They do find the incident logged, but security isn't answering their phone so we are asked to call back in a couple of hours.

So Saturday morning (our checkout day) we stop by the concierge desk again and are told that the items were not turned in to lost and found and I asked if they had reviewed the security camera because the resort wasn't that busy on Friday and there should have been a perfect view of our chairs.  She tried to contact security and we were asked to check back later.

11:30a Saturday morning, we talk to the concierge desk staff again.  I ask if I should be the one contacting the police or if their internal staff files a report.  They call security again and we are told they will be down soon.  After 10 minutes we go eat, because we have to catch our ride to the airport at 1p.

12:30p, back at the concierge desk.  The lady asks if we had seen security yet because she hadn't seen them, we said no.   She tried calling again, but they didn't show up.

We would have rated this place At the 4-star / Very Good level even with the theft if their security team really tried to figure out the theft.  But since there was no follow through from them, we have to rate our experience as poor.  We are not unreasonable people, we do understand that unfortunately people steal, but in this case, it was a low traffic time of day, defined short time period and right in front of the camera.  They could have figured out what happened and chose not to so we will choose to stay with a non Paradisus Resort on our next trip in October.

This was our 7th trip to Mexico (2-Cabo, 1-Riviera Maya, 4-Cancun Hotel Zone) since 2011.  As mentioned above we have also stayed in ARUBA, Jamaica, Bahamas, and St Thomas during the past 6 years.  We have stayed at properties owned by RIU, Iberostar, Occidental, Hyatt, and Hard Rock Hotel.  We do like to travel and overall we do like the Cancun Hotel Zone area so it is unfortunate that this hotel's security did not follow up with us.

reviews.author: cheto27
reviews.title: Costoso para ser tan viejo
reviews.text: Me parece que las habitaciones dejan mucho que desear, son bastante austeras con relación a lo que pagas, el servicio en la mayoría del personal es muy buena sin embargo existen muchos otros que no tienen esa virtud de servir.

reviews.author: davidivanh
reviews.title: Restaurantes de reserva
reviews.text: Todos los restaurantes de reserva estaban solos y no nos dejaban entrar sin reserva cosa q nos habían.dicho q estaban llenos. La gente baja a reservar camastros desde las 6am y no hay ninguno para las 8 am. Falta de lugares con sombra y falta de camastros. Nos llamaron todas las mqñnypara agendar un desayuno para ofrecernos su tiempo compartido o su meliarewards, cosa que desde el inicio dijimos q no estábamos interesados. Instalaciones del hotel hermosas y restaurantes bonitos lastima q no pudimos asistir por falta de cupo del mismo

reviews.author: Corrie B
reviews.title: Not such a great property for Time Share owners.....
reviews.text: Time share owners are put in their own "tower" of the building.  We were moved more than 3 times because of severe flooding in our room from rain.  Had a difficult time securing reservations in the nicer restaurants.  No dance club.  Other than salad bar (which was very large) very few healthy options available on resort.  Not impressed.....

reviews.author: Carly R
reviews.title: Outstanding wait staff, underwhelmed by Hotel staff
reviews.text: The wait staff is the reason this hotel gets 3 stars and not 1 or 2. Traveled here with my husband and 2 children last week (March 2016) and was impressed with the hotel and the service the first day. When we checked in, we asked if we could be upgraded to a room with a bedroom and he said they were out until 2 days after we checked. We agreed to move rooms and paid extra for the family concierge. My husband and I are NOT picky people but this was definitely not worth it. The only thing the butler did was make reservations for us 2 nights and messed them up both nights. We requested between 7-8 and he made them for 8:30 and 9:30 each night and then told us they were for 8 and 9 each night! Who eats at 9pm with small children? We were very frustrated only because we felt we paid more for a service that was really underwhelming. Don't eat at ENSO- horrible service and encountered the only rude waiter on the resort. Food wasn't great at this restaurant- just stick with the buffet at NAOS. Blue Agave was great food as well.  Yhoni and Arturo at NAOS were AMAZING! We had them 3-4 days in a row and were nothing but awesome. They work so hard with a smile on there face. Lastly, pool and beach access with loungers was just too stressful. Felt like you had to be out by the pool at 7 am to get a lounger by the pool. Bottom line, OK stay if you get a deal. If we would have not paid extra for the concierge service, I probably would have given this hotel a 3/4 star. Since we paid extra, I felt we got ripped off so only 2 stars for this place:(

reviews.author: elisabetta802016
reviews.title: poor Royal service
reviews.text: Please try another hotel chain. I know now we will. And it was our second time staying here. Royal service was not as efficient as they make it sound they will be. Room service food was always cold!!!

reviews.author: MAITE66
reviews.title: Infraestructura imponente, servicio normal.
reviews.text:
Estuvimos unos dias de la luna de miel, veniamos del riu palace y la diferencia fue abismal.
No a nivel infraesctructura, sin duda el diseño del paradisius es mas imponente, pero aun asi con falencias. Los cuartos no estan bien insonorizadoa, y si te hospedas en la piramide 1 que es donde esta la disco y los restos es dificil dormir si tenes el sueño liviano. Para hospedarse en las demas piramides hay que pagar un plus, el cual estabamos dispuestos a pagar pero la primer noche estaba completo, asi aceptamos quedarnos en la habitacion de la piramide 1. Habia mucha fiesta y fue imposible dormir, por lo cual solicitamos cambio de cuarto al otro dia, lo cual nos hizo perder gran parte del dia. Ademas de que hubo inconvenientes con las valijas y tadaron muchisimo en trasladarlas, casi 8 horas. Si bien la decoracion del hotel es muy linda estan mal distribuidos los ambientes.

En cuanto al personal y al trato, es medio para abajo. Mas viniendo de un all incluve como el palace. El personal del bufett es muy malo. Sin embargo los mozos que trabajan en los restos a la noche son super atentos, ademas de que la comida de la noche es de excelente nivel, no asi la del bufet.

Por la tarde tuvimos un inconveniente , ya que la mucama se metio en nuestra habitacion estando nosotros adentro y mi esposo desnudo, pero sin embargo en el pasillo habia platos de comida sucios que no recogieron durante mas de 4 horas.. a la habitacion le faltaban juegos de toallas hubo que llamar y solicitarlas.
El personal sin duda no tiene la misma predisposicion y capacitacion que en otros all inclusive quizas por la cantidad de gente que hospeda el hotel.

La zona de la psicina y la playa no cuentan con suficientes reposeras para la cantidad de gente que hospeda el hotel,.lo cual llevaba a que mucha gente tenga que sentarse en una toalla en la arena, y el buffet tampoco cuenta con gran capacidas, por lo que a la mañana habia que hacer cola para desayunar.

Y lo peor de todo es que ni bien uno llega al hotel despues de horas de vuelo y queriendo disfrutar el dia al maximo, despues de hacer el checkin automaticamente te mandan con un empleado del hotel que solo te quiere vender tours o para ser parte del club melia. Y en la zona de la piscina cuando uno va en busca de las toallas tambien, es continuo como quieren vender todo el tiempo tornandose denso.

A ver... en lineas generales el servicio no es malo, pero remarco todos estos detalles porque el parsdisius pretende posicionarse a la altura de otras cadenas hoteleras y le falta mucho!! y mas por el precio que cobra!! No es que sea malo pero hay mejores sin duda!!

reviews.author: Mike C
reviews.title: Was not happy at all
reviews.text: First of all it was our first trip to Mexico when we got there they put us into double beds was supposed to have a king bed and took them all night to put us in a different room they finally transferred us to a king bed but  it was on the first floor with no view so I was not happy with that. So we stayed in that room for the 5 nights we didn't want to fight to get a different room it was a nice room with a hot tub on the dack but no view.And the room service was horrible and cold every time we ordered it and they kick me out of the buffet for wearing tank top but as I was there throughout the week I saw a lot of guys in tank tops at the buffet and my room was a long walk to go get a t shirt. They cond us do in a timeshare presentation warning don't do it took over 3 hours and all we got was a discounted jungle tour on 2 person speed boat was fun but the tour guy demanded tips at the end of the tour he gave attitude because we didn't leave a big tip he was asking for $20 and the tour cost 180 $ than they sell u a picture and a beer bottal with your picture on it for 20$ and the tour guys name was Diego.The frist time we want to go do the tour the port was closed so we couldn't do the snorkeling so we had to come back the next day to do the tour the hotel never informed us the port was closed so we had to make 2 trips on the local bus warning they drive crazy.The best part about the trip was the pool bar and they closed that at 6pm.I give it 2.5 3 Stars at the most. Overall was not happy with the stay there.

reviews.author: cortnol
reviews.title: My Wedding Weekend (Party of 33)- wedding went great- hotel disappointed on so many fronts
reviews.text:
This is perhaps the hardest review for me to write. There were few things this hotel does right. 
- The food is good, restaurant service is great
- The facilities are beautiful

For me, choosing a wedding venue was hard. I visited Paradisus a year ago and was not expecting to have the mistakes, errors, services, etc as I had in hosting my wedding day at this hotel. Some of these things are unforgivable in my opinion, thus, I am not recommending for folks to stay at this resort

- I reserved a VIP Suite and was told I could get an upgrade, which did not happen as part of my wedding package. This was to come with a Butler, we only saw our Butler once and the VIP services were minimal, definitely not worth the extra $$, rooms were not much better
- our room was practically never cleaned. My sand ceremony bottles were broken and sand got on the floor- the floors were never cleaned. We never tipped our maids for this reason. 
- The Hotel was turning off 1/2 of their electricity at times, and the night of my wedding, I had no AC and no outlet use for a hair dryer so I could not wash my hair the night before my wedding day.
- Red Lounge has hours listed to be open until 2am- the only night club. They were closing all together and did not even have it open the FRI/SAT of my wedding. They provided NO alcohol to my wedding guests after 10pm- at an all inclusive, this is unacceptable.
- I asked as it is included in my wedding package to have my Wedding Dress pressed, and it was provided to me with an Iron Stain on the front- they scrubbed it and got it off, but ruined the silk. Upon checkout, the tried to charge me for this which was horrible! It was to be free and included anyway
- 2 guests rooms had no hot water
- When a guests was missing because he fell asleep in the hotel and could not be found at 5am, the manager on duty was not helpful at all, nor was any of the security staff to help find him. Then he told us it was 'impossible for anyone to drown' when I asked if he had security cameras, they do not.
- The same night manager came down to the beach after my wedding and blamed me, the bride for taking 10 beers from the bar... one of my guests stole the ten beers, I did not and did not know it had happened. Instead of yelling at the bride, you should have asked her if she needed a case of beer! This was supposed to be an all inclusive resort.
- Because the red lounge was closed, I had to pay $2,000 more for my wedding reception to be extended from 10pm to midnight. I had to pay at an all inclusive to keep a bar open. Ridiculous and HORRIBLE!
- Planning the wedding remote was not easy either as I had to work with several people over and over and would have preferred to just work directly with all the vendors myself. I asked repeatedly for a new remote wedding planner as I did not like mine and they refused.  She told me NO for everything I asked for as  a bride. Instead of telling me no, offer me something else or offer for me to pay. It was horrible.
- Upon arrival, I was happy to see the person I met a year ago when I planned my wedding, but unfortunately, she herself was very disorganized as well as the remote planner. They never told me I would have to change the location of the reception until the day I arrived, and I was planning the wedding for a year. 
- When I stayed a year ago, I did a make up trial in the spa- and it was horrible, so I do not recommend anyone to pay for this service either. I did my own make up and eye lashes.
- When I asked for chips and guacamole for my guests at 11pm at my reception, we were told yes... but at 11:30 when I asked if we could get it again, we were refused.
- VIP concierge could not help my husband and I get a car.

I have never been told no so many times in my life. We left this resort and went to the AM Resorts line, Zoetry resort. The Zoetry was an amazing 5 days and they never told me no, even when my husband had the wrong attire, they gave us everything we could have dreamed of. It made Paradisus seem rude and not worth the money. My wedding venue looked beautiful and I ended up enjoying my wedding day with my guests and great service staff. That said, the management of this hotel needs to get their act together! Especially for a large 30+ party like I had provided to you.  I gave you well over $50K of services and expected more. I recommend folks to stay at a Dreams/Secrets resort going forward and not a Paradisus. The Gazebo here is beautiful, as are the grounds, the food is good and some of the wait staff, but it stops there. Cleanliness, Concierge, etc are horrible. Michael Jackson show is the best and only show I liked too.

reviews.author: ssdmw
reviews.title: paradisus cancun is no 5 star resort
reviews.text:
I am rapidly coming to the conclusion that the people who write glowing reviews of mediocre resorts like Paradisus Cancun are either from Iowa or the whole Tripadvisor thing is a massive fraud perpetrated by hotels posting one bogus review after the next. 

I am staying in the exclusive part, the "Royal Service" .  Keeps the riff raff out, they put a little bracelet on you to signify your status and it has its own separated space of beach. 

Food here is not good.  Plentiful yes, good, no. 
In arrival they told us dinner reservations must be made 24 hours in advance. So if they do not tell you that beforehand, what are you supposed to do on your day of arrival?  I believe it is a ploy to send you to the buffet restaurant. 
when we told them that was not okay, they found an opening for us in the Asian fusion restaurant. when we arrived there at 830 it was almost completely empty. amazing 

There is a real challenge communicating with some of the waiters. Their English is pretty poor. They serve things you did not order. Then they work frantically to fix things. Would be a lot easier if they understood English more if they are the primary interface. Did not have this communication issue at the Excellence resort. 

Hot Tub may have worked 20 years ago.  Snow water is ice cold. When asked about it they said they were aware it was not working. No evidence they are even thinking of repairing it. 

Rooms are good. Service is good   The private butler is solid. 

Place needs a facelift. Also needs better management.

reviews.author: Megan H
reviews.title: Great staff, poorly managed
reviews.text:
I have mixed feelings about my time here. To start, the check in process was long and difficult. They did not have a room available that met our reservation so we were put in a room with one bed and an "ocean view" the view was a sliver of the ocean and the top of one of the nearby buildings. No apologies were made and no offers for an upgrade due to the lack of rooms. The next day we returned to the office to check on available rooms with double beds. Only after we asked how they would make it right by us did they offer any upgrade. This included giving us gold wristbands that gave us access to royal service areas. The staff was unapologetic that we had spent nearly half of our first day of vacation standing in line trying to fix their mistake. 

The food here was amazing. The daily buffet has great options, the food is kept fresh throughout the day. In the buffet there were several meals where we had no service, which meant we could not order drinks or water. This seemed due to poor staffing levels as I watched one waiter and one busser care for large sections of the seating. We ate at Bento and Fuego for dinners.  Bento was outstanding, even for those that do not enjoy sushi. The bartenders and wait staff were all excellent, friendly and made for a great dining experience. I want to especially mention Martin Sanchez in Naos restaurant, he was an amazing waiter who made our last meal at the resort a special experience. The Bellman Raul was also phenomenal in the service he gave. 

In our final room the view was perfect, everything you want on a vacation by the ocean. The minibar was disappointing. Two beers, several sodas and a bag of chips. No water was provided until we called room service. Housekeeping skipped our room the first day due to the do not disturb sign falling to the ground when we left the room. That was understandable, but not ideal. The next day we went on an excursion (Loma Bonita- very fun day). After leaving the room at 7:30am and returning at 2:30pm housekeeping still had not been to the room. We left the room again and returned at 4pm, the room had been cleaned and towels replaced but the shampoos had not been replenished. 

Each night we stopped by avenue bar to watch the show. Each night was unique, the dancers and singers were very talented and we had a great time. It is worth fitting them into your night. 

Overall, if your main priority is great food this property is a good option. The service staff in all areas are outstanding, they are just clearly mismanaged. The priority of this property does not seem to be in creating a seamless vacation experience for customers. I felt like a customer not a guest. If you are looking for an all inclusive service with an emphasis on hospitality I would suggest looking elsewhere.

reviews.author: haemi07
reviews.title: Family trip
reviews.text:
6 adults and three children under age of 4 came here to celebrate our FILs 60th bday...as hosts of this trip I was so excited to introduce Paradisus to my in law family only to find thatbour request for King beds (so the kids can sleep with us) were not met. We all got twin size beds. Activity paper were no where to be found and we learned that someone was to give us a tour to tell us some of the guidelines but nobody offered us that so we missed the time to make the dinner reservation at one of the restaurants. So there goes there first impression. 

Food is ok thus far but I've had better resort food elsewhere however the people all working here are very friendly. So I would assume this is more of management's wrong. First trip with my 9mos baby so wished the kiddie pool was warmer (too cold that my baby cried) and I was also shivering in coldness pf the water...

reviews.author: LindseyandMike
reviews.title: Bait and switch
reviews.text:
I cannot read one more of these positive reviews from December without calling it out.

I booked a 10-day vacation for six for my parents' 50th wedding anniversary A YEAR IN ADVANCE. I did a ton of research and decided this was a good resort for us because it's family friendly. We get there after traveling all day, we're given a bottle of water and a "WE'RE SORRY WE'RE OVERBOOKED." Come to find out now that there is some company that pretty much takes over the place in December and has for THE PAST THREE YEARS.

CAN YOU SAY BOOKING SCAM? They might as well have sent me an email saying they have a million dollars waiting for me in Nigeria as long as I will give them my PIN number.

So what do they do? They send me and my husband (40s), my two young teens and my 70-something parents to ME and put us in rooms without balconies or bathtubs (two things I was specifically looking for) on the first floor over the nightclub. :|  ALL THE ROOMS AT ME HAVE EARPLUGS ON THE NIGHTSTANDS IF THAT TELLS YOU ANYTHING. And I do mean ALL.

Paradisus KNEW they were overbooking and did it anyway. This was a very expensive trip. So we were shipped to ME for five days and then back to Paradisus. (FYI we met people who spent their whole bait-and-switch trip at ME, which I'm guessing they couldn't fill, thus the overbooking by Paradisus.)

Let me tell you about ME. Drunk kids everywhere. Mexico's drinking age is 18 :(  These rooms had condoms, sex toys and lube as part of the mini bar. Techno music until 3 a.m. Upcharges everywhere, including $5 for room service. That's where they sent us. (Food was terrible too. OMG they sent us into a ballroom for some half-baked buffet on the first night.)

The best thing I can say about ME is that my husband and I met some nice people there, many of whom had the same experience as us. I blame the management and not the staff as well. The property is fairly small where as Paradisus is almost overwhelming in its size. I'm sure if you are 18 that ME would be a dream, although MANY people were complaining about how many small children were there because it's billed as adult (another bait and switch).

Best thing about Paradisus? A lot actually. Once we got there we liked it. Lots of activities for the kids and the food was great. Rodrigo and the other activities folks made it a lot of fun for my kids and I kept hearing "I wish we had been here the whole time." They did upgrade us to royal service, but because we have older kids we didn't really need it. Our butler Rosanna did a great job trying to "fix" things as best she could. Drink service is kinda slow because the property is so huge and they don't have enough wait staff, but our main server Asuncion did a great job that we appreciated.

I can't recommend the Paradisus as they lie and you won't get what you paid for. As far as ME, no freaking way. If you want an adult trip without drunken teens, go to Live Aqua. My husband and I went there on a different trip and had a wonderful time. Still can't report on the family vacation front and will never be able to redo my folks' 50th anniversary. Very disappointed and feel ripped off.

reviews.author: GettingBy
reviews.title: Although it states.....
reviews.text: As with the other reviews, I too find myself very upset with the management. Rooms are outdated & the room maintenance substandard. Our 2 tvs will turn on themselves, a little eerie to say the least. Out of 6 days, we had turn down 2 nights only? We are "owners" & have been since 2000. Asking anyone to confirm on anything is like going to a dentist...painful. We stayed one week, we do NOT have the "Royal service"..& it shows. We were never told about reserving a Bali Bed...had to ask & requested 3 days in a row. By the way, You CANNOT GET A SEAT near the pool...impossible, so NO SWIMMING. Went to confirm the 1st requested Bali Bed...they forgot, 2nd day requested...not marked, no Bed. 3rd day...which is tomorrow, we were told it is in the kids section, kids pool close by...& have to walk a fair distance to the adult section. We are both in our 60's. And specifically asked to be placed near the adults we are only 2 people! Will we be back? No...do not waste your $$$coming here. Go elsewhere, where they listen & try not to sell you $17,000 more of value for what little u get.

reviews.author: Derin Y.
reviews.title: If you want noise, this is the place for you!
reviews.text: Everything that happens in the lobby echos and can be heard from the 8th floor. The music is very very loud, people are loud and drunk up until 3 am in the morning. Noway to sleep and relax Food is poor quality and waves are harch making it impossible to swim.

reviews.author: Stacey L
reviews.title: Good Resort, Great Beach, No Management.
reviews.text:
With mixed feelings I write this review, but ultimately can not recommend this resort. I dismissed the few negative reviews I read on Trip Advisor before booking as isolated personal experiences that wouldn't be the norm. And I'm remiss to leave a negative review because only a few changes would make all the difference.

PROS:

Food is good.

Rooms are fine.

Beds are comfortable.

Staff is very friendly and helpful!

Very nice beach.

CONS:

The atrium in the main tower is hot & humid & smells like used cooking oil from the open food kitchens (no windows & no air flow from the outside).

Dismal wifi. I had to login to the wifi every time I used my iPhone if I could get a connection at all. Don't come planning to keep up with work unless you purchase an international phone & data plan.

Very loud evening music performances in the atrium that didn't end until 10:00pm (we couldn't hear the TV in our room over the music outside). What about young sleeping children & families who have early morning activities?!

Not enough shaded beach chairs on the beach (you have to claim them very early in the morning).

Constant loud club/trance music blasting on the beach all day.

The restaurants fill up quickly for dinner so you must make reservations early in the morning, and you can't book more than a day ahead.

The restaurants are all crammed in the main tower so none feel unique (like eating in the mall).

The layout of the resort is very confusing with no signs or good maps. Took me half an hour to find the gym and then had trouble finding it again the next day!

Old fitness equipment in the gym.

Conclusion:

It really does feel as if you are staying in a shopping mall or casino. The only window in the atrium is the glass roof which only lets in the hot sun. One of the reasons it's so easy to get disoriented inside the resort is that you can't see the beach or the laguna from anywhere inside the buildings. It's a shame the architects didn't incorporate any of the location's beautiful views in its design.

Like I mentioned before, the staff are great, but the the resort lacks from a sense of overall management who have the flexibility and authority to patronize its customers. It seems as if this was an older quaint resort that was purchased by a company who came in, added neon lights to every light fixture they could reach (even in the gym), and pumped in some bad club music in a cheap attempt to update the place. They then trained their staff, set the place to run on auto pilot and then left to turn other nice relaxing resorts into places that resemble bad casinos.

reviews.author: Gennady K
reviews.title: A for effort, F for execution
reviews.text:
This is a review of my stay at Paradisus Cancun from 12/16-12/20

The good:
-beautiful hotel inside
-two huge pools
-easy beach access
-friendly staff
- comfortable beds

the bad:
-uncomfortable pillows on the beds
-very slow service at times (balcony was missing lounge chairs, took 2 days of several calls to service desk to bring these up)

-pushy sales tactics (twice during our 5 day stay we were approached about attending an "information" session about the new Paradisus locations - the first push at attending this was right after we checked in!!! this would NOT make me want to come back to this hotel

- air conditioning system: i know, mexico can be humid. however, the filtering in the AC system, or the system itself, is in need of servicing. every room had a musty wet smell to it, emanating from the AC vent when it was turned on. the room smelled very unpleasant, like a cheap motel rather than a four diamond all inclusive.

the ugly:
-restaurants: this was a HUGE HUGE problem at this resort. the entire reservation system is terrible, especially at an all-inclusive!!! restaurants except the buffet require a 24hr reservation... 24 HOURS!. we found every single restaurant to be empty, or serving very few parties. for example, one night we had a reservation for 2 at 8, and 8 at 8:30 to Enzo Thai. when we tried to combine these, we were told they could only accommodate 10 people at 8. when we got there, there were maybe 6 other people eating at the restaurant, with space for about 200. we encountered this same issue at Vento, at Bana and at Fuego, where we would be told they could not accommodate, yet would remain empty.
none of the restaurants we managed to eat at actually let us order off the menu, rather telling us they will bring us "customer favorites", which I'm pretty sure were the lowest cost items on the menu.

also.... not all restaurants are open 7 days a week. when blue agave is open, bana may be closed, and vice versa. none of this is specified at time of check-in. this random closure, combined with the reservation system basically funnels everyone to the buffet with so-so food and low food costs for the hotel.

On 12/19, when the rain closed down the poolside grill, the hotel opened blue agave earlier in the day. they were clearly not prepared, with staffers from other jobs being forced to work as waiters - they had no idea what was on the menu, and were constantly bringing the wrong orders to everyone at our 8 person table.

this is a very poor policy adopted either by management, or by the hotel owner. requiring a draconian reservation system, in order to manage food and labor costs is blatant. this is an all-inclusive - your guests should be able to eat when they want, what they want.

-another issue at this hotel was booking. we were told that after 12/20 there weren't any rooms available - fine, its the holidays, and its busy. however what they failed to mention was that the hotel was fully booked because some power company bought out all the rooms for a corporate retreat - fine, they're entitled to do this. however, the main issue with this is that the company also paid to have its logos and banners plastered ALL OVER the property. i did not pay to have my senses attacked by booming music, and corporate colors that were everywhere - corporate pillows on all couches around the hotel, their banners on nearly every glass surface around, the constant construction sound on the beach of the huge party tent being but up. the hotel treated all other guests as second-class customers, catering to this one big corporate client.

overall, this was a terrible stay, not worth my money. i could have easily taken my business elsewhere, however having stayed at another paradisus property in mexico, i chose this location. it is clear to me that the staff is friendly and tries very hard to be helpful, however the management needs to reassess its policies.

reviews.author: Scott Griest
reviews.title: Checked Out Early After Two Nights, Only Gets 2 Stars Due To Location & View
reviews.text:
Traveled with family of three and other family members booked a second room and were also at the resort (We actually checked out early to move to Paradisus La Esmeralda in Playa Del Carmen. Which is 5 star in every aspect.)  Overall have a hate/love of this resort, its really an older 4 star property that management is trying to pass off as 5 star.  What is so frustrating about staying here is that the place has the potential to be 5 star if management was actually around and managing.  During our four day stay never saw one manager at all. As other reviewers have written the actually line staff that interacts with guests are genuinely nice and really try hard to please guests (except the Family Concierge, see below in Hate section).  If management actually cared about the facilities and trained & managed the staff it would be 5 star and they could easily increase their rates by 25% or more.  Being a partner in hospitality industry in Los Angeles, wish I had the investors to purchase the resort and turn it around; the business would be printing pesos!

Would recommend staying here only for a full day (so only a night or two depending when you check in) to experience the location and beach/playa which is amazing.  Then move to Paradisus in Playa del Carmen.

Love About The Place
-------------------------------
Definitely worth it to upgrade to an ocean view room as water is amazing.  Sand on the beach is like powdered sugar and great to play in.  There was a little seaweed on the beach (think they raked the beach each morning) but didn’t bother us at all.

We stayed in Tower 3 the main tower in 1 bedroom ocean view suite with family concierge services (room 3712,) that appeared to have been recently renovated and was actually very nice.  Other reviewers complained about sound from evening entertainment but could only hear it some when the main entertainment happened. Also the incense other reviewers commented on was only occasionally noticeable and not bothersome.  We did visit the other towers and they are quite a far walk if you have small children or traveling with older relatives.

Food and beverage was top shelf in both quality and quantity.  The buffet is actually amazing for breakfast, lunch and dinner.  Wide selection, great presentation, and items always being refreshed.  Also ate at Mole and Vento, which were both excellent and would recommend.  All of our food and drinks experiences were 5 star except the food served beach/poolside that was only okay.

Hate About The Place
------------------------------
The facility its self has so many issues.  First off the night lighting is almost non existent. We arrived after sunset and reception was so dark (lower light level than a typical night club) you can’t even see the floor or read any of the papers you are signing.  Makes no sense?

The hallways outside your room are almost as dark as reception.  Your first reaction walking out of your room is that you are entering a dark alley and should be on alert.  Last 100 hotels I’ve stayed in had well lit reception areas and walkways that were inviting, maybe there’s a reason for that, like guest like it!

Through out the property lots of fixtures are damaged, need repair or just some paint.  Place just needs a little TLC to be 5 star.  In the fitness room there are a dozen cardio machines and three had “out of order” signs on them causing people to wait.  In the spa about half of the water hydro therapy devices were inoperable.

Proper staff training and oversight is desperately needed to pay attention to the details.  As mentioned before all the staff were awesome or friendly, it appears they just haven’t been trained properly in many instances.  Pool servers would bring you food to your chair without napkins and utensils.  Coffee would be served in the mornings sometimes without cream.  We took our 4 year old to Kids Club for one afternoon and it had 20 kids from probably 2 to 9 years old and two olders boys were playing a very violent video game with the volume cranked to 12 on a scale from 1 to 10 (don’t have a problem with them playing the game, but don’t think the younger kids should be listening to killing, gunfire, etc.)  

One of the pool staff told us La Perla restaurant (beautiful outdoor space overlooking pool and beach) was going to open for lunch and feature an Asian buffet.  So went there at Noon, and was closed; another server told us that it was closed on Sundays but comeback tomorrow.  Went back Monday, the following day, still closed and third pool staff told us that its not yet open at all as they are experimenting with a new menu.  What is so frustrating is that the staff are very capable of creating a “Four Seasons” experience if they were made aware of the expectations.

Bartenders and waiters at restaurants were great and friendly, but all of them are required to wear hair nets?  Understand why a food server or buffet line worker would be required to wear it, but bartenders? Makes no sense, was a little distraction when ordering a nice martini in the night club and having my 8th grade cafeteria worker shake it and serve it.

Our other family members upon check were quoted a rate that was $100 higher than they had reserved directly with the hotel on Melia.com.  I can understand a misunderstanding if we had booked through a vendor or travel site, but this was with the hotel itself.  They were so worried about that it consumed them for a day until they used the Business Center to print out the confirmation and bring it to reception and then the rate was honored.  Bring a print out with you of your confirmation if you stay here!

The whole towel chair system at the resort causes stress at the resort as well.  There is signage that says after 30 minutes unattended towels and belongings will be removed, unfortunately this never happened.  People get up early and throw towels on chairs at 7am and then don’t return till well after 12 Noon to use them.  One morning at around 11am there were 40 to 50 chairs with towels and maybe 15 guests using them.  After swimming with my daughter for 45 minutes I asked a server if I could take a chair and pointed out that a row of over 12 chairs had never been occupied.  He took off the towels from some and had us occupy the seats.  Two hours later another guest comes up and accuses us of being a “towel thief.” My response was the server cleared the chairs for not being occupied for over 30 minutes and that we had been enjoying the seats for a couple of hours (and tipping our server well, so I’m sure he appreciates that.)  The other guest gets makes more snide remarks and basically laugh at him.  The whole chair situation has now created ill will between two separate guests. (conversely at Paradisus La Esmeralda, towels were removed often and there was always a decent spot open to get a chair at either the pool or beach and you didn’t feel stressed about getting or protecting your space).  Many other guests commented that this was the largest drawback of the resort.  Such a simple fix would create such a better atmosphere.

Charging for day beds really sucks (note: they is no charge at Paradisus La Esmeralda), many go unused which puts even more pressure on the “free” chairs.  Also, each afternoon the pool and beach ran out of towels for extended periods of time, sometimes for over 2 hours.

Family Concierge is a joke and a complete waste of money.  In fact, the lack of service and unresponsiveness caused us to end our stay after three nights and move to Paradisus La Esmeralda which saved our vacation!  Upon making our reservation directly with Melia.com I called to enquire about making dinner reservations at the restaurants ahead of time (as other reviewers suggested this).  The Melia phone representative said to email from the link on the website and everything would be handled since I was Family Concierge.  Emailed four days ahead of time with specific requests, however did not get a response.  Then phoned the hotel 2 days in advance to confirm the reservation, got transferred to a voice mail and left a detailed message following up.  Never got a response.

Arrive at the hotel and inquired about restaurant reservations and they had no record of it and all the restaurants are full for the first two days of our stay; but you can check back tomorrow to see if something frees up. Told that restaurant reservation requests must be made two days in advance.  I’m like but didn’t I just spend a lot more cash for this Family Concierge and I attempted to make reservations days in advance and got zero response.

Next morning at Family Reception, inquire about a restaurant reservation to find out they got me one, at the only restaurant that I don’t want to eat at (Mole, which turned out to be great Mexican food however being from Los Angeles we have great Mexican food everywhere.)

Day three, check in with Family Reception and still no reservation for either of the restaurants I requested all along.  Now I’m pretty annoyed, up to this point have been an ideal guest understanding the situation and ask why they can’t accommodate since I’ve requested by email 7 days ago, by phone 5 days ago and upon my check in over 48 hours ago; and I’m paying extra for this ridiculous Family Concierge.  The Concierge gentleman has no good solution for me.  He has the balls to tell me that they don’t take restaurant reservation requests by email and that he needs 48 hours.  At this point about three staff are all involved.  Now really pissed off I ask to speak to a manager, whom he gets on the phone but I can’t speak with, but he tells me his “supposed manager” on the phone cannot help me.  My response to all the staff is that this is the worst service I have ever had, I’m checking out tomorrow.  One note that the representative who initially checked us in was awesome and was very annoyed that their was no record of our initial email and phone request; too bad he can’t work 24/7.

That evening I get a call from the Head Manager of Concierge. Sergio, who truly expresses is concern with us checking out early (even though we are going to another Paradisus property) and asks that I visit him at the main Concierge desk.  Told him I would visit him later in the day or next morning once I’ve had a chance to relax a bit.

After breakfast the next morning around 10am, take my daughter over to his desk where two other people are being helped by Concierge staff.  For five minutes one of them a woman is sobbing hysterically about a problem with transportation and how she has been waiting since 7am.  The other guy is going lunar ballistic and shouting at the top of his lungs in a fit.  Obviously I see a common theme now and not wanting to be around this environment when on vacation or with my child, I see no need to meet.

Finally get to check out around 11am and Sergio comes over and asks why we are leaving and why I didn’t come see him.  Told him that I tried to see him but didn’t want to be around with other pissed off patrons and I was just over the place and Family Concierge.  He asked to hear it directly from me so gave him a very condensed version and told him that the staff is great and whom ever is the Food & Beverage Manager should be promoted to take over all of hotel management to turn the place around.  Sergio was the first management person I saw during our stay and while he was very nice and apologetic it was just way too little, way too late.

Rarely write bad reviews & never this much detail, as we are just a normal traveling family with normal expectations (check all our reviews).  If you’ve read all this, hopefully you’ll have realistic expectations if you visit Paradisus Cancun.

To summarize:

1. Come for a night or two only to enjoy the beach and view

2. Bring a flashlight or charged smart phone with a light feature so you can navigate at night.

3. Wake up early on your vacation to stake your space outside and come prepared for battle to defend it.

4. Bring a printed confirmation of your reservation and rate to reference when checking in so you don’t get overcharged.

5. Make any desired restaurant reservations weeks in advance by email and calling; making sure you record the day & time of confirmation along with the person’s name both first and last!

reviews.author: Sue L
reviews.title: Annoyed.
reviews.text: In 2014, we had booked a room thru Orbitz, for a friend's destination wedding.  When we arrived, we were told that the hotel was overbooked and we would have be moved to another hotel.  We were upset, we wanted to stay at the Paradisus to be close to our friends and spend time with them.  Apparently, all the wedding guests who booked thru Orbitz, or other non-hotel websites were booted.  I sent a complaint to Orbitz, but no response with them.  However, the hotel was nice and gave us a compliment voucher for a return stay.  This year, 2015, we decided to take advantage of the free stay and booked a room.  I emailed the hotel several times before our arrival, and told them we do not want a repeat experience of being bumped from the hotel.  When we arrived, we were told that our room was not ready, which was not a problem, we decided go eat lunch and have drinks.  Few hours later, room was still not ready.  At this point, I was irritated.  We expressed our annoyance with the situation, and finally, they found us a room.  We were "upgraded" to the butler service section of the hotel.  We were very excited about this "butler" service, then we get to the room, and realized it's a regular room, and we were supposed to have a junior suite.  At this point, we were so done with the check in process and wanted to start enjoying our vacation.  We didn't complain any further.  Our butler was very pleasant and accommodating, however, we did not utilize his services much, and I don't know if it was necessary to have this service ever, there really was no additional benefit for simple, do-it-yourself travelers like us.  We also made the mistake of signing up for a sales pitch, which we were told would take about 2 hours or less, and it took an hour longer.  Overall, as much as I don't want to sound ungrateful for the free stay, but overall experience is not positive.  We really tried hard to love this place, as we were super bummed the first time because the resort was so lovely, and extremely thrilled anticipating the second trip, neither trips were what we expected.  We love Cancun, and we will be back, but not to Paradisus or any of their sister hotels.

reviews.author: Telly W
reviews.title: The food was AWFUL
reviews.text:
Positives:
Nice Beach
Nice Pools
Nice room layouts (Family bunk room)
Decent tequilla 

Negatives:
Food- It was so awful we could barely choke it down, made the hotel feel like a 1 to 2 star hotel
No AC in common area, make for uncomfortable meals
Checkin took 1.5 hours
Pool too cold to get in or stay in
Theft in neighbors room while we were there

reviews.author: travelnut2009
reviews.title: Spring break hotel for grown ups.
reviews.text:
Baffled by all the glowing reviews as what is really a 2-3 star hotel.  
Pros:
Very nice staff
Good drink service at pools
Enjoyed pool Bali beds
Beach is pretty 
Cons
Hotel is obscenely huge.  Takes forever to get around.  Upon arrival they didn't have any beach or pool towels.  Ultimately told to get some from the room.
The breakfast buffet is packed with mediocre food and long lines for things like omelette service ( cheers to Samantha who always had a smile on her face but looked overwhelmed)
The entire hotel smells like perfume and is very dark and often slippery.
Sheets on two occasions were dirty.
The family concierge is a complete waste.  You need to make dinner reservations a day ahead. They don't do much for you.
Mole was the only restaurant we actually liked.
Rest food sub par.
Everyone had a least one post meal stomach problem.
Pool atmosphere is like spring break.  Drunken adults who are very loud and not age appropriate for things like playing football on the patio after tequila shots.
If you like blaring music and annoying poolside games shouted on a microphone then enjoy that.
Not for us and not something you'd typically see at a high end resort.
Weather pattern may have been problem but ocean was so rough we could only get in twice and we are used to Long Island beaches.
The pool is very cold  and very deep.
There are constant renovations under way.  Paint fell out of the sky at dinner one night and landed on my daughters head.
We have travelled to a lot of the great  resorts in Anguilla, st barths, Barbados, Antigua etc and this doesn't even compare
So if big resorts with rowdy atmosphere and nightclub blaring all night long are your thing you might enjoy ( bring earplugs)
Would in no way recommend this property.  Went to the beloved in playa mujeres last year .  Blew this place out of the water

reviews.author: frank r
reviews.title: Unfulfilled expectations
reviews.text: The food although better, staples lack authentic taste. Often overbooked main restaurant which has problems seating people and host has no clue to handle large crowds. Other restaurants require prior reservation which leaves you lacking choices. Daniel the host was rude when asked if I could take a table.

reviews.author: Sarah A
reviews.title: Avoid, No Customer Service
reviews.text:
Our honeymoon started out great - our flight got in early, we had a VIP taxi service waiting with beverages, the rain had just passed - and that all came to an abrupt end as soon as we tried to check in an the Paradisus. We had booked and paid in full through BookIt.com (who, by the way, Paradisus is STILL advertising their rooms through) back in February and I had confirmation of this along with an email BookIt.com sent me the day before we left for our trip. Paradisus was obviously expecting us - had all of our information, a room for us, and for the correct dates. However, they then informed us that they never received payment from BookIt and it would be OUR responsibility to then contact them after arriving in a foreign country, This was the first we were hearing of any of this, why they had not tried to contact us at least the day before is beyond me. What is even more ridiculous is that they forced us, they're guests, to contact one of THEIR vendors to receive payment. After two very stressful hours (and a lot of tears) somehow the payment magically went through. We received NO APOLOGY and nothing to compensate us for our troubles. From this experience alone, I would never return nor would I recommend anyone else waste their time at this mediocre hotel. The customer service is nonexistent.

The rest of our week here was just okay. The lunch options are poor and the food at dinner is so buttery and salty and overall inconsistent. Everything is falling apart, especially the furniture. The bars are randomly closed during the day or have an early last call at night. The pool is pretty much one depth - 5 ft. Not ideal for hanging out and relaxing in all day. The atrium (where all the bars and restaurants are) is large and beautiful, but so unbelievably hot even at night. I can only imagine what it's like in the summer months. 

The best part about the hotel was the staff working at the bars and by the pool. They truly want you to have a good time and it seems like they have fun doing it. We tipped  everywhere we went to show our appreciation, but I have seen them give great service regardless. 

This was my fourth all inclusive I've been to around Cancun/Riviera Maya and I would definitely recommend you don't waste your time or money at Paradisus.

reviews.author: Sibarista
reviews.title: La peor eleccion, dias de descanso arruinados! Pretende ser algo que no es. Nunca mas!
reviews.text: Despues de ir a Cancun desde hace mas de 20 años y alojado en JW Marriott, Ritz Carlton,  ME by Melia, Nizuc y en Riviera Maya en Banyan Tree Mayakoba (fantastico). Nos decidimos por este hotel Paradisus porque tenia la opcion del Royal Service. Es un completo desastre, farsa de servicio, escribiremos nuestra estadia a las oficinas de Melia en Mallorca y al gerente del hotel cualquier opinion personal con gusto la dare.

reviews.author: Mauricio F
reviews.title: bebidas alcoholicas y otros
reviews.text:
en la playa y en las albercas son pesimas. Una piña con sabor a jarabe, un vampiro ke no sabia a como se llama. jugos ke se dicen naturales y son de marca.

Por lo demas como su personal es excelente su servicio, aunque no falta uno que otro que anda de malas o simplemente no le gustaste y da la casualidad que se equivoca contigo varias veces.

En el restaurant fuego tuve unos problemas con la que te asigna la mesa, pero su encargado daniel arreglo la situacion y pase una cena muy agradable y si olvidar al mesero jorge que kn sus atencionea hizo ke fuera memorable

reviews.author: 진모 장
reviews.title: 파라디수스 방문
reviews.text:
장점들은 많은분들이 평가했기에 단점을 위주로 보자면.. 비바람이 좀 심하게 몰아치는날에  왔는데 베란다샷시가 노화되어 틈사이가 벌어져 있어 바람이 그대로 들어오며 소음차단이 전혀 되지 않습니다. 에어컨을 틀지 않아도 솔솔 들어오는 바람에 추위를 느낄정도입니다.
날씨 좋은날에만 추천합니다.

reviews.author: JMP9840
reviews.title: Decepcionante
reviews.text:
No merece estar en la lista de los Paradisus de Melia. Ni por sus instalaciones, ni por el servicio. Un hotel muy caro y sin instalaciones adecuadas para el número de habitaciones que tienen. No hay suficientes bares donde tomar una copa tranquilo. Las escasísimas atracciones no se pueden ver por la aglomeración de gente. No hay jardines para pasear, ni lugares donde sentarse a ver el atardecer. Un solo restaurante donde comer, en el que hemos tenido que esperar 45 minutos para que nos dieran mesa y cuando por fin lo han hecho no quedaba de nada para comer. 
No tiene nada que ver con otros Paradisus que hemos visitado como el Palma Real, en Punta Cana, o el de Playa del Carmen o incluso el Proncesa del Mar, que son infinitamente superiores. 
Lo dicho, una decepción.

reviews.author: 646dustind
reviews.title: Poor service and overpriced.
reviews.text: Overbooked, problems with check-in, staff seemed indifferent to anyone who complained.  Service was great from a select few people and terrible from the rest, with the bar staff topping the list of ignoring people and moving slowly at all times.  Also, this is the only all-inclusive I've stayed at where it just seemed like they were trying to get me to always spend more money on either service, products, or the staff making me feel like I have to tip at all times with tip jars out.  I've had better stays at half the price in other resorts.

reviews.author: Rounsie
reviews.title: I think I got the bad room
reviews.text:
I'd love to score this higher. The staff were beautiful. Nothing too much trouble, I hope they are well looked after. 
The food was really good. Considering the volumes they did an amazing job. The individual restaurants were faultless. 
Now my room! Above the disco you can't get to sleep. Friday night was the worst, but here for a conference and it was exhausting. The room thumped all night. Wireless internet was useless in the room, we had to go into the lobby to get it. The shower didn't have enough pressure or hot water to be comfortable or efficient. On the last day we decided to watch a movie after dinner to find the tv didn't work. There is a gap across the top of the door, and we're adjacent to the lifts, so the noise is straight in. We certainly didn't sleep well. So yes, love to give a better rating, and I think it was just our room, but not at all good.

reviews.author: J O
reviews.title: Would have given 4 stars but they stole our credit card information
reviews.text:
Ok, let me be frank.  I have never had any interest in visiting Cancun past sophomore year of college.  If I want tropical there's plenty of other places to go.  That being said, we had a wedding to attend in Cancun and decided since we were going to make a week all-inclusive vacation out of it.  For what I was expecting, I must admit I was pleasantly surprised.  The hotel is beautiful- the pictures from other travelers accurately portray it.  It was built in 1999 we were told and changed over to Paradisus in 2011, so its relatively new.
We learned through other members of our party that that high rates we were offered through expedia and on the Paradisus website for Royal Service, or upgrades, were negotiable.  Other members of our party were able to upgrade for $15/night.  When we arrived we explained we were there for a wedding and asked about an upgrade, which was quoted by Alma for a lagoon view (the cheaper option) for $1k for the week.  When all was said and done, she worked with us and we paid a third of that.  I was very satisfied.
Our room in Royal Service was nice but had no view what so ever. Others has gorgeous views.  This didn't bother us because we planned to spend zero time on a balcony anyway.  Our Butler, which is basically one person you deal with for every need was Rosanna.  She was very kind and accepted calls even when she was home.  I guess it's her job, but it's not a job I would ever accept so I admire that a lot.  Overall she was good.  She did forget to book our bell service to have our bags brought to transportation upon our departure which cut it close.  She also forgot to book one dinner reservation for us, but the restaurant took us anyway.  So again, not deal breakers for me and I was happy.  I learned from another member of our party toward the end of our trip that the hotel does offer nightly shows.  She learned from her Butler.  Rosanna never told us about entertainment on the resort.  But I did google search and learn that they sell hookah on the property, which was nice for me because I enjoy hookah here and there.
I also want to note Miguel from Fuego restaurant who went out of his way to have to chef prepare me two types of rice one evening when I was disappointed to rice is scarce in Paradisus. You rock Miguel.  And Sergio at the pool was a great server.  And Eduardo at the Royal Service pool.  I remember their names because they were very good.
Overall, I felt that everyone at Paradisus were extremely accommodating and the hospitality was exceptional.  I thought I'd give them 5 stars, until...
When it rains, the hotel leaks.  The automatic doors stop, the pool bathrooms flood, water drips in down some walls so there's towels all over the floors, and even one staircase was closed.  But no water came in my room so it wasn't too big of a deal to me.  What did bother me was that all night it was noisy as all hell.  Footsteps, people talking, workers pushing carts, the people above us seemed to move furniture around for hours.  Alllllll...night.....
Then housekeeping kept taking my wash rags, but never replaced them.  So every day I had to call and ask for wash rags so I could shower.  Inconvenient, annoying, but again not a deal breaker.  That's where discretion in tipping comes into play.
The wedding we attended was beautiful. I saw 4-5 during my week and ours was by far the best.  It was held outside on the gazebo and the reception was alllllllll the way across the hotel but on the beach.  All the other ones I saw were indoors next to the buffet and pool, which was undesirable.  During the ceremony, which was lovely, we guests got to smell gasoline and listen to the jet skis that felt it was appropriate to ride directly behind a wedding.  Also on that note, the bride and groom have a child.  So they weren't able to stay in Royal Service.  But for people who paid to hold their wedding at the resort, they were treated as nothing special.  A normal room, no extra care, etc.  The groom and his extremely well behaved daughter came to the Royal Service pool to chat with us for a few moments on a day that the place was empty, and were chased out.  He just paid to get married here...
And one night I was laying on a bali bed on the beach, awake.  I heard a worker come down the stairs, turned my head, watched him approach the entire time, only for him to state to me "these bed's are not for sleeping that's what your room is for."  Did I look like I was sleeping?  I just watched you.  There were more professional ways to address me thanks.
And lastly, when we arrived Alma at the front desk took our credit card to swipe it.  Then she wrote the numbers down.  My boyfriend questioned why she was writing it down and was told that's their policy.  Once we checked in at Royal Service they again took our credit card and wrote the numbers down.  We didn't question this since we were already told it was policy.  But two days later the card was cancelled on us because someone tried to spend $140 at a gas station in Mexico.  So we had no use of that card the entire trip.  And someone or some people working at Paradisus are stealing and scamming customers.  The card was only taken out of it's wallet two times, both times given to Paradisus staff.
That being said, I will never, ever return here.  All the hospitality in the world doesn't mean a thing when it's to distract me from your dirty work.

reviews.author: jacoby361
reviews.title: Second class experience
reviews.text: They have different packages and they don't treat you properly if you are not part of the good ones.  No one offer us those packages or give us any orientation on the premises, services or activities.  No power, AC, WiFi, almost every single day, from 2 hours to 12 hours wish is unacceptable.  First time in my life that something like that happen to me. No one took responsibility of anything.

reviews.author: Sheila T
reviews.title: SKIP THIS RESORT....OLD & HORRIBLe
reviews.text:
Where do I start... I'm sad to write a bad review because I was so excited for this trip.  Came with a group of 6 families from east and west coast, and picked this resort based on tripadvisor reviews. And I still don't understand how it comes close to any good reviews

 1) Family concierge.... HORRIBLE.....They gave us the wrong colored bracelets which would show the staff that we have special services with family concierge. WE discovered this error 1.5 days later, how did the staff not realize that!!!  Not even an apology about it

2)NONE of the amenties were told to us... no offering of a tour to the hotel.... With family concierge we were supposed to get a bottle of liquor (we had to remind them), 550$ of credit for resort (THIS IS CRAP... was a whole bunch of coupons worth 550$) 
Our family concierge was supposed to provide each family with a phone that connected with our butler.... they gave us one phone for 3 families that were in 3 different rooms/buildings. Asked him to get my family one the next day..... never happened.

3)Smell of incenses all over the hotel is so overpowering.... I wonder what smell they are hiding???

4)Rooms... Pyramid 1 was quite and relaxing, close to the pools but far from buffet.  Don't stay in pyramid 3 unless you want your room to sound like the club, I kept thinking our door is open!

5) WIFI service was iffy... had to call 4 times to get someone to come fix it 

6)Food.....I've staying in resorts in Mexico many times with no problems.  Buffet was overwhelming with amount of food, but very little quality food.  Soggy churros, really?  Dinner food was the only thing I looked forward to. My 10 mo baby got vomiting from the food one day  & we all had diarrhea from time to time

7)Pool/Beach.... Beach was fabulous.  Clean, beautiful, easy access.  The main pool was so deep that I couldn't even stand in it???  WTH??  I'm not a short person but I had to tred water the whole time.  With family concierge, they were supposed to come by the pool with fruit/wet towels... etc We got that ONE day out of 6 days!!! ONE!!! We were by the pool the whole day

reviews.author: Kj G
reviews.title: Not what i was hoping for
reviews.text: My wife and i travel to Cancun once a year , this was our first time in this resort . Upon arrival we were informed that due to some maintenance work we may experience some power outrages during our stay , of course we figure it was not a big deal after all this is the slow season in Cancun and lots of resorts take advantage of this to catch up with some stuff that need to be done .We stayed for a week and during this time every single day was a problem with the electric , and i  am not talking about just for an hour or two it will be the whole day and at time during the night as well witch it can really get to you if you are under the sun all day and at night you want to have a good night sleep but there's no AC ! . Also when you think of a tropical vacation you can imagine yourself on a beautiful beach sipping pina coladas , but not here the fact that most of the time there was not electricity  means no frozen drinks at all ,witch will leave you with the option or beer ( that will get warm after a few minutes ) or another mix drink with a hard liquor in it ( not a good idea for a refresh drink unless you are an alcoholic or a college kid who likes to drink to the point of blacking out just because is the cool thing to do ). I can't really say nothing  about the staff  ( this is not a compliment ) you see , through the years we stayed in different all inclusive resorts in Mexico and always after a few days we got to know some of the staff members just because we  frequent the same areas and you always remember  them because they made your stay a bit more personal , but not here i wont go as far as saying that they were rude but there was nobody going out their way for you . Food was not to bad but repetitive , unfortunately some restaurant were not available  when we were ready to try them . The place was fairly clean in the general areas it was only one day that actually for not a reason at all our room was not clean and we had to  call them to do so ( not to be picky but if i am out at the beach the whole day i like to comeback to a clean towel , a bed made and garbage taking out ) .All in all ,in all my years visiting this was the worse experience i had , maybe for some first timer this is a great place all i can say is get out there and try different things but the same price you will find other resorts near by that run circles around this place . I know now that my next visit will not be to this resort , in fact even i talked to the manager on site about some of this issues and he offered me a free stay witch i refused because i have no intentions to set foot in this place ever again .

reviews.author: SeniorSkiier
reviews.title: Something Rotten in Paradise
reviews.text:
First, let me mention the positive points of our extended-family vacation at Paradisus. The hotel is beautiful, our rooms were clean and comfortable (one family said their room was too hot). The food was very good. We ate in just about all the restaurants. My personal favorites were Bana (Asian fusion menu) and Fuego (Latin). And, overall, the staff were very accommodating.
On the flip side, though, was an incident that occurred at the pool outside the Market Grill, early on in our stay . A hotel service worker came to the pool, stood and looked at the pool for awhile and then went away. After a while, this worker returned, together with another service worker who had a pool skimmer. Only then did we look around to see that there was feces floating close to where our group was in the pool. We immediately got out of the pool and told others to do the same. The feces was removed from the pool; and, the original worker threw two handfuls of pellets into the pool. The worker never told us there was feces in the pool, didn't tell anyone to get out of the pool before or after removing the feces, or take water samples after throwing pellets into the pool. 
The incident bothered me so, that the next day I requested to talk to someone from management. I spoke with a front desk manager. I was told that he would review the CCTV video from the day before to identify the employees; and, that they would be interviewed. I was assured by this manager that he would contact me after the review was conducted. 
Needless to say, no one ever contacted me. I was told by another worker that a report was sent to upper management. I sincerely doubt that that happened. For this reason, I cannot give Paradisus an overall favorable review.
A final negative comment concerns the registration process. It was arduous. All of our group had booked lagoon view junior suite rooms. First, I was offered to upgrade to royal service. When I asked how much, I was told it would be $120/day. When I said no to that, I was immediately quoted a $90/day offer. When I said no again, I was asked about an upgrade to an ocean view junior suite at $60/day. I was told that the upgrade couldn't take place until the next day. I initially said yes. The next day I realized it was too much of a hassle to change rooms, so I cancelled the upgrade. 
Since we came home, I've checked the prices at Paradisus numerous times; and, have never seen the difference in room rates to be as large as I was quoted at registration. So, decide what kind of room, and how much you're willing to spend for a room, before you book.

reviews.author: fmorazan26
reviews.title: Mal servicio
reviews.text:
Bonito hotel 
Pero muy pobre la atención 
Royal service solo el nombre y lo q te cobran de mas el mayordomo solo lo mire el día q llegue y después no supe nada de todo lo ofrecieron como royal service 
La comida no hubo mucha variedad 
Donde si estuvo buena la atención fue en el restaurante Market grill los meseros si son más amables y atentos complacientes

reviews.author: Rafael G
reviews.title: No vale lo que cuesta en convenciones
reviews.text:
El hotel es muy grande y se ve muy bien. Sin embargo, para los que vamos unas horas a una convención deja que desear.
Empezando por la recepción, donde el trato parece que te estuvieran haciendo un favor. Es costosisimo, y para los que vamos sólo unas horas y no podemos hacer las comidas, el all inclusive, que dicen es la única opción, es demasiado. ¡Y aún así, de bebidas alcohólicas sólo hay cervez! El servicio a cuartos es lentísimo, y es la única opción por una hora ¡y no te pueden llevar bebidas alcohólicas!. De haberlo sabido, esperaba al self service after hours. 
Además, la caretera del cuarto no funcionaba (¡no tenía botón de encendido!), y dado el tiempo de servicio, no lo reporté.

reviews.author: aglez23
reviews.title: Awful outdated and hot room
reviews.text:
I recently visited the paradisus cancun with my husband, from the 22-26 of August. We were assigned room 1501.. DO NOT let them give you this room.. Very hot, we even had to request them to change at least the filter. This room looks like it was remodeled at least 15-20 years ago, nothing like the pictures we had seen here or in Expedia.
