Outdated stained furniture, the TV had a huge water stain, the minibar's door was scratching the floor every time we tried to open it, Etc.. The list can go on and on. The view was nice, and it had a jet tube in the balcony. Bathroom ok. 

As per the overall hotel service I would say five star, high quality drinks... Food ok.

Very upset about the room though.. Should not advertise the rooms you will not provide #paradisuscancun

reviews.author: WorldTraveler552015
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
We were so excited to go to cancun and experience the all inclusive luxury resort as the hotel advertised.  The reviews were stellar and the pictures were beautiful so I booked the hotel for 7 days for the family.  I am sharing my view of the hotel so others won't make the same mistake I did and be mesmerized by all the wonderful reviews.   

Staff: 
They are friendly and hardworking for the most part.  If you tip them, they will remember you and provide you with better quality service.    

Entertainment: 
Very limited and disorganized activities during the day other than drinking at the swim up bar...    The non-motorized sport equipment is on the other side of the road from the hotel in the bay area.  No one was there because the only thing they offered was cheapest looking kayaks.  The nightly half hour show they provide at the Avenue bar is decent but because it's not on a stage, only 10 to 15 people can see the complete show.  Most of us peer through small openings in between people where you saw little bits of the show.   

Pool: 
Their main pool is very large with a swim up bar.  I was excited to plunge into it with my kids. I could not touch the bottom; I am 5'2; I am used to deep pools but there is usually an area where I can touch the bottom comfortably so I can  be anchor to the kids when they need to rest.  Well, this pool had same depth through out the entire pool except the baby area where the water was lower than your waste.  So was I suppose to swim or tread water the entire 4-5 hours we are in the pool?   They had no floating tubes or beds so I had to hold on to the sides when I wasn't swimming.  We did ended up buying a tube at their store which made it better but still not ideal.  If you are 5'10, your face will clear.   I smelled urine everywhere I went in the pool; not sure if they test the pool water regularly...  

Food:
They had many options between multiple restaurants, buffet, and snack bar by the pool.  We tried three restaurants; our favorite was the Mole Mexican, Taco snack (Agave), and the snack bar by the pool.  Buffet was similar to seafood buffet you would get in the states so it met my expectation.  I would stay away from Bana for sushi, worst sushi I have ever tasted.  Drinks are water down but similar to what you would get from any all inclusive resorts.  

Facility:
They just went through major renovation to be eco friendly.  I completely am all for that.  However, when you are vacationing, you don't want to be sweating sitting in a nice restaurant with best clothes on.  It would have been better if they had most of their restaurants outside, at least you get nice ocean breeze.   Night time, hotel is completely dim; at Bana, I couldn't see what I was eating...   I felt like I was in a cheap motel whenever I was in the hall to get to our room because it was so dim.    In our room, the air conditioner noise was constant (not what I was expecting from a luxury hotel).  

Cancun beaches are beautiful but not ideal to swim; large waves and seaweed issue.

For $300 - $500 per day, this hotel completely fails to meet my expectation.  Despite this, my family had a good time which had nothing to do with the hotel.   Xel-ha is a must.

reviews.author: Jules
reviews.title: 2 night in July 2015
reviews.text:
We moved to this hotel for the last two days of our 2 week holiday as our Hotel was overbooked and they were looking for volunteers to move to Cancun. We decided to go as the beach in Cancun is lovely and not covered in seaweed as our beach in Playa del Carmen was where we were staying. This is only reason we moved. A big mistake 
The hotel is huge, the staff are grumpy apart from the Concierge who was very helpful
Our room was small and the bathroom tiny. 
The swimming pool water was hot so not refreshing at all. The ground was boiling hot so you needed to make sure you always wore your flip flops or you could burn your feet
There were not enough beds round the pool for everyone and both days we were there they had run out of towels
We were not impressed at all by this resort and definately would never go back

reviews.author: Enrique O
reviews.title: Problems, Problems, and more problems!
reviews.text: I paid a lot of money to stay here and I expected to be pampered. Let me say, that I wasn't. Our room air conditioner leaked and only after several days of complaining were we moved to another room, a smaller room I will say. When I returned to complain and ask for an upgrade to a room with an ocean view  due to my repeat inconvenience, the manager told me that he'd give me a "discount" on that room. I couldn't believe he still wanted money. Anyhow, the hotel is 30+ years old and it shows. Restaurants are always booked, so if you don't make a reservation very early you'll find yourself eating a burger or at the buffet again and again. Again, for the amount of money I paid I should not have run into these problems. Finding a chair at the pool was close to impossible! Each chair had a towel on it so we had to walk around and around until someone left. Beach towels were also hard to find, each time we went for one they said they were out. All in all, the hotel is old and the amenities are lacking. For the $5,000 USD I paid, I should NOT have encountered so many problems. I will not be returning under any circumstance.

reviews.author: Gaby R
reviews.title: Estuvimos de domingo a domingo y para el miércoles ya estábamos fastidiados, ya nos queríamos regresar
reviews.text: Nuestra visita fue por la Luna de miel, estuvimos una semana de domingo a domingo, en cuanto al servicio y limpieza de la habitación estuvo excelente, estuvimos con vista al mar y  las plantas de la jardinera estaban quemadas, eso se veía muy feo cuando salgas al balcón, en cuanto al buffet en el restaurante Naos no tenían variedad de alimentos, estaba desabrida y la fruta y los jugos ni se digan, era cansado desayunar lo mismo, comer lo mismo y cenar lo mismo, si es que no alcanzaba reservación en los otros restaurantes que cuenta el hotel, el personal de servicios de meseros, estuvo muy malo, esto debido a que se le hacia una pregunta al personal ellos contestaban primero con un gesto de impaciencia, molestia y malhumorados, se batallaba mucho para conseguir toallas limpias para la playa, el área donde se encuentran los camastros estuvo sucio toda la semana y el persona responsable de esa área no fueron amables, solo limpiaron el área de camastros vip, el servicio del bar en cualquier área era muy tardado, la limpieza en los sanitarios durante toda la semana  estuvo pésima, el aromatizante y repelente de insectos era demasiado fuerte en los sanitarios, en información de consulta de medico no saben los costo de la consulta,  que primero era ir con el doctor y el te decía cuanto era por la consulta, la música que tienen en el jardín interno del hotel era  muy tediosa estando una semana entera hay  ya no deseas volver a escuchar esa música nunca mas, jamas regresaremos a este hotel, no se los recomiendo para nada.

reviews.author: Eva B
reviews.title: Ideal si tu objetivo es comer y beber, si no, no vayas!!!
reviews.text:
Esperabamos un gran hotel y no fue asi. Llegamos y la persona encargada de nuestra habitacion nos ofrecio un viaje en catamaran para 10 personas a Isla Mujeres. Si escuhabamos al dia siguiente durante el desayuno "algo" que nos queria contar nos hacia una reduccion en la excursión del 40%, obviamente accedimos. A la mañana siguiente nos dieron una charla para hacernos socios del Club Melia, la cual duro 2 horas. Al ver que no estabamos interesados, la amabilidad dejo de existir y nos trataron bastante mal. Cual fue tambien nuestra sorpresa que al llegar al catamaran este no era de 10 sino de 100 personas!!! Nos habian hecho el descuento bajandonos de categoria por no asociarnos al Club Melia. 
Cuando llegas a las hamacas de la piscina, estas estan con toallas reservadas desde las 7 de la mañana , intentamos "pagar" una palapa, pero estaban resevadas hasta 6 dias despues. En la piscina esta lleno de gente bebiendo alcohol libremente y sin moderacion. Es barra libre!! Un espectaculo deplorable para los niños!
La musica comienza estridentemente en la piramide 3 a las 7 de la mañana y termina a las 11 de la noche cantando o con conciertos. 
Finalmente decidimos ir la mayor parte de los dias de excursion, por cierto un diez para la señorita de la agencia Best Day que esta en la planta 1, vende unas excursiones impresionantes! Al hacer excursiones desde la mañana temprano, no puedes reservar en los restaurantes porque estan cerrados y cuando regresas las reservas han finalizado, asi que debes cenar la mayor parte de los dias en el buffet. Sálvese quien pueda!! Que si llegas un poco tarde (sobre las 8,30) hay unas colas inmensas y se acaba la comida, asi que debes esperar a que hagan mas.
El ultimo dia nuestra habitacion estaba sin hacer a las 8 de la noche cuando llegamos de la excursion y tardaron hora y media en subir a hacerla. Otros dias se les olvida dejar toallas, gel, alfombrilla de baño....
Es un hotel para beber y comer desmesuradamente alejado de todo lujo que fue lo que se nos vendio a nosotros. 
Nunca lo recomedaria!!

reviews.author: Maria P
reviews.title: Huge disappointment
reviews.text: Stayed here in April for my brothers wedding I was so excited to go back and tagging along finally was my parents who never wanted to go to Mexico but I told them it's the best ever! I was sorely disappointed with this resort food was horrible everyday bad, drinks bad-go figure they usually rock! And if you don't tip lots they don't leave you enough towels etc. there is no place to gather as s family in the evening, this is truly my first complaint, but again I cannot say enough about the staff they are amazing and work hard.

reviews.author: travelbug696
reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: Rooms dated and in terrible disrepair. Mold on ceiling over shower with bulging ceiling plaster which burst and the faulty pipe sprayed water all over the bathroom and its electrical outlets and electric mirror lights! Hairdryer didn't work and had to be replaced. Towels in our room were very random. We are a family of 4 and some days were given 1 hand towel and 2 bath towels. Some days 2 wash clothes, no hand towels? Our "lagoon view" was a ground floor view of a car park. Our 4 yr old was not permitted to play in the Kid Zone with his 5 yr old brother Amanda we were told he could play in the Baby Room which was not suitable for a child over the age of 2. Having stayed at the wonderful Paradisus La Esmerelda in Playa Del Carmen, the Cancun Paradisus was a big disappointment.

reviews.author: 207elisaa
reviews.title: No para visitar en verano
reviews.text:
La comida buena en general, considerando que es un hotel all inclusive.
El área de alberca no cuenta con camastros suficientes para los huéspedes y de las sombrillas ni hablar y al personal del área parece no preocuparle, pues se limitan a decir "si encuentra uno, uselo".
Además, tienen letreros por todas partes que dicen que no se pueden apartar y que después de 30 minutos el personal del hotel retirará las toallas que los estén apartando, cosa que no sucede!!!!!!

reviews.author: Chris F
reviews.title: Too hot no a/c!!!!!!!!
reviews.text: Let start royal service is a joke don't waste your time not worth the money only thing was that side was adults only and it was quiet  other than that a waste our room had no a/c they tried fixing and told us it was all set which to find out it wasn't so they gave us a fan I did not want to switch rooms because we already unpacked everything one good thing they refunded us our upgrade others than that food was decent plenty of options weak a/c inside restaurants some of them are outside and it was so hot couldn't even enjoy the food pool was hot you couldn't even enjoy the water after sitting in the sun and trying to cool off beach was covered in seaweed all over and in the water couldn't even enjoy it I wouldn't waste your time booking this place It's like a jungle inside

reviews.author: Kesia A
reviews.title: Beautiful resort but Horrible customer service
reviews.text:
On June 19, 2015, my boyfriend and I checked into the Paradisus Cancun Resort, to not only have a beautiful vacation but also to celebrate our one year anniversary. Since our anniversary was June 20th, I started seeking out a vacation resort early; a resort that would allow us to have a romantic vacation, in a safe and beautiful atmosphere. Therefore, we chose the Paradisus Cancun Resort and purchased the three night, four day package which was an all-inclusive, lagoon view, junior suite. Because it was our one year anniversary, we wanted it to be special; however, this was not achieved. 

Unfortunately, there were several things that went wrong: 1) our room was not ready when the front desk person said it was going to be. She said it would be ready by 11 AM and it wasn’t ready until after 3 PM. 2) when we finally checked in, well after 3PM (room 1011), we walked in the room to the maintenance man working on the living room TV and the housekeeper cleaning the room. Because they were still in the room, we were unable to get comfortable until they were done. Sadly, when we try to turn on the TV, once the maintenance man left, the TV still didn’t work. We had to call the front desk again for him to return. The end result, the TV remained unfixed. 3) While the housekeeper and maintenance man was in our room we decided to go out to the terrace and look out to our “lagoon view.” To our surprise our “lagoon view” was nothing more than a view of the entrance. The view was so bad you could watch people walk in and out from our bedroom.

Disappointed with how things were going we called the front desk to find some kind of resolution to these problems. We were promised to be moved to a comparable room the next day and that they would send us a bottle of wine for our troubles. The next day we went on our excursion and upon our return we went to our new room. 4) Once we entered the room, we immediately realized that this was just a regular room and not a junior suit. In addition the terrace didn’t have a Jacuzzi or any patio furniture. Furthermore, the wine bottle was not waiting for us in the room, just small deserts that can be found in the buffet area. 

By this point, we were tired from our excursion and decided to make the best of our vacation; it was our anniversary after all. So we continued with our vacation but we still ran into hiccups for example, there wasn’t enough lounge chairs by the pool area; for dinner, we could not make reservations the same day and you couldn’t make the dinner reservations too far in advance either (it had to be 24 hours prior only); we couldn’t order sushi at the sushi bar unless we had a reservation but we were allowed to drink. 5) Then our key to our new room stopped working and we had to call the front desk again for help. Someone finally showed up about 30 to 45 minutes later to let us in to our room. 

We finally made it to our final night, we wanted to get a good night’s rest as we had to leave first thing in the morning.   6) However we were not able to achieve this, as our air conditioner stopped working at about 1:30 AM. We couldn’t believe it!! Tired and uncomfortable, we called the front desk to notify them. We did not want them to send a maintenance man at that time because we had to try to rest a little as we had an early flight the next morning but we informed the front desk to make note as we would be talking to a manager in the morning. In the morning, we went to check out and speak to the manager. The manager did not know anything about the air conditioner or that we changed rooms. When we expressed all of our concerns in a respectful manner, we just got a blank stare and was told well, you’re checking out today and there’s nothing we can do. She just apologized, when we said we would write a letter about our concerns, she just said yes you can do that and did not seem to care about us, her guests, or our stay. 

Overall, we were extremely dissatisfied with the resorts customer service and what’s worst this was supposed to be our one year anniversary special get away. We will never stay at the Paradisus Cancun again.

reviews.author: Alessandra Parr... M
reviews.title: Ferias 2015
reviews.text:
Bed maintenance, the curtain in my room was falling and nobody fixed it up. 
Whole hotel smells food 
So expensive for extra facilities or upgrades, creating areas side by side impossible to access 
Beach impossible to swim  because the sea has several algae

reviews.author: Joel G
reviews.title: Muy mala atencion haciendo fila para desayunar nadie nos ayudo para encontrar la habitacion.
reviews.text:
No es posible que no nos guien a la habitación, que nos dicen que van a dar 500 dlls. y son cupones de descuento no existe el WI-FI mucha gente les paso igual. Aguantamois muchos días x que era muy caro el boleto de avión ya queríamos irnos solo el Sr. Juan de Dios, Sofonia, Oniver, 
Sra. Asunción Sr. Perez Gerente de bar en alberca gracias a ellos nos ayudaron con la estancia increíble pero no se conseguían sillas en la alberca. Lastima de $ que se gasto y queríamos ir al Paradisus Palma Real de Punta Cana, que bueno que no vale la pena.

reviews.author: pabloCordoba
reviews.title: No vale lo que puntuan
reviews.text: el hotel no no es de lujo, lo mas destacado que posee es su personal, especialemtne los meseros y bar tender, quiero destacar a Eric del Rest Bana, el Japones, que junto con el Vento son los mejores del hotel, ya que los otros y el buffet la comida i bien es buena, no sobresale incluso en el buffet hay poca variedad. Las habitaciones tiene muy buen servicio de limpieza pero ya se nota el paso del tiempo y el poco mantenimiento, Lo peor del Hotel es el servicio de animación casi inexistente, y el hotel no cuenta con un espacio destinado a los shows a la noche ni sala de juego (mesa de pool, ping pong, vilar, etc) como tiene otros hoteles, Por el mismo precio la cadena Iberostar ofrece mucho mejor servicio en animación y en los buffet.

reviews.author: Wiegee
reviews.title: Vacation from Hell
reviews.text:
I brought my family to Cancun for a much needed vacation and decided to stay at an all-inclusive resort....The Melia Paradisus appeared to be exactly what we needed.  The problem was that staying at the resort was like going on a cruise - there was always someone trying to find a reason for me to pay for something else.  I had decided that we deserved to stay in a Family Concierge Room, complete with butler.  On our first night, while walking to dinner, I found the dimly lit hallway had an unexpected obstacle, stairs.  These steps were not lit or even marked with contrasting colors - just white marble against white marble and I fell down all of them breaking my foot in the process.

I toughed it out for a few hours but called the house doc around midnight...he assured me that I was suffering from gout (?) but I could go to the hospital if I insisted.  I did go and returned to the hotel at 4:00 AM bandaged and on crutches, it wasn't gout but it was broken.  To the credit of the property, they did show an inordinate amount of concern.  I bought into their protestations of caring right up to the point when they told me I might have to pay for a wheelchair.  I declined the wheelchair - it wasn't worth the effort.

To be perfectly honest, an employee of the hotel did go the pharmacy and get my prescription filled and for this I am grateful.  They also delivered chocolate-covered strawberries and marshmallows to my daughter after she tangled with a jellyfish and got badly sunburned (15-year-olds are invulnerable), but they made no effort to help with the medical expenses which totaled roughly double what they would here in the United States.

reviews.author: Luis I
reviews.title: Muy malo el hotel
reviews.text: Hotel ya viejo, falta mucho mantenimiento, resulta que con lluvia no muy fuerte el agua se empieza a filtrar a las habitaciones por la terraza, ademas por todo el hotel hay goteras, el servicio es regular y no corresponde a lo que se supone que son 5 estrellas, yo le pondría sinceramente 4, si se supone que es todo incluido te quieren cobrar todo hasta las palapas del área de la alberca. En resumen yo prefiero el Me que es de la misma cadena, esta mil veces mejor y la atención es de igual forma superior a este. Mala experiencia en este hotel

reviews.author: Jesus P
reviews.title: Servicios por debajo de su categoria
reviews.text:
El hotel está en buen estado y las instalaciones son así. Sin embargo es un hotel de 5 estrellas Gran Lujo y esperamos servicios de ese nivel. Somos una familia con 2 hijas de 13 y 11 años y reservamos una suite con Family Concierge. El personal es atento y servicial excepto en la limpieza de las habitaciones que tuvimos una atención desastrosa. Unos días limpiaron a las 6 de la tarde y otros a las 10 de la mañana. En la pirámide 3 la música está las 24 horas y no hay un momento de tranquilidad. La mala animación y su música deberían estar en un lugar cerrado.
La comida y las bebidas fueron muy mediocres, mala calidad y mal cocinadas. Hemos estado en muchos otros hoteles Melia, y sin duda éste ha sido el peor en la comida. Esperábamos calidad y la comida es básica, repetitiva, poca variedad y productos mediocres. Existe un buffet, pequeño, a la hora del desayuno hay colas, en que no hay zumo de naranja natural, la bollería industrial y poca calidad, los embutidos muy malos, y para una tortilla puedes tener que esperar 15 minutos. En comida y cena poco más, quizá lo único que se salva es la pastelería en los postres. Fruta poca y sin variedad, mala presentación, sin variedad de panes. Carnes poca y siempre repetida. En los restaurantes tampoco nada mejor. El restaurante vento con supuesta comida española ni se le parece: horrorosa tortilla de patata, jamón de bajísima calidad, queso igual: el resto de las tapas sin sabor; fuego, comida peruana chilena sin sabor; la perla carne mediocre. El mejor Mole pero sin destacar mucho.
En resumen, baja calidad para las expectativas de su categoría y su precio. El año pasado estuvimos en un hotel de 4 estrellas, Sirenis en Tulum, y ampliamente le supera en todo.
Un consejo para sus directivos, la reducción de costes, reduce a los clientes y lo que pagan. Como ejemplo, en vez de entregar el periódico en la mañana (nos alojamos en suite), te entregaban 3 hojas fotocopiadas. La música molesta y la penumbra (en los restaurantes no se ve lo que comes) es constante en las noches

reviews.author: 672mabelm
reviews.title: My ten year wedding anniversary ruined!!!
reviews.text: I was very dissatisfied!!! My ten year wedding anniversary was not romantic at all. I had to complained several times to recive the services that my husband had paid for. The staff needs to be retrained on customer service. The only person that went above and beyond was the food and beverage manager that was on staff that night. The chef accomodated our dinner. He was good as well.

reviews.author: ggrimaldosv
reviews.title: ME SIENTO ESTAFADA
reviews.text:
Esta es mi segunda vez en Cancun la primera nos.hospedamos una noche en el hotel Riu Peninsula (excelente) y . vez decidimos con mi esposo apostar por otro hotel y conocer; pero ahora.nos arrepentimos......
Llegamos ayer 08/06 al hotel y aun nos quedan 7 dias por "disfrutar" de nuestro aniversario. Aqui van los.comentarios. 

Lo mejor: 
- Atencion de los mozos; personal de limpieza y personal de entretenimiento.
- La vista al mar es alucinante.
- La playa es hermosa.

Lo peor:
- En las fotos todo se ve hermoso.pero el hotel se ve viejo por fuera y por dentro tiene plantas colgantes que deprimen.
- La habitacion es buena; pero no excelente como deberia ser un hotel de esta categoria.
- En la playa hay unos.colchones precisos para una maravillosa siesta frente al mar; pero si quieres utilizarla tienes que consumir nada menos que 120 dolares por el dia que quieras usarla.
- En la.piscina hay unos colchones similares para descansar pero tienes que hacer una reserva y pagar 50 dolares por el dia que la quieras usar.
- En estos 2 dias que tenemos de estadia hemos sido acosados por 3 personas del "Club Melia" para vendernos su membresia; la cual NO NOS INTERESA!!!
- Por ultimo fuimos a la recepcion del hotel para consultar si existia la posibilidad de cambiar de hotel y despues de hacernos esperar aprox 30 minutos por el Gerente nos dijero que lo hablemos.con la agencia de viajes y eso fue todo.

En conclusión; no recomendamos este hotel; no estamos contentos y nos arrepentimos de no haber ido al hotel Riu o a otro similar. 

PD.- no hay espacio en el Riu en este momento; de otro modo ya estariamos fuera.

reviews.author: Michele WZ
reviews.title: The good and the bad.
reviews.text:
I want everyone to know that my stay was with Royal Service. The views, beach and pools are incredible. There is not a swim-up bar at the Royal Service pool but the staff are constantly bringing drinks. They have complimentary pool bags in your room and sunscreen SPF 30, 50 and oil at the towel shack. The pool staff is wonderful, a special mention to Guadalupe, Daniel, Eddie, Edgar and Alexander, but truly everyone out there was wonderful. 
Our rooms were cleaned very well everyday and we were never in need of towels.

The food was good. Vento was my favorite. Fuento was very good, as well as the buffet Naos. Please be very careful! If you don't have a reservation you will NOT be seated until very late. I would suggest making the reservations when you first arrive. If you order a bottle of wine be aware that you will be charged 15% on top of the pesos that are on the menu. A $56 bottle of cost us $76. We were not informed of this special charge. The next day when questioned we were told it is for the waiter bringing it to the table and uncorking it. 
We were given a butler Ivan, who we just loved. The butler is to make reservations and to help you with other things that you may need him to do. Let me start this next part with... we are by no means needy people, we made our bed on the days we did not want our sheets changed. Ivan worked 7-3 for the first 2 days, everything was fine. He informed us that he would now be working 3-11. We had no butler assigned to us. from 7-3 and that we can just call the desk. Others we met were given phones, we were not. I don't know what happened there. We would go to the desk. It seemed like no one really wanted to help or could help. I am not sure which one. I went in on our last day and asked if there were boarding pass kiosks at the airport and was told there are not. I was told to go to the computer and I could print them out. The computer is Spanish and after navigating I was told the computers are not hooked up to the printers. Hard to print a pass without a printer. I spent 1.5 hours of my last day trying to print out my boarding pass. After all of that a new person was sitting at the desk and told me I could have done this at the airport. What? , My friend, who also had many problems went to the main concierge desk, not Royal Service, we told them some of the complaints we had and we were told that if we wanted to take a timeshare Club Melia tour we could see how much better it would be for us if we bought a time share and we could get $150 a spa service. Ok look...If I am not happy what makes this guy think I want to buy a timeshare with them. Upon leaving my husband and I also spoke with the Royal service manager.They say they are sorry but you can tell they are not. I feel the resort is opportunistic with both us and the staff. It is not the staff that is the problem. It is management. The things I mentioned are a few there were other problems that would take a book to write. The views are so beautiful and I really felt relaxed at the beach and the pool, but my experience was so bad we will not return and our friends are not returning. We were going to take our 5 adult sons and girlfriends next year and that will not happen now. Customer service is not part the experience. If you go, have low expectations and if things are better for you great.

reviews.author: Natalia Z @paraisoglam
reviews.title: Esperaba algo mejor
reviews.text:
Es creo que la 9na vez q vengo a la riviera maya y es la primera vez q no recibo el buen trato que destaca a los mejicanos. 
El servicio es malo. 
No hay buena predisposicion de los empleados. 
El edificio es viejo. Ya algo de 25 años. 
Todas sus instalaciones son viejas, incluido piso del solarium que aun sigue siendo de laja como si estuvieramos hablando de 30 años atras. 
Por las tardes no hay comida!!!!
Solo un grill donde hay hamburguesas, nachos y panchos. Nada mas. 
Se supone q es un all inclusive y a la merienda nos morimos de hambre. Hoy tuve que ir al market a comprarle helado a mi hijo de 2 años.
Contratamos el servicio de family concierge para estar mejor atendidos y realmente es inutil. 
No vengan. No lo recomiendo. 

Lo unico bueno es la playa. Solo eso!

reviews.author: malvicinir
reviews.title: cancun
reviews.text: Overall a fine stay but complaints neglected. Wait staff and housekeeping very acommadating. Front desk personel not so and misleading. Butler very friendly and resorceful. Nitely entertainment very good , both in center court and the lounge.

reviews.author: Karen O
reviews.title: The food and service need a Hugh improvement
reviews.text: The food was so disappointing and very little entertainment.  The butler service was poor and needed training. It's never proper to had someone ask for a tip. Tip are earned with service. The best meal we had was room service getting a salad and wings.

reviews.author: 원석 최
reviews.title: 로얄서비스
reviews.text: 그란 멜리아 칸쿤으로 1주일간 여행을 다녀왔습니다. 평균치에 음식과 서비스 간혹 서비스 좋은 종업원도 있지만 평균적으로는 그렇지 못하던군요. 저희는 2일은 일반실에 5일은 로얄 서비스를 신청했습니다.일반실과 로얄서비스에 차이점. Cabana를 이용할수있나 없나 그 차이정도. 로얄서비스에 집사 한명이 붙지만 하루정도 보이고 찾기도 힘듬. 차라리 로얄 서비스 받지 마시고 일반실 오션뷰로 받으세요.

reviews.author: Aury-salome
reviews.title: Que decepcion!!!
reviews.text: Estuvimos ahi finales d abril y principios de mayo, el primer dia ooohh ke sorpresa nos llevamos cuando regresamos al cuarto y habian echo la limpieza y nos robaron dinero 😞 se hizo el reporte fueron a tomar fotos bla bla bla hablaron con nosotros ke harian un seguimiento etc jamas nos volvieron hablar no supimos nada ya de esa investigacion por tal motivo decidimos ke no hicieran la limpieza en el cuarto en nuestra estancia ahi , segundo dia nos salio un cucarachoo en el cuarto 😖mi esposo tuvo ke matarlo con su chancla ya ke me dan mucho ascooo y pensar ke mi bebe d un año anduvo en el piso antes no se le subio creo ke para ser un hotel de gran turismo tienen muchas areas de oportunidaddddd el cuarto olia a humedad y el colchon rechinaba en cda movimiento pienso ke ya estaba viejo se escuchaban todos sus resortes para ser un hotel ke tiene 25 años esta cuidado pero no siento ke para tener categoria de gran turismo, por otra parte la playa esta divina es por lo uniko ke dije valio la pena lo ke pagamos por el viaje !

reviews.author: Hector O
reviews.title: Completely overrated!
reviews.text:
My family and I spent a long weekend at Paradisus Cancun and were a bit disappointed. This was our first time travelling outside of the US with our 11 month old daughter and we chose this resort because of reviews stating it was good for families. Well I'm sad to say it is not. 

Check-in Process
-By far the worst I have ever experienced. After being on a plane for a few hours and a 30 minute drive from the hotel we still had to wait in line with the people check-in and out mixed. After about 30 minutes of waiting we finally got to speak to a person who got my reservation confused and immediately started to up sell me on their "Family Concierge" package. After I refused to upgrade the woman at the desk assigned me a room and told me "you will have to wait 3 hours for your room". Since we were hungry we decided to go have lunch at their buffet (review below) after an hour of waiting our daughter needed to nap but there was no area with A/C and quiet where she could nap. I asked to be purchase a higher level room, essentially giving in to their up set just to get a place quiet enough for my daughter, but then told me we only have rooms in building 3 (avoid building 3 if you have children) I went to see that room and it was right above the night club and did not take it. I decided to wait some more but I overheard another couple that just arrived be given a room of my original category and had to fight in order to be given that room since I arrive a few hours prior and been waiting. Apparently even more money does not work in this place to get good service at check-in.
- Last comment about the check-in process; STOP THE CONTINUOUS TIME SHARE SALE!! As soon as we got our room assignment a lady, whom I did not know was a sales representative, was going to escort us to the elevators, but before that she sat us down to describe the resort but then jumped right into her sales pitch of the time share Club Melia, so if you are not into that experience I would suggest find your own way to the elevators.

Junior Suite Room
- Tiny, uncomfortable bed, dirty pillow, broken bathtub floor, and hot water not working.
- The mini bar was pretty sad also. Basically water, 2 beers, and a few cans of soda, which was not refilled regularly. I had to call each day in order for them to refill it.
- Had a balcony, however, unusable because there was no patio furniture.
- Connecting room doors are thin window shutters style doors that did not block the noise from the connecting rooms.

Entertainment
- Non existing! The nightly show was a very sorry excuse for one. I have been to other resorts and they have a dedicated are with chairs and/or tables for guest to sit around and enjoy, but not here. The show was held in one of the indoor bars with no AC, which had a few day beds that if you did not get to by 5PM (show starts 9) you were not getting one. Since we had our daughter we obviously did not stay and were forced to go to the room since there was nothing else to do.

Food
- Buffet was ok, maily lacking variety and attention to detail from the waiters.
- We decided to eat at their version of a steakhouse, but were highly disappointed. I ordered a roasted pork chop, but after 30 minutes of waiting was told they had non. I changed it for the flank steak and that came out in less than 5 minutes. The steak was not good at all so I went to the buffet which was attached and found that they also had the flank steak and I knew that it was from the buffet not the a la cart preparation we expected.
- Blue Agave, their Mexican restaurant was a horrible disappointment. We ordered a few tacos for dinner, and at first bite I wanted to run out and look for a taco bell  (the american fast food chain) which has superior tacos.
- About the only thing that was good was the room service buffalo wings. We ate buffalo wings for dinner 3 nights in a row because of our disappointment with the restaurants and food.

Not a good place for families. No activities and the children pool was more of a sun bathing area for adults. Even with the "Family Concierge" there still nothing for children to do while at the resort. Completely overrated and the last time I will visit this chain of hotels.

reviews.author: Diane T
reviews.title: " Stay Somewhere Else"
reviews.text:
I don't understand the raving reviews.  The hotel is alright, but  showing its age.  Hard to navigate to your room unless you are in Tower 3.
There is virtually no entertainment.  Only one bar with music at night.  Nothing during the day at the pool.   Speaking of the pools.  They are very big, but tiles need to be repaired in areas.  Water looks clean, but when you walk outside in the evening and look into the water by the lights you see what looks like millions of  dead skin cells from bathers.  We spoke to a pool attendant who claims it was sand.  But, sand would sink to the bottom and Not continue to float around.  Gross.
Next, big disappointment was the food.  Nothing recognizable to an American Palate.  On a scale of 1 -10 , maybe a 3.   
Our last 2 days were spent with a stomach or intestinal bug.  Only drank bottled water, beer, soda's and alcohol, but managed to catch something.  We could over hear other conversations, where folks were talking about family members being ill.  
My advice is to pick another destination, or at least a another resort.

reviews.author: Kristin Y
reviews.title: Para Di Sucks - With a Great Kids' Zone
reviews.text:
This is my first negative review ever although there are some really good parts of this resort.  As background, I have traveled to Cancun eight previous times at six different resorts including family friendly resorts on the weeks the kids were off from school and busy and always had the best experience of my life, which is why I continue to travel to Cancun.  This was the first time I left a resort in Cancun feeling very disappointed and cheated of a wondeful vacation.  There are some great aspects about the resort though, so I will start with those.  

KIDS ZONE

The Kids' Zone was far and away the best Kids' Zone I have ever seen at a resort.  They have a beautiful facility inside the resort with large rooms for the kids.  There is often a jumpy house inflated for them to jump in.  There were Barbie dolls for my eight-year old daughter to play with, air hockey, electronic games, a television.  They also have a small outside area for the Kids' Zone.  Every hour there is a different activity for the kids including pizza making, water activities, origami, treasure hunt and all kinds of crafts and activities.  They stay true to the schedule and actually do these activities, which is great, so if the kids want to pick and choose what parts of the day they want to go to the Kids' Zone, it is easy to do.  The staff was beyond phenomenal, I wish I could remember everyone's name, but Frances, Dayanara, Jacqueline, Luciana were some of the wonderful people there that just made me feel safe leaving my eight-year old daughter there and gave her a fabulous vacation.  Thank you so much.

FAMILY CONCIERGE

The Paradisus resort is rather confusing about extra charges and upgrades when you stay there but one of the upgrades is the Family Concierge, which I opted for since I went with my eight-year old daughter.  Part of the reason why I chose this is it was advertised that I would have my own butler who would make reservations for me and I would get a cell phone to be in contact with to assist me with anything I needed at the resort.  When I checked in, I was never told of any butler who was assigned to me.  I was never given this alleged cell phone.  When I asked about it days later after having various problems at the resort I was told "they don't have any more."

Having various problems at the resort, I went to the Family Concierge room and the night staff was a whole different breed.  A lot more helpful and wonderful.  The gentlemen on staff there were Mauro, Ricardo, Alvaro and Oscar.  I had to go to them basically every day and they were able to help me with a lot of the problems that I was encountering and made reservations for me and couldn't have been more professional and helpful.  I finally found out who my butler was and saw her the day we checked out.  I think I got the worst butler they had there, but I won't say her name here.

THE VERY UGLY

BEACH ROOM/CHAIRS

I am aware that the week we traveled was Easter week when many kids were off from school and expected it to be crowded.  What I did not expect was that if I did not get to the beach by 7:00 a.m. I was not getting any kind of beach chair or shade.  The same went for the entire pool area.  There are simply not enough chairs.  However, you had the "option" of renting a cabana for the day at the bargain price of $100 per day.  And those were hard to reserve!  So all the room they could use for beach chairs, they use for these cabanas where they charge you.  What am I paying the all-inclusive price for if I can't even sit at the beach or the pool?

THE POOL BAR

I don't even drink alcohol at the pool.  However it is very hot in Cancun and I just wanted water several times during the day.  They have ONE bartender working at ONE pool bar for an unbelievable amount of people.  They use recyclable cups, which is commendable.  However, the ONE bartender they have to serve the whole resort outside has to wash all these recyclable cups and has to be busy doing that.  So on any given day, there are about thirty people waiting to get a drink at any given time.  Factor that into your day.

CONVENTIONS

They had at least two very large conventions there during my stay.  And what Paradisus did was actually block off and take chairs away from one of the pools, which was already filled to triple capacity so all the guests who were not in the convention had to get jammed into the other areas with absolutely nowhere to sit or stand.

SUMMARY

There is more I could complain about, but in general this resort was just extremely overbooked for what it could handle.  There was no staff around to help anywhere to help you with anything if it came up.  I was thankful for the Family Concierge night staff who assisted me, but without them I would have been totally stuck without any help.  There is no one accountable, no managers of anything and it was just a zoo.
I felt like I was at Penn Station (our busy train station in New York) during rush hour the entire time I was there.
Poor management, poor crowd control, poor customer service (except for Family Concierge night staff and Kids' Zone.)

Sorry folks...

reviews.author: payalsp
reviews.title: Definitely not as expected
reviews.text: The hotel staff are friendly however that doesnt amount too great service. There are many little things that are overlooked. I walked into the hotel at 34 weeks pregnant with two toddlers and the staff member standing by the door didnt even open it.  There were no refreshments offered until we were checking-in. The assistant that was supposed to show us to our room only showed us to the elevator, the bathrooms were sub-par and dirty upon arrival, In general things definitely need a facelift. If you're looking for leg room while using the toilet, you may as well forget it. The toilets on the airplane may offer more space, there is a bidai hitting your feet while you're using the toilet.  Towels are rare by the pool and on the beach, definitely a huge lack of space around the pool area and the towels tend to be dirty.   When you try to complain to the manager, like I did, it was pretty much dismissed.  The staff at the buffet were extremely nice. However the food was so disgusting all around that we questioned whether or not it was worth to pay the all-inclusive. We wouldve enjoyed the McDonalds and the Papa Johns accross the road.  Food was not catered for the toddlers/children. Seating for the shows was ridiculous and even worse with two kids. Not much entertainment throughoug the day as I have seen at other all-inclusives. Beach had seaweed everywhere.

reviews.author: Azher T
reviews.title: Honest review from the lobby as we speak
reviews.text:
To start off, I had incredibly high hopes for this place, some due to exaggerated reviews on trip advisor. But sometimes I guess when you pay so much, mentally you want to make yourself believe you made a good decision. 

What prompted this review was me trying to print my boarding passes and I was told I have to go to market place and pay for them. I mean for an all-inclusive resort, this place sure knows how to nickel and dime its customers. You'd like to use the sun screen by the pool? Not allowed as you have to upgrade to family conceirge. You want a room that doesn't have broken lights, broken bathroom and broken tiles? Upgrade to a different class. You want to try certain items that ARE on the menu? Sorry, not part of all inclusive. Gotta pay extra. Oh but it gets better. Out of supposed 8 or 9 restaurants, 3 are not part of all inclusive deal and yes you have to pay extra to eat there. Also the resort policy is you cannot reserve more than one restaurant per night. This policy, by the way, ended up leaving my 5 and 3 year old going to bed hungry. Guest service's advise? ''Order room service'' (which by the way has a grand total of 10-12 items in total- Other resorts have more food items in breakfast category alone). As for trying to go to any other restaurant? Nope. Not allowed. You can't show up to a restaurant (regardless of how empty they are) and be seated - you *need* reservations. I've been to 5 resorts in Cancun and Punta Cana and not one place acted this greedy and unsympathetic.

As for service, nope. They lack there as well. We were consistently bugged to attend these timeshare presentations everyday. Shows that were announced were canceled. Room service takes anywhere from 35-45 mins--for a HOT DOG. If you want to speak to a manager, good luck. Was kept on hold for 10-15 mins and then had to release the call. 

So if you'd like better service and a heck of a lot more bang for your buck, don't pay up.. instead pay the equal amount or less and go to Live Aqua or Iberostar or ANY other place than this. I've never in my life gotten so turned off by tripadvisor's over-inflated reviews as this place. If this review even saves one person's money, writing this will be worth it.

reviews.author: David H
reviews.title: Bana Asian restaurant ruined the hotel experience for us
reviews.text:
The moment you walk into Paradisus Cancun, the first thing you see (apart from decorative vines) is Bana Asian Bistro. Now, one would think that Bana would be, as a result, the finest of their restaurants; it does take up 2/3 of the central pyramid, and is complete with live music! One would be mistaken.

We went on a Thursday night, and had a reservation ahead of time. Looking at the other reviews, it seems that we chose the worst night of the week or something to go, since the sushi was Goddawful. We ordered several kinds of rolls, and from a New Yorker's point of view, none of the rolls were satisfactory. The traditional sakemaki (salmon) traditional roll tasted like the fish was fed tire rubber in its diet, and the rice was literal mush. The seaweed? You can't exactly call it seaweed if you can't even chew it - try gnawing on a shoe, it felt about the same.

I have to admit, though, the service was quite nice. Our waiter had a strong grasp on the different sushi styles offered, sashimi, hand rolls, etc. But as I am now waiting to find out if the fish was clean or if I will be sick, the restaurant clearly is a 'no' for me.

reviews.author: Nathan Thomas D
reviews.title: Not at all worth the money!!!!!!
reviews.text: The room was not cleaned very well. There was feces on the bathroom wall and in the bidet.  The towels are old and it wouldn't give you extra. You cannot make reservations the same day at any restaurant all they wanted you to do is eat at the cheap buffet. And the Internet is horrible it only works in one spot of the hotel.  No Internet in your room no Internet at the pool. If you do get a signal it gets drop

reviews.author: Wayne W
reviews.title: Choose your Cancun hotel wisely
reviews.text:
Stayed here for a week in March 2015 with my family for Spring Break.
Allow me to score the hotel in segments:
1. Front end - Victor was a super host; the staff performing check in/out were super; the help desk changing currency was great.
2. Mid-section.....the room was a bit small for a junior suite, but the balcony overlooking the pool and beach was nice. The maid service was a bit challenged by not replacing wash cloths, but that sort out after the second day. Room service was super and timely. The resturaunts requiring reservation had world class service and food. The gift shop items were reasonably priced.
3. Back end - the open seating resturaunt had average food, the cooks were friendly, but the staff were exceptionally rude on multiple occaisions and to different members of my family. I won't get into the weeds, but Americans are not welcomed in this section. It was appalling each time. The Coco bar staff were super rude to my family members and myself to the point that I reported it to management based upon no service whatsoever unless you handed them your wallet at this "all inclusive" resort. The same with the pool bar and the beach wait staff.
Also, the beach wait staff made remarks during the day to each other abiut Gringos and Americanos that were deragatory and within earshot of the customers, some of which were from Texas and knew what the words meant.

For the negative items, they all came in the first two days, making the trip miserable to the point that I wanted to check out, but did not becuase I prepaid the trip through an online travel agency.

I have fond memories of all my other grips to Mexico...Puerta Vallarta many years ago, Cancun many years ago, Riveria Maya a couple of years ago. My best advice: choose hotels that have'professional stafflike Mariott or Iberostar and not the untrained, unsupervised and burnt out staff at hotels like this one. Read the negative reviews, not the glowing honeymooner reviews before you choose.

reviews.author: Flyer372305
reviews.title: poor service, cold food
reviews.text:
not a friendly staff at all. food was always cold. safe did not work. most of the staff other than front desk and front of hotel staff spoke very little english.
not a great place to go for a person solo. good beach, good pools, but nothing more than average. i would not recommend this to anyone other than those simply going to only party, as when drunk who cares about all the stuff at a hotel.

reviews.author: Timothy Richard R
reviews.title: Don't come here unless you want to get drunk and party
reviews.text: Great location close to the airport.  Well maintained hotel - although the cleaning staff are not that thorough.  Food is ok but you need to reserve early for best restaurants.  If you don't want to be accosted by drunk girls in the rest rooms stay away from the nightclub.  During the day avoid the party pool unless you want to party!!

reviews.author: Shawna M
reviews.title: Dirty Underwear!!!
reviews.text: Upon arrival our room was not ready and we paid for a king bed and they tried putting us in a double room. We waited for 2 hours for a room with a king bed and when we arrived in our room there was dirty underwear in the closet. Our room was right above the night club so it was loud until 2 AM. Not good.

reviews.author: IslandDayDreams
reviews.title: Would not stay here again
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed here on an anniversary trip from Feb. 13-17 with my sister and her boyfriend.  The hotel grounds are very nice, but the food is average. Also, the hostesses do not honor the mandatory dinner reservations & you will be forced to eat at the dinner buffets when this happens. Finding warm food at the breakfast or lunch buffets is impossible, except the omelette station. The only good meals we had were tacos & quesadillas at Blue Agave & lobster lunch on the Bali beds that Coco's Bar operates. Because by 9:00 am, all the beach chairs were towel-reserved, we ended up paying $70 each for a lobster lunch so we could use the beach beds. Also, when we arrived, I advised the front desk that I am pregnant & had allergies, but they still put us in Tower 1, which was so strongly scented that I began itching all over & my husband got a headache.  They eventually moved us to Tower 3, which does not have that issue, but they put us in double beds. Great way to spend your anniversary! After calling back, they offered to moved us into a room that had a king bed in Tower 3 a couple days later. We wasted a lot of the precious few hours of sunlight on room changes and were never even offered an apology or late check out for the inconvenience. The front desk was responsive when we called after being woken up at 2:30 a.m. by loud drunk guys in the room next door.  We really enjoyed Secrets the Vine on our prior Cancun trip in August, but tried this resort because it was less $$. If you are looking for a party atmosphere and care less about quality dining and helpful front desk staff, you might enjoy Paradisus.

reviews.author: AnnaRioDeJaneiro
reviews.title: Decepcionante
reviews.text: A arquitetura e a vista são maravilhosos, mas a comida e o serviço são péssimos. E olha que ficamos no Royal Service...  Não sei como tem coragem de servir uma comida tao ruim.   Os funcionários só funcionam a base de propina.Nosso mordomo não atendeu em nada aos nossos pedidos. Por ex., pedimos 2 vezes que desfizessem a mala da minha filha. Nunca foi feito. Reservou horários errados nos restaurantes.Esperamos 3 horas e depois de várias reclamaçoes conseguimos uma reposiçao das cápsulas de café. Nos aborrecemos bastante a ponto de trocarem nosso mordomo. Nos colocaram em um bangalô longe de tudo e se quiséssemos algo tínhamos que nós mesmos pegar.  Sem gorjeta nao te tratam bem.. Os drinks não sao nada bons. O vinho é de péssima qualidade. Funcionários atrapalhados, restaurantes com o atendimento dos garçons péssimo, nem um pouco atenciosos. Enfim não indicaria este hotel  que, apesar de muito bonito, pouco tem a oferecer pelo custo tão alto .

reviews.author: crystalline242
reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: We came to cancun for the renown service.  This is our 4th time in Mexico and have stayed in Riveria Maya and Cancun before. First let me say they call the junior suites but they are regular rooms. When we tried to upgrade and pay they said they had no more ocean view room suites. Meanwhile the hotel was so empty it could count on our hands the number of people walking around. We asked for a crib to be in the room but there was no crib and even hours later after we ate I had to call again. Then I called for some hot water for the babies bottle and it took an hour and and a half to deliver hot water. I just wanted to warm up my baby's bottle and there is no microwave in room. Nervous about the rest of our stay here. I am quite disappointed so far especially with the service.

reviews.author: avb2k
reviews.title: How disappointing for that amount of money
reviews.text:
This is my first review of a hotel in my life. I have been to many many hotels and never felt I needed to add to the reviews that already existed until now.

First the positive, the food is decent in this hotel and the location, pool and beach are pleasant and the inside is well done.

Now to the part which made me want to write a review: We had booked an 8 day stay at their family concierge service for over 5000$ for the three of us (my wife and our 2 yr old son)
I had asked for an early check in at 2 pm instead of 3 pm before we arrived so we could freshen up and take care of the needs of the two year old.

We got ushered into the family concierge area which I thought was a nice start but I was wrong. Of course early check in was not available. The whole check in procedure took over 45 minutes with crying kids in the background and total disorganization from the check in staff. After traveling for 8 hours with a child it would have been nice if our stuff would have been ready and check in would have been fast. My inlaws that had booked a regular room checked in within 10 minutes. They also paid 1000$ for their stay. 
After waiting until 4 our room was finally available and we were taken by a lady called Fernanda to our room in pyramid 3. I asked her if there would be any noise since the room was above the main bar especially having our child in mind and she said, there was never a complaint about noise. So I trusted her.
At 8 o clock at night just when our little one went off to sleep it was like a night club in our room. The music was so loud it was almost damaging to our ears. Needless to say I asked the next day to be moved and they could only accommodate us the following day.
We were moved to pyramid 1, which was very quiet. The room was ok but there was a wet puddle on the floor from the AC which was dangerous on the tiles for slipping. Other issues we had was that the minibar was never refilled nor the coffees etc. We had to call for it almost every day.
At the family concierge area we booked a bali bed for 50$ per day which was dirty when we arrived and it took the gentleman an hour to make those beds in the morning. We encountered drunk party people with beers in their hands in the morning in the kids area, couples on lounge chairs without kids smoking. There was no one that told them off our asked them to go to a different section of the hotel/pool
Our inlaws did everything that we did but paid 1000$ less. I must say that our child did receive during the stay a coloring book, 5 cookies and a marionette when we left. But is that really worth 1000$? I think the family concierge thing is a scam as we could have had the same benefits minus the cookies etc for 1000$ less. If you have a kids program you should maybe have the kids needs at heart by giving quieter rooms, more attention, faster check in, no smoking area?

At check out we got overcharged 150$ which was due to the exchange rate eventhough our booking was confirmed in dollars. The lady Maria at the concierge kept saying she would sort it out but blamed the overcharge on our bank and to date we have not heard from her.

I think the hotel is good if you get a decent rate but for the rate we paid we can have a lot better especially with kids in mind

reviews.author: Miguel I
reviews.title: Les falta mucho por mejorar!!!!
reviews.text:
Estuve hospedado en la fecha del sabado 20 al 23 de Diciembre y resulto que en esa misma fecha llego un grupo de personas bastante numeroso, de una empresa estadounidense. No sé si el servicio que me prestaron se deba a eso pero: 
Lo que me molesto del hotel 
•	sabiendo que tenían ese compromiso decidan cerrar restaurantes por atender a el grupo de la empresa, cuando se compró el hospedaje  lo que nos vendieron fue un todo incluido no tan barato que debía ser completo con todos los restaurante no solo los que ellos decidieran, esto para mí es un robo por parte de la gerencia.
•	Otra cosa que a mi gusto, es bastante malo, es el servicio de meseros realmente hay muy pocos meseros que sean buenos. Yo no sé si se deba a que luzco bastante mexicano y piensen que no dejare propina o a que se deba. Gerencia espero que le des más capacitación a tu personal, no culpo al personal pues entiendo que la atención está en función de la  capacitación. Y por lo que se ve a ustedes no les importan sus empleados por eso tratan así a la gente al menos los meseros. Como anécdotas, fui al restaurante de espadas Grill no sé qué, y uno de sus meseros en plena cena estaba gritándole a otro mesero, entiendo que la gente se equivoque y sobre todo si acaba de empezar, pero no me parece el lugar apropiado ponerse a corregirlos delante de los comensales. El ultimo día fui corrido por un mesero del restaurante central  que solo funciono el ultimo día por un mesero, no recuerdo su nombre del restaurante pero esta por el área del jardín en donde en el centro tienen una fuente, que según porque no traíamos reservación  nadie nos pidió esta al entrar por lo que entendimos que se podía pasar, lo que me molesto fue el tono en el que nos lo dijo, volví a pasar y nadie estaba vacío. Como consejo le sugiero al gerente que vaya a the royal cancun para que vea que es que te traten bien.
•	El Bufet en relación precio comida es malísimo, yo esperaba algo mejor en los restaurantes, y el primer día en verdad me gusto, pero conforme fueron pasando los días, yo no sé si se les acabo la comida por el grupo que estaba en esas fechas o que paso pero cada vez fue peor.

Lo que me gusto del Hotel.
•	El servicio en el restaurante de comida peruana, fue bastante bueno la comida en este restaurante la recomiendo, cabe mencionar que solo estuvo abierto una sola vez. Otro restaurante ese siempre estuvo abierto y que me agrado la atención fue el de taquitos, la atención muy buena la comida, no vale mucho la pena lo único que a mi gusto vale la pena son los tacos de lengua bastante buenos.
•	Tienen bonita playa y mar.
•	Las albercas son bastante limpias.
En general yo no recomendaría este hotel, y por supuesto no regreso otra vez. Yo espero que la gerencia haga cambios en su personal.

reviews.author: Rampr
reviews.title: Average to poor experience
reviews.text: Resort was clean. Not kid friendly. No kid activities except for a large pool. No entertainment in the evening. Food is vegetarian unfriendly and insensitive. The restaurants made an effort at serving vegetarian food but they had very little concept. Resort is old and rooms need a lot of reoairs. They say they have free wifi but it does not work in the rooms

reviews.author: Denisse a
reviews.title: Problemas llave y agencia de viajes
reviews.text: En cuanto instalaciones y restaurantes excelente... El problema fue la llave de la habitación  en 5 días  de estancia 4 días  fallo  y era molesto estar hablando cada que queriamos entrar... respecto a la agencia que vende paseos xcaret pesimo servicio... Ponen horario y lobby como sitio de encuentro y el camión jamas subio y dejo un grupo de 26 personas y nadie se hizo responsable

reviews.author: Melissa D
reviews.title: Not what we expected from Melia
reviews.text:
Upon stepping in to the Paradisus Cancun, we immediately felt a different atmosphere from that of the Reserve at the Paradisus in Punta Cana. We moved from NJ to TX in July after having booked our favorite destination; The Reserve at the Paradisus Punta Cana. There were no direct flights from Austin to the DR so we changed our vacation plans to The Paradisus Cancun. We trusted the Melia name and felt it would be just as nice and up to Melia standards. Although the all-inclusive fees are lower in Cancun, we did not expect that to be reflected in service, quality and appearance. 
     That being said, here's my review:
      I had requested an ocean view room weeks prior to our arrival, I also requested a platnum upgrade as we are RCI platnum members. This request was not even considered. We were not greeted with cool towels and drinks like we were in Punta Cana. They did greet some guests this way but it seems if you're staying with RCI you aren't worthy. 
    Our room was a nice size but outdated and mediocre with a view of the road and lagoon (which gets no sun till the afternoon and is not very pleasant) I don't go on vacation to hear cars driving by. When we were shown to our room, the bell hop didn't even come in and show us around he just grabbed hip tip and left. We were treated better at the Vacation Village in Kissimmee!
     The bathroom is cramped and old. I have a nicer tub at home! No jacuzzi (as we've had in all other resorts) The toilets ran all night and there were spots on the wall where there used to be telephones. It was not nice to look at. 
     The staff was hit or miss. The bartenders at the pool bar and the Avenue were the best part of the trip! Those guys rock! The mini-bar person was rude and uninterested in anything we asked for. 
     We had a nice time and if we hadn't experienced the Paradisus in Punta Cana, I don't think we would have been expecting as much as we were from Melia. We may try their other resort in Playa Del Carmen next year, but I'm now sceptical because of this experience. It wasn't horrible by any means, but it wasn't amazing and something I'd consider a year of hard work and saving for. If you have the money I highly recommend foregoing the Paradisus Cancun and spending your hard earned money at the Reserve at the Paradisus Punta Cana instead!

reviews.author: alecerdlom
reviews.title: Not great
reviews.text:
I book to this hotel because my great experience in Paradisus Playa del carmen.  Did not like it, did not enjoyed it.  Terrible food, too crowded, terrible service at a buffette restaurant.  Pool area too crowded bad service, too slow.  Rooms are old.  Children area is not usefull if you have toodlers because you hace to stay there the hole time and theres no enough toys for them to play with.

There is no comparison to Paradisus Playa del Carmen.

reviews.author: Patriciap47
reviews.title: Embarrassed
reviews.text: We took our entire family of 11 to this hotel for a Thanksgiving holiday week. We have vacationed together 5 times and sorry to say this was the worst. Ages range from Grandpa and Grandma late 60's to our married kids in their 40's and grand kids all boys, 11, 16, 16, 18. I will try to be brief and direct. The 2 Stars were for the waiters Luis, Luis, Jesus and cleanliness of the facility. First check in was a nightmare with no air conditioning anywhere but our rooms. It took 3 hours to check in and that was after reaching the desk. A long flight, sweat and tired we finally reached our rooms. Nice enough. Beds hard and old mattresses. 2 pools, one hot like a sauna, the other where the bar was along with hot tub were freezing. No hot tub there. Jets but freezing cold water. Bali beds at the beach cost a bottle of rum. $125.00. We are good tippers so we received great service. Ocean was beautiful. Very rough. Ages in this resort were young couples with lots of kids. No teenagers. They had a kids club but that was it. Nothing for our boys. Thank god we brought a football to toss around. No activities at all. They had classes at the cold pool but no one would go into water.....cold. Lots of stairs with no railings for us older people. So many restaurants. No reservations so had to wait 1-2 hours for table of 11. I'll make it simple. Food was horrible. Every restaurant tasted like the one before. We are not snobs by any means but we could not find anything that tasted good. These other reviewers...I have no idea where they ate. Vento was the only one I thought was acceptable. Everyone went to Walmart to get processed food. The fruit was good but you can't eat that every minute. We had 4 rooms. And they were only cleaned 3 of our 7 days. The refrigerator was supposed to be stocked every day. Nope not even close. Had to call down and still had problems. Never replaced coffee, soap, shampoo. We tipped too. Really. Entertainment was in a small room that you could never get near. You could hear but never see. So that's about it. We have had wonderful times in Disney, Cancun at Dreams, Moon Palace in Punta Cana. This hotel was chosen by my travel agent. Really? Even the hot dogs and hamburgers were not edible.....this is an open hotel so the blast of hot humid air is everywhere except your room. We asked for a cot in one of the rooms. 3 adults in a room with 2 double beds. The cot was ordered when I booked the trip in August. After calling non stop, we finally received the cots on the 3 rd night. My biggest thing is this was probably our last trip together related to health issues and I just wish the reviews had reflected the truth. Beware of this hotel.

reviews.author: Ana Vega
reviews.title: Overpriced and very bad service
reviews.text:
It was a big hotel with nice rooms but very bad service. The first day I got there, the concierge took around 1 hour to take my luggage to my room and I had to call receptions. It seemed as if they had forgotten about it. I went there as a business trip and when leaving, the concierge lost the bag of one of my team mates making us run late to the airport. This happened on November 7th and till this date (8 days later), it has not been recovered. The fact that the suit case was lost made our whole experience very bitter. 

Another thing we experienced was that the staff would over charge without consulting. We all agreed as a team, that we will not come back or organize a seminar again in this hotel.

reviews.author: Noori B
reviews.title: MONEY STOLEN FROM ROOM- USE SAFE!
reviews.text:
The hotel, view, and location are all gorgeous! So beautiful.
Unfortunately, money ($180.00) was stolen out of our room from a friends purse the FIRST day of our stay. Room service came in the evening ( around 730pm) and we suspect they were the culprits. No other days did room service come in the evening.
When we reported the incident to Security, 3 men searched our room for 3 hours and the head of security made up a bogus story saying our friend left the room door open and had to be escorted to the room in the middle of the night because she was so drunk( which was not the case AT ALL). It was convenient for him to tell us this story AFTER the money went missing. 
USE THE SAFE AT ALL TIMES! nothing valuable should be left out. 

The food available at the resort outside by the pool was okay- but the hamburgers gave me food poisoning. Be careful with eating the meat that has been sitting out in the sun and not cooked properly. 

The bartenders called us "Borrachitas"! No bueno.

reviews.author: salosm
reviews.title: Don't let them fool you
reviews.text: You pay a lot and obviously expext luxury. You won't get it in here. Food and service is not even average. All restaurants except Tempo (not included as All Inclusive plan) serve the same and the food is bad, not enough servers and you have to wait long to eat or drink. If you want to get comfortable in the pool or beach in a bed you have to pay 50 USD a day. If this is your budget there are a lot of better hotels in Cancun

reviews.author: PimpMx
reviews.title: Dejo mucho que esperar
reviews.text:
Es un hotel excelente, "todo incluido", ya que cuando llegamos el frigobar de la habitación no enfriaba y todo estaba caliente y no puedes pedir más de lo que ya te incluye el frigobar, por ejemplo queríamos cervezas en la noche, ya que nuestro check in fue a las 11 pm... y no quisieron proporcionarnos más... creo que los empleados se enfocan más en visitantes extranjeros que en los nacionales. Muy mal!

En la noche, la playa esta totalmente oscura y no se puede ver más que llevando lamparas.

reviews.author: Dominic Z
reviews.title: Nice stay but was stolen from by housekeepers
reviews.text: Overall the property and employees were very nice. Settlement to our experience was having money stolen by housekeeping. After talking to front desk and being questioned by "investigation team" of hotel employees we were never offered anything in retribution. We were told at checkout to contact their chief concierge. Due to this I would not stay or recommend this property.

reviews.author: michellef16
reviews.title: Below average - go to Playa del Carmen resort instead
reviews.text:
After staying at the Paradisus in Playa del Carmen, we were looking forward to the visit to the Cancun resort. There is absolutely no comparing the 2. I haven't been to any other resorts in Cancun, so my comparsion is against that.The only thing better about the Cancun resort is its proximity to the airport. 

Overall is just wasn't good. The food was not good - especially the room service. Also with the room service - no matter what time or what you ordered it always took over an hour (even if you ordered the night before there was a delay). The pools were ok, but the main pool with the bar was pretty deep and hard to stand and talk and relax for a long period of time. The service was subpar. The only exception was the spa! The massage was amazing.

reviews.author: AnneBay
reviews.title: Bad perfume/Glade plug-in smell throughout
reviews.text:
The hotel was excellent in service, pool, the people, etc. But the killer for us was the horrible glad scented plug-in smell piped through the air system. Was not in the rooms, thankfully, at least where we were, but all the common areas, elevators, bathrooms, the family concierge... Gave us bad headaches. They seemed to think it was some sort of "ambiance," apparently unaware that tons of research links perfume to migraines. Was really bad in the kids zone. Could not step foot inside the hotel without getting a headache. We complained a lot about it, but they said they could not do anything -- many of the staff hate it too, and would cover their noses. 
Wifi did not work except if you sat underneath the hub, which was in the hallway. 
Their version of a "suite" is a room with multiple beds, the size of a regular motel 6 room. We had to get the 1 bedroom to have any space (mother-in-law and child were with us), and that was a pull-out couch. All that would have been fine - the smell was the killer. 
Oh, there are not enough beach chairs with umbrellas to go around, so you have to go down early in the morning to reserve one -- 7am they were all gone but 1. You could pay for a Bali Bed, but most of those were on reserve for some other special group inside the hotel. And they cost $50 a day.

reviews.author: PJeff81
reviews.title: Way off the mark
reviews.text:
This was my 4th time to Mexico where I had previously stayed at Sercets The Vine/Silversands/Maroma and Dreams Riviera. I thought I would book Paradisus for something different but very quickly regretted that decision. 

Positives:
Amazing beach. Crystal clear water and white sand. 
First impression of the Hotel was really nice. As soon as you walk in you think you are somewhere special. 
Unfortunately that's it! 

Negatives: 
Service: Awful! Too much to list so won't go into detail. 
Amenities: So it's an 'All inclusive Resort' but you need a wrist band? You will quickly realise that not only do you have to book restaurants every night for the next night at a specific time, but not every restaurant in the resort is included! 
Also the hotel don't seem to accept dollars. This would have been good to know at check in to save the embarrassment of going in the shop making our own coffee going to the till to be told you need local currency. 
You need cards for towels on the beach, which we didn't get at check in. Due to the size of the resort the last thing you want to do is be refused towels on the beach and have to walk through the hotel in wet trunks. Why aren't there towels on the sun beds? 
Rooms: Poor. So on the balcony you get 1 sun lounger? So I guess your meant to top and tail with your loved one?  
Food: I'm not a fussy eater in the slightest but I couldn't eat anything that was put in front of me. No taste, no presentation and not really much choice. 

Conclusion: 
Having been to other resorts in the area it is obvious that Paradisus is so far away from being a five star hotel. I would strongly advise you to consider any secrets, dreams or now resort. All inclusive to them means all inclusive, no restaurant reservations required, amazing food and impeccable service. You are treated with a real personal touch unlike Paradisus where you are just a number. 
Two nights into our stay here we knew we couldn't bare it anymore so fortunately our holiday rep changed us to Secrets Silversands, which was AMAZING! Paradisus showed no remorse in losing our custom. Summed it up for us!!

reviews.author: Gislobera
reviews.title: Deberia decir habitación con alimentos y bebidas, no todo incluido
reviews.text: Me hospede con mi esposo del 23 al 27 de agosto para festejar nuestro aniversario, envié correos al área de romance para conocer costos e informes y disfrutar mejor la estancia, los cuales sigo esperando. Llegamos a las 12:30 y no se nos recibió como dice la publicidad ( con toalla para refrescarnos y coctel de bienvenida), nos entregaron la habitación hasta las 15:30, por lo que tuvimos que dar vueltas por tres horas sin poder cambiarnos ni descansar. La habitación dejo mucho que desear, dicen que son de lujo, pero el aire acondicionado hacia mucho ruido, la lámpara de la entrada no funcionaba, la bañera no servía, el toallero, el tubo de la cortina y el picaporte de la puerta del baño a punto de caerse. Reportamos las fallas y se corrigió lo de la lámpara el primer día, lo de la bañera el segundo y el aire acondicionado después de dos visitas hasta el tercer día, lo demás quedo igual. Lo del titulo es porque dicen que es todo incluido, pero existen varios costos extra: camas en la playa.- 50 dólares, servicio medico 120 dólares la consulta, tours con descuento condicionado a tomar la platica del club Melia. No incluye WIFI en las habitaciones como se publicita y el costo de llamada por teléfono nacional era de 38 pesos el minuto. Si desean deberás conocer un hotel con todo incluido reserven en la cadena palace, como en el moon  o el beach. Yo no vuelvo a hospedarme en este hotel.

reviews.author: John H
reviews.title: would not return
reviews.text: Went to Paradisus Cancun for a wedding.  We had 30 people staying and the first thing they asked went we checked in was if we wanted to upgrade for $200 we said no and then they gave us the same upgrade for free.  Then they give you a coupon book so you can spend all your money at the resort. They screwed up the rehearsal dinner and then tried to charge us more money for the dinner then the wedding was going to cost.  Only after contacting every major person in the corporation was that resolved.

reviews.author: lalab123
reviews.title: We can't recommend it....
reviews.text: We recently stayed here and I really don't know where to start....first, the hotel does have a nice appearance and most (not all) of the staff are nice and polite. The main problem here is how how the lobby and other common areas are too hot!!! We couldn't sit at any of the bars for long because we were drenched in sweat.  The room ac worked ok but never got very cold.  Our room did not face the pool and ocean, which was disappointing. The food is ok, but not good. I hate being critical, but there are just other places where we have stayed that are much better. In fact, the first part of our week we stayed at the Hyatt Zilara and it was wonderful!! We have also stayed at Live Aqua and it is also amazing!! I would pick other places over the Paradisus.

reviews.author: Meghan C
reviews.title: Cancun trip Ruined
reviews.text: The hotel itself was beautiful. That is my only compliment. We waited for 3 hours for our luggage to arrive to our room after check in. It was lost in the hotel because the bellmen brought it to the incorrect room. Glasses and camera were both stolen by employees. All inclusive but need a 24hr reservation before hand was not compensating to us. We would recommend Fiesta Americana Condensa again instead of this hotel. We regret venturing to try a new hotel.

reviews.author: David K
reviews.title: Poor Service
reviews.text:
I gave two stars out of three because for me service out weighs the facility and beach.

STAFF/SERVICE:  This was the rudest staff I've ever experienced on a resort.  Food Service people were very polite and friendly.  However, anyone working behind the desks were much more rude than what I'm used to.  I work in New York City and live in New Jersey so I'm used to rude people and even I was taken by surprised.  Lot of them don't even look at you in the eye when you speak to them.  I've had one staff (Delia) that worked in room registration that rolled her eyes during conversation.
