I was also had someone say "it's you again...." when approaching the front desk.  My luggage was lost during the flight and no one helped.  It was left me to keep going to concierge to ask for help.  Even the concierge never went out of their way to help.  I had to explicitly ask them to call the airport for them to assist with the situation.

FACILITY:  Not a bad hotel.  Large hotel so you won't feel trapped.  Rooms are not bad, but stay away from top floor as it gets hotter as your go up floors.  There were no chairs were prepared in my balcony so I had to ask for it.  All other rooms had a chair in the balcony.  The fridge in the room didn't work.  I didn't bother asking them to fix it.  

BEACH:  Beach is not bad as well and plenty of pool space.  Sand is pretty fine and gets finer as you go into the water.  Beach wasn't over crowded, but recommend going out early enough in the morning to claim a chair.  Most people woke up and put their towel on the beach chair before grabbing their breakfast.

FOOD:  I thought the food was good.  Had to wait at least 20 minutes every time I made dinner reservations but was worth it.  Make dinner reservations in the morning as most get booked by night.  

ACTIVITIES:  There is aquawater company right across the street and onsite to entice you with various activities (at cost) so you will have plenty of extra activities to do.  We went on snorkeling package at Isla Mujeres.  Snorkeling itself wasn't impressive and was short, but the trip itself was great as the package includes time on the island.  We rented a golf cart for $30 and rode around the island which was fun.  

Overall, the resort is not bad if you don't mind the rudeness.  If you are like me and service is important to you, avoid this place.

reviews.author: Laura F
reviews.title: Too Hot and Food Not
reviews.text:
Hotel is too hot. Glass roof in atrium of main building creates too much heat and AC not sufficient in rooms to feel relief.
Pool water also too hot. Not refreshing at all.
Most restaurants require reservations yet are empty and still wont seat you if without a reservation.  Food choices limited and small portions.

reviews.author: Amanda S
reviews.title: Nice resort but EXTREMELY disappointing royal service!
reviews.text:
This review is a bit late seeming as we went in March but i have been busy and wanted to share. My fiancé and I stayed at the Paradisus from Feb 26 - March 5th. We are both in our mid twenties and felt as though we were treated differently then the older guests. We booked royal service as we were looking at the resort as a potential wedding venue. This was our first mistake. At no point did we ever receive any royal services. Having spent as much money as we did it was frustrating to feel the entire week that you had to tip excessive amounts of money to actually receive this royal service. Do not get me wrong I always tip but when you have to go your maid $100 tip to get her to clean thats ridiculous.

Butler Service-
Our butler was Sergio, and he was never found anywhere, when we did interact with him he seemed disinterested. He insisted on making our a la carte reso's so we agreed and let him know we would be doing excursions during the day so not to book anything before 7pm. We are also very easy going and said we don't care where we eat as long as it is somewhere different every night. So imagine our surprise when we returned from our excursion one day and had missed our dinner reservation as he had booked it for 5:00pm. He said he would make our redo for the pool cabanas meanwhile when we went there, there was none made. When we found him finally and asked he shrugged his shoulders said he forgot. we spoke with other older couples who had him as a butler and said he was outstanding. I do not know if it is because we are young and he assumed we were cheap that he essentially ignored us the entire week but i was extremely disappointed and had high hope for the experience. 

Room-
Our room was nice and clean on the first day we arrived. After that it went down hill quickly. We had been given a platter with welcome fruit and cake on it, which was nice, until it was left in our room on the table for 3 days, even after we had left a note for the maid to collect it. This plate caused an army of ants to invade our room so the whole floor under the bed and next to the bed was covered in ants. I get it is a tropical climate and ants happen, but what is not ok is when we report to the royal service desk THREE times and nothing was done about it besides them lazily mopping the area of the floor. When we asked twice to switch rooms we were told nothing was available and they would contact us the next day, this went on for two days and we finally gave up. Our maid was non existent, the only way we could tell she had been there was the bed was made. We were there for my fiances birthday and a bottle of champagne in a bucket of ice had been left in our room, with a piece of cake. Once again this would have been a nice gesture, except the plate and ice bucket sat in our room for 3 days before we complained to the front desk to have to removed. We finally got fed up and asked to have a new maid for our room. The royal service desk apologized, sent someone up to clean the room properly and then the next day it was back to the same lazy maid. VERY disappointing considering we left the maid a $5 tip everyday. I guess thats not enough as another couple we met on the same floor said they had left $100 on the f first day and received great service. 

Royal Service Pool - 
While the food and drinks at the royal service pool are on point the organization of the cabanas is horrible. We were there in a high point of the season and the hotel only guarantees that you get a cabana for 2 days of your stay. That would be acceptable if that limit was actually enforced. As previously mentioned our butler was useless which led to me trying to book the cabanas on my own. Everyone on these reviews are always praising David, these must be the people who slipped him a $50. We had to argue and fight to get cabanas, and when we put ourselves on the waiting list to get one we sat next to the booth all morning waiting to get one of the empty one only to have them given to other people who walked up and gave David money for it. I no for a fact this was occurring as we made friends with a couple who had a cabana for all 7 days they were at the resort, and they told us on the first day they gave David $100 and told him to take care of them and low and behold they had one everyday. This is disgusting, the resort should list on the website that booking royal service simply gives you the opportunity to tip and pay extra money for the services that are supposed to be included for FREE.

Yhi Spa-
DO NOT book any massages through the spa. I payed over $100 for a 1 hour massage and the lady spent maybe 20 mins actually touching me. The other 40 minutes where spent walking around the room, and adjusting the sheet. I have received better massages for $10 in Cuba on the beachfront. 

Overall the property and food at this resort is amazing. I could not have asked for better. But unless you are over the age of 50 or are willing to spend excessive amounts of extra money to receive services that are supposed to be included do not visit this resort. I am not alone on thinking the service we received varied drastically from older patrons. Many older patrons we talked to were shocked at the way we were treated compared to themselves. It is unfortunate because i would have loved to returned to this resort, and the wedding package they offered looked beautiful and sophisticated and I had high hopes, but considering the service we received i could consider entrusting this service staff with the biggest day of my life.

reviews.author: Amarilis R
reviews.title: Verano 2014
reviews.text:
Por este medio quisiera compartir mi experiencia en este resort. Aunque llegamos recomendamos por unas amistades, entendíamos que por el precio que pagamos estaríamos en un lugar 5 estrellas. Eramos un grupo de 31 personas la bienvenida estuvo muy buena, la acomodación también, el servicio brindado por Juan y Hector  fue de A+++  ellos fueron los mayordomos asignados Royal Service . Fuimos a comer en en Blue Agave y por estar vestidos con ropa de playa, no nos dejaron comer en el restaurant  el encargado de nombre Gabriel fue un poco brusco en la forma en que nos dijo que no podíamos comer hay, hay que hacer la aclaración que estamos en un resort de playa. 
La comida no tiene buen gusto,  nada de la comida me impresiono. 
En términos generales muy caro para lo que encontré en el resort. 
La verdad ni lo recomiendo ni vuelvo a este hotel.

reviews.author: ajay7232014
reviews.title: Not all inclusive...
reviews.text:
i went to the Paradisus Cancun with my fiance from July 6, 2014 to July 11,2014. We had purchased the vacation through a travel agency and were given a MY TIME reservation, which basically gives you a booklet of coupons for discounts to the resort. one of the coupons was a room upgrade to an ocean front view. Upon check in, we asked if we could to do a room upgrade to an ocean front view, which they had ( i called the travel agency the Monday  before departing and was told they were all booked up)  and they had said that the room wasn't ready until 2:30pm. but before we could have done anything, we were bombarded with people asking us to sign up with them to go see a 5-6 hour time share presentation so we can get $100 for a couples massage. the woman that we were dealing with, did not know how to explain why the time share presentation was so long. all she kept saying was , you buy $100 for massage, you go to time share presentation, we give you another $100 for massage. My fiance asked how much it would be for a couples massage and the woman jumped the price from $250 to $500! We looked at each other and said " we will think about it over lunch " and we walked away. 
 
Once we went to lunch, we sat outside by the "market grill"  since there were no tables inside, it was hot and muggy. no ventilation. a waiter came and asked us for drinks, only beer they had was tecate, sol, or dos equis, nothing else.  took him about 10 minutes to come back with them, and took the plates away. He asked my fiance if he would like anything else to drink and my fiance said cappuccino, it took the waiter another 10 minutes to come back.He took one sip and said he was full. 
 
After lunch went to the stores in the hotel, and when we got back to the main check in area for 2:30pm, we were told that check in was after 3:30. this basically ruined a day of relaxing by the pool or beach, since we didn't have our bathing suits with us. Once we got our hotel key, we went to check out the room. an ocean front jr suite was tiny! i went to other resorts, and a jr suite usually has a couch area to sit down and watch tv. this did not. it was a king size bed, 2 night stands, and right next to it, a small sofa and coffee table. the table and chairs in the corner were dirty and one of the chairs had a HUGE stain mark on it. the balcony only had one lounge chair, nothing to hang your wet clothes on to dry. we asked for the bell boy to bring another one up. he said that he put it in for a request, NEVER heard back from him.
 
the hotel is NOT air conditioned!! there are vines that hang over the rails of each floor, and in the center of the hotel, there is a Japanese restaurant.  Speaking of restaurants, we were told that we can only make reservations for one place at a time, and we had to do it from 6-9 am. we were told that the restaurants were all booked up for Sunday and Monday and the earliest would be Tuesday for a booking. When we went to dinner in the buffet around 8pm on Sunday night, the restaurants by there were EMPTY!!! maybe only 3 families in each of them. In the buffet, my fiance asked again for a cappuccino, but the waiter looked irritated and said it was broken. so we just ate and left.
 
Back in the hotel room, we had the DO NOT DISTURB sign on the door. the maid for the turn down service knocked once and was about to open the door. Do they not read the signs? 
 
On Monday, my fiance went to see if we could sign up and do any of activities through the hotel, but since i was not with him, the agent said he wasn't able to give the FULL explanation. No pamphlets or anything. The agent said that both parties have to be there. After having our breakfast and set reservations for dinner, which we were told only one restaurant was available (everything else was "booked up"), we went to the agent, and he kept pushing for the aquatic park that was right across the street from the hotel. i heard amazing reviews from Isla Mujeres, so we ended up going there. (everything was fun, except for the prices for the pictures $80 USD for 2 pictures with dolphins?!?!?) really? 
 
oh lets not forget, YOU MUST ONLY ASK FOR BOTTLED WATER!!! Don't drink the water when they pour it in the glass for you, and i unfortunately did drink from the glass and got EXTREMELY sick. I was in the bathroom all night!  
 
In the MOLE restaurant, the waiter comes by and offers you a wine list, never says anything about prices, we don't ask since everything is ALL- INCLUSIVE. after my fiance decides on a glass of wine, the waiter comes back and says he has to chill it a bit more, but opens the bottle up, gave my fiance a sample, and after that he walks away. about 15 minutes later, he comes back, pours the wine, and says the wine is not part of the inclusive deal, we would have to pay extra for it. we were not sure what he meant by that, so after the "average" meal, the waiter comes and gives us a bill. $17 USD for 1 glass of wine?!?? he said that the wine which was picked was domestic, so wouldn't that mean free? No. so the money that was to be left as a tip, was the money to pay for the wine. We get back to the room, and BEHOLD, in that booklet, a coupon for that restaurant for $20 off wine!! So the all inclusive hotel is indeed NOT all inclusive.
 
the last problem we had with the hotel was on Thursday, we woke up early around 610am and placed towels under the palm umbrellas by the pool. around 830am, we go for breakfast, i check and the towels and shirt we left are still there. but by 10 away when we go to the pool, there is a family of about 10 people sitting in our spot. They said that they took the spot because there was more room, which i understand since there was 10 of them and only 2 of us. we asked if they saw anyone sitting in the area next to them, and the daughter said we came at 930 and no one has been here. so we sat down, and at about 1130, i go to use the restroom, and some woman goes and sits down in my lounge chair. after explaining to the woman that we were there for over an hour, we get a manager, waiter, security guard, whatever he was, says that there is a rule for reserving anything for only 30 minutes and if you are not there, the seat can be taken. So the employee says that he will move her to another area, but would have to take the lounge chair i was laying on! i said absolutely not, i was there before her, she comes down and claims the area after 90 minutes or more of not being there. the employee finds her another area next to the bali beds, and leaves. 
 
so in all, I would have expected more for the price that we paid. I have numerous friends that are planning a trip to Cancun, and I will make sure that they don't go there and have the experience that we had. Also, MAKE SURE THAT ALL INCLUSIVE MEANS ALL INCLUSIVE!!

PS the "free wifi" throughout the hotel is poor.. the best service is outside by the pool. and at about 9pm the service gets so slow, also as if they cut it out..

reviews.author: jill s
reviews.title: Very disappointed
reviews.text:
Complete waste of money for my family…book my old standby the Fiesta Americana Condessa-From the moment we arrived (family of 4) and were told to wait in a lobby with an ambient temperature of 85 degrees, where we waited for over 2 hours I knew we were in trouble in Paradisis.  Once we were finally helped we were placed on the first floor-which always worries me for safety reasons.  I asked to be moved-I was told, and this is a quote “someone has to be unhappy as our resort is full” and then made to wait another ½ hour for our room (miniroom) to be assigned.  Our “suite” was not a suite-a small room (with a large balcony bereft of any furniture to sit on).  We were also told we would be unable to book a place to dine for the evening.  Once we got to our room “Marta” called-with an insistence we go to a sales pitch in order to “learn the resort”-unless you go to this pitch nobody upon checkin offers the mearest information on the hotel, how to book dinners, etc. 

Then off to the pool-why do they fail to mention all the pools are 5’5” (tooo deep for me nonetheless my kids) with the exception of a small, very shallow (maybe 1.2’) kiddie area-no zero depth-the only place kids can stand and not have to hang on a tall person or swim is the bar area, where my kids were sometimes exposed to nasty behavior language and people smoking a “hookah”…
The next day I spend a looooong time with Sergio, the head concierge.  He told me the hotel was full up and apologized and asked how he could help, as we had an 8 night stay.  We asked if he would mind helping us book our dinner reservations and a “bali bed” for 2 days….well, he booked the first night reservation…and that was it.  We went to find our Bali Bed and ran around for literally over 1 hour to find it had never been booked.  At this point we basically gave up and booked a few (very expensive) outings to Xel-ha (fabulous) Tulum (fabulous but hot) and Isla Mujares (loved it too, especially the turtles) and took the Paradisis for what it is –a body shop.
To end on a sour note-on our last night, our kids wanted a “final drink at the swimup bar”-but it was closed for a private event.  So we ended and began on a horrible note.
Be prepared for a hot, loud, crowded environment.  The beach itself, servers, and spa are the only bright spots.

reviews.author: mharrison60
reviews.title: Nice but had much better
reviews.text: Food was great.  Service was good....loved Francis in the kids club.  She was Wonderful!!! My daughter adored her. The pools were nice. Plenty of chairs, towel service was easy.  The beach had plenty of chairs and the beach was nice.  Unfortunately the Hotel was outdated and needs work.  Our room was pretty nice until it rained, then it flooded.   Many parts of the hotel flooded when it rained.  Buckets sat in several places to catch drips from the ceiling.   Our experience probably would have been much better had it not rained but when it rained it poured....all over the hotel...unfortunately. bottom line was it a good deal...absolutely. ...would we go back...probably not

reviews.author: Stephanie C
reviews.title: Over Promised / Under Delivered
reviews.text:
While I wanted to love this hotel and experience, it simply fell short.  I traveled with my husband and 2 children (5 & 7) for 5 nights last week and opted for the family concierge benefits.  The entire stay was a fight for anything that you have been promised, and while they tried to help if you called to ask/complain, you shouldn't have to ask!  Not for this price.

I wrote in to the hotel a month prior to our stay asking if we could request the jacuzzi on our balcony I had noticed in other reviews.  Upon check in they were nice enough to move our room to accommodate this request only to realize once we get there that the jacuzzi doesn't work!  If this is the sole reason for moving a guest, wouldn't you think to ensure it actually works?

The next day our fridge in the room is broken. They sent someone quickly but why is everything broken?  The following day there were ants everywhere, on the wall and on our table.  This was also taken care of however the ant problem came again when cookies for the kids were delivered during turndown.  We came back from dinner and the kids cookies were covered.  Really?

Alvaro, our personal butler, was anything but personal.  He checked us in and took us to our room and that was the last we saw of him (after tipping him of course).  Again, if we called the concierge, our requests were usually met quickly enough, but is this the personal service I was expecting and paying for?  No.  Our welcome bottle of liquor wasn't available and only delivered on day 3 of our 5 day stay.  We didn't need it at that point.  He made all of our restaurant reservations when we checked in, and on the final night they tried to tell me I didn't have a reservation.  By this point I'm annoyed with everything and got quite frustrated, telling them I would be right down to complain IN PERSON.  They called me right back with a convenient "cancellation" from another guest and honored my reservation.  Alvaro left us a note on our final day saying he was off but would see us tomorrow.  Guess what?  We are leaving in the morning so you will not see us, and if this was really personal service you would know that!

The chair/palapa saving is REAL and it's a pain.  I was up every morning at 6:30am to save our beach chairs with shade and was still barely able to snag one.  The shade by the pools were already taken by this time.  I have never experienced this in any other hotel, and certainly not to this degree.  GIVE US MORE SHADE!!  I also was under the impression that with family concierge you got at least 1 or 2 days of bali beds.  Not true.  They apparently ended that this year.  Thanks for telling me.

Mini-bar in the room?  Hardly.  2 beers and some sodas.  I had to request water multiple times but was only restocked once.

The pool is nice, but as everyone has mentioned it is VERY deep.  I could touch on my tip-toes only.  Don't most people want to walk around the pool a bit and enjoy it without having to do a full swim from one end to the other?  Yes the beach is beautiful, but overall the hotel and service was a complete let down.  I would stay elsewhere.

reviews.author: Gela F
reviews.title: Not Paradisus experience other locations offer
reviews.text:
This location is far from Paradisus experience you will get in DR or Esmeralda. Wish the name was different to avoid misleading customers. 

Hotel is old. Paradisus made an effort to bring some of its decor from DR, but this location lacks the serenity, beauty and landscape of other locations. Small. With most restaurants inside the hotel a long with other stores, it reminds more of a busy mall than a high end resort.

Beach is beautiful, but expect to spend most of your time thinking about how to get a chair. We arrived on Thursdays and were told that there were no availability until the following Tuesday to reserved beds by the pool or on the beach. Family concierge area had no reserved availability (like they do in DR) . Not only there is no availability you have to pay extra for it. Not the experience we had in DR. 

Kids club is not very friendly. Not a lot of engaging activities, mostly free play. Staff doesn't seem very interested in the kids. Our kids usually love kids clubs, but didn't enjoy this one at all.

I'd say this is easily the worth vacation we had.

reviews.author: Jenn B
reviews.title: Hit or Miss
reviews.text: Check in was  nightmare (hot room with cheap horrible drinks).    Food was great or horrible, service too.  The Pool was great, drinks at pool bar better then others. There are better places then this not a 4 star!

reviews.author: Carolina C
reviews.title: GRAN DECEPCIÓN
reviews.text:
Es un hotel hecho para atender a gente europea y americana, lamento decirlo y comprobarlo, pues mi esposo y yo le dábamos el beneficio de la duda, por favor NO CONTRATEN EL ROYAL SERVICE es un total ENGAÑO, el mayordomo no se aparece ni es las curvas del hotel, el mantenimiento de las habitaciones no es satisfactoria, la bienvenida es horrible , ya que la atención parece forzada, nosotros vinimos de luna de miel y estamos muy tristes porque no encontramos nada de lo que esperábamos! No hay animación en ninguna instalación! No hay mantenimiento a las instalaciones y la actitud de la mayoría es áspera. NO VALE LA PENA gastar en un resort, la pasamos mucho más rico cuando vinimos en plan mochila y gastamos mucho menos. 

La comida no es rica y el servicio es súper tardado. Lo peor es q nos restan la mitad de las vacaciones

reviews.author: NENA2326
reviews.title: GRAN DECEPCION!!!!... SOBRE TODO EL ROYAL SERVICE
reviews.text: Acudimos en dias pasados mi pareja y yo festejando nuestro aniversario de Boda. Con anterioridad estuvimos en el Resort cuando aun era Gran Melia, y la verdad nos causo una muy buena impresion. Lamentablemente esta ocasion todo fue TERRIBLE, y mas tomando en cuenta que optamos por el Royal Service. Para empezar, cabe mencionar que al llegar no fuimos recibidos por nadie!! Solo se nos pidio pasaramos a una sala interior en un lobby y esperaramos. Mas tarde acudio con nosotros una persona que nos comento que nos llevaria al Lobby del Royal Service, caminando entre habitaciones atravesando tres piramides por fin despues de 15 minutos sin recibir siquiera un vaso con agua ni explicacion de las instalaciones llegamos a un Patio Central de la piramide 5 donde esta ubicado el Lobby del Royal Service. Esperamos un rato y por fin la recepcionista nos atendio, de manera forzada, haciendonos saber generalidades sobre el cobro y la habitacion asignada. Se nos hizo saber que tendriamos una habitacion con dos camas... (aun y cuando sabian que acudiamos por festejo de aniversario), mencionando que nisiquiera nos felicitaron. (es eso un Royal Service????? obvio NOOOO). Hice saber que somos cliente Melia Rewards Gold y que unicamente estariamos 3 dias y necesitabamos disponer del Late Check Out que es beneficio de ser cliente GOLD, Y COMO SIEMPRE LA RESPUESTA ES.... dejeme ver que puedo hacer... para al final terminar en NO RERSOLVER NADA. Jamas son coherentes en otorgarnos los beneficios por ser Clientes Melia Rewards.. es un fraude... Al llegar a nuestra habitacion, la misma estaba sucia, en pesimas condiciones, con los pisos resanados y arenosos, telefonos inservibles sin linea, NINGUNA AMENIDAD ROYAL SERVICE!!!! Tinas en la regadera en pesimas condiciones, esto es... LAS HABITACIONES NO RECIBIERON NINGUN MANTENIMIENTO, a mi parecer son mejores las de la zona que no es Royal Service lo cual es vergonzoso por los costos que cobran del Servicio Real.  En fin, a las 11 pm tuvimos que solicitar un cambio de habitacion!!! y para colmo ni servicio de descuibierta nos realizaron. No habia restaurantes para la cena, nada especial. Echaron a perder nuestro festejo. Es una pena que la cadena MELIA, y sobre toda la linea de resorts PARADISUS CONSIDERADA POR NOSOTROS COMO CALIDAD CERTIFICADA EN EL SERVICIO E INSTALACIONES venda este hotel como un cinco estrellas y mas por esos costos con un supuesto SERVICIO REAL. Es un fraude. Al otro dia nos hacen saber que si queriamos una cama balinesa debiamos reservarla, proque no habia... que igual y para otro dia, con previa reservacion podrian hacer algo por nosotros... y sorpresa,... al salir.. todas las camas vacias y supuestamente reservadas. Pregunto nuevamente... ¿CREEN QUE ESO ES UN ROYAL SERVICE SEÑORES???? Pues no. Cualquier persona con un minimo de conocimientos en Hoteleria y Calidad en el Servicio lo sabria. Que decepcion. Las comidas en los buffettes pesimas. Siempre te sorprenden con una carta con alimentos con costos extras, como un simple corte de carne, mismo que NUNCA pudimos encontrar en el buffette. Que triste ver que Melia denigre asi la marca. Nuestro mayordomo era un mito. Por las mañanas nunca tuvimos mayordomo,... porque entraba a las 3pm. Eso es Royal Service.... NO LO PAGUEN... no vale la pena. No te hacen sentir especial ni consentido. y a las 10 de la noche... todo el lobby desiertoooo... los royal service no existiamos..... Que pena de servicio señores. Sobrevalorado, en ruinas y sin inversion de peso alguno en mantenimiento. No hay animacion, el hotel es un laberinto en el cual nunca nadie te puede ayudar ni hacer nada por ti. Aun asi, lo unico que lo rescata es la atencion de muchos empleados que realizan su mejor esfuerzo, sobre todo meseros y hostes. Si pueden elegir otra opcion en CANCUN ... no lo duden. Mas si acuden a festejar alguna fecha que merezca un recibimiento especial.

reviews.author: Johna B
reviews.title: Wasn't what we expected.
reviews.text: The resort was just too hot. All pools closed at 7:00 which was disappointing. The buffet was at best okay. The Royal Service wasn't any different then normal room service. The resort was very beautiful  though. If you're looking for beauty and not comfort.

reviews.author: MHB1971
reviews.title: Beautiful location, needs remodeling and new HVAC
reviews.text: I spent 5 days at the Paradisus for a business meeting. The price was certainly great for an all inclusive stay. However, food options are extremely limited if you have any dietary restrictions (e.g., gluten-free for medical reasons, thus cross contamination is an issue). While there are some restaurant options that could work, we were consistently told our only option was the main buffet restaurant. We had difficulty getting into the Japanese restaurant despite it being virtually empty one evening.  Overall, the hotel is extremely humid and air quality is poor - it smells very musty and moldy. Of course, that's hard to avoid due to all the indoor plants and water features. But, it was also that way in the meeting rooms in the convention center. And, it carries into the guest rooms.    It was quite strong in the bathtub area with the plexiglass bathtub shell moving under my feet, as well as in the toilet area.  Fortunately, the beach was nice so I minimized the time spent in the room. Since the Internet in the rooms did not work well at all (connecting for 2 minutes and then dropping all the time!), there wasn't much to do in the room anyways.

reviews.author: Lily_15701 M
reviews.title: No lo recomiendo
reviews.text: El hotel es lindo, pero en cuánto a la comida no tiene variedad... Siempre había lo mismo, Arroz, pastas y papas. Solo cerdo y pollo, la carne de vacuno no se veía mucho y mucho menos camarones. La bebida no muy buena

reviews.author: travelgure
reviews.title: Not so paradisus
reviews.text:
We went on vacation end of March for 9 days to Paradisus Cancun Mexico.We had been to the sister hotel (Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana Dominican Republic) 3 TIMES,so we assumed
we would get the same treatment,especially since we signed up for the family conciege.Not the case! When we arrived tired and just wanted to get to our rooms and unpack,we found out the rooms were not what we asked for(2 adjoining rooms 2 double beds).So they did switch us ,but it took 2 days to do so.Then when we got to the new rooms,yes they were nice and yes they were what we asked for however,the air conditioning was out in 1 room so it was 87 degrees for 2 nights not so great to sleep in.I do want to give a cheer to Reyes in family conciege,she went above and beyond she would not stop until the problem was finally resolved.Also the mini bar was not working and when i finally found someone who understood the problem they got a brand new one,but again,wish it would not have taken a day to get it fixed.I did really cut into our vacation time which is precious time you can't get back. Will i go back probably but to a different hotel.

Take my advice,go to the hotel in Punta Cana Dominican It is truely a 5 star hotel .
Paradisus Cancun A 3 star,they still need work.

Travelgure

reviews.author: Kany G
reviews.title: Pésima atención !!!
reviews.text:
El hotel es imponente por su enorme infraestructura pero es lo único que tiene. 
Y se presentan con una onda feng shui, spa, todos de ropas blancas y saludo ceremonioso. (El Spa es hermoso pero carísimo).
Pero es sólo apariencia porque la atención y organización es pésima!!!!! Porque:
- NUNCA conseguíamos reposera en la playa !!!! Aún llegando a las 8 de la mañana!!!!! Una vergüenza que semejante hotel no dispusiera de suficiente cantidad de lugar para estar en la playa !!!!! Ya que si no tenías la suerte de conseguir reposera, no tenías sombra!!!!!
-Otra cosa, te hacen perder muchísimo tiempo para comer en el buffet haciendo una cola esperando que una empleada te busque mesa, siendo que el buffet no era con reserva!!!!!! Todos saben lo que atesoramos nuestro tiempo en vacaciones y fuera de eso, cada uno debe disponer de su tiempo, no perderlo por la pésima atención de un hotel, 
-que es pretencioso: Impresiona por lo grande y forma piramidal del edificio pero es una pantalla!!!!
-Otra más, dependes de los mozos para conseguirte la bebida cuando estás en un sistema all inclusive !!!! Una tontería !!!! Y te atendían después de que se lo rogabas por poco!!!!! Horrible!!! Caro y malo!!!!!! Los que dirigen ese hotel deben estudiar hostelería, atención al huésped!!!!!! Obvio NO LO RECOMIENDO!!!!!!
Al irme veo una placa que dice que en el '91 estuvieron los Reyes de España..... Supongo no le habrán brindado la lamentable atención que a nosotros, huéspedes que pagaron por una estadía en un hotel 5 estrellas!!!!

reviews.author: VOYONSDONC
reviews.title: très déçus- n'arrive pas à la hauteur de son prédecesseur
reviews.text:
Il s'agit de mon 10ième voyage dans le Sud où j'ai eu l'occasion de rester dans des hôtels de 3 à 5 étoiles et d'essayer toute une panoplie de forfaits. C'est la seconde fois que je vais à cet hôtel. En 2007 il s'appelait le GRAN MELIA CANCUN et c'était un vrai 5 étoiles. La nourriture y était absolument succulente. Le buffet et les restaurants étaient absolument succulents. Nous n'avions aucun problème à nous trouver des chaises sur la plage/piscine. Quelle grande fut notre déception lorsque nous avons rencontrés les problèmes suivants:
1) pas de bus à l'aeroport ( probleme avec Expedia)
2) se lever tous les matins a 6 h00 pour se reserver une chaise
3) la bouffe au Naos était franchement ordinaire pour pas dire pas terrible: pain blanc au petit dejeuner; omelettes et légumes pas cuits sans parler de la viande ( bouffe a cuba est meilleure...)
4) je devais systématiquement appeler la reception pour que la femme de menage apporte des gants pour le visage (oubli au quotidien....)
5) et le pire: il n'avaient plus de lits doubles mais seulement un grand lit malgré ma requête avec Expedia i.e. ils ont dû rajouter un lit d'enfant en extra pour dormir. Quand ils ont finalement eu une chambre avec deux lits qui s'est libérée, nous avons perdu 3 heures entre défaire les valises, refaire les valises etc..... LAMENTABLE

Je ne vous recommande pas le Paradisus. Je suis d.accord que l'hotel est beau mais la qualite a nettement diminuee et nous nous sommes faits voler.

reviews.author: experience o
reviews.title: Solo regresaria por la playa
reviews.text:
Esperaba más por ser parte de la cadena Meliá. Para empezar al hotel le urge una remodelación o al menos un buen mantenimiento, ya que hay parte de los edificios donde la pintura ya se cayo completamente y esta descarapelado, en las habitaciones las cortinas ya están percudidas y varios muebles están muy maltratados.
La comida en lo personal nos dejo mucho que desear ya que hay muy poca variedad en el buffet y los cortes de carne están muy malos.
El servicio me pareció bien de parte de algunas personas como de la señorita Guadalupe de recepción, pero creo que pueden mejorar aun mas.
Nos ofrecieron tomar una platica para ser socios del hotel y el que era el vendedor, el señor Octavio Pielli, nos termino corriendo al ver que no quisimos comprar, esto entre las otras muchas groserías que hizo, no puedo creer como pueden tener a "vendedores" como el.

reviews.author: Michael U
reviews.title: Unless receiving tips, staff is horrible
reviews.text: If you go to this hotel, just be aware that unless the staff is in a position to receive tips (waitor, bar tender, etc), you will probably receive the worst service ever.  It took us over an hour to check in...there were only about 5 other families there.

reviews.author: Erin W
reviews.title: Great service... If you're tipping...
reviews.text:
My husband and I stayed at this hotel while on a family vacation with his family. We were really excited to stay here as he'd stayed here on a previous stay (before it was the Paradisus). And loved it. It started bad and at the end we could only say that the facilities were nice but the customer service was horrible, except for the pool waiters and others working for tips. They were wonderful and very helpful. 

So, what went wrong? We arrived to the hotel around 7pm, well past what we thought would be the check in rush since check in begins at 3:00. We were greeted at the door and led into the lobby and then left to wait in a line that did not move for 1 hour! During this time the front desk staff had maybe 10-12 family groups waiting. They had 3 people working and the line did not move during that entire time. Thanks to people's kids running around and exploring, we found a cabinet with complimentary beverages, which you would think the greeter would have pointed out, given the line. After 30 minutes we asked a staff member if there were any other people who could be called to assist and got no response. Finally, after an hour the manager showed up and things started moving. We thought maybe it was just us but my in laws, who arrived hours before us, were greeted with a 2 hour check in time. 

I've done a few all inclusive stays but this was the most frustrating when it came to restaurant reservations. They stated they had a 1 day max for advance reservations but we repeatedly showed up at 6am and we're told all the restaurants for the next day were already booked. Turns out, if you're in the Melia club you get priority for reservations. We were so frustrated we ended up going off property to the Marriott next door where we called the day before and got a table for 12 at the Japanese restaurant at a normal time, not 10pm. 

The food at the buffet was good for a buffet. A couple days it was frustrating as the more traditional lunch items weren't an option, e.g. sandwiches, Mexican lunch fare (tacos, tostadas, et al). We found the lunch option the last day, but you had to be seated in its area to order from that menu, even though they were seating buffet eaters on that patio taking up all of the seats. 

Another top notch customer service example was when we booked the golf round at the par 3 course. We talked with the rep in the store who said it would cost $22 US per person, including clubs, balls, and fees. So we set a tee time for 9. When we went the next morning to check in, the fee had magically increased to $33/person! We asked and he said that's what it always cost. When we asked if he had lied to is yesterday we got no response. Then when we got to the golf course we were left to our own devices and pointed toward a tee that wasn't there. 

The poor service added a dark mark to what was otherwise an enjoyable trip, I'll spare you the check out drama, but just revisit the check in, it was equally as horrible.  So if you plan to have no interaction with the hotel staff not working for tips, stay here. Otherwise I'd recommend any other hotel.

reviews.author: Marlene V
reviews.title: Muy mala administracion
reviews.text: Nos toco cambiar de habitacion y la segunda tambien llena de problemas. La primera estava sucia, el piso sin trapear. Goteava del techo y solamente nos hicieron caso cuando empezava gotear arriba de la mesa de noche.la televisio se prendi sola despues de media noche. La segunda habitacion , el lavabo se cayo solo sin nadie en el baño y el dia que llovio, la habitacion quedo inundada. Estuvimos con toallas por el suelo en las dos...al salirmos nos presentaran un adicional  que no teniamos que pagar. Tuvimos mucho stress en el check out.

reviews.author: Kevin B
reviews.title: Should have stayed at moon palace
reviews.text:
Where do I begin?? When we arrived, we were greeted and taken to family concierge. After waiting for almost three hours, we finally had our rooms...the wrong rooms. The first room we were taken to was occupied and when they opened the door, there was a man laying on the bed. The second room was dirty and the third room was not even close to the room we had booked, not to mention that the pyramid shape of the hotel made your room a weird shape and space was hard to come by. 

The room service was so slow that by the time the food got to your room, it was cold. How did they know I like to eat cold eggs for breakfast? They didn't have the best food selection at any of the restaurants, I mean, if you like to eat the same thing for a week straight, this hotel is for you. Variety is obviously not a word that they know.

The staff overall sucked. If you had a question or problem & needed to address it, they would look at you like you were insane. It was a "do it yourself" attitude the staff had. The girls in the kids zone rarely interacted with the kids and when they did it was to yell at the kids. That's just what I want, someone yelling at my kids on their vacation because they want to have fun. If you don't like your job, quit!! Housekeeping was awful!! We left for the beach early one morning, a few hours later we headed back to our room. The beds were made nicely, the room had been picked up, but...there were no fresh towels in the room & after a day at the beach, you need clean dry towels. I will say that the female housekeepers did a better job than the guys!!

I could go on forever as to why you should spend your money elsewhere, but I won't. I will say that Karla in family concierge was a true blessing. She is one amazing lady and that hotel does not deserve her!! Love you Karla! Thank you for everything!!

reviews.author: Dani A
reviews.title: Pelo preço atendimento pessimo e comida e atendimento dos restaurantes a desejar
reviews.text:
, o hotel é bem estruturado, quartos bons e limpos e impressiona a sua dimensão.

Mas seguem alguns pontos que não foram bons:

1-	Chegamos ao hotel e não tinha nosso quarto disponível, precisamos aguardar 1h30 a desocupação e limpeza do mesmo;
2-	Após viagem de 12 horas queria tomar um banho, mais 1 h para a bagagem ser entregue no quarto. Depois de muitas ligações na recepção foram entregues;
3-	Todos os restaurantes do hotel que exigiam reserva (ou seja todos, exceto o internacional), todos sem exceção fomos muito mal atendidos. Ofereciam de cara um cardápio pago, fora do nosso pacote previamente contratado, quando solicitávamos o menu do hotel, falávamos com os garçons e eles continuavam andando de costas ignorando nossa necessidade. Tratados como cachorro mesmo.
4-	Há no hotel um serviço de concierge, diferente do nome, são uns 10 profissionais que te barram diariamente nos corredores do hotel querendo vender proposta de clube. Isto acaba não deixando o hospede a vontade, incomodando a toda hora.
5-	A proposta de venda e pacotes da equipe da nascimento (best day) que conhecemos no transfer muito mais cara do que a da equipe da mesma empresa que fica no hotel.

Somente no restaurante internacional fomos muito bem atendidos. Nos demais uma porcaria, comida de péssima qualidade e tudo muito regulado. Pelo preço achei que deixou a desejar bastante.

reviews.author: JCNavarrete80
reviews.title: No me gusto
reviews.text:
Tenía ciertas expectativas de la marca Paradisus pero en esta instalación creo que no se logró o será que así sean todas?.

En nuestra llegada todo parecía muy bien pues lo primero que me llamo la atención fueron los aromas tanto de la recepción como de ciertas áreas públicas, mismos aromas que me relajaron al hacer cola en dos ocasiones para que me dijeran que mi habitación no estaba lista...tanta espera para que al ver la habitación tan simple y con detalles que delatan la edad/uso del hotel me desilusiono, debo admitir que la ropa de cama era de buena calidad y la cama me pareció cómoda pero el aire acondicionado emitía ruido, el baño tenía tina que además lucía vieja o no te invitaba a usarla, el minibar en la habitación tenía el stock de un hotel promedio y el área de la terraza se veía muy vieja, desgastada y con falta de mantenimiento sin omitir que sólo tenía un sólo camastro cuando deberían ser dos...les mencione que la decoración es muuuuy simple también e incluso uno de los 3 cuadros estaba mal colocado mismo que intente acomodar pero creo que estaba mal colocado el clavo en la tablaroca y mejor ya ni le moví.

El área de albercas estaba aún en trabajos de construcción, así que nos concentramos en el bar, tienen buena selección de bebidas que ofrecen -no la mejor, pero variada y de buena calidad- sin embargo cuando pides o te dicen ya se acabo y ya no tengo más o simple te dicen no hay, que no manejan un standar de bebidas en todos los bares??, que no hacen inventarios para ver que les falta??.

Nos toco ver que un colaborador del hotel tuviera una discusión con un huésped que venía dentro de un grupo de convención de una marca de autos nipones...resulta que el vuelo del huésped (varias personas) salía alrededor de las 7 pm pero habían entregado habitación y seguían en la piscina, recepción no te informa que tu ALL INCLUSIVE se termina a las 12:00 de tu día de salida pero tampoco te quita el brazalete del todo incluido, estas personas pidieron un snack, se los sirvieron y de inmediato les querían cobrar, era lógico que si no te informan un huésped puede reaccionar de diferentes maneras, pero que se pongan a discutir en un área pública frente a más huéspedes...deja mucho que desear, ya con este incidente teníamos antecedente y efectivamente si no preguntas a la hora de hacer check out no te dicen y puedes pasar un rato muy malo.

La parte central del hotel es muy bonita, le corresponde al Restaurant oriental llamado Bana, de inmediato hicimos reserva y llegamos 10 minutos antes de la hora...si mi reserva era a las 18:00 horas, llego a las 17:50, no vemos ningún/a host y preguntamos en el bar del lugar y nos dicen:..."no veo a la host aquí, debe de venir tarde"...si bien vimos que llego todo el personal a las 18:01 ya nuestro trago fue amargo, nos asignaron mesa y ordenamos...no ha sido el mejor sushi de mi vida ni el mejor sashimi además el tiempo de espera del servicio fue demasiado.

En The Market Grill también nos toco algo de desorganización por lo que se podía observar con el personal pero la señorita Dasia en el lunch y Gerardo durante la cena nos atendieron muy bien y de cierta manera su servicio nos hizo pasar una buena comida.

reviews.author: Tractorstant
reviews.title: Baffled by other reviews!
reviews.text: Let's get it right, I am baffled by other reviews, this place is average at utter best. Yes the staff are friendly, when they understand you ( lots of nodding and smiling, not so much compression.) We stayed in Pyramid 3 on the 6th floor, on the first night we asked to be moved. Why? the Nightclub can be heard until 2am, imagine the local station car park full of boy racers, then at 9am the drilling started for the renovation work. Unfortunately they had no other rooms available. The breakfast buffet was nice, which was good because the rest of the food was typical All Inclusive rubbish. Apart from the Royal Service, pool bar which was ok. Coffee machines did not work, neither did the bath, and if you value your clothes was them when you get home, had to skip an Eaton shirt! Oh and the sun goes down at 5.....after that, there's not a lot to do! There must be better?????

reviews.author: Carmen C
reviews.title: DOBLE COBRO....NO HAY RESPUESTA
reviews.text:
Estuve en Paradisus Cancún desde el 9 al 12 de octubre, cuando llegué me sentí ahogada, aún no te registran cuando tienes pegada al lado tuyo una vendedora de tiempo compartido, le dije que no me interesaba hacerme socia, entonces te ofrecen de todo, dije que ya había comprado tour en otro lado, apareció la supervisora, la jefa de todas ellas , la gerente, etc todo el mundo , 
El doble cobro es intencional, claramente, para estos asuntos no hay nadie que responda, tengo 3  correos que  me rebotan, y en mi cuenta tengo 2 veces cobrado mi estadía, son más de 800 dólares los que me cobraron de más.

reviews.author: mrmarkx
reviews.title: More heat then happiness.
reviews.text: Having stayed at other various resorts in Mexico, this place can no way be compared to other 5 star resorts. Rooms that were held together by paint and caulk, lack of air conditioners that properly worked to cool our room, let alone to cool the restaurant's, and a crew of pushy "members only club" sellers, all deemed to work  for a heated time, but not a enjoyable one. The resort had numerous plant boxes and vines for an enchanted view of greenery, yet to grow these, the roofs all have glass panels to let in the sunlight, along with the tremendous heat that comes with it. Thinking the pools will cool you off, well they can a bit until 7pm each night,, since after then the pools are closed for "cleaning and sanitizing", which as a vacationer seemed ridiculous! Even though this resort had over 700 people there the week before, we found that most of the restaurants were closed every other day because this was "slow season". Now the restaurants that we finally did eat in had incredible dishes. I do recommend the food at the restaurants, yet the buffet at lunch time was awful, really awful. As usual in Mexico, the wait(Hector), pool(Rogelo), and bar staff(Karina Reyes) were tremendously courteous, but the room cleaning staff wasn't really up to par, even if it had been for a local run down interstate motel. In the end all I can say is "wont be going back there any time soon, unless its half price and I know the air is on "super high".

reviews.author: J F
reviews.title: Super hôtel mais...
reviews.text: Cela fait 9 ans que nous venons au Mexique en Aout car nous adorons ce pays, cet hôtel est très joli, très propre, la nourriture est de qualité, il y en a pour tous les goûts, les piscines sont très propre également, vous trouverez toujours des transats sur la plage, par contre notre déception s'est portée sur l'animation qui malheureusement est inexistante. En effet c'est la première année que notre fils de 12 ans s'est ennuyé. Il y a bien un planning qui affiche des activités mais les horaires ne sont pas respectés et bien souvent pas d'activités du tout. Mon fils adore le volley ball mais malheureusement il n'a pas pu y jouer souvent car un tournois de volley ball était organisé pour le personnel de l'hôtel à 17h avec boissons et musique et nous clients nous sommes vu être dans l'obligation de quitter le terrain de volley pour les laisser jouer avec les animateurs cela peu paraitre incroyable vu le prix de cet hôtel. D'autre part nous avons souhaiter parler à un directeur mais impossible de le voir, par contre une personne se présentant comme un manager nous a fait attendre 1 heure avant de venir nous voir comme prévu. Vraiment incorrect !!  Il y a beaucoup de couples avec des jeunes enfants (bebe), donc pas mal de pleurs pendant les repas.  Si non c'est un endroit paradisiaque mais il faut savoir que les ados s'ils sont seuls et ne se font pas de copains ils risquent de s'ennuyer. Je dirais que cet hôtel est très bien pour un couple. Salle de sport correcte et propre par contre l'accès au Spa hammam et sauna compris sont payant.

reviews.author: Worldtraveler20005
reviews.title: Doesn't live up to its promises and rating...
reviews.text:
Positive: nice view, proximity to the sea, good food, nice staff
Negative: very poor maintenance, room in bad shape, when it rains, leaks in the dining room and bedroom, today no water pressure until 6 pm, staff trying to sell you activities every time you pick up a towel at the beach...
This is NOT a luxury hotel.  Perhaps average quality at best.

reviews.author: nicolelinsey
reviews.title: Don't upgrade to Royal Service and waste your money!
reviews.text:
Let me start this by saying I have never written a review online before. I feel inclined to share our experience so hopefully other people won't make the same mistake we did. The resort is nice, my husband and I were actually surprised when we walked in that it was nicer than the pictures we saw on tripadvisor. We immediately upgraded to the Royal Service (adults only side) based on what we read here. BIG mistake and huge waste of money. You get a butler but we didn't see him again one time after he brought us to our room the first night. Every time we called him for something we were transferred to someone else. All of the restaurants are in the main tower so you are constantly walking back and forth, which is fine but we were told several things are accessible on the adults only side in the main area but the self serve breakfast for example is horrible. If you are an early riser like we are and you can't drink coffee without cream, good luck getting coffee before 8am. 
It rained almost the entire time we were there, which of course isn't the resorts fault but they should have made up it with the service. Instead there wasn't a bartender to be found. The only helpful person was the cabana/towel boy, Sergio. We loved him! Very nice guy and very helpful but he isn't a waiter or a bartender so there is only so much he can do. We found ourselves on the other side of the resort at the swim up bar where we would have been anyways if we didn't upgrade. So many other complaints that I cant even list them all here. One of the days that it was raining we were coming back in from outside and my husband slipped on the stairs outside. Why you would have wooden stairs painted with a high gloss paint is beyond me. The first drop of rain and they are a huge accident waiting to happen! Trust me, we found out first hand. The manager took us to the nurses station but made him walk there.. WHY?! He is now missing 2 days of work and going to the doctor today... I just hope nothing is broken. I complained to the royal service manager about everything and he reimbursed us some of our upgrade but not enough. I regret that we spent the money to upgrade, period. All in all a huge disappointment for our 4 day getaway. 
** Side note** Don't go to Coco Bongo. Another $150 wasted. The drinks are terrible and if a fire broke out in that place everyone would die! They pack you in like sardines.

reviews.author: tania m
reviews.title: era mejor cuando era melia.
reviews.text:
la verdad la 1a vez que fuimos fue exclente cuando era gran melia..
en este 2013 ya se llama paradisus cancun y fue muy desagradable todo.
--llegamos del aeropuerto y nos tuvieron esperando 4hrs porque el hotel no registro nuestros nombres y aunque llevamos el comprobante del pago ,no se nos ofrecio nada..... y según era todo incluido...
la habitación q nos dieron fue en la pirámide principal y fue otra hora mas de espera, pues el botones no pudo abrir la puerta , debido a una falla en la chapa y por si fuera poco ,,,,nos dijeron q si queríamos consumir algo tendría costo extra.
fue un total abuso pues las vacaciones se habían pagado 2 meses antes. y aun con comprobante el trato fue déspota y fuimos 8 personas viajando en familia y con niños..
no se nos comento q habían actividades para los huéspedes
la calidad de la comida bajo mucho diario era el mismo menú cuando era gran melia tenia otras cosas.
las albercas sucias..
llegaron personas a decirnos q el chapoteadero era solo para los q compraban membresía...q abuso...
muy desilucionados al comentar a un gerente y nos dijo q no se podía hacer absolutamente nada. y q podríamos buscar otro hotel..
muy caro servicio pésimo..

reviews.author: rapte
reviews.title: TERRIBLE SERVICE!!!
reviews.text: It's a very good hotel (great instalations). The bad part is the staff. Constantly all over us trying to sell us every single thing ( time sharing properties...). I had to talk to the General Manager begging him to tell the staff to stop. It was so annoying. they were like flies over us. It was too much.

reviews.author: Chris W
reviews.title: Not a great experience
reviews.text:
Came to Cancun for a large conference and party. We had booked the week leading up to the event at Secrets the Vines, which was simply spectacular, and then moved to the Paradisus for the event. So maybe my relative expectations were skewed, but oh what a return to reality!

The hotel lobby is its most impressive feature, with vines hanging down from the atrium ceiling down to the lobby level. Good wow factor!

When we arrived there was no one greeting guests, and when we approached the reception to ask about check in she looked blankly at us and a little flustered. Fortunately we saw some staff from the tour company who were managing the logistics for our event and they got us checked in.

Once we had our room keys we had to find the room - it's a fairly big hotel with 4 "pyramids" so we asked one of the hotel staff for directions. He grabbed my room key from me and led the way - great, I thought! Unfortunately he didn't know the way himself and we walked to every tower and what felt like every floor before we stumbled on our room.

The rooms themselves are fine. We just had the standard room and its normal hotel room size and reasonably well appointed. Our balcony planter box was just a tangle of weeds. Think we must have had the forgotten room, as other balconies seemed to have some actual plants! The air con in the room switches on and off quite noisily with the thermostat every couple of minutes, loudly enough to wake you if you are just drifting off, and it also had a strange electricity "zapping" sound coming from it, worryingly.

After settling in we went to find some lunch. We weren't on the all inclusive deal for this event, so couldn't have food from the pool grill, didn't seem to be much else apart from buffet and the market grill. Tried the market grill, had a very strange, flustered and annoyed waiter who brought us what can only be described as microwave food. Just terrible.

On the second day I came back from the conference to find everything in one half of my suitcase soaking wet with a sort of chemical smell. Seems that housekeeping had spilled some cleaning products and had chosen to ignore it. Took some negotiation with the hotel but the eventually they agreed to clean my clothes, which they did.

The only other little niggle is that in a place where they recommend you don't drink the tap water, they charge US$5.00 for s bottle of water in your room. Come on!!

I guess we had just come from an amazing hotel so we had high relative expectations, but given the above experiences I can't offer more than 2 stars.

reviews.author: wcalo13
reviews.title: solo para este hotel eres un simbolo de $$$$$$
reviews.text: Hola, solo no quisiera que te pasara lo mismo que ami y ami familia. Me quede en este hotel para la semana del 22 del mes de junio 2013,lei muchas de sua opiniones pero se quedaron cortos,primero cuando llegas te reciben estos empleados vestidos de blanco,,wao yo habia pensado que servicio una persona para ti,disque para explicarte lo que incluya tu plan aja,resulta que este empleado cobra comision por darte la bienvenida llevarte a un cuarto encerrado que dice ser el check in que no puedes estar ahi ni 5 minutos por la apeste  a ??? no se ni que es,ya que olor no es..luego esta vestida de blanco trata de comprometerte a una cita del club melia,,,grrr la cual tienes que pagar 20 dolatres para hacerla,,en este caso me toco Graciela,,por cierto muy amable y luego que consiguio su cita jamas me saludo y mucho    menos me dirigio la palabra,cuidado con la cita te dicen que sin ningun compromiso,que solo una hora y termine perdiendo mi tiempo de 3 horas, y luego por lo menos el que nos toco Gerardo un patan malcriado y molesto por que no quisimos pagar claro pero quien quiere pagar al menos 500 dolares todos los meses para irte de vacaciones ,,bueno eso se los dejo a su criterio en otras palabras es un tiempo compartido.ellos tienen 2 paquetes en su hotel,primero :royal service:,que pagas mas por tener una almohada con olor,una picina aparte claro no aceptan ninos,,es la unica diferencia,te ofrecen otras cosas pero nuncas las clumples y lo se por los comentarios de otros que estaba ahi,,tienen otro paquete que se llama  :family concierge: este es otra mentira yo lo pedi y luego me dijero son 100 dolares extra por noche ,no tenemos un telefono que te ofrecen, un playstation para la habitacion mentira solo esta en un salon de juegos ,lo unico cierto es que entretienen los ninos un ratito,ya que es hasta las 6. pm luego todods uyos,,jajaj que mal.al final no hay nada privado toda la picina es para todos incluye el club melia y family al igual que la playa ..Bueno te ofrecen 14 restaurantes bla,bla,,te explico Naos es para todos ya que es el unico buffet,desayuno ,almuerzo y cena ahi tienen a Dulce muy buena ,ademas del gerentecreo es francisco trabajan mas que mas nadie ahi y siempre sonriendo,,los felicitos.por cierto todos los dias es lo MISMO,segundoLa Palapa solo para Royal Service,luego Mole y Tacos,,solo para adultos,Bana para adultos ya que los ninos no comen Suhi,Tempo solo adulto y tienes que pagar,Red Lounge solo adultos es de bebida,Fuego estaba cerrado,Vento ahh y por cierto nos cambiaron la reservacion por que error de ellos y asi se quedo so ojo con su reservacion,,Market Grill el mucho mejor alli me atendieron Jeremias,Jose y Israel muy amables,luego Blue Agave para todos y es exelente alli me atendio Leonardo y es unico ahi me comi una super langosta ,,claro tuve que pagarla 50. dolares todo es dinero en este hotel..Otra cosa muy importante para recalcar y para los ninos la picina es muy profunda,una picina grande y las personas solo en la esquina y los ninos en un area que es de bebes y al final del hotel escondido,y ademas no tienen salvavidas ni en la picina ni en la playa, no hay donde sentarse las sillas son limitadas y las casetas que ves son pagadas 50 dolares al dia, si tuvieran mas empleados en la picina e servicio fuera mejor. En otros comentarios vi cucarachas pues muy cierto hay miles a mi tambien me toco matarlas y llamar al gerente,y este dice que es normal por la area de vegetacion ,,y cual si alli no hay ninguna..vegetacion,,en general a este hotel le falta mucho calor ,para con sus huespedes y no enfocarse en el dichoso club melia que lo que hace es molestarte.....Otra cosa tengan cuidado con las excursiones ,,las haces en el hotel pero ellos no se hacen responsables para cualquier error,por ejemplo fijensen en el ticket que lo que pago esta ahi ,,aun asi tuve problemas para las entradas y el hotel no se hace responsables ,,ademas de que pagas transportacion de ida y vuelta,,en la manana te recojen en la puerta y en la tarde te dejan en la avenida dis que por que la guagua es muy grande.Los cuartos estan deteriorados,pero si cojes vista al mar es lo unico bueno.y para senar con broche de oro nostoco hacer el check out y quedarnos esperando en el hotel por 3 horas mas y para nuestra sorpresa te quitan inmediatamente la manilla del allincluse y no puedes ni tomar agua en lo que esperas wao me he quedado en otroa Melia PR y hasta en Cuba y esto no me habia ocurrido,que mal. En ese momento de 3 horas de espera Me dio coraje ver como fuimos ignorados por todos ya que su mision de buena gente termino en el momento en que consiguieron tu cita para El Club Melia   y ati Graciela que me ignoraste en todo momento mas el ultimo dia que me pasate por el frente una una y otra vez mientras yo esperaba para irme,,ten un poco mas de conciencia  y recuerda que quien paga tu sueldo somos nosotros los turistas...En conclusion no me vuelvo aquedar en este hotel,penas por uno ,dos o tres empleado que si valen la pena,,y no los volvere aver..

reviews.author: HOMERUNSAREGREAT
reviews.title: Will never go back!!!
reviews.text:
OK, here it goes. I have read other reviews about this hotel and mine will be going in the other direction. It took us about 10 hours to get to this hotel. This is not reason for the bad review because it takes that long for most hotels we go to. It is what happened at the 10 hour mark that makes this hotel a two thumbs down. We arrived after the 10 hours of travel and this is true. So when we entered the hotel does anyone greet us with a cold towel or a nice refreshing drink? NO!!! So we check in and get our room number. And at this point we just want to chow down on some food and get a swim in. All of a sudden this woman appears with a folder. She is telling us she will show us where the restaurants are. To be honest we did know what she was up to. For anyone who is going to this hotel beware of these vampires that just want to suck another 2 hours from your vacation by selling you things under the guise of helping you. THEY DO NOT WANT TO HELP YOU. They are trying to sell you time shares or whatever. They say they will give you these bonus coupons, but you will have to sit through some presentation. Be warn, they where what looks like karate outfits with a blue/purple sash around their waste. When you see them with their fangs out run and do not stop. When we told her we do not need to know where the restaurants are we just want to go to our room she then said she will show us where it is. I asked about our luggage and she said it is on the way up. We finally put a stake into her heart and told her we do not need to get help to go to the room. Well at that point she shrivelled away. We got to our room and of course there was no luggage, and in fact we had to call to get our luggage up. The She Devil lied about the luggage. So please do not even look into the eyes of these vampires. Look, I know I am coming on strong here but just think about it, after all that travel this is the last thing you want to happen to you. It left a very bad tast in our mouths. 

Ok some good points. Room service was excellent. Our room safe was broken, no water in the mini bar and we needed another chair for the balcony. All came very fast. And whenever we ordered food room service that came fast as well. And the rooms were made up everyday. So this is a good thing. The help for the most part was helpful.

Now to the food. We went to the buffet and when you enter you at times have to open the door. I am not being a snob here, but most places there is always someone there to open the door and welcome  you. And then when we entered there was nobody there to even show you to the table. So you find your own way and when you get to the table you have to flag someone down if you need a drink or a setting for the table. Sorry folks this is no way to run a restaurant. And the food was terriblel. A lot of heavy sauces. My wife likes her steam veggies but that was in sauce as well. So there is a group of women who usually hang around the front that really do nothing at all but to stand there and do nothing at all. I called one over and I explained my wife would just like a plate of steam veggies plain. She looked at me, walked away and never came back. And the veggies, please, I am still waiting for them and we have been back home for 4 days. And when it comes to breakfast I am so darn easy to please. Give me my scrambled eggs with bacon and saussage. Well the scrambles eggs were either in green sauce or red sauce. And they had bacon ever other day and they place it where it was very hard to reach. Trust me, the food was terrible. For lunch we asked for pizza and what we got was the worst pizza I ever ate, or actually looked at because eating it was a no no. I could go on and on about the food, but I feel my stomach getting ill just thinking about this. 

The room was nice, but try to figure out how to turn the lights on and off. And the same goes for the shower, figuring out how to use it. And they do not have shower doors but a curtain. And to get into the shower you had to climb over the high ledge of the tub. Very high. Not easy with a bum knee.

The beach and pool was very clean and truly wonderful. But if you are not in a upgrade you can't be sitting around the pool since there aren't any umbrellas. There is protection if you upgrade othewise you are at the merch of that Mexican sun. We went to the beach where they do have protection from he sun at these hut like umbrellas. But you better get there early and mark your spot or you will be out of luck. One good thing is they give you as many towels as you need and you do not have to sign in and out. So this was a plus.

If you want any entertainment at night do not go to this hotel. At about 8 or so they have this bar called the Avenue Bar and they play this music that would be good if you plan to commit suicide to it. My Lord, I am so thankful my hearing is bad so the music only bothered me a lot insead of tremendously. And at 10 at night a "disco" opens. It is called the Red something or something. Very small and only Latin music is played there. There is just no entertainment there. 

My wife got sick at the hotel, from either bad drink or bad food. We are never going back there again.

O, on the beach the vendors are not to bad but one guy who was selling cigars was selling pot as well. Yep, that is something you want to buy with all the bad press Mexico is getting. 

We have been to other resorts in Mexico but it would not be fair to mention them here. 

I know there are other things I am forgetting, sorry. Again the staff for the most part was good, but not in the restaurants.

reviews.author: Sergio M
reviews.title: Ruim
reviews.text:
Estamos hospedados no paradisus cancun e nossa avaliação não ė nada boa. Funcionários atrapalhados, restaurantes com o atendimento to dos garçons péssimo nem um pouco atenciosos. Estamos em dois quartos de frente para o mar que ė a única coisa que vale pois o ar condicionado não gela direito. O elevador da Torre que estamos não funciona, tem dois e só um funciona por pouco tempo, nao aparece um funcionário para informar que o elevador esta fora de serviço ou colocar pelo menos uma placa. Somos obrigados a subir de escada ou no elevador de serviço. O atendimento na área da praia e da piscina tb e muito fraco. Sem contar que o hotel nao oferece nenhuma estrutura para criança até piscina ė só para adultos.
Li vários comentários falando maravilhas mas eu sinceramente só posso ter pego uma semana onde os funcionários estão numa fase ruim.  Ainda tenho 2 dias por aqui, espero poder mudar minha opinião mas até agora estou decepcionado e frustrado com esse hotel.

reviews.author: MarisaMedina19
reviews.title: No volvería.
reviews.text: Cuando solicitamos recomendaciones de alojamiento en Cancún, varios fueron los hoteles recomendados. Tomamos la opción de Gran Meliá Cancún en junio de 2012 por algunas referencias de amigos. En el mes de noviembre 2012, cambió de Gran Meliá a Paradisus, con un concepto de mayor "exclusividad". Reservamos y pagamos el Servicio de Red Level, sólo con desayunos incluidos; y creo que haber optado por tan "exclusivo servicio" fue la peor opción. La infraestructura de este hotel es de 05 pirámides. Cuando entras al lobby principal debes caminar tres pirámides para llegar a esta ala; así que si vas con personas de tercera edad, es terrible porque se hace infinito llegar. Tienes unas tarjetas de acceso, así que si llevaras acompañantes, no pueden ingresar. Cuando llegamos nos ofrecieron una habitación que no era la que habíamos pagado, porque no había disponibilidad, así que tuvimos que optar por otra, donde yo (que era la tercera persona) tuve que dormir en un sofá cama en vez de una cama matrimonial como había acordado. Nos habían asignado un "mayordomo" para cualquier eventualidad o solicitud que tuviéramos y muy poca fue su ayuda, únicamente el primer día de llegada y jamás supimos de él el resto de la estadía. La atención de la alta gerencia fue muy mala, por el contrario las personas de atención en el área de piscina, bar y restaurant fue maravillosa. Parte de nuestra familia se hospedó en el hotel aledaño (Casa Magna Marriot) y jamás les fue permitido el ingreso al hotel, NI SIQUIERA porque tuvieramos reservación en el Restaurant de comida Japonesa del Hotel, nos sentimos maltratados, jamás recomendaría este hotel, únicamente por el trato, porque sin duda es un hotel hermoso y con buenas instalaciones. Cero expectativas cubiertas para el alto precio que pagamos por noche: USD 350 p/n.

reviews.author: LKM1979
reviews.title: Not What It Seems
reviews.text:
I haven’t written a Trip Advisor review in quite a while, but I feel compelled to do so after staying at this resort and reading the other reviews. My husband and I stayed at the Paradisus from March 9 to 16, all-inclusive, non-Royal Service. While this resort is beautiful, I think if you carefully read the responses from the management at Paradisus to other reviewers’ comments on this site, you’ll glean all you need to know about this resort – if something is wrong, it is either a “misinterpretation” by the guest, or an “exception” that guest experienced. In summary, it’s the guest’s fault. 

The staff at Paradisus is unorganized and they simply do not care. I’m a firm believer in you get what you give – we always tip staff and make a point to be courteous to everyone, speaking Spanish when we can, etc. But, at the Paradisus, the majority of the treatment we received was condescending and bordered on disdain. Perhaps if we were Royal Service guests or with the convention we would have been treated with more respect? 

In terms of the restaurants, the buffet food was great. However, getting seated was always a hassle due to lack of tables and unorganized staff. The Market Grill, Vento and Fuego are basically connected to the buffet, so I’m not sure how those are really considered separate restaurants. There may be separate menus, but they all run together. Vento is not outside, as is described on Paradisus’ website, and it is frequently used as run-over buffet seating. 

Room service was limited, but tasty and efficient. We ate at Blue Agave (tacos) and had an average experience. Mole, next door, repurposes the food from Blue Agave. For example, chicken mole enchiladas were the chicken tacos (not kidding) from Blue Agave covered in a cold mole sauce. And, the conchinita pibil seemed remarkably similar to the carnitas we had the night before at Blue Agave. La Perla was closed to guests, except for convention parties. The bad food, coupled with the often rude service, lead us to eat at some of the great restaurants near this resort (several are within walking distance or a quick ride on the great bus system in the hotel zone). 

The gym is sub-par and seemed as though it was an afterthought. It’s in the basement with no windows, thumping club music and not enough machines. Good thing it only rained one day so we could go outside. 

Also, just a warning – if you have trouble climbing stairs you may want to consider another resort. There are several stairs up the front of the resort (to take the bus, etc.) as well as to access to pool and beach areas.

I will say that the beach and pool areas are beautiful at this resort. However, I will be staying at another resort, with another beautiful beach and pool area, next time I’m in Cancun.

reviews.author: OJR
reviews.title: Decent grounds... Horrible customer service... Suited for Collegiate Spring Breakers, Not Seasoned World Travelers
reviews.text:
We stayed at Paradisus Cancún in February to celebrate the birthday of a friend. Our party consisted of 20 to friends from different parts of the US who all flew in to Mexico for this weekend celebration.

I generally don’t like to write unfavorable reviews about an establishment; I only do so when the experience is so horrible that I would not recommend it for a friend. Unfortunately, this is one of those instances. You may read the details below if you wish, but here’s the executive summary:

1. Check-in took 5 hours.
2. The resort’s “all-inclusive” doesn’t include room service sans pizza, quesadilla, and hamburgers. None of the other 50 items are available.
3. We were given “complimentary” upgrades that we never requested because the resort kept making it customer service mistakes. Once we checked out, we were asked to pay for a room type we never received because the resort gave us perks.
4. We were publicly asked in front of other guests to leave a restaurant in the elite “Royal Service” dining lounge in Tower 5 (where we were staying), because an uninformed server had her facts incorrect and had no training in customer experience.
5.  We were asked to leave one of the lobby bars because we were dressed inappropriately in shorts and tank tops at 2:00pm in the afternoon at beach resort, though we saw other guests in the same bar wearing two-piece bikinis and mesh cover-ups/sarongs while other guests were roaming the lobby shirtless, shoeless, and dripping wet from the pool or ocean.
6. When we asked to speak to the General Manager, the Front Desk personnel BLATANTLY LIED, and gave us the # to an Accounting Manager that they were attempting to pass off as the GM.

CHECK-IN: 
In a nutshell, it took us nearly 5 hours to be checked into our room. Two months in advance, we booked a Deluxe Ocean View King. When we arrived at 2:00 on a Friday, we signed our intake forms, gave them our credit card, and did the normal check-in activities. We were then told by the front desk to “come back in an hour, and we might have a room available.” We returned at 3:00 only to be handed the keys to a Deluxe Ocean View Double Bed Room. Of course, this is not what we requested, so the front desk told us to check back in another 90 minutes. 

Around 4:30, we returned to the front desk. We were given a “wonderful, ocean view room on the 6th floor in Tower One with a Jacuzzi on the terrace.”  BEWARE IF THEY OFFER YOU THIS ROOM. Once we walked in, we immediately turned and walked back out. It is an extremely dated room that looks like it was last redecorated circa “Golden Girls” Season 3. It had none of the appeal of the new rooms, and the jacuzzi was less than inviting. I returned to the front desk, and we were told to check back around 6:00 for another room. At this point, it had been 4 hours, and we still had not been given accommodations.

ROOM SERVICE: 
Finally, around 6:00, we were given a Deluxe Ocean View King on the 5th Floor in the main tower, Tower 3. It was exactly what we were looking for. We settled in and decided to order room service before meeting our friends for dinner. We wanted salads, but were told that salads were not included with the all-inclusive package. Livid, I returned to the front desk. I was told the wrong room service menu was placed in my room, but for my inconvenience, I could order anything I wanted at no cost. (I thought this was the entire point of all-inclusive.)

Minutes later, recognizing that I was nonplussed and completely displeased, the front desk manager offered to move us a one-bedroom suite in the “Royal Service” tower for no additional charge as our first day had been a horrendous affair thus far. This tower has additional amenities and limited access to only guests of this Tower. At the time, only Lagoon View rooms were available, but the following day, we would be free to move to an Ocean View room to have the view that we initially requested.

GROUND-FLOOR “OCEAN” VIEW: 
The following day, we were offered a one-bedroom suite with an ocean-facing view. But, given that the “terrace” was actually below ground, the only thing one could see was grass.
