This in no way parallels an actual ocean-view from a higher floor. We refused the room and decided to stay in our suite facing the Lagoon on the entrance side of the property. 

But, because the resort proactively recognized that, once again, they had messed up, we were given a “complimentary” couples massage.

CHECK-OUT
Upon checkout, I looked at the bill and asked that our charges be reduced to reflect that we had a Lagoon View and not an Ocean View. The Front Desk Manager argued with me about the fact that my suite did not have an Ocean View. He literally had to send someone down to check.

Well, in the end, the resort refused to lower the charges, citing “we were given a complimentary upgrade to Royal Service, and we were also given complimentary massages.” Come again? We never requested those services.

So, we were taken away from the view and room that we requested to be placed into a room and view that we never requested with the unfulfilled promise that we would have an Ocean View, but we should still pay because we were offered amenities that we actually never requested. Not a good way to do business.

GENERAL MANAGER FIASCO:
As world travelers who have stayed in some of the best hotels across the globe, we are accustomed to the occasional hiccup in customer experience. We always speak directly to a General Manager in these cases, and we are promptly given the service and attention we should have received from the start. We asked to speak to the GM for two days straight to no avail. Upon check-out, we asked THREE times, but the Front Desk refused. Finally, they acquiesced and gave us a phone name and number. Because I knew the GM’s name, I knew that the information they had given me was fake.

We asked them to confirm that this person was indeed the GM repeatedly. Finally, after the 4th or 5th ask, the Front Desk Manager admitted that the person was actually on the Accounting Manager. Flabbergasted at the blatant disrespect and lies, we left the resort having endured the worst weekend getaway we’ve ever experienced.

reviews.author: babycakes_13
reviews.title: Not a 5 star! More like a 3
reviews.text:
First I will say the resort is beautiful, however the rooms are completely outdated. The bathtub is gross, almost looks like it was not cleaned. The drapes in our room were full of mold! And we asked for a king size bed but had no choice but to take two double beds. We were told we would be charged extra for a king bed, after we already spent close to $5,000 to stay here. 
Our rooms were not cleaned until 4-5pm, which I think is unreal, and I have traveled a lot and have never experienced this. 
The service on the beach and pool area was great and the staff was always so pleasant. We only ate at one restaurant because our waiters Antonito and Luis were awesome. Whatever we wanted to eat, weather it was on the menu or not, they provided. They truly made our vacation. 

I will return to Cancun, but will NOT return to Paradisus.

reviews.author: roben l
reviews.title: Big, clean but poor service and food
reviews.text:
Stayed 2 weeks from jan. 23-feb. 6 and after day 3 I went to Walmart to buy king size pillows. They refused to give more than 1 towel at the pool.Mini-bar staff forgot to replace the coffee almost every day- bad training. Internet is almost too slow to send a picture attached to an email. The buffet is the same warm food every night, the specialty restaurants except for Vento were not good- seems like the same kitchen cooks all the food.We ordered steaks on 4 occasions and although they asked us how we would like it cooked it always came out well done- which i can deal with and its probably safer too.The wine offering would make you cringe if you really were at a 4 star hotel. For the most part the staff are friendly but very poorly trained.The problem is the management, they were also very hard to reach. i would not recommend this place to anyone, unless you get an awesome rate and don't mind a 650 room 3 star hotel. i will say that it is very clean and the spa is great.
Its a shame because we've stayed at their property in Cuba and it is really a 4.5 - 5 star property.

reviews.author: Gloria Fernanda G
reviews.title: Descartalo para viajes familiares
reviews.text:
Lindo Hotel, mala atención. Los garzones se enojan cuando pides una mesa para un grupo de 6 personas, no sirven con gusto.
La comida maaal.
No te ayudan con las maletas.
 Por suerte nos fuimos a terminar las vacaciones a Iberostar

reviews.author: louise c
reviews.title: Never Again!
reviews.text: Don't waste your money,one of the worst hotels I've stayed in.  This hotel is not about customer service, It's about selling tours and buying Time share.Took over 3 hrs. to check in,food at buffet is based on how many people are in the hotel. We were told there would be shows everynight but only 1 show in 1 wk. There was an employee in our room while we were sleeping. Only bar open during the day was outside at the pool.Our travel agent told us the travel agency bought into My Time therefore we were entitled to certain anemities,we went to our travel representative and they knew nothing about it and told us no. I found the staff to be cold and indifferent.  The do not have a clue and the hotel travel representative should know what is going on for his guests that he is suppose to be representing.

reviews.author: araujorogerio
reviews.title: Hotel impróprio tanto para adolescentes quanto crianças .
reviews.text: Arquitetura muito bonita, grandes espaços, porém sub utilizado. Os funcionários não explicam quase nada sobre o hotel , tentam a qualquer custo vender o pacote do clube Melia. A comida não tem variedade alguma, as bebidas do all inclusive sao de péssima qualidade, a começar pelos vinhos apresentados. Enfim não indicaria este hotel , que apesar de muito bonito, pouco tem a oferecer pelo custo tão alto .

reviews.author: Flagarcia
reviews.title: Uma pena!!!!
reviews.text: Um hotel maravilhoso, dependências maravilhosas, vista para o mar indescritível, praia deliciosa, mas é só, uma pena, estive na virada do ano neste hotel, o mesmo passou por uma reforma e trocou de bandeira, de gran melia para paradisus, ambas da rede melia, s'o que a paradisus é a bandeira all inclusive da rede, antes como gran melia nao era e para nao queimarem a marca e como em cancun o que manda é o all inclusive, trocaram. O fato é que nao estao preparados para esta nova modalidade, até manteiga faltou no café da manha, o serviço de alimentação no quarto é péssimo, os restaurantes sao fracos e vc só é atendido um pouco melhor, se der propina, prepare 100pesos para tudo q for fazer no hotel, no bar da piscina, com exceção do Francisco, que se esforça muito, os outros sao mal humorados, ah, a academia é boa, mas pq tem ótimos aparelhos e ninguém lá para vc ter q dar propina!!!, enfim é uma pena, só visual, vou me abster de comentar o jantar da virada do ano pois quero esquecer este pesadelo.

reviews.author: Patricia A
reviews.title: Muito Ruim parado
reviews.text:
O hotel que quando se chega parece lindo, tem uma infra enorme,não oferece tudo que divulga...não tem recreação para crianças,tudo se pede propina,se você não as da não é bem atendido, e ainda paguei cerca de 8 dólares por uma toalha que eles relataram que estava muito suja!!! 
A comida no Naos é horrível, e nos restaurantes El Fuego,Vento e japonês a comida tb é ruim!!!
Não recomendo!!!

reviews.author: osbaldoc
reviews.title: pesima recepcion y trato del  personal para "socios"
reviews.text: Realmente este resort  ofrece un pesimo servicio a los socios de rci, y al parecer discriminatorio ya que segun me dijeron que tanto las habitaciones como servicio para socios del gran melia, (ahora paradisus) eran mejores, que si queria un mejor servicio me tenia que hacer socio???. mi experiencia fue terrible me recibieron de mala manera tenia reservada una habitacion para 6 con privacidad para 4, y me querian alojar en un estudio, finalmente mande al resto de mi familia a otro hotel, y solo nos alojamos 3, la recepcionista del area de socios de nombre Blanca  poco amable me dijo que esa era la habitacion que me correspondia,  no acepte y finalmente me dio una suite de dos camas matrimoniales y un sofa cama en la sala.  ademas que la torre 2 donde me alojaron no cuenta con elevador, esta por instalarse, y habia que subir por escaleras, o por el elevador de la torre 3 y caminar hasta la torre 2,  y otra situacion un miembro de la familia  tiene falla renal y por ende una dieta restrictiva en proteinas por lo que buscamos habitaciones con cocina completa o parcial, este resort tiene solo horno de microhondas, tostador, y no tenia  parrilla ni licuadora, siendo un mecanismo de presion de manera velada para que consumamos en sus restaurantes. pesimo no??? yo no lo recomiendo para los socios, quien sabe como sera por  hoteleria. y deberian quitar que tiene cocina limitada, porque realmente esta muy limitada y no hay donde cocinar.

reviews.author: GARNER_12
reviews.title: very disappointing
reviews.text:
Have been in this hotel for 2 nights now and am very disappointed. Im here with my wife and 2 children and have booked the family concierge package with a luxury junior suite with a lagoon view !!! The room is in building 1 which is some sort of time share complex with a view that overlooks the car park: The children are sleeping on a fold out sofa which is very uncomfortable; some luxury suite !have asked to move and been told it will take a few days: 
  Prior to booking holiday we were told we could get priority when booking restaurants because of family concierge package but have been told today that not the case and tonight only booking we could get was in the buffet for 9 oclock. When i said that is late for children to eat i was told i should have booked earlier this was at 11:30 am ? Hoping this holiday improves !

reviews.author: FamilyTravelerCV
reviews.title: Truly Disastrous Start at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
My wife and two kids arrived the evening of Dec 28th 2012 and embarked on a brutally painful path that has left me shaken, and writing this review at 3:45 am. A few minutes ago -- well after midnight -- I was woken by employees ignoring the "do not disturb" sign on our room, using the master key, and barging in. My wife awoke with a small panic and a scream and the Paradisus employees scuttled out, disappearing before I could engage them. 
ARRIVAL: We arrived earlier this evening and were greeted by friendly staff who - over the course of a nearly 90-minute check-in process (checking how angry we would get?) - informed us the ocean view room with two queen beds we had reserved months ago was not available. We were instead brought to a tired-looking timeshare unit with a king bed in "building 1" overlooking the parking lot and traffic. We were then brought to a two-room combo in "building 2" with a view of "building 1". We were provided with little introduction to services available and no materials to review. Our new keys were never delivered. The door between the rooms remained locked despite requests to open it. Later, an employee attempted to open the adjoining door with a butter knife with no luck.
THE ROOMS: OK but not great. The walls are barren - appears as if they're unfinished. Our room's refrigerator door is broken (difficult to shut) which before our arrival resulted in a large puddle streaming out of the fridge on to the floor. The sink doesn't drain. The kids' room has a digital clock, but ours doesn't. The kids' room shower is broken. Overall, I get the feeling these rooms were not meant to be inhabited tonight.
DINNER: We sought reservations for any restaurant besides the buffet at the NAOS cafe - however none were available upon check-in. Later that evening we pleaded the hostess for a table at the MARKET GRILL and received a table in the largely empty restaurant. The food was moderate and the servers were very nice.
OVERALL: We are unhappy and concerned that this is the beginning of a really bad stay at the Cancun Paradisus. Neither my wife nor I can sleep. I just read the post regarding a family getting robbed and I am actually fearful we may suffer the same fate. We have reservations for the spa tomorrow (a concession from the staff) but I am fearful of leaving our things or separating from our kids at all. We will probably skip that, try to get a refund, and go somewhere else.
